【原文 English Original】
Composite Energy Technologies (CET) Hadalus-XL at the 401 Tech Bridge, BlueTIDE event in 2025. CET photo

SAN DIEGO, Calif. — At first glance, the Hadalus-XL unmanned underwater vehicle and its dark flat panels might not catch the curious eye like a go-fast boat or sleek fighter jet.

But its value is in what it does, said Ben Rosenthal, chief technology officer with Composite Energy Technologies, a Rhode Island-based company. The 34-foot underwater vehicle can haul several tons of cargo. Its panels and components fold flat for transport in a 20-foot container, packaged for quick assembly or disassembly with simple tools.

“We’re kind of a pickup truck of the ocean. We can bring big, heavy things into position,” Rosenthal told USNI News on Wednesday while standing next to the extra-large, UUV variant parked on a submarine pier at Naval Base Point Loma. “It’s much bigger and much heavier than any other vehicle that’s out there.”

Hadalus-XL might not be the sexiest tech, but the utility of such an autonomous vehicle is meant to be clear to maritime commanders needing to resupply forces, track an enemy submarine, counter-attack or call for fire support.

“What wins wars is logistics,” Rosenthal said.

Logistics is among the growing threats U.S. military officials are focused on through the trilateral AUKUS security agreement between Australia, the United Kingdom and the United States. The proliferation of cheap, high-tech systems like small aerial drones and attack vessels threaten forces from the Black Sea and the Persian Gulf to the North Atlantic. Resupplying units and supporting troops elsewhere are also vulnerable.

While the trilateral agreement initially focused on nuclear-powered submarines and the industrial base, military officials in AUKUS Pillar II have expanded the focus to new and emerging robotics and autonomous technologies for undersea warfare.

Hadalus and several other UUVs developed by private industry participated in the[AUKUS Pillar II “Maritime Big Play-Pacific”](https://www.cpf.navy.mil/Newsroom/News/Article/4621543/us-navy-aukus-partners-launch-landmark-maritime-big-play-pacific-demonstration/)demonstration on Wednesday in Southern California. Hadalus spent five days at sea for the event, which included more than 40 industry and government maritime multi-domain systems.

The demonstration and live-fire operational vignettes focused on strike operations, contested resupply and undersea warfare, according to the U.S. Navy. San Diego-based Naval Information Warfare Center Pacific, U.S. Pacific Fleet and the Marine Corps hosted the event, held in San Diego, at San Clemente Island and Camp Pendleton Marine Corps Base.

Collaboration among industry and governments from all three countries is central to AUKUS to develop and field emerging technologies, officials said Wednesday during a media roundtable.

“The objective is straightforward. Identify areas where working together delivers an operational advantage that no one nation could achieve as efficiently on its own,” said Michael Dodd, assistant secretary for critical technologies in the Office of the Undersecretary for Research and Engineering at the Pentagon.

Through Maritime Big Play events, the Pentagon is bringing operators, technical experts and industry together earlier in the process, said Dodd, whose office sponsored the MBP-Pacific event.

“That ensures operational relevance and interoperability are built in from the outset of these sprints, not added after a system’s already been developed,” said Dodd. “The work is practical. It’s about evaluating systems under demanding conditions, improving interoperability in real time and identifying force multipliers that can strengthen the combined force.”

## **AUKUS is Making ‘Real Progress’**

A U.S. Mk 48 Heavyweight Torpedo is loaded onto the Royal Navy’s experimental XLUUV XV Excalibur on Sept. 13, 2026. U.S. Navy image

[This year’s priorities under Pillar II](https://www.defence.gov.au/news-events/news/2026-06-02/aukus-partners-launch-pillar-ii-project)are focused on[torpedoes](https://news.usni.org/2026/09/22/u-s-u-k-launch-torpedo-from-royal-navy-unmanned-submarine), unmanned vehicles, mines and undersea communications, Dodd said. Autonomous undersea vehicles – with the ability to deploy and employ a range of payloads in a contested logistics environment from sensors to drones and torpedoes – was the focus of MBP-Pacific. The delivery of systems and payloads is slated to start next year.

But Pillar II goes beyond demonstration, said Sir Stephen Lovegrove, the U.K.’s Special Representative for AUKUS. Pillar II is seeing experimentation and capability building, as well as improved interoperability among industry and governments.

“This is not about looking at the best of each other’s kit and systems and seeing which one to choose,” Lovegrove said. “This is about making sure that the whole thing works together, and that 1+1+1 equals considerably more than three.”

David Nockels, Australia’s first assistant secretary for Defense Trade, Regulation and Industrial Collaboration, said he’s seeing “real progress” across Pillar II.The government is developing the [Royal Australian Navy’s Ghost Shark](https://news.usni.org/2026/10/21/royal-australian-navys-ghost-shark-uuvs-will-have-minelaying-uav-payloads)fleet in partnership with Anduril Australia. This week, military and government officials announced investments in UUV payloads, including the ability to lay sea mines and deploy drones, small and towed sonar.

“As the strategic environment becomes far more complex, the need to accelerate our delivery of military capability and strengthen interoperability is only increasing,” Nockels said. “[Lessons learned] will inform future experimentation, future capability development and the operational integration of our militaries and… help ensure AUKUS continues to deliver practical capability outcomes for our warfighters.”

The Royal Australian Navy’s Ghost Shark are being equipped with sea mine, aerial drone swarms and supply payloads for use in the coming years, according to a video shared Oct. 21, 2026. Anduril Industries image

In the overall scenario for the latest demonstration MBP-Pacific Pillar II, joint forces moving across island chains faced off against an adversary that impacted logistical support and resupply, said Gerry Tighe, Maritime Big Play director and former naval aviator. Enemy threats came from drones in the air, on the surface and undersea. The scenario represented “a whole new world” where using lethal systems or sensors like acoustic sonar arrays demonstrated during Pillar II can provide a warfighting advantage, Tighe said.

While this latest Pillar II scenario was set with the Indo-Pacific in mind, Pillar II’s focus on maritime capabilities is “theater agnostic,” Lovegrove said.

“We clearly are committed to playing our part in the Indo-Pacific, but our main focus is the North Atlantic, Mediterranean and High North. These are obviously areas where the principal threat is Russia,” he said.

U.K. military officials have deemed Russia the greatest threat to U.K. security, most recently[in September during a speech](https://news.usni.org/2026/09/21/russia-is-greatest-threat-to-u-k-security-says-first-sea-lord) at the Department of Naval Research in London. First Sea Lord Gen. Sir Gwyn Jenkins said Russia has increased its activities in the North Atlantic and is probing the U.K. for weaknesses. The Royal Navy is spending more time and resources monitoring Russian vessels and the shadow fleet. An average of two Royal Navy warships deploy each week to conduct such tasks, Jenkins said.

“Our approach is to monitor, track and then call out the bad behavior,” Second Sea Lord Vice Adm. Paul Beattie, told reporters on Wednesday. “I think we know how important undersea cables and pipelines are to any nation, but particularly to an island nation.”

## **Maritime Solutions**

Hadalus XL fit in a 20-foot container for easy transport. CET image

AUKUS Pillar II provides tech companies a way to collaborate with other vendors and products, and MBP-Pacific served as a realistic venue to show their capabilities and utility to the military.

“You’ve got to be able to work together and collaborate and make a system of systems that solves the mission, rather than the one thing you’re looking at,” Rosenthal said.

CET’s fully autonomous Hadalus UUV has everything it needs to swim, navigation sensors – “everything it needs to know where it is in the world to avoid hitting anything,” Rosenthal said.

Additionally, it can be equipped with additional systems as needed. On Wednesday, the battery-operated vehicle was outfitted with a launcher system to deploy six drums.

Hadalus’ carbon-fiber composite hull “is acoustically invisible,” Rosenthal said, its dark hue helping it blend into the sea. Over the five days Hadalus was in the water, data showed it is undetectable, according to Rosenthal.

“It’s surprising how hard it is to spot when it’s bobbing around in the waves,” Rosenthal said. “We suspected that it would be hard to find in the water, but we didn’t have hard data to show that. Getting that data saying we truly can’t be detected was super, super beneficial.”

CET is currently capable of building 110 UUVs per month at its Rhode Island factory with the possibility of expanding to accommodate a higher production rate, Rosenthal said. The company and its partners are working through a contract with the Marine Corps for a smaller UUV.

Anduril Australia’s extra-large autonomous undersea vehicle Dive-XL participated in MBP-Pacific in California in October of 2026. Anduril image

Among UUVs in play at MBP-Pacific was[Dive-XL](https://www.anduril.com/dive-xl), Anduril Australia’s extra-large autonomous undersea vehicle that fits into a standard 40-foot container. It can carry multiple payloads, including[Ultra Maritime’s Sea Spear deployable acoustic array](https://umaritime.com/sonar-solutions/deployable-sonar-arrays/).

“You could leave this behind on the bottom and then it can detect contacts that swim by and then communicate between the different nodes,” said Tim Rochholz, Anduril Maritime’s director of fleet integration and U.S. XL programs.

Dive-XL’s configurable bays support various payloads, including Copperhead UUVs, Mark 48 torpedo equivalents and[Seabed Sentry](https://www.anduril.com/news/anduril-introduces-seabed-sentry), he said.

“The challenging part is the data,” Rochholz said. “You can collect all this data you want on the bottom of the ocean. You’ve got to get it somewhere off the ocean floor and then do something with that information.”

One U.K vendor’s system played a key role during MBP-Pacific.[Seaber’s RECALL,](https://seaber.fr/applications#asw-training)a small orange recoverable UUV, served as the enemy in the anti-submarine warfare scenarios.

“It’s pretending to be a submarine. We were the target,” said John Peters, ocean systems technician with RS Aqua, a Portsmouth, U.K.-based company that distributes the French-made device.

The UUV has a wide range of frequencies that it can emit to mimic a range of undersea threats.

The underwater drone can reach a depth up to 300 meters. Because it is recoverable, the UUV can reduce costs with repeated use.

Feedback from the ASW demonstrations were positive, Peters said.

“Systems were detecting us, which is good,” he said.

## **Easing Barriers**

Existing U.S. regulations – specifically International Traffic in Arms Regulations, or ITAR – control the sale, transfer and export of defense and military technologies that can stymie innovation and limit interoperability among industry and nations.

Easing ITAR restrictions will smooth those acquisition pathways and get systems produced and into the hands of operators more quickly, officials said.

Some restrictions and exclusions go back decades and are still impacting systems in use during the demonstrations, Dodd said.

content:
菲律宾国防部长特吉尔伯托·特奥多罗(Gilberto Teodoro)警告中国，任何试图拖走坐滩在第二托马斯浅滩的“马德雷山”号(BRP Sierra Madre)军舰的行动，都将被菲律宾视为“战争行为”。

特奥多罗是在星期五(10月23日)的一次线上采访中做出该表述的。他表示，对“马德雷山”号登陆舰的任何威胁都将被非常严肃对待，因为这等于针对菲律宾共和国军舰采取行动。

菲律宾媒体报道，当被问到中国海警或军人若试图强登“马德雷山”号，菲律宾能否援引美菲《共同防御条约》共同应对时，特奥多罗说：“这种可能性是存在的。”

但特奥多罗也强调，是否援引防御条约作出回应，最终须由菲律宾总统小费迪南德·马科斯（Ferdinand Marcos Jr.)决定。

根据美菲1951年签订的《共同防御条约》，两国若在太平洋海域遭到武装攻击，均被视为危及自身的和平与安全，两国将依照各自的宪法程序采取行动应对共同危机。

美国多次重申，《美菲共同防御条约》适用于在南中国海任何地点针对菲律宾武装部队、公务船只和飞机发动的武装袭击。

就菲律宾国防部长的说法，美国之音向美国战争部发出问询电邮，但截至美国之音发稿时为止，还没有收到战争部的回应。

**菲华文报刊爆：中国拟推十项反制措施**

10月22日，一家总部位于马尼拉的华文报刊《菲律宾商报》援引消息人士的话披露，由于中方对菲方近期涉华行动和相关言论逐渐失去耐心，正考虑推出[十项反制措施](https://www.shangbao.com.ph/pdf/2026/10-22/U205P5038T1D207070F103DT20261022011508.pdf)，其中包括将坐滩第二托马斯浅滩(Second Thomas Shoal，中国称仁爱礁，菲律宾称阿云津礁) 破旧的“马德雷山”号拖走，以彻底解决该问题。

十项反制措施还包括制裁一批被中国视为反华的菲律宾政客、公布部分菲律宾政客于中国的利益往来、不再允许菲律宾对“马德雷山”号运补、切断中国对菲的成品油及化肥供应等等。

“马德雷山号”是一艘二战时期的老旧军舰，菲律宾1999年将其搁浅在第二托马斯浅滩，以强化其主权主张。军舰上驻有一支小规模部队，菲律宾船只定期向舰上驻军运送食品和其他物资，并轮换人员。第二托马斯浅滩是该地区主要的冲突热点之一。

截至目前，中方官方尚未证实十项反制措施的消息，但相关传闻在菲律宾引发高度关注。

**中菲外交争议持续**

菲律宾外交部星期四(10月22日)发表声明，重申马尼拉坚持“一个中国”政策，但是抨击中国驻菲大使馆近期“升级且有违外交礼仪”的言论。

中国驻菲大使井泉10月15日在接受记者采访时表示，如果北京动用武力，可能轻易就能获胜。

井泉当时说：“如果我们想动用武力，可能很容易就能获胜。但我们不会这样做，我们不会动用武力。要知道，我们热爱和平。”

菲律宾外交部当天发表声明，对井泉的发言表达不满和强烈反对的立场，指责他“用词不当”，向马尼拉传递出一种“隐晦”的武力威胁。

菲律宾外交部随后召见井泉，就其言论表达了菲方的强烈反对。菲律宾外交部副部长玛丽亚·特蕾莎·拉扎罗(Maria Theresa Lazaro)以“具有挑衅性”且“不可接受”描述井泉的言论。

10月21日，菲律宾十位跨党派众议院议员提出一项决议案，敦促马科斯总统宣布井泉为“不受欢迎的人”。

**中菲南中国海上冲突不断**

自9月份以来，中菲除了外交争议外，在南中国海上的冲突也不间断。

10月初，中菲双方就发生在第二托马斯浅滩附近的一次医疗救助行动相互指责。据菲律宾军方说，10月8日，菲律宾军方需要从 “马德雷山”号军舰上撤离一名生病的菲律宾军人。

菲律宾海岸警卫队指责中国海警船阻挠紧急撤离行动，其中包括使用高压水炮，显然意在阻止菲律宾巡逻船抵达该浅滩，以接回生病的执勤人员。

此外，菲律宾军方报告称，9月份出现在南中国海有争议岛礁周边的中国军舰和海警船数量几乎翻了一番。

另外，9月8日，在韩国首尔举行的2026年首尔安全对话(SDD)上，菲律宾国防部长特奥多罗对他认为的中方现场递上的一张纸条当场做出强势回应，抨击中国此举践踏《联合国海洋法公约》(UNCLOS)，并称纸条是“赤裸裸的胁迫、霸凌和侵略”。

中方对于上述事件的菲方表述均予以否认和反驳。在撤离生病的菲方军人事件中，外交部发言人毛宁指责菲方“对中方倒打一耙”，属“挑事生非、哗众取宠”。

# 【名家專欄】地方告急 促中共重大財政轉向

[![Image 7: 【名家專欄】地方告急 促中共重大財政轉向](https://www.epochtimes.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fi.epochtimes.com%2Fassets%2Fuploads%2F2026%2F10%2Fid14875187-GettyImages-1347299510.jpg&w=1200&q=75)](https://i.epochtimes.com/assets/uploads/2026/10/id14875187-GettyImages-1347299510.jpg)

2021年10月18日，湖北省武漢市，恆大武漢文化旅遊城，一名女子從廣告牌下的破洞穿過。(Getty Images)

中港台時間 2026-10-24 04:30 發表

人氣 31

[設為Google新聞首選來源](https://www.google.com/preferences/source?q=https://www.epochtimes.com/)

[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=www.epochtimes.com%2Fb5%2F26%2F10%2F23%2Fn14875185.htm)[](https://line.me/R/msg/text/?Check%20this%20out%3A%20www.epochtimes.com%2Fb5%2F26%2F10%2F23%2Fn14875185.htm%3FopenExternalBrowser%3D1)[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=Check%20this%20out!&via=dajiyuan&url=www.epochtimes.com%2Fb5%2F26%2F10%2F23%2Fn14875185.htm)[](https://www.epochtimes.com/b5/26/10/23/n14875185.htm#)[](https://www.epochtimes.com/b5/26/10/23/n14875185.htm#)[](https://www.epochtimes.com/b5/26/10/23/n14875185.htm)[](https://www.epochtimes.com/gb/26/10/23/n14875185.htm)

【大紀元2026年10月23日訊】（英文大紀元專欄作家Milton Ezrati撰文／信宇編譯）中國各省和地方政府長期以來不得不向北京中央政府尋求財政幫助。然而，房地產危機已經大幅削減省級收入，因此向北京尋求財政援助的頻率和規模都變得更大。

事實上，這些問題已經變得如此緊迫，以至於北京已經開始考慮根本性的財政改革，特別是在房地產危機沒有減弱跡象的情況下。來自陷入困境的省級政府的巨大壓力促使北京中央政府提高了財政改革的必要性。

當2022年房地產危機首次爆發時，各省級政府收入就開始遇到麻煩，曾經豐厚的土地轉讓稅費收入也隨之消失。近年來，收入缺口不斷累積，今年省級預算的壓力似乎已經達到臨界水平。

根據總部位於貴州省貴陽市的華創證券有限責任公司（Huachuang Securities）的研究，如果沒有北京的幫助，中國任何一個省份都無法履行其債務。所謂的自給率——衡量一個省可以用自己的資源融資的支出比例——在今年第一季度（有數據的最新時期）下降至55.9%。

上海的情況很能說明問題。作為中國經濟總量最高城市的上海市長期位居中國財政表現最強勁的城市之列，並定期報告直接預算盈餘，但是截至今年春季的12個月裡，上海市的收入僅增長了2%，而支出卻增長了20%。

北京中央政府必須加緊努力彌補上海和全國各地的預算缺口。它以前也曾這樣介入過，尤其是自房地產危機爆發以來。

但是緩解危機壓力的政策努力失敗了，中國各省對資金的需求不斷增加，最終導致北京認識到需要進行更加持久的財政改革。中共副總理丁薛祥提出了這個問題，指出「十五五」規劃中提到的「財政管理試點計劃」是北京和各省應該採取的具體步驟。

這項擬議改革的一個方面是中央政府通過直接資助國家優先事項來緩解當前對各省級和地方政府的一些需求。過去，為許多此類優先事項提供資金一直是省級或地方政府的義務。

丁薛祥表示，由於目前中央對地方的轉移支付效率低下且不透明，轉移這些財政義務將使省級政府在行使其財政權力時擁有更多自由裁量權。據推測，這種自由裁量權將使他們能夠應對土地出讓收入的損失，今年上半年土地出讓收入比2025年同期平均減少31.5%。

改革者還重點關注消費稅，將其作為至少部分填補省級預算缺口的一種方式。中國已經徵收了相當大的增值稅，相當於消費稅。但它還對香菸、酒類和汽車等15種商品徵收特別消費稅。

上半年，特別消費稅為北京帶來收入約8,670億元人民幣，成為繼增值稅、企業所得稅和個人所得稅之後的第四大收入來源。

通過將稅收歸屬從現在的生產層面轉移到批發或零售層面，其中一些收入將從中央政府轉移到省級和地方金庫。這種轉變無論有多大幫助，都需要立法和監管方面的轉變，而這需要時間。

具有諷刺意味的是，這些預期的變化逆轉了1994年財政改革的大部分內容。當時，幾乎所有的收入來源都向省級和地方政府傾斜，導致北京中央政府財政長期短缺。但是當時，中國經濟特別是房地產行業蓬勃發展，土地出讓金和稅收水漲船高。

現在情況緊急，特別是房地產危機的頑固持續，要求採取相反的行動，將收入從中央轉移到省級和地方政府，作為土地出讓收入的替代方案。丁薛祥正在艱難領導這項工作，當然這不能保證中共政權能夠應對這個變化。

**作者簡介：**

米爾頓‧埃茲拉蒂（Milton Ezrati）是紐約州立大學（The State University of New York，簡稱SUNY）布法羅分校（Buffalo）人力資本研究中心主辦的《國家利益》（The National Interest）雜誌的特約編輯，亦是總部位於紐約的知名傳播公司Vested的首席經濟學家。在入職Vested之前，他曾擔任Lord, Abbett & Co.等公司的首席市場策略師和經濟學家。他還經常為總部位於紐約的《城市雜誌》（City Journal）撰寫文章，並定期為《福布斯》（Forbes）撰寫博客。他的最新著作是《即將到來的三十年：未來三十年的全球化、人口統計學和我們的生活方式》（Thirty Tomorrows: The Next Three Decades of Globalization, Demographics, and How We Will Live, 2014）。

title: 日本钇库存据报仅存数月后 美驻日大使痛批中国政府将关键矿产当作“政治武器”
summary: 美国驻日本大使乔治·格拉斯(George Glass)星期五(10月23日)痛批中国政府将关键矿产当作“政治武器”，并表示，北京对日本严厉的稀土出口限制不仅伤及日本，也让美国公司枉遭池鱼之殃。 格拉斯是在社交媒体平台X上作出上述表示的。他特别反感北京以日本涉嫌“再军事化”为借口，限制对日本的稀土出口。 “这种论调我听过无数遍了，”格拉斯说，“称日本‘再军事化’的诡辩，不过是一种拙劣的托词，旨在为将关键矿产供应作为政治武器的行为寻求正当性。”格拉斯又说。 > その主張は聞き飽き
content:
美国驻日本大使乔治·格拉斯(George Glass)星期五(10月23日)痛批中国政府将关键矿产当作“政治武器”，并表示，北京对日本严厉的稀土出口限制不仅伤及日本，也让美国公司枉遭池鱼之殃。

格拉斯是在社交媒体平台X上作出上述表示的。他特别反感北京以日本涉嫌“再军事化”为借口，限制对日本的稀土出口。

“这种论调我听过无数遍了，”格拉斯说，“称日本‘再军事化’的诡辩，不过是一种拙劣的托词，旨在为将关键矿产供应作为政治武器的行为寻求正当性。”格拉斯又说。

> その主張は聞き飽きた。日本の「再軍備」などという詭弁は、重要鉱物の供給を政治的武器として正当化するための、見え透いた口実にすぎない。中国政府による不当な輸出規制の弊害は、日本だけに収まるものではない。日本企業の品質と信頼性を高く買い、強固な絆を結んできた米国企業をはじめ、この地域の経済活動全体に冷や水を浴びせる行為だ。かの国では「安定」と「混乱」が、同義語として辞書に載っているのだろうか。
>
> — ジョージ・グラス駐日米国大使 (@USAmbJapan) [October 23, 2026](https://x.com/USAmbJapan/status/2113497495951245700?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw)

日本首相高市早苗于去年11月7日在国会众议院接受质询时表示，如果发生“台湾有事”，可能构成日本可行使集体自卫权的“存亡危机事态”，日本自卫队不排除进行武力干预。高市早苗的这番发言导致日中关系持续恶化、跌入谷底。

中国声称台湾是中国领土不可分割的一部分，即使诉诸武力也要实现台湾与大陆的统一。北京称台湾问题是其“核心利益中的核心”，并表示绝不容许外部势力干涉其所谓的内政。

高市在国会有关“台湾有事”的表述被北京视为“明目张胆的挑衅”和“干预”中国内政之举，因此立即引发北京的口诛笔伐。

中国政府要求东京撤回高市在议会的发言，但是遭到拒绝。日方只愿重申“政策不变”，而这无法平息北京的愤怒。中方随后逐渐加大对日本的政治和经济施压力度，包括对制造各种高科技产品所需的稀土实施贸易限制。

中国商务部将多家日本实体列为出口管制对象，禁止向它们出口任何可能用于军事用途的物资。北京还批评了高市早苗政府的扩军政策，声称日本国内“新军国主义”正在抬头。

英国《金融时报》星期二援引知情人士的消息报道说，除非中国放宽出口限制或日本立即找到替代供应来源，否则日本的钇库存可能在几个月之内耗尽，最快在今年年底就会面临钇供应短缺，直接冲击汽车、航空和半导体制造业。

作为一种稀土金属，钇广泛运用于喷气发动机的耐高温防护涂层和半导体制造设备等领域。而中国是全球主要钇供应国。

其他受管制的稀土产品对日出口也持续下滑，引起日本产业界对稀土供应中断的担忧。

根据《金融时报》的报道，日本已向美国政府以及多家美国主要企业求救，希望华盛顿协助向北京施压，放宽对日稀土出口限制。

香港《南华早报》10月8日援引消息人士的话报道说，特朗普总统在与习近平会晤时，曾敦促他改善与美国盟友日本的关系，并解除中国对日本实施的一些出口管控。

报道说，特朗普告诉习近平，中国针对包括稀土在内的输日商品实施的出口限制，对“依赖日本供应商的美国产业”构成了威胁，并称此举“间接违反了”去年10月在韩国达成的美中贸易休战协议。

据报道，习近平对特朗普的这些呼吁和要求“反应冷淡”。他对特朗普说，北京与东京之间的争端应与美中关系分开处理，不应影响后者。习近平还警告称，“日本军国主义的风险正在上升”。

中国外交部发言人毛宁在星期二举行的例行记者会上被问及《金融时报》的报道时重申了有关防止日本“再军事化”的说辞。“中方依法依规对日本实施出口管制，目的是制止日本‘再军事化’和拥核企图。”毛宁说。

格拉斯就是看到毛宁的回应之后，在X上连续发了两条贴文。在另一条贴文中他强调，中国政府对日不合理的出口限制措施，其危害绝不仅限于日本。

> Here we go again. Absurd claims of Japan’s “remilitarization” are nothing but a ploy to justify the weaponization of critical mineral supplies. Beijing’s gratuitous export restrictions don’t impact Japan alone. They harm businesses across the region, including American ones, that have built strong partnerships with Japanese companies and value the quality and reliability of their products. Clearly, the words “stability” and “disruption” mean the same thing in Chinese.
>
> — ジョージ・グラス駐日米国大使 (@USAmbJapan) [October 23, 2026](https://x.com/USAmbJapan/status/2113497123736215770?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw)

“北京毫无根据的出口限制并非只影响日本。它损害了整个地区的商业利益，包括与日本企业建立了牢固合作关系、重视其产品质量和可靠性的美国企业。显然，在中国，‘稳定’和‘破坏’这两个词的意思是一样的。”格拉斯写道。

美国驻华大使庞德伟(David Perdue)9月29日在习近平结束对美国的国事访问后也在X平台上贴文，批评中国将其稀土出口的主导性地位“武器化”，并用来针对全世界。

他说，美国已经向中国表示，这是“不可接受的”。

“中国规定任何为多元经营而离开中国的操作均属违法，中国可以逮捕人员，将其起诉，扣押其资产，限制其出境等。”庞德伟说。

# Expatriate loses HK$2m in hotel booking scam as Hong Kong police report HK$10m weekly job fraud

Hong Kong police received over 20 reports of online employment fraud in a week, with losses nearing HK$10 million. One expatriate woman was swindled out of more than HK$2 million in a deceptive hotel booking commission scheme.

Hong Kong police have recorded more than 20 reports of online employment fraud over the past week, involving total losses nearing HK$10 million. One expatriate woman was swindled out of more than HK$2 million in a deceptive hotel booking commission scheme, according to authorities.

The expatriate victim was lured by a recruitment advertisement on Facebook offering lucrative commissions for boosting hotel booking numbers through online order-brushing tasks. After expressing interest, she was contacted by scammers via WhatsApp, who provided a referral code and a link to a fake hotel reservation website.

Following instructions from individuals posing as customer service representatives, the victim registered an account on the fraudulent platform. She was then told to transfer funds into several personal bank accounts under the pretext of making hotel reservations to earn substantial commissions.

Although the bogus website initially showed commissions credited to her account, the victim found she could not withdraw any funds. After discussing the matter with family members, she contacted the Anti-Deception Coordination Centre via the 18222 anti-scam helpline, where officers confirmed she had fallen prey to an online fraud ring. Within days, she had transferred more than HK$2 million to the fraudsters.

Police noted that this case was part of a broader surge in employment-related deception, with more than 20 similar reports in a seven-day span resulting in nearly HK$10 million in collective losses. The recent wave highlights the persistent threat of cyber fraud targeting job seekers, with criminal syndicates using social media platforms and encrypted messaging services to lure victims with promises of high, quick returns.

Investigators urged residents to exercise caution when encountering online recruitment advertisements promising easy money or high commission rates. They warned against transferring funds to personal bank accounts or clicking on unverified links provided by strangers on messaging apps.

# China says US should stop discriminatory measures against Chinese research institutions

# China says US should stop discriminatory measures against Chinese research institutions

Just now

23 Oct 2026, 16:27

 Share

## The ministry was responding to US Defence Department restrictions on research funding for dozens of Chinese universities and laboratories.

 A view of Wuhan Institute Of Virology in Hubei Province. A Republican lawmaker urged the defense department to add 58 more Chinese universities and 62 technology laboratories to its sanctions list. (EPA Images pic)

HONG KONG: China’s Commerce Ministry urged the US on Friday to “respect the facts” and immediately end what it called discriminatory measures against Chinese research institutions.

The ministry also said in its statement that strengthening Chinese-US scientific research cooperation serves the common interest of both sides.

The comments were made in relation to the US Department of Defense putting US research funding restrictions on dozens of Chinese universities. A Republican lawmaker earlier this month called on the department to add 58 more Chinese schools and 62 Chinese technology labs to what is known as the 1286 list.

Several of the Chinese labs and schools named by the lawmaker focus on areas such as semiconductors, AI and quantum computing, according to a letter reviewed by Reuters.

“The US’s actions are essentially coercing US research institutions to take sides, deliberately undermining normal China-US scientific research cooperation,” the Commerce Ministry said.

“This will only weaken the US’s own scientific and technological progress,” it said.

The Department of Defense, which US President Donald Trump and Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth call the Department of War, is barred from providing research funding to any entity that works with Chinese universities on the list. The department says collaboration with schools on the list a compliance issue that puts US federal funding at risk.

content:
As the Chinese Communist Party prepares for its Fifth Plenum, the leadership is looking beyond its anti-corruption campaign to tighten discipline, enforce political loyalty and rein in bureaucratic dysfunction. Lianhe Zaobao associate editor Han Yong Hong gives her analysis.

Chinese President Xi Jinping and other officials attend a gathering commemorating the 90th anniversary of the end of the Long March, at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, China, on 22 October 2026.(CNS via Reuters)

(Edited and refined by Candice Chan, with the assistance of AI translation.)

The Fifth Plenum of the 20th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) is set to convene in Beijing for four days from 26 October. Besides the much-anticipated personnel changes within the Central Committee, the plenum will focus on “steadfastly advancing full and rigorous Party self-governance”.

When the agenda was first announced, observers initially assumed that the meeting would centre on the fight against corruption. But the concept of “full and rigorous Party self-governance” clearly encompasses much more than anti-corruption efforts.

There are growing indications that the CCP leadership is seeking to tighten oversight of officials and impose greater constraints on how they carry out their duties, possibly through more detailed performance assessment mechanisms. The decisions taken at the Fifth Plenum could therefore have far-reaching implications for the management and discipline of China’s officialdom.

Meanwhile, the relentless anti-corruption campaign of recent years shows no sign of easing and is likely to ramp up even more. Some observers have even remarked in private that the CCP’s “real fight against corruption” may just be starting.

On 21 September, the Political Bureau of the CCP Central Committee reviewed feedback on a draft decision document on advancing full and rigorous party self-governance. The meeting endorsed the draft for its objective assessment of the achievements and lessons of the party’s governance efforts since CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping came to power, its in-depth analysis of the challenges facing party building now and in the coming years, and its strategic plans for sustaining these efforts. The revised document will be submitted to the Fifth Plenum for deliberation.

Just two weeks before the plenum, former Chongqing mayor [Huang Qifan](https://www.thinkchina.sg/politics/former-chongqing-mayor-who-outlasted-bo-xilai-meets-his-downfall?ref=inline-article), nicknamed a “roly-poly toy” in Chinese politics, was officially placed under investigation on 13 October for “suspected serious violations of discipline and law”. Huang stepped down as Chongqing mayor a decade ago, and had long since moved away from frontline politics, frequently appearing as an economist. Chinese media outlet Caixin reported that Huang and his son, Huang Ranfei, were taken from their home by the authorities on or around the evening of 10 October, shattering the widespread belief that the elder Huang had managed to retire from politics unscathed.

... not only would retirement offer no protection from investigation, but officials who were corrupt yet competent would no longer be tolerated.

Chongqing mayor Huang Qifan leaves the Great Hall of the People after a plenary meeting of the National People's Congress, China's parliament, in Beijing, China, on 4 March 2016.(Jason Lee/Reuters)

A few days later, the website of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection (CCDI) published a commentary noting that “over the past week, two former centrally managed officials were announced to be under investigation or expelled from the Party”. It said this again demonstrated the unwavering determination of the CCP Central Committee, with Xi Jinping at its core, to pursue the fight against corruption, sending a strong signal that there would be “no areas off-limits, full coverage, and zero tolerance”.

The commentary also stressed that “all Party members and officials, regardless of their rank, contributions or retirement status, have no way out and no so-called safe landing if they have engaged in corruption”.

Although Huang was not named, the reference was unmistakable. The message was politically significant: not only would retirement offer no protection from investigation, but officials who were corrupt yet competent would no longer be tolerated.

More importantly, Huang’s ability to survive successive political upheavals after moving from Shanghai to Chongqing was clearly due to more than his personal capabilities — he also had an intricate network of political and economic connections behind him. The decision to act against Huang ahead of the Fifth Plenum therefore appears aimed at the vested interests surrounding him, while serving as a stern warning to others within the political establishment.

With the anti-corruption campaign still in full swing, academics estimate that as few as 291 full and alternate members of the Central Committee may be left to attend next week’s plenum. That would be a drop of over 20% from the 376 members elected to the 20th Central Committee in 2022, comprising 205 full members and 171 alternate members.

Since last year’s Fourth Plenum, another 20 or so full and alternate members have come under investigation, died or disappeared from public view for extended periods, including former Central Military Commission vice-chairman Zhang Youxia and former Politburo member Ma Xingrui. The number of senior officials whose expulsions are formally confirmed at the Fifth Plenum could therefore reach a new high.

Then Central Military Commission vice-chairman Zhang Youxia arrives at the Western Pacific Naval Symposium in Qingdao, Shandong province, China, on 22 April 2024.(Florence Lo/Reuters)

Yet, fighting corruption is hardly new territory for the Fifth Plenum. The real priority is to advance full and rigorous party self-governance “with higher standards and more concrete measures”.

Last week, the Qiushi website published a speech Xi delivered at the CCDI’s fifth plenary session in January this year, offering a preview of the themes likely to dominate the upcoming plenum.

Xi stressed that implementing the major decisions and directives of the CCP Central Committee was a fundamental requirement of party discipline and political rules. “We cannot just shout slogans, much less say one thing and do another. Anyone who violates these requirements must be held accountable. Those who deserve criticism must be criticised, those who need to be reassigned must be reassigned, and those who warrant disciplinary action must be disciplined. Such matters must not be played down or handled ambiguously.”

Some are political opportunists who resort to flattery and deception, shift their loyalties with the prevailing winds and stand ready to jump ship at any moment...

Xi went on to describe the many forms of “two-faced” behaviour among officials. Some loudly proclaim their political loyalty while quietly defying orders, doing as they please and even openly disregarding directives and prohibitions; others embrace liberalism in their thinking.

Some are political opportunists who resort to flattery and deception, shift their loyalties with the prevailing winds and stand ready to jump ship at any moment; others engage in factionalism, building their own power bases and cliques while pursuing narrow group interests under the guise of collective action.

Still others put their own interests first in their work; some are so concerned with avoiding confrontation that they fail to intervene or correct problems, allowing them to fester and spread — they claim to be preserving unity, when in reality they are simply shirking responsibility.

Attendants listen to Chinese President Xi Jinping's speech at the National Day reception on the eve of the 77th founding anniversary of the People's Republic of China, at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, China, on 30 September 2026.(Florence Lo/Reuters)

Xi also called for stricter enforcement of formal rules to curb the influence of unwritten ones. He warned that political fixers and fraudsters continued to thrive because informal practices had undermined the effectiveness of laws and regulations, creating a “broken window” effect in which bad practices drove out good ones.

The very problems Xi highlighted reveal a deeper contradiction: despite the extraordinary concentration of power at the top, the leadership has still struggled to secure genuine loyalty from the bureaucracy, often receiving little more than “performative obedience”.

Years ago, there was already a saying that “orders from Zhongnanhai never make it beyond its walls”...

**This**is a longstanding problem in China’s political system. Years ago, there was already a saying that “orders from Zhongnanhai never make it beyond its walls”, reflecting the difficulty of translating central directives into action on the ground. But the problem also stems from the many challenges and competing demands that officials at different levels face in carrying out their duties.

China’s bureaucratic culture and the practical dilemmas facing its officials cannot be changed overnight. For now, the leadership has little choice but to rely on regulations and disciplinary measures to keep these problems in check.

In a lengthy article published this week by US think tank Asia Society, senior fellow Neil Thomas noted that the number of officials at various levels disciplined under party or administrative rules for “formalism” and “bureaucratism” had surged from 46,000 in 2023 to 118,000 last year. With the implementation of the decision document expected to be adopted at the Fifth Plenum, the crackdown on such practices will continue to tighten.

This article was first published in Lianhe Zaobao as [“中共五中全会主题：强化反腐又不止反腐”](https://www.zaobao.com.sg/news/china/story20261023-9880499?utm_source=ThinkChina-website).

[![Image 2](https://cassette.sphdigital.com.sg/image/thinkchina/9b2735878df2654e51b9f821fa72751e3e2351a4042183c64917141bd700cac1)](https://www.thinkchina.sg/politics/building-lifelines-north-koreas-china-russia-tightrope)

title: Where art, justice and democracy meet at SA’s highest court
summary: The adoption of South Africa’s non-racial Constitution 30 years ago included the creation of a new apex court – the Constitutional Court. Over the decades, this court has issued landmark judgments that fundamentally transformed South Africa
content:
The adoption of South Africa’s non-racial Constitution 30 years ago included the creation of a new apex court – the Constitutional Court. Over the decades, this court has issued landmark judgments that fundamentally transformed South African jurisprudence, particularly through expanding free speech protections and securing the right to shelter. Back in the late 1990s and early 2000s, despite disagreement over the nature and treatment of the HIV/Aids epidemic and South Africa’s support for Robert Mugabe’s regime in Zimbabwe, the bilateral relationship between the United States and South Africa remained generally cordial. ### Could we help the court? During my time with the American Embassy in South Africa, our team paid close attention to the new Constitutional Court’s mandate to consider foreign legal precedents when reaching its decisions. However, conversations with members of the court revealed a major practical hurdle: researching international law was time-consuming and often incomplete. We realised we could bridge this gap by providing access to Westlaw, an electronic database containing US court decisions and legal material from virtually every jurisdiction across the United States. In those early days of searchable internet databases, lawyers and judges typically researched precedents by directing interns and clerks to laboriously search through stacks of published law reports. Westlaw, by contrast, offered a continuously updated digital alternative. Because Westlaw belonged to the Thomson Reuters media empire, major local and international law firms in South Africa were already using it. We approached Westlaw’s local representatives and urged them to extend courtesy log-ins to the Constitutional Court. Recognising the immense public benefit of assisting the new court, the company agreed to grant the court multi-year, free access. Sometimes a simple initiative yields profound public benefits at minimal cost – an outcome that gives us great pride. ### The Constitutional Court’s art collection Shortly after I retired from diplomatic service,Justice Albie Sachs invited me to visit the court’s temporary quarters in Braamfontein. He wanted to discuss a new task that he and fellow Justice Yvonne Mokgoro were undertaking: assembling an art collection for the court’s permanent home using a modest starting budget of R10,000. Apex courts around the world take varied approaches when choosing art and architectural design for their buildings. For instance, the architects of the US Supreme Court building, completed in 1935, adopted a neoclassical style typical of official Washington, decorating the building’s exterior pediments with bas-relief friezes depicting historical lawgivers such as Solon, Confucius and Moses. Other nations adorn their courts with portraits of eminent jurists and political leaders, or depictions of heroic moments in national history. Still others commission works illustrating allegorical concepts like “blind justice” – often drawing on centuries-old traditions of depicting a toga-clad woman holding a balance scale and a sword. Justices Sachs and Mokgoro took a distinctly different path. Working under severe financial constraints, the two began gathering art even before workers finished constructing the new court building. Instead of purchasing an established collection, they built a repository that arrived organically from artists and generous donors. When I met Justice Sachs in his temporary office, donated artworks were already filling the walls. Among the growing collection, Judith Mason’s The Blue Dress stands out as perhaps the best-known piece. Mason created the work after hearing radio broadcasts of Truth and Reconciliation Commission testimony regarding the execution of two anti-apartheid activists, Harold Sefola and Phila Ndwandwe, by security forces. Ndwandwe had reportedly been kept naked in her cell to force her to inform on her comrades; in defiance, she fashioned plastic bags into crude clothing to preserve her dignity. Moved by this story, Mason collected discarded blue plastic bags, sewed them into a dress, and painted a poem on the fabric honouring Ndwandwe’s extraordinary courage.
(Image: CCAC)](https://cdn.dailymaverick.co.za/i/km0GA66Q2pLh0uqd4HT4JJvubQM=/200x100/smart/filters:strip_exif()/file/attachments/orphans/Brooks-ConCourt30th5_293532.jpg) Judith Mason’s painting The Man Who Sang and the Woman Who Kept Silent, also known as The Blue Dress. (Image: Constitutional Court Art Collection) As construction neared completion, workers installed the building’s main entrance doors – massive wooden sculptures carved by hand. These doors depict the 27 fundamental human rights listed in Chapter Two of the Constitution (the Bill of Rights) using South Africa’s 11 official languages, alongside sign language. The bronze door handle incorporates Braille commemorating the court’s opening in 2004. The late artist and set designer Andrew Verster, alongside artist Andries Botha and a team of skilled carvers from KwaZulu-Natal, created these magnificent doors. Verster likened the collaborative process to building a Gothic cathedral, where thousands of hands contributed to create a unified whole. The main entrance to the Constitutional Court. (Photo: iStock) Outside the court stands a large bronze statue cast from a smaller clay work by the famed artist Dumile Feni, titled History. The Tallix Art Foundry in Beacon, New York, scaled up Feni’s original work and cast it in bronze before shipping it to South Africa in 2003 as a gift to the court. The sculpture depicts a broad-shouldered man straining to pull a cart carrying several figures. While the figure initially seems burdened, closer reflection reveals a tribute to those who tirelessly carry the responsibility of caring for others. As Justices Albie Sachs and Edwin Cameron noted, Feni created no racial distinctions among the four figures, showing how human relationships rely on mutual dependence: “Sometimes you carry, and sometimes you are carried.” Dumile Feni’s statue History. (Photo: Constitutional Court Art Collection) Since those early days, leading figures and emerging artists alike have donated works to the court. The collection now features pieces by William Kentridge, Judith Mason, Dumile Feni, John Baloyi, Willie Bester, Marlene Dumas, Karel Nel, Cecil Skotnes, Hamilton Budaza, Sue Williamson, Anton van Wouw and Andrew Verster. Artists felt drawn to the vision of a court that embodies constitutional values through diverse artistic expressions. Justice Sachs’ well-known passion for connecting art, justice, and freedom helped catalyse this massive outpouring of creative support. In the end, the Constitutional Court spent its entire original art budget of R10,000 on a single piece: Joseph Ndlovu’s tapestry Humanity. Justice Sachs frequently observes that the collection essentially assembled itself through the passion and enthusiasm that the artistic community felt for South Africa’s new democracy. Today, the curatorial staff offers theme-focused “Art & Justice” public tours that highlight the court’s position at the intersection of constitutional law, public memory, and artistic expression, allowing visitors to engage directly with the core values of South African democracy.
(Image: Constitutional Court Art Collection)](https://cdn.dailymaverick.co.za/i/8Cv0Zayaq3qnJb9S0BVZZY_Piuo=/200x100/smart/filters:strip_exif()/file/attachments/orphans/Brooks-ConCourt30th2_643993.jpg) Joseph Ndlovu’s tapestry Humanity. (Image: Constitutional Court Art Collection) ### A visit by Associate Supreme Court Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg On 7 February 2006, less than two years after the court moved into its permanent home, US Supreme Court Associate Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg delivered a major address at the court. Justice Sachs initiated the invitation, which our embassy and the State Department facilitated, making Ginsburg the first American Supreme Court justice to visit South Africa. Before President Bill Clinton appointed her to the US Supreme Court, Ginsburg had built a distinguished legal career advocating for women’s equality and environmental protection, alongside her work with the American Civil Liberties Union and service as a federal appellate judge. Despite her stance as a leading progressive jurist, she maintained a close personal friendship with her conservative colleague Antonin Scalia, bonded by their shared love of opera. From the opening moments of her speech, Justice Ginsburg praised Section 39 of South Africa’s 1996 Constitution, which explicitly directs courts to consider international law and permits them to consult foreign law when interpreting the Bill of Rights. She noted that while countries like India and Spain embraced similar principles, the practice of looking to foreign decisions remained contentious in the United States. Ginsburg openly defended comparative legal analysis, arguing that American jurisprudence grew richer when judges learn from other constitutional democracies like Canada, South Africa and the United Kingdom. Supreme Court Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg addressed the Constitutional Court in 2006. (Photo: Shannon Finney / Getty Images) She anchored her belief in comparative dialogue within the foundational history of the United States, pointing out that the authors of the Declaration of Independence cared deeply about international public opinion. Quoting former DC Circuit Chief Judge Patricia Wald, Ginsburg emphasised that foreign judicial decisions offered a rich pool of persuasive reasoning that judges could draw upon with appropriate caution and restraint. She respectfully rejected Justice Scalia’s view that US judges should ignore foreign commentary, asking why judges who freely consult legal treatises and law review articles should refrain from reading well-reasoned decisions from the Supreme Court of Canada or the Constitutional Court of South Africa. Justice Ginsburg concluded her address with a call for humility and international comity, observing that American courts benefitted when they respected the opinions of humanity and learnt from legal innovations worldwide. While today’s more inward-looking US Supreme Court contrasts with her vision, Ruth Bader Ginsburg’s enduring optimism reminds us of the power of constitutional courts to look outward and learn from one another. **DM** _This story is part of a series marking 30 years since the signing of the Constitution. The series has been made possible, in part, by the support of the_[_Friedrich Naumann Foundation_](https://www.freiheit.org/sub-saharan-africa).

title: 台湾地方选举倒数一个月：“台风假”牵动选情？
summary: ## 台湾地方选举倒数一个月：“台风假”牵动选情？ 图像来源，台北市政府提供 图像加注文字，10月23日上午，台北市长蒋万安参加台北市政府蔷琵台风工作会报。 * * Author, 蒋宜婷 * Role, BBC中文记者 * Reporting from, 台北 * Published 1 小时前 * 阅读时间: 4 分钟 蔷琵台风来袭，台湾各县市是否宣布停班停课，成为九合一地方选举前的舆论焦点。 台湾中央气象署周四（10月22日）针对中度台风蔷琵发布陆上台风警报后，全台22
content:
## 台湾地方选举倒数一个月：“台风假”牵动选情？

图像来源，台北市政府提供

图像加注文字，10月23日上午，台北市长蒋万安参加台北市政府蔷琵台风工作会报。

*       *   Author, 蒋宜婷
    *   Role, BBC中文记者
    *   Reporting from, 台北

*   Published 1 小时前

*   阅读时间: 4 分钟

蔷琵台风来袭，台湾各县市是否宣布停班停课，成为九合一地方选举前的舆论焦点。

台湾中央气象署周四（10月22日）针对中度台风蔷琵发布陆上台风警报后，全台22个县市中有21个宣布翌日停班停课。

台北市长蒋万安当晚宣布台北市停班停课，即俗称放“台风假”，在社群媒体引发热烈讨论。不少网友表示支持，也有部分舆论质疑决策受到选举因素影响。

值得留意的是，台湾过去有学术研究指出，地方首长在选举年“宣布停班停课”的机率较高。学者分析，台风假是民众最直接感受到的政策，成为评价执政表现的依据，尤其在首长寻求连任时更是如此。

](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/ace/ws/640/cpsprodpb/abc7/live/5ddd2f70-cec2-11f1-93e1-3b657b665bcf.jpg.webp)

图像来源，Getty Images

图像加注文字，2026年10月15日，台北街头一名男子骑车经过印有国民党台北市长候选人蒋万安肖像的竞选看板。

## “谢谢市长，祝您连任”

台湾人俗称的“台风假”，在法律上并非正式假期。

各地方政府依据中央气象署发布的风雨预测，包括平均风力达7级以上、阵风达10级以上，或累积雨量达停班停课标准等条件，决定是否停班停课。

民众通常留在家中等待风雨过境，但若实际天候状况较预报温和，百货商场、电影院及餐厅等往往会出现人潮。

今次情况较为特殊的是，下周一（10月26日）适逢台湾光复节补假。若加上此次停班停课，形成长达四天的连假。

周四晚间，台北市长蒋万安宣布台北市翌日停班停课后，其脸书贴文涌入大量留言，不少网友留言表示支持，包括“谢谢市长，祝您连任”、“高票当选”、“我全家11月会投你”等。

部分舆论质疑，停班停课决策可能受到政治与选举因素影响。

台北市长蒋万安回应表示，相关决定均依据中央气象署最新预报作出，当时风力与雨量预测已达停班停课标准。

蒋万安将在11月28日寻求连任台北市长，对手为民进党立委沈伯洋。蒋万安过去在多项民调中大幅领先，但近期多份民调显示两人差距缩小。

除了选情最受关注的台北市，其他县市首长的社群平台上，也出现大量支持停班停课的留言，其中不乏将决策与选举表现连结的评论。

台东县政府22日晚间原宣布23日正常上班上课，一度成为全台唯一未宣布停班停课的县市。消息公布后，大批民众涌入县长饶庆铃的社群平台表达不满，有留言称她“不选了、没差”。

台东县政府于23日清晨改宣布停班停课。部分民众认为决策时间过晚，表示当时已经出门通勤。

县政府则指出，中央气象署清晨更新的预报显示风力进一步增强，可能影响全天活动，因此调整原有决定。

图像来源，Getty Images

图像加注文字，2026年10月18日，民进党台北市长候选人沈伯洋的支持者在台北一场造势活动中挥舞旗帜。

## 选举年“台风假”可能性增31%

台湾各地是否放“台风假”经常引发讨论，尤其在选举期间往往受到更高度检视。

美国内华达大学拉斯维加斯分校政治系教授王宏恩，曾于2016年发表台风假选举政治相关研究。他向[纽约时报](https://cn.nytimes.com/asia-pacific/20261023/taiwan-typhoon-champi-mayors/zh-hant/)表示，在选举年，市长宣布停班停课的可能性会增加31%，因为台风假能在短期内显示官员是否做出正确决策。

“对于人们来说，这是一个非常简单直观的标准，可以评估现任官员做得好还是不好。”王宏恩也表示，当现任官员寻求选举连任时，“人们会记住市长做出的决定是正确还是错误。”

本届地方选举中，全台22个县市共有9位现任县市首长登记参选，争取连任。

2024年发表于《台湾公共行政学报》的[一项研究](https://pa.nccu.edu.tw/upload/2/publication_file/636/66-2%20%E9%99%B3%E6%99%BA%E6%98%86--C.pdf)指出，地方政府决定是否停班停课时，除了依据风雨预测及法规标准，也可能受到政治因素影响。

研究分析2010年至2018年间的案例发现，随着地方首长任期接近尾声，即使风雨条件尚未达到停班停课标准，宣布台风假的机率仍呈上升趋势。相关比例从任期过半时约15%，增加至任期结束前约33%。

但研究指出，首长是否寻求连任，与批准台风假的意愿并无明显关联。研究认为，相较于个人选情，执政者更在意政党整体执政表现可能受到的影响。

研究也表示，除非遭遇极端强烈台风，一般台风造成的灾害未必会对执政者选情带来显著冲击。研究认为，民众可能愈来愈倾向将台风假，视为一项行政决策，而非评价政治人物表现的重要依据。

台北市民陈先生向BBC中文表示，台风假并不会改变他的投票意向，“但是推测市长会想要提高民众对他施政的好感度”。他认为，执政者倾向在数据可支持的范围内，宣布放台风假，以避免届时台风造成未预期的伤亡损害增加对政府的不满。

图像来源，Getty Images

图像加注文字，2026年10月22日，基隆一名女子在岸边拍摄海浪，中度台风蔷琵正逼近台湾。

图像来源，Reuters

图像加注文字，2024年10月2日，台风“山陀儿”（Krathon）逼近台湾高雄之际，孩童在街头玩耍。

## “台风假”制度

台湾所谓的“台风假”，在法律上并非正式假期，部分企业仍可能要求员工出勤或远端工作，这让不少家长头痛。

台北市民陈小姐育有一名四岁孩子，她向BBC中文表示，放台风假最困难是要同时兼顾工作与育儿，“等于两头烧，还要一直想办法让小孩不无聊”。

陈小姐表示，虽然停班停课，但她与丈夫仍需在家远端工作，因此一早便先协调彼此的会议与工作安排，轮流照顾孩子。“一个人陪小孩，另一个人就赶快处理工作、开会；如果两个人同时有事，就只能先让孩子看看电视。”

社群平台Threads上，不少台湾家长分享连续假期的育儿日常，有人列出一整天的活动安排；也有人称，自己上班“不是为了薪水，而是为了休息”，并指“台风假”应为“育婴假”。

根据台湾劳动部规定，若员工工作地或居住地已宣布停班停课，因天灾因素无法出勤，雇主可不发放工资，但不得将其视为旷工或迟到，也不得强制要求请事假或扣发全勤奖金；另一方面，若员工在台风期间照常出勤，亦不违反相关规定。

亚洲各地也有类似机制。中国、菲律宾、香港及澳门等地，都由政府统一发布停班停课或相关防灾安排。

相较之下，日本与韩国并无类似台湾“台风假”的全国性制度，台风侵袭期间，多数民众仍须照常上班上课。日本部分地区如冲绳，则可能因公共交通停驶或地方政府决策，而出现停课或临时停工情况。

title: 從王愛琳案看中共影響力如何滲入美國政治(二)

### 五、新疆案例分析

司法部公布的證據中，最具代表性的案例發生於2021年6月。當時，國際社會正持續關注新疆維吾爾人權問題。

美國及多個西方國家指責中共政府在新疆實施大規模人權侵犯。

中共政府則展開全球宣傳反制。

根據法庭文件，一名中共官員透過微信向王愛琳傳送一篇題為「中國在新疆問題上的立場」的文章。文章內容全面否認相關指控，並將批評中共政府的聲音描述為針對中國的政治攻擊。

收到文章後，王愛琳迅速將其刊登於「美國新聞中心」。隨後向中方回報發布情況，中共官員則回覆表示肯定。

從法律角度看，這一案例的重要性在於證明了內容供應鏈的存在。它不再是單純的媒體立場問題，而是具體顯示了外國政府與平台之間的指揮關係。

### 六、流量回報與績效機制

除了內容發布之外，司法部文件還揭示了另一個值得注意的現象——即閱讀數據回報。

在部分通訊記錄中，中共官員要求對文章進行修改。修改完成後，王愛琳向對方提供文章閱讀量與流量截圖。

這種行為與一般新聞媒體的編輯流程存在明顯差異。正常媒體或許會關注流量數據，但不會向外國政府主管部門匯報閱讀成果。從組織運作角度看，這種模式更接近委託任務執行與成果回報機制。因此，聯邦檢察官認為雙方並非平等合作關係，而存在明顯的上下級結構。

### 七、族裔媒體的影響力價值

從中共官方角度看，為何要投入資源經營海外中文媒體？

原因在於族裔媒體具有特殊的社會功能，許多新移民獲取資訊時仍然依賴母語媒體。

尤其在涉及國際新聞、中國議題以及華人社區事務時，中文媒體往往具有較高影響力。因此，誰能影響中文資訊環境，誰就能在一定程度上影響相關社群的認知。

這並非中國獨有的現象，許多國家都重視海外僑民媒體。然而問題在於：當媒體與政府之間存在隱蔽控制關係，而讀者無從知曉時，其性質便從正常公共外交逐漸轉變為影響力操作。

這也是司法部關注此案的核心原因之一。

### 八、資訊戰的新特徵

王愛琳案顯示，現代資訊戰已經發生明顯變化。

過去人們談論宣傳活動時，往往想到官方報紙、政府電視台或公開發言人。然而，在數位媒體時代，資訊傳播更加分散。小型網站、自媒體、微信群組以及社群平台，都可能成為影響力傳播節點。

因此，現代資訊戰不一定依靠大型媒體機構。相反，眾多看似普通的小型平台往往更容易獲得特定族群信任。

這使資訊戰呈現出去中心化特徵，而「美國新聞中心」正是這種模式的一個典型案例。

## 九、本章小結

王愛琳案中的「美國新聞中心」不僅是一家網站，更是一個資訊傳播節點。

其重要性不在於規模大小，而在於其在外國政府、地方政治與族裔社區之間所扮演的橋梁角色。透過內容供應、新聞包裝與社群傳播，原本來自政府系統的政治訊息得以進入海外華人社會。

從司法部角度看，這正是案件構成外國影響力行動的重要原因。然而，媒體平台只是整個網絡的一部分。

在王愛琳案中，另一個重要角色是孫耀寧及其所涉及的情報搜集活動。

## **第四章 孫耀寧與蔡英文監控事件**

### 一、問題的轉折——從政治宣傳到情報搜集

在王愛琳案中，最初受到關注的是政治宣傳活動。

無論是「美國新聞中心」發布特定內容，還是中共官員透過微信提供宣傳材料，其核心仍然屬於資訊與輿論領域。

然而，聯邦調查後續披露的證據顯示，相關活動並未停留於媒體宣傳層面。

案件中的另一名核心人物孫耀寧（Yaoning 「Mike」 Sun），還參與了對特定政治人物的實地追蹤與資訊搜集活動。其中最受關注的案例，便是2023年台灣總統蔡英文訪問美國期間所發生的監控事件。

這一事件的重要性在於，它顯示相關網絡的活動範圍已超越宣傳工作，而開始進入情報搜集領域。

### 二、孫耀寧的背景與角色

根據美國司法部公布的資料，孫耀寧長期活躍於南加州華人社區。他不僅是王愛琳競選團隊的重要成員，也是「美國新聞中心」的共同運營者之一。

司法部文件顯示，孫耀寧曾在中共軍隊服役。在部分對中共官員提交的材料中，他亦主動提及自己的軍旅背景。雖然公開資料無法證明其曾任職於中共情報機構，但聯邦調查顯示，其與中共官方保持長期聯繫。

在王愛琳案中，孫耀寧扮演的角色並不僅限於媒體運營者。相較於王愛琳主要負責政治與社區層面的活動，孫耀寧更多參與具體執行工作。

因此，在整個網絡中，他實際上更接近行動協調者（Operational Facilitator）的角色。

### 三、蔡英文訪美背景

2023年4月，時任台灣總統蔡英文展開中美洲訪問行程。依照慣例，她在往返途中過境美國。

期間，蔡英文在加州與多位美國政界人士會面，其中包括美國眾議院議長麥卡錫（Kevin McCarthy）。此次訪問受到國際媒體廣泛關注。

北京方面則表達強烈不滿。中共政府長期反對台灣總統以官方身分進行國際活動。

因此，每次台灣高層官員訪美，通常都會引發中共外交與宣傳系統高度關注。也正是在這一背景下，孫耀寧的活動進入聯邦調查人員視野。

### 四、聯邦調查發現的行動模式

根據法庭文件，蔡英文訪美期間，孫耀寧持續搜集與行程有關的資訊。其內容包括：

*   活動地點；
*   時間安排；
*   現場情況；
*   支持群眾數量；
*   抗議活動情況；
*   現場照片與影像記錄。

司法部指出，相關資訊並非僅供個人使用。搜集完成後，孫耀寧透過微信向中共官員進行回報，部分資料屬於即時傳送。

從調查結果看，其運作方式與一般新聞採訪存在明顯差異。

一般媒體工作者關注的是公開報導，而本案中的資訊流向則直接連接至中共官方聯絡人。這也是聯邦調查人員高度重視此案的重要原因。

### 五、從宣傳到情報搜集

從國家安全角度看，宣傳與情報雖然經常被同時討論，但兩者本質並不相同。

宣傳工作的核心目的是影響認知，情報工作的核心目的是獲取資訊。

王愛琳負責的「美國新聞中心」主要服務於前者，而蔡英文事件則顯示相關網絡已涉及後者。

這也是聯邦檢察官在起訴文件中特別強調孫耀寧行為的原因。因為案件所揭示的，不再只是單向訊息傳播，而是出現了資訊回收機制。

在情報工作理論中，這種模式通常被稱為情報循環（Intelligence Cycle）。即：

任務提出；資訊搜集；分析整理；向上級回報；形成決策參考。

聯邦調查認為，孫耀寧的部分活動已呈現出這種特徵。

### 六、跨國鎮壓的延伸問題

除了情報搜集之外，蔡英文事件還涉及另一項近年受到廣泛關注的議題——跨國鎮壓（Transnational Repression）。

所謂跨國鎮壓，是指一國政府在本國境外對異議人士、反對派或特定群體施加壓力的行為。其手段包括：監視；跟蹤；恐嚇；資訊搜集；家屬施壓；輿論攻擊。

近年來，美國司法部已起訴多起與跨國鎮壓有關的案件。蔡英文事件雖然並非典型跨國鎮壓案例，但其所呈現的監控模式與相關案件具有一定相似性。即：

在美國境內搜集政治目標資訊；再將資訊回傳給外國政府。因此，該事件在國安領域受到高度重視。

### 七、司法部如何看待此案

從公開文件可以看出，美國司法部並未將蔡英文事件視為孤立個案。相反地，檢方認為這是整個影響力網絡的一部分。

在司法部的分析框架中：「美國新聞中心」負責敘事與宣傳；王愛琳負責政治與社區層面的影響力；孫耀寧則負責執行與協調工作。三者共同構成一套較完整的運作結構。

因此，聯邦檢察官在後續起訴中，將王愛琳案描述為一個同時涉及宣傳、政治影響與情報活動的綜合性案件。

### 八、孫耀寧的認罪與判刑

2025年10月，孫耀寧承認非法充當外國政府代理人。2026年2月，美國聯邦法院判處其48個月監禁。

根據司法部公告，量刑時法官特別考量了其長期為中共政府執行任務的事實。雖然案件並未指控其從事傳統間諜活動，但法院認為其行為已對美國政治體系與國家安全造成損害。

孫耀寧的認罪，也成為聯邦調查進一步鎖定王愛琳的重要突破口。隨著大量微信記錄與電子資料被取得，整個網絡逐漸浮出水面。最終導致王愛琳於2026年5月認罪並辭去市長職務。

### 九、本章小結

蔡英文監控事件是王愛琳案的重要轉折點。它顯示相關網絡的活動已超越單純的政治宣傳與媒體操作，而開始涉及特定目標的資訊搜集與回報。

從國家安全角度看，這種轉變具有重要意義，因為它反映出現代影響力行動與情報活動之間的界線正在變得模糊。

在許多情況下，政治宣傳、社區工作、媒體經營與情報搜集不再彼此獨立，而是共同構成一套完整的運作體系。

## **第五章 從王愛琳案到****S.Res.444****：美國對中共影響力行動的法律與政治定性**

### 一、王愛琳案為何受到高度重視

從法律層面看，王愛琳案只是一宗違反18 U.S.C. §951（非法外國代理人法）的案件。

然而從政治層面看，其重要性遠超過一般刑事案件。原因在於：該案發生於美國政府對中共黨戰略定位發生重大轉變的背景下。

如果放在二十年前，類似案件很可能被視為一般政治遊說或海外宣傳活動。但在今天，美國司法部與國會已逐漸將此類活動納入國家安全框架進行評估。

因此，要理解王愛琳案，不能只看聯邦法院的起訴文件，還必須觀察美國國會與行政部門對中共的整體認知變化。

### 二、美國對中共認知的轉變

冷戰結束後相當長一段時間內，美國主流政策界普遍相信：中共在融入全球經濟體系後，將逐步向國際規則靠攏。因此，美國長期採取接觸政策（Engagement Policy），然而近十餘年來，這一認知逐漸改變：貿易爭端；網絡攻擊；知識產權爭議；新疆問題；香港問題；台海局勢；跨國鎮壓活動；海外影響力行動。

正是這一切殘酷的現實，使美國兩黨逐步形成新的共識。即：中共已不再被視為單純競爭對手，而是對美國國家利益構成系統性挑戰的力量。

王愛琳案正是在這一背景下受到關注。

### 三、S.Res.444號決議的象徵意義

2026年6月16日，美國參議院以無異議方式通過S.Res.444號決議。

該決議由佛羅里達州共和黨參議員Rick Scott提出。值得注意的是，決議通過時間恰逢中共黨魁習近平73歲生日次日。雖然參議院並未公開說明時間安排原因，但其象徵意義受到廣泛關注。

更重要的是，決議內容反映出美國國會對中共的最新政治判斷。決議中列舉多項指控，包括：新冠疫情資訊隱瞞；芬太尼問題；網絡間諜活動；新疆人權問題；迫害法輪功及活摘法輪功學員器官；西藏問題；香港問題；對台軍事威脅；南海爭議；以及與俄羅斯、伊朗和朝鮮的戰略合作。

決議指出，中共是習近平領導的「犯罪組織」，對全球和平與安全構成重大威脅，並呼籲持續追究相關責任。

### 四、從刑事案件到國家安全問題

王愛琳案之所以受到司法部高度重視，其原因正在於此。

如果從傳統刑法角度觀察：案件涉及的只是文章發布、資訊交流與社區活動。然而從國家安全框架觀察：問題則完全不同。

司法部認為中共政府透過地方政治人物；社區媒體；非營利組織；族裔社團；建立影響力網絡。其目的並非單純宣傳，而是逐步塑造有利於中共官方利益的政治與社會環境。

因此，美國執法機關開始將此類活動視為國家安全問題的一部分，這也是近年來951條案件明顯增加的重要原因。

### 五、18 U.S.C. §951的法律邏輯

王愛琳案主要依據18 U.S.C. §951進行起訴。該法律的核心並不是禁止支持中共，也不是禁止發表親中觀點。而是要求如果一個人在美國境內代表外國政府行動，就必須依法申報。因此，案件真正的爭議點不是政治立場，而是代理關係。

司法部需要證明：中共官員提出要求；王愛琳執行要求；完成後進行回報；雙方形成持續的指揮與服從關係。

一旦證明上述事實存在，即可構成非法外國代理人罪。

### 六、證據鏈如何形成

從公開文件來看，檢方建立了一條完整證據鏈。包括：微信聊天記錄；網站後台資料；文章發布記錄；流量統計資料；中共官員的指示內容；孫耀寧提供的相關證據。

其中最重要的是「任務—執行—回報」模式。例如：中共官員提供新疆宣傳文章；王愛琳發布；向對方回報；提供閱讀數據。

這一完整流程使檢方能夠證明雙方存在代理關係，因此案件最終得以成立。

### 七、從王愛琳案看美國執法新方向

近年來，美國司法部處理中國相關案件的重點正在發生變化。

過去主要集中於：間諜活動；軍事情報；商業機密竊取。

如今則逐步擴展至：地方政治；族裔媒體；跨國鎮壓；社區組織；公共輿論。

這反映出美國國家安全觀念正在轉型，在新的安全框架下，影響力行動本身已被視為戰略競爭的重要組成部分。

因此，王愛琳案不只是一起刑事案件，更是一個觀察美國對中政策變化的重要窗口。

### 八、本章小結

王愛琳案最終得以定罪，法律依據來自18 U.S.C. §951。然而案件受到高度關注的原因，則來自更大的政治背景。2026年參議院通過的S.Res.444號決議顯示，美國國會已將中共視為對美國及全球安全的重要挑戰。

在此背景下，地方政治、族裔媒體與海外影響力活動不再被視為單純社區事務，而被納入國家安全視野。因此，王愛琳案既是一宗法律案件，也是一個戰略信號。它反映出美國政府對中共影響力行動的認知，已從個別事件調查逐步上升為整體國家安全政策的一部分。

# 西藏发生7级强烈地震，据报至少16死、数十人受伤

**Article Information**
*       *   Author, 哈里·塞库利奇（Harry Sekulich）

     和
    *   Author, 碧嘉兰（Laura Bicker）
    *   Role, BBC驻中国记者

*   Published 2026年10月23日凌晨12点15分 最近更新： 19 分钟前
*   阅读时间: 2 分钟

据中国官媒报道，西藏一处山区发生7级强烈地震，造成至少16人死亡、数十人受伤。

新华社引述当地应急管理局报道，地震于周四（10月22日）晚间发生，震央位于西藏那曲市巴青县，距离西藏首府拉萨东北约400公里。

当局已启动地震灾害应急响应，并派遣救援队伍前往灾区。另有32人在地震中受伤。

美国地质调查局（USGS）记录到震央附近发生七次地震活动，全部位于该山区地带。其中规模最大的一次余震为5.2级，震源深度10公里。

与此同时，USGS数据显示，主震震央深度为18公里，震级达7级。据估计，地震发生当晚约有11.1万人感受到中度至强烈震动。

一般而言，震源较浅、接近地表的地震和余震，往往比深层地震造成更严重的破坏。

图像来源，CCTV via Reuters

图像加注文字，消防员协助救援西藏巴青县地震中的伤者。

地震引发山石滚落，导致区内部分道路封闭，令救援人员更难抵达受灾的高海拔地区。西藏昌都和林芝两市亦有强烈震感。

社交媒体上的影片显示，黑夜中当建筑剧烈摇晃时，村民纷纷跑到街上避难。地震于周四深夜发生，其后又接连出现多次强烈余震。

据中国官方媒体报道，至少339间房屋倒塌，相关损毁情况仍在评估中。救援队伍已抵达震央。震中位于海拔超过4,800米的高山地区。

中国官媒新华网报道，国家主席习近平指示全力搜救和伤员救治，最大限度减少人员伤亡。

报道引述习近平称：“灾区地处高海拔地区，天气寒冷，要密切监测震情和天气变化，科学实施救援，防止发生次生灾害。要抓紧调拨抢险救援物资，妥善安置受灾群众，抢修受损基础设施，切实保障人民群众生命财产安全。”

青藏高原是地震频繁发生的地区，过去曾发生造成严重灾情的地震。

2023年，中国邻近的甘肃省山区发生6.2级地震，造成超过120人死亡。

不到两个月前，西藏和尼泊尔亦遭受严重洪水和山泥倾泻侵袭。灾害由冰川崩塌引发，造成至少1,400人死亡，据报仍有数百人失踪。

西藏长期以来一直要求更大的自治权，亦是中国管控最严密的地区之一。

由于外国媒体进入当地受到限制，而当局亦对资讯实施严格审查，每当这类灾难发生时，中国官方媒体往往成为外界获取最新消息和相关细节的主要来源。

# 中共五中全会前瞻：会前为何密集“打虎”？未来怎样“从严治党”？

图像来源，Getty Images

Published 1 小时前

阅读时间: 3 分钟

中共第二十届中央委员会第五次全体会议（五中全会）将于10月26日至29日在北京召开，主题为“全面从严治党”。这是二十一大前一年举行的全会，在反腐持续升温、高级官员接连落马的背景下，外界关注中共如何总结过去的反腐成果，以及是否为明年换届铺路。

会前数月，反腐行动再度密集。8月27日，江西省长叶建春被查；10月13日，已退休的前重庆市长黄奇帆也被宣布接受调查。近年落马的中管干部人数持续攀升。

美国乔治亚州立大学政治学教授安德鲁·魏德曼（Andrew Wedeman）长期研究中国政治与反腐运动。他对BBC中文表示，近几年被查的“老虎”数量屡创新高，反腐的力度和速度远超以往任何时期。“这意味着两件事：第一，反腐运动确实抓到了很多人；第二，它并没有成功发挥威慑作用。”

分析人士认为，北京正透过会前的反腐行动，进一步整顿官僚体系，并处理二十一大前的人事问题。但十三年反腐之后，仍有三个关键问题没有答案：习近平能否让官僚体系真正按他的意志运作？十三年反腐后，腐败是否减少、威慑是否有效？退休官员是否仍有安全空间？

## “党建”主题：从制定政策到落实政策

按照惯例，五中全会本应聚焦下一个五年规划。但本届三中全会延迟，四中、五中全会的议题依次顺延。四中全会已审议通过“十五五”规划建议，五中全会因此承接通常属于六中全会的党建议题。官方已明确，会议将审议《中共中央关于持之以恒推进全面从严治党若干重大问题的决定》。

魏德曼认为，这反映习近平当前最关注的已不只是制定新政策，而是如何确保政策得以落实。习近平近年多次批评地方官员“阳奉阴违”、“自行其是”。在魏德曼看来，北京真正希望解决的不只是腐败，更是官僚体系的执行力。

亚洲协会政策研究所中国政治研究员牛犇（Neil Thomas）在发给BBC中文的电邮中预测，全会后可能出现几项变化：重大项目和财政支出的监管加强，党委书记的问责机制强化，更多利用大数据查处腐败，地方官员面对更严格的监管，纪检部门的权力进一步扩大。

不过他也提醒，如此严厉的问责制度，可能令基层官员更不愿承担风险。

## 十三年反腐，如何继续“从严治党”

中共反腐在习近平2012年底上台之后，开启“风暴”模式，“打虎拍蝇”成为中国人耳熟能详的政治语码。“老虎”通常指中央管理的副部级以上官员；“苍蝇”指查处基层腐败官员。

落马的中管官员人数近年持续攀升，根据中纪委披露，2025 年立案审查调查的中管干部181人，比2024年的92人增加近一倍。同期立案县处级干部4.1万人，立案乡科级干部13.7万人。

魏德曼说：“过去十几年里，习近平的反腐运动累积了惊人的战果，但他并没有赢得这场战争。”他指出，反腐的目的不只是查处，更在形成威慑，让涉腐者收手，让未涉腐者不敢越界，但高官落马数量长期居高不下，说明这一效果没有达到预期。他说，许多今天落马的“老虎”，在中层任上就已涉腐，有的持续十年、十五年，期间不仅逃过查处，还一路升迁。

对于外界所说的“越反越腐”，他并不认为是反腐催生了更多腐败。更准确的说法是，十三年高压反腐，仍未完全改变官员的行为模式。

图像来源，Getty Images

## 被污染的池子中，如何选人？

魏德曼认为，习近平如今面对的，已不再主要是前任时期提拔的官员。“现在他真正不得不面对的，是那些在他任内被提拔上来的人当中的腐败问题。”他形容，习近平把落马的“老虎”清除，再提拔新人接替，却发现自己是在一个已被污染的池子里挑人。在他看来，问题未必只存在于个别官员或特定派系，而可能与整个干部选拔机制有关。

他还留意到，许多落马官员近年公开发表的忏悔录，叙事高度相似：从怀抱理想、服务人民开始，进入体制后逐步受环境影响，最终走向腐败，落马后完成悔悟。他认为，这种公式化的自白，反映官方倾向把腐败归因于个人道德失守。但如果大量官员讲述几乎相同的故事，问题是否仅在个人道德？

他分析，改革开放后的经济高速增长和市场化，改变了官员的激励方式。相比毛泽东时代强调的集体主义和奉献精神，如今许多官员更倾向于把个人、家庭和未来发展纳入考量。习近平透过意识形态教育和党建工作，试图重建官员的服从意识与使命感，但魏德曼认为效果并不明显。

牛犇同样认为，反腐如今已是持续性的组织整顿机制，而不再是派系斗争。于是，五中全会再次强调“全面从严治党”，一个难以回避的问题是：中共能否改变滋生腐败的制度环境和官僚文化，还是只能继续靠更严格的监督与惩罚维持运转？

图像来源，Getty Images

## “安全着陆”不再存在？

会前，叶建春、曾与薄熙来共事的黄奇帆相继被查，外界讨论“安全着陆”是否已不复存在。

香港大学政治与公共行政学系副教授朱江南表示，目前这一轮密集的反腐传递出即使退休、离任也没有所谓安全着陆的讯号，表达中央反腐没有放松的意图。

魏德曼说，他从不相信中共官场存在真正的安全着陆，1995年的陈希同、2006年的陈良宇，以及后来的周永康、薄熙来都是例证。

至于黄奇帆为何落马，他认为目前很难判断：可能与重庆任期有关，可能与上海时期有关，可能与退休后的金融圈人脉有关，也可能纯粹是“政治祭旗”。

牛犇则认为，黄奇帆是专业技术官僚，他的落马显示当下的反腐已超越传统派系划分，更聚焦政治忠诚、风险控制和组织纪律。

五中全会也是观察二十一大前人事布局的重要窗口。近年多名中央委员落马，部分政治局职位出现空缺，这些位置是否会有新安排，是外界关注的焦点。

此外，中国政坛至今没有明确的接班人。魏德曼和牛犇都认为，这反映习近平面临两难：不指定接班人有助维持权威，指定接班人则可能提前形成新的权力中心。

# 西藏發生7級強烈地震，據報至少16死、數十人受傷

Play video, "Rescuers search through rubble after Tibet earthquake", 節目全長 0,41 00:41

音頻加註文字，西藏發生地震後，救援人員在瓦礫堆中搜救。

**Article Information**
*       *   Author, 哈里·塞庫利奇（Harry Sekulich）

     和
    *   Author, 碧嘉蘭（Laura Bicker）
    *   Role, BBC駐中國記者

*   Published 2026年10月23日凌晨12時15分 最近更新： 7 分鐘前
*   閱讀時間: 2 分鐘

據中國官媒報道，西藏一處山區發生7級強烈地震，造成至少16人死亡、數十人受傷。

新華社引述當地應急管理局報道，地震於週四（10月22日）晚間發生，震央位於西藏那曲市巴青縣，距離西藏首府拉薩東北約400公里。

當局已啟動地震災害應急響應，並派遣救援隊伍前往災區。另有32人在地震中受傷。

美國地質調查局（USGS）記錄到震央附近發生七次地震活動，全部位於該山區地帶。其中規模最大的一次餘震為5.2級，震源深度10公里。

與此同時，USGS數據顯示，主震震央深度為18公里，震級達7級。據估計，地震發生當晚約有11.1萬人感受到中度至強烈震動。

一般而言，震源較淺、接近地表的地震和餘震，往往比深層地震造成更嚴重的破壞。

圖像來源，CCTV via Reuters

圖像加註文字，消防員協助救援西藏巴青縣地震中的傷者。

地震引發山石滾落，導致區內部分道路封閉，令救援人員更難抵達受災的高海拔地區。西藏昌都和林芝兩市亦有強烈震感。

社交媒體上的影片顯示，黑夜中當建築劇烈搖晃時，村民紛紛跑到街上避難。地震於週四深夜發生，其後又接連出現多次強烈餘震。

據中國官方媒體報道，至少339間房屋倒塌，相關損毀情況仍在評估中。救援隊伍已抵達震央。震中位於海拔超過4,800米的高山地區。

中國官媒新華網報道，國家主席習近平指示全力搜救和傷員救治，最大限度減少人員傷亡。

報道引述習近平稱：「災區地處高海拔地區，天氣寒冷，要密切監測震情和天氣變化，科學實施救援，防止發生次生災害。要抓緊調撥搶險救援物資，妥善安置受災群眾，搶修受損基礎設施，切實保障人民群眾生命財產安全。」

青藏高原是地震頻繁發生的地區，過去曾發生造成嚴重災情的地震。

2023年，中國鄰近的甘肅省山區發生6.2級地震，造成超過120人死亡。

不到兩個月前，西藏和尼泊爾亦遭受嚴重洪水和山泥傾瀉侵襲。災害由冰川崩塌引發，造成至少1,400人死亡，據報仍有數百人失蹤。

西藏長期以來一直要求更大的自治權，亦是中國管控最嚴密的地區之一。

由於外國媒體進入當地受到限制，而當局亦對資訊實施嚴格審查，每當這類災難發生時，中國官方媒體往往成為外界獲取最新消息和相關細節的主要來源。

# 中共五中全會前瞻：會前為何密集「打虎」？未來怎樣「從嚴治黨」？

圖像來源，Getty Images

Published 1 小時前

閱讀時間: 3 分鐘

中共第二十屆中央委員會第五次全體會議（五中全會）將於10月26日至29日在北京召開，主題為「全面從嚴治黨」。這是二十一大前一年舉行的全會，在反腐持續升溫、高級官員接連落馬的背景下，外界關注中共如何總結過去的反腐成果，以及是否為明年換屆鋪路。

會前數月，反腐行動再度密集。8月27日，江西省長葉建春被查；10月13日，已退休的前重慶市長黃奇帆也被宣布接受調查。近年落馬的中管幹部人數持續攀升。

美國喬治亞州立大學政治學教授安德魯·魏德曼（Andrew Wedeman）長期研究中國政治與反腐運動。他對BBC中文表示，近幾年被查的「老虎」數量屢創新高，反腐的力度和速度遠超以往任何時期。「這意味著兩件事：第一，反腐運動確實抓到了很多人；第二，它並沒有成功發揮威懾作用。」

分析人士認為，北京正透過會前的反腐行動，進一步整頓官僚體系，並處理二十一大前的人事問題。但十三年反腐之後，仍有三個關鍵問題沒有答案：習近平能否讓官僚體系真正按他的意志運作？十三年反腐後，腐敗是否減少、威懾是否有效？退休官員是否仍有安全空間？

## 「黨建」主題：從制定政策到落實政策

按照慣例，五中全會本應聚焦下一個五年規劃。但本屆三中全會延遲，四中、五中全會的議題依次順延。四中全會已審議通過「十五五」規劃建議，五中全會因此承接通常屬於六中全會的黨建議題。官方已明確，會議將審議《中共中央關於持之以恆推進全面從嚴治黨若干重大問題的決定》。

魏德曼認為，這反映習近平當前最關注的已不只是制定新政策，而是如何確保政策得以落實。習近平近年多次批評地方官員「陽奉陰違」、「自行其是」。在魏德曼看來，北京真正希望解決的不只是腐敗，更是官僚體系的執行力。

亞洲協會政策研究所中國政治研究員牛犇（Neil Thomas）在發給BBC中文的電郵中預測，全會後可能出現幾項變化：重大項目和財政支出的監管加強，黨委書記的問責機制強化，更多利用大數據查處腐敗，地方官員面對更嚴格的監管，紀檢部門的權力進一步擴大。

不過他也提醒，如此嚴厲的問責制度，可能令基層官員更不願承擔風險。

## 十三年反腐，如何繼續「從嚴治黨」

中共反腐在習近平2012年底上台之後，開啟「風暴」模式，「打虎拍蠅」成為中國人耳熟能詳的政治語碼。「老虎」通常指中央管理的副部級以上官員；「蒼蠅」指查處基層腐敗官員。

落馬的中管官員人數近年持續攀升，根據中紀委披露，2025 年立案審查調查的中管幹部181人，比2024年的92人增加近一倍。同期立案縣處級幹部4.1萬人，立案鄉科級幹部13.7萬人。

魏德曼說：「過去十幾年裡，習近平的反腐運動累積了驚人的戰果，但他並沒有贏得這場戰爭。」他指出，反腐的目的不只是查處，更在形成威懾，讓涉腐者收手，讓未涉腐者不敢越界，但高官落馬數量長期居高不下，說明這一效果沒有達到預期。他說，許多今天落馬的「老虎」，在中層任上就已涉腐，有的持續十年、十五年，期間不僅逃過查處，還一路升遷。

對於外界所說的「越反越腐」，他並不認為是反腐催生了更多腐敗。更準確的說法是，十三年高壓反腐，仍未完全改變官員的行為模式。

## 被污染的池子中，如何選人？

魏德曼認為，習近平如今面對的，已不再主要是前任時期提拔的官員。「現在他真正不得不面對的，是那些在他任內被提拔上來的人當中的腐敗問題。」他形容，習近平把落馬的「老虎」清除，再提拔新人接替，卻發現自己是在一個已被污染的池子裡挑人。在他看來，問題未必只存在於個別官員或特定派系，而可能與整個幹部選拔機制有關。

他還留意到，許多落馬官員近年公開發表的懺悔錄，敘事高度相似：從懷抱理想、服務人民開始，進入體制後逐步受環境影響，最終走向腐敗，落馬後完成悔悟。他認為，這種公式化的自白，反映官方傾向把腐敗歸因於個人道德失守。但如果大量官員講述幾乎相同的故事，問題是否僅在個人道德？

他分析，改革開放後的經濟高速增長和市場化，改變了官員的激勵方式。相比毛澤東時代強調的集體主義和奉獻精神，如今許多官員更傾向於把個人、家庭和未來發展納入考量。習近平透過意識形態教育和黨建工作，試圖重建官員的服從意識與使命感，但魏德曼認為效果並不明顯。

牛犇同樣認為，反腐如今已是持續性的組織整頓機制，而不再是派系鬥爭。於是，五中全會再次強調「全面從嚴治黨」，一個難以迴避的問題是：中共能否改變滋生腐敗的制度環境和官僚文化，還是只能繼續靠更嚴格的監督與懲罰維持運轉？

## 「安全著陸」不再存在？

會前，葉建春、曾與薄熙來共事的黃奇帆相繼被查，外界討論「安全著陸」是否已不復存在。

香港大學政治與公共行政學系副教授朱江南表示，目前這一輪密集的反腐傳遞出即使退休、離任也沒有所謂安全著陸的訊號，表達中央反腐沒有放鬆的意圖。

魏德曼說，他從不相信中共官場存在真正的安全著陸，1995年的陳希同、2006年的陳良宇，以及後來的周永康、薄熙來都是例證。

至於黃奇帆為何落馬，他認為目前很難判斷：可能與重慶任期有關，可能與上海時期有關，可能與退休後的金融圈人脈有關，也可能純粹是「政治祭旗」。

牛犇則認為，黃奇帆是專業技術官僚，他的落馬顯示當下的反腐已超越傳統派系劃分，更聚焦政治忠誠、風險控制和組織紀律。

五中全會也是觀察二十一大前人事布局的重要窗口。近年多名中央委員落馬，部分政治局職位出現空缺，這些位置是否會有新安排，是外界關注的焦點。

此外，中國政壇至今沒有明確的接班人。魏德曼和牛犇都認為，這反映習近平面臨兩難：不指定接班人有助維持權威，指定接班人則可能提前形成新的權力中心。

title: Ethiopia: Who Protects the Protectors? Inside the Growing Danger for Ethiopia's Humanitarian Workers
summary: Addis Abeba — When humanitarian workers travel to the field, they carry more than food, medicine, or information. They carry the hopes of people facing hunger, displacement, illness, and conflict. Yet, the danger increasingly exposes those
content:
Addis Abeba — When humanitarian workers travel to the field, they carry more than food, medicine, or information. They carry the hopes of people facing hunger, displacement, illness, and conflict. Yet, the danger increasingly exposes those delivering this assistance.

In Ethiopia, humanitarian workers have been killed, kidnapped, threatened, robbed, and caught in crossfire. Some have been abducted for ransom. Others have lost their lives while carrying out routine duties. These are not simply workplace accidents or unfortunate incidents. They raise serious questions about the protection of people who help others survive crises.

The question is simple: Who protects the people who protect others?

Keep up with the latest headlines on [WhatsApp](https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VaIdDi8Bqbr263erhw1K "https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VaIdDi8Bqbr263erhw1K") | [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/allafrica/ "https://www.linkedin.com/company/allafrica/")

Ethiopia needs to move beyond telling aid workers to be careful. It needs a system that prevents avoidable harm, supports those affected, investigates serious incidents, and ensures that national and local responders are not left to carry the risks alone.

**From kidnappings to drone strikes**

Consider the death of Mahelet Sitotaw Abera, a staff member of ORDA Ethiopia. On 20 June 2025, she was collecting humanitarian data in Angot District, North Wollo, when she was critically wounded during crossfire between government forces and non-state armed groups. She died later that day. [The United Nations condemned](https://addisstandard.com/un-condemns-killing-of-aid-worker-in-amhara-calls-for-protection-of-aid-personnel/ "https://addisstandard.com/un-condemns-killing-of-aid-worker-in-amhara-calls-for-protection-of-aid-personnel/") her death and called for the protection of humanitarian personnel.

In 2024, Ethiopian NGO worker Yared Melese was abducted in North Wollo. His kidnappers demanded a ransom. His death was confirmed in August, according to [The New Humanitarian's investigation](https://www.thenewhumanitarian.org/news-feature/2024/09/19/aid-workers-risk-death-kidnap-ethiopia-troubled-amhara-region-fano "https://www.thenewhumanitarian.org/news-feature/2024/09/19/aid-workers-risk-death-kidnap-ethiopia-troubled-amhara-region-fano").

The danger is not limited to national organizations. On 24 June 2021, [three Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) staff members](https://msf.or.ke/news-and-resources/news/deafening-silence-no-accountability-killing-three-msf-staff-tigray-ethiopia "https://msf.or.ke/news-and-resources/news/deafening-silence-no-accountability-killing-three-msf-staff-tigray-ethiopia")--María Hernández Matas, Tedros Gebremariam Gebremichael, and Yohannes Halefom Reda--were killed in Tigray. In June 2026, MSF said the families had still not received the findings of a credible and impartial investigation. MSF's internal review had concluded that the clearly identified humanitarian workers were deliberately targeted.

These incidents are different. Mahelet died during crossfire, Yared was abducted, and MSF maintains that its colleagues were deliberately targeted. They should not be treated as legally identical. But each raises urgent questions about prevention, protection, and accountability.

> No one should have to risk their life simply to help others survive."

The wider situation remains concerning. On 30 September 2026, the [UN Resident and Humanitarian Coordinator in Ethiopia](https://ethiopia.un.org/en/323625-statement-united-nations-resident-and-humanitarian-coordinator-ethiopia-northern-ethiopia "https://ethiopia.un.org/en/323625-statement-united-nations-resident-and-humanitarian-coordinator-ethiopia-northern-ethiopia") reported that at least ten humanitarian vehicles had been seized by armed groups between 2025 and 2026, with only two recovered at the time of the statement. The UN also expressed concern about incidents affecting aid personnel, humanitarian assets, and premises.

The global picture is equally troubling. According to the [Aid Worker Security Database](https://www.aidworkersecurity.org/incidents/report "https://www.aidworkersecurity.org/incidents/report"), 713 major incidents affecting aid workers were recorded in 2025, compared with 637 in 2024. A Reuters report published in August 2026 said that 907 aid workers were killed, injured, or kidnapped in 2025. These figures measure different aspects of violence and should not be confused: one counts recorded incidents, while the other counts people affected.

On [World Humanitarian Day, 19 August 2026](https://www.unocha.org/publications/report/world/world-humanitarian-day-2026-aid-workers-under-fire-armed-drones-transform-war-making-19-august-2026-enarruzh "https://www.unocha.org/publications/report/world/world-humanitarian-day-2026-aid-workers-under-fire-armed-drones-transform-war-making-19-august-2026-enarruzh"), the United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) warned that armed drones were changing the risks faced by humanitarian workers. OCHA reported that 350 aid workers were killed, 322 injured, and 235 kidnapped worldwide in 2025. It also reported that, during the first part of 2026, a further 82 aid workers had been killed, 97 injured, and 39 kidnapped. The message was clear: public condemnation alone is not enough. States and parties to armed conflict must respect international humanitarian law and ensure accountability for violations.

This threat has also become a direct concern in Ethiopia. On 20 September 2026, a humanitarian truck carrying approximately 41 tonnes of food assistance for internally displaced people in Sheraro, northwestern Tigray, was reportedly hit during drone strikes while travelling along a road in the region. Addis Standard [reported](https://eastleighvoice.co.ke/ethiopia/403114/drone-strike-hits-humanitarian-aid-truck-carrying-41-tons-of-food-in-northwestern-tigray "https://eastleighvoice.co.ke/ethiopia/403114/drone-strike-hits-humanitarian-aid-truck-carrying-41-tons-of-food-in-northwestern-tigray") the incident. The truck was transporting food intended for displaced families who depend on humanitarian assistance. Reports differed on the driver's injuries and how much of the cargo was lost, so those details should be treated cautiously.

The attack drew international concern. [Human Rights Watch reported](https://www.hrw.org/news/2026/09/25/ethiopia-indiscriminate-airstrike-in-tigray "https://www.hrw.org/news/2026/09/25/ethiopia-indiscriminate-airstrike-in-tigray") that the United States condemned the strike on the humanitarian convoy. The incident is a serious warning: when humanitarian transport is hit, the danger extends beyond the driver and the vehicle. Food supplies may be lost, deliveries delayed, and already vulnerable families left waiting for assistance. The available reports establish that the convoy was struck, but responsibility for the attack should not be asserted without reliable evidence.

The use of armed drones raises difficult questions for humanitarian protection. A vehicle carrying relief supplies may be exposed to attack even when it is travelling to support civilians. Humanitarian organizations must continually reassess security risks, protect staff and drivers, review routes and movement procedures, and ensure that personnel can stop a journey when conditions become unacceptable. But these measures cannot replace the responsibility of parties to a conflict to respect humanitarian personnel and relief operations under applicable international law.

Behind every statistic is a person, a family, and a community that may lose access to essential assistance. Ethiopia needs credible investigations into serious incidents, public accountability where appropriate, and practical measures to prevent attacks from happening again.

**My Own Experience: Danger does not end when an incident is over**

My concern about aid-worker safety comes not only from reports and statistics but also from what I personally experienced while travelling through a conflict-affected area.

On one occasion, armed men wearing military-style uniforms stopped several vehicles along the road. At first, we assumed they were government security personnel conducting a routine checkpoint inspection. We soon realized they were members of a non-state armed group impersonating security personnel.

They ordered all passengers to get off the vehicles and lie face-down in muddy water beside the road. We were forced to remain there, unable to raise our heads, fearing for our lives. When a woman and two male passengers objected to the order, one of the armed men shot them. All three died in front of us.

The armed men then took passengers' mobile phones, money, jewelry, watches, and other valuables. Several vehicles, including other buses, were looted.

When we were finally released, I discovered that I had lost my laptop, camera, tablet, clothing, and other belongings. More painfully, I lost months of humanitarian assessment data, photographs, field documentation, and research materials. Their loss disrupted my work and meant that valuable information gathered in the field could no longer be used without significant effort to recover or reconstruct it.

The effects went beyond material loss. I had witnessed three people being killed and feared for my own life. The experience reminded me that surviving a security incident does not mean its consequences end when the immediate danger passes.

I share this experience because incident reports cannot fully capture the human cost of insecurity. Behind the statistics are people whose lives, families, work, and sense of safety are changed forever. When aid workers are attacked or robbed, humanitarian operations and the communities depending on them can also suffer.

This must lead to action. Governments and parties to armed conflict must respect humanitarian personnel and their work. Humanitarian organizations and donors must provide realistic resources for staff protection, emergency support, and care for survivors and families. Serious incidents must be investigated, and those responsible must be held accountable where the evidence supports it.

Protecting aid workers is not simply about protecting organizations or projects. It is about preserving the lifeline between people in crisis and the assistance they need. No one should have to risk their life simply to help others survive.

**Why do aid workers remain at risk?**

There is no single explanation. In conflict areas, humanitarian workers may be caught in fighting, deliberately attacked, kidnapped for ransom, or threatened because their work is misunderstood or politicized. Vehicles, supplies, and equipment may also be seized.

Elsewhere, risks may arise from crime, extortion, administrative restrictions, community disputes, misinformation, or pressure from powerful local actors. The danger is not only about the threats workers face. It is also about how organizations prepare for them.

Three factors help explain why the same environment can be more dangerous for some workers than for others. First, "threat" refers to the possibility of harm, such as armed violence, kidnapping, or detention. Second, exposure concerns how often and in what circumstances workers encounter that threat. Third, vulnerability describes the factors that make harm more likely or make it harder to prevent and respond to an incident.

These are common elements of humanitarian security risk management. | 台湾 | 7.9% | 6.0% |
| 不知道或没有意见 | 11.3% | 13.2% |

开源执行环境Node.js 10月21日为22.x、24.x和26.x三个版本线发布安全更新，修补10个漏洞；程序语言Go 10月20日也发布紧急更新，拒绝任何经过8个中间证书机构密钥的证书链。台湾数位发展部资通安全署10月22日说，已透过资安警讯等联防网络，要求各级公务机关和关键基础设施限期完成清查和修补。

受影响的是用Node.js和Go写成的网站和服务：资安署说，Node.js广泛用于网页前端工具链、后端微服务和各类API服务器。资安署说，Node.js这次修补的10个漏洞里有4个属高风险；最严重的是Brotli解码器的越界写入漏洞，Node.js说它可能被用来远程执行代码，只要程序解压攻击者控制的Brotli数据就会暴露。

公开的概念验证程序只在故意削弱的测试版本上做到执行代码；到10月22日，还没有这个漏洞在实际中被利用的报告。修补后的版本是22.23.4、24.22.1和26.12.1；20.x和更早的版本已停止支持，不会得到修补，这个漏洞也没有临时的应对办法。

zh_title: 美光桃园工会代表在台中交易后开始象征性“罢工” - 焦点台湾
summary: 中新网台北10月22日电 美国内存芯片制造商美光科技桃园工厂的11名工会官员周四开始24小时“罢工”，指责该公司未能提供具体的利润分享方案，并批评一天前与台中工会达成的协议。桃园工会周一宣布了有限的罢工行动，以声援台中工会，台中工会原定于周四与美光进行调解谈判。然而，美光科技与台中工会周三下午宣布，双方已签署劳资协议
content:
中新网台北10月22日电 美国内存芯片制造商美光科技桃园工厂的11名工会官员周四开始24小时“罢工”，指责该公司未能提供具体的利润分享方案，并批评一天前与台中工会达成的协议。

桃园工会周一宣布了有限的罢工行动，以声援台中工会，台中工会原定于周四与美光进行调解谈判。

然而，美光科技与台中工会于周三下午宣布，已签署劳资协议，并取消周四的调解会议。当时并未透露细节。

桃园工会周三晚间证实，11名工会官员将参加计划中的一日罢工，罢工时间为周四上午9点至周五上午9点。

[● 美光与台中工会劳资谈判达成协议](https://focustaiwan.tw/business/202610210014)

## 桃园工会批评协议

周四上午，在美光桃园工厂外举行的新闻发布会上，工会主席林哲瑞批评美光、劳工部 (MOL) 和中科局将桃园工会排除在谈判之外。

林说，两工会共同提出了四项要求，但桃园工会代表及其观点“没有充分纳入谈判”，导致仅与台中工会达成协议。
林说：“劳工部的责任应该是保护工人的权利。”他认为，劳工部不应优先考虑达成协议而不考虑桃园工会的观点。

林还对报道的协议投票结果提出异议，他说最终以九票赞成、两票反对和一张无效票结束。

他认为，应该允许12名桃园代表投票，这样一来，投票结果将达到9票赞成、14票反对、1票无效，这意味着“不应该达成共识”。

林说，当被问及协议条款时，美光科技提到了保密义务。

桃园总工会副主席曲佳云形容该协议“令人震惊”，并指责商船三井通过片面谈判帮助美光“分裂工人”。

## 利润分享要求

“我们的四项要求从未改变”，林说，并敦促美光提出具体建议。

争议的焦点是美光科技的激励薪酬计划（IPP），工会称该计划缺乏透明度。工会正在寻求一种长效机制，将公司营业利润的15%分配给员工。

工会秘书长魏豫绫表示，这次罢工从周四上午9点持续到周五上午9点，并不是为了扰乱生产，但警告说，未来可能会有更多工人加入罢工行动。
美光在桃园雇用了约 3,000 名员工，在台中雇用了 12,300 名员工，其中 2,335 名和约 11,000 名员工属于各自的当地工会。

10月7日，桃园工会获得罢工授权，2,012名投票会员中有1,994名支持罢工。

工会还呼吁成员在定于周四上午 10 点举行的全公司会议后投票决定是否接受美光提出的条款。

桃园工会与美光科技定于下午1点在桃园市政府恢复谈判。据魏说，周五。

【原文 English Original】
Taipei, Oct. 22 (CNA) Eleven union officials at U.S. memory chipmaker Micron Technology Inc.'s Taoyuan operations began a 24-hour "strike" Thursday, accusing the company of failing to offer a concrete profit-sharing proposal and criticizing an agreement reached with its Taichung union a day earlier.

The Taoyuan union announced the limited industrial action Monday in solidarity with its Taichung counterpart, which had been scheduled to hold mediation talks with Micron on Thursday.

However, Micron and the Taichung union announced Wednesday afternoon that they had signed a labor-management agreement and canceled Thursday's mediation meeting. Details were not disclosed at the time.

The Taoyuan union confirmed Wednesday evening that 11 union officials would participate in the planned one-day strike, which would run from 9 a.m. Thursday to 9 a.m. Friday.

[● Micron, Taichung union reach deal in labor talks](https://focustaiwan.tw/business/202610210014)

## Taoyuan union criticizes agreement

At a news conference outside Micron's Taoyuan facility on Thursday morning, union Chairman Jerry Lin (林哲瑞) criticized Micron, the Ministry of Labor (MOL) and the Central Taiwan Science Park Bureau for excluding the Taoyuan union from the negotiations.

Lin said the two unions had jointly formulated four demands, but Taoyuan union representatives and their views "were not adequately included in the negotiations," resulting in an agreement being reached solely with the Taichung union.

"The MOL's responsibility should be to protect workers' rights," Lin said, arguing that the ministry should not prioritize reaching an agreement over considering the Taoyuan union's views.

Lin also disputed the reported vote on the agreement, which he said ended with nine votes in favor, two against and one invalid ballot.

He argued that 12 Taoyuan representatives should have been allowed to vote, which would have brought the tally to nine in favor, 14 against and one invalid ballot, meaning "there should have been no consensus."

Lin said Micron had cited confidentiality obligations when asked about the agreement's terms.

Qu Jia-yun (曲佳雲), vice chair of the Taoyuan Confederation of Trade Unions, described the agreement as "shocking" and accused the MOL of helping Micron "divide workers" through one-sided negotiations.

## Profit-sharing demands

"Our four demands have never changed," Lin said, urging Micron to present concrete proposals.

At the center of the dispute is Micron's Incentive Pay Plan (IPP), which the union says lacks transparency. The union is seeking a long-term mechanism under which 15 percent of the company's operating profits would be distributed to employees.

Union Secretary-General Wei Yu-ling (魏豫綾) said the strike, running from 9 a.m. Thursday to 9 a.m. Friday, was not intended to disrupt production, but warned that more workers could join future industrial action.

Micron employs approximately 3,000 workers in Taoyuan and 12,300 in Taichung, with 2,335 and around 11,000 belonging to their respective local unions.

On Oct. 7, the Taoyuan union secured strike authorization, with 1,994 of 2,012 voting members supporting industrial action.

The union also called on members to vote on whether they accepted Micron's proposed terms following a company-wide meeting scheduled for 10 a.m. Thursday.

Negotiations between the Taoyuan union and Micron are scheduled to resume at the Taoyuan City Government at 1 p.m. Friday, according to Wei.

[● Micron Taoyuan union announces Oct. 22 solidarity strike](https://focustaiwan.tw/business/202610200021)

## Government, company responses

The MOL said Thursday afternoon that Wednesday's negotiations between Micron and the Taoyuan union had ended without an agreement, adding that it respected the union's legal right to strike.

The ministry said it had participated in the talks at the Taoyuan city government's invitation and would continue facilitating negotiations.

At an online news conference Thursday, Micron Taiwan Chairman Donghui Lu (盧東暉) said the agreement with the Taichung union included a new quarterly profit-sharing bonus linked to company earnings, in addition to its existing IPP.

Lu said the company would also implement further structural salary adjustments, increase shift allowances, provide three additional days of paid leave and raise its labor pension contribution rate from 8 percent to 10 percent.

Regarding the Taoyuan strike, Lu said Micron respected the industrial action and appreciated the union officials' rational and restrained approach to expressing their demands.

He said the company would continue communicating with the union in hopes of reaching a mutually acceptable outcome.

# 台湾陆委会说将修《反渗透法》 补上受中共指示跟监伤人的漏洞

茉莉花综合报道 2026年10月23日 03:15

台湾大陆委员会副主委兼发言人梁文杰10月22日在例行记者会上说，政府正在研议修正《反渗透法》等法规，补上反制中共跨境镇压的法律漏洞，修法版本应该很快就会提出；他希望行政院提出版本后，朝野各党立委都能支持。

梁文杰说，现行《反渗透法》对接受中共指示而跟监或伤害他人的行为没有规范。以相声演员黄逸豪案为例，检方只能对跟监适用《个人资料保护法》，伤害行为依伤害罪处理，接受中共指示的部分，现行法律没有涵盖。他说，跨境镇压的样态很多，包括跟踪、教唆，必须把漏洞补起来。

新北地检署侦结黄逸豪被境外人士出资策划假车祸的案件，依涉嫌重伤害未遂、违反个资法等罪起诉5人，并说5名被告涉嫌接受昵称“K”的大陆地区人士指示和资金。黄逸豪2025年12月上传短片讽刺习近平；今年5月29日他演出当天，演出场地被人泼粪弹，台北地检署认定涉及中共跨境镇压。检方查出，“K”今年7月出资45万元，委托一名前征信业者收集黄逸豪的个人资料和行踪，企图阻止他演出。
