title: 100欧元当中共弃子被遣返 15年内禁返意大利(图)  -  时评 - 陈静
summary: 米兰大教堂 和米兰大教堂广场。（图片来源： muratart/ stock.adobe.com） 按：从米兰马尔彭萨机场的当场落网，到老家每月2200元工资的网格员：极权“长臂管辖”背后，那些被当作破抹布随手扔掉的海外**[跨国镇压](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E8%B7%A8%E5%9B%BD%E9%95%87%E5%8E%8B)**的帮凶，如今后悔不已。 ## **米兰马尔彭萨国际机场的遣返** 2026年8月下旬的
content:
米兰大教堂 和米兰大教堂广场。（图片来源： muratart/ stock.adobe.com）

按：从米兰马尔彭萨机场的当场落网，到老家每月2200元工资的网格员：极权“长臂管辖”背后，那些被当作破抹布随手扔掉的海外**[跨国镇压](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E8%B7%A8%E5%9B%BD%E9%95%87%E5%8E%8B)**的帮凶，如今后悔不已。

## **米兰马尔彭萨国际机场的遣返**

2026年8月下旬的一个清晨，米兰马尔彭萨国际机场（Milan Malpensa Airport）的入境大厅依旧人流如织。初秋的亚平宁阳光穿透高耸的玻璃幕墙，照在一位40多岁的浙江籍华人女子身上。她右手紧紧攥着8岁女儿稚嫩的小手，左手拉着沉重的行李箱，脸上带着某种自以为风平浪静后的松弛感。

一年前，当意大利警方雷霆收网时，她急急忙忙买票逃回国内避风头；如今一年过去，她以为欧洲人忘性大，风头早已过了，这才满心期待地带着女儿重返意大利，想要继续她那经营了整整12年、儿女成群、月入5000欧元的米兰安逸生活。

[![Image 2](https://img6.secretchina.com/pic/2025/7-29/p3676411a560438137.jpg)](https://www.naturenergy.us/)

然而，当她把护照递进边检柜台的刹那，警报在终端屏幕上骤然亮起。没有电影里的喧嚣追逐，只有几名神色冷峻的意大利国家警察与反恐部（DIGOS）探员缓步上前，将她与女儿隔开。

探员当场向她宣读了由意大利内政部签发的特级行政法令：依法永久注销其欧盟长期居留许可（绿卡），自即日起驱逐出境，并在未来15年内，严禁再次踏入意大利及任何申根区国家一步。那扇通往自由世界的旋转门在她眼前轰然闭锁，等待她和女儿的，是边防警察原机押送返回中国的刺骨冰冷。

## **8小时[100欧元](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/100%E6%AC%A7%E5%85%83) 一笔将全家前途砸得粉碎的“廉价外快”**

这位中年女子可能直到被押上返航客机那一刻，都没能想明白：自己究竟是如何从一个在欧洲安居乐业的华商家庭主妇，沦为国际反恐情报部门黑名单上的跨国危险分子的？

答案可能荒诞得令人窒息，仅仅是因为无知和那区区100欧元。

根据意大利知名主流大报《页报》（Il Foglio）的后续披露以及知情人士的细节还原，该女子平日活跃于米兰某华人商会的外围社交圈。一次在微信“老乡群”的闲聊里，一位颇有面子、整日把“爱国统战、替祖国办事”挂在嘴边的侨社上线，神神秘秘地给她塞了一桩“私活”：去跟踪、盯梢并偷拍一名居住在当地的中国人，记录其住所门牌、常去的超市路线以及日常接触的人员。任务时长8小时，当天结算，报酬是100欧元（约合800元人民币）。

在米兰，一个普通的华人小餐馆服务生或者服装工厂剪线工，辛苦一天也能拿到80-100欧元。这名女子家境并不缺钱，夫妻俩在意大利打拼了10余年，每月合法收入在5000欧元上下，3个孩子在当地享受着优质免费的公立教育和全民免费医疗。然而，面对这100欧元的蝇头小利，加上微信群里那种“替国家教训海外反华分子”的廉价狂热，她没有丝毫犹豫便欣然接单。

她拿着手机，躲在米兰街头的梧桐树影和咖啡馆廊柱后，鬼祟地将镜头对准了目标。她以为自己只是在打一份无伤大雅的“零工”，既能在老乡面前讨个好彩头，又能顺手赚张菜票；她浑然不知，自己已经一只脚踏进了意大利反恐司法体系的严打绞索。

## **被盯梢的目标与意大利警方的雷霆收网**

她奉命跟踪的这个“目标”，不是别人，正是近年来在社交平台X（原推特）上令北京维稳高层寝食难安的著名异议博主——“李老师不是你老师”，真实名字为李颖（以下称李颖）。

自2022年岁末那场点燃海内外的“白纸运动”以来，李颖凭借一人之力，成为打破中国信息黑箱的最强中继站。无数在墙内被404、被封杀的底层抗争、群体事件、烂尾楼维权、银行暴雷惨剧，皆经由他的帐号第一时间公之于世，但在中共国安与统战体系眼里，他成了拔之而后快的“眼中钉、肉中刺”。

为了摸清李颖在意大利的真实行踪、住所和社交轨迹，中共情治部门放弃了成本高昂且极易引发外交海啸的专职特工，转而打起了“情报分包、海外淘宝化”的算盘。他们通过长期渗透的海外同乡会、华人商会、甚至某些打着中文资讯旗号的侨民门户网站，将搜集情报、实地踩点、言语骚扰等见不得光的脏活，层层下包给贪图小利或头脑发热的底层侨民和小粉红。

可惜，中共显然低估了意大利政府对捍卫国家主权的决心。早年间，意大利曾因签署“一带一路”倡议备忘录和默许设立所谓“海外警察站”而备受国际诟病；但随着近年欧洲对中共跨国长臂管辖的集体警醒，罗马当局的态度发生了180度的大转弯。

事实上，这可不是意大利警方第一次出手了。早在今年3月份，意大利政府就已经一口气驱逐了另外8名涉嫌参与针对李老师跨国镇压行动的华人，其中包括在意大利当地的华人餐馆老板、商会成员或者家庭主妇，他们背后都接受统一的遥控和指令。

在法治文明国家，任何未经司法授权、受外国政府操纵针对合法居留者进行的跟踪、偷拍、滋扰与情报采集，直接构成对该国主权与人身安全的严重侵害，属于重大刑事与危害国家安全行为，绝非所谓“民间爱国热心”。

## **弃子悲歌 每月2200元的网格员宿命**

如果说被米兰机场当场驱逐是命运的当头棒喝，那么回到中国后的魔幻遭遇，才真正让这名女子体会到了什么叫作“极权的彻骨冰凉”。

根据当事人近期在网络上的泣血自述与多方爆料，回到老家后，她感到天旋地转、冤屈难伸。为了全家能出国扎根、拿到这张珍贵的欧洲绿卡，当年年迈的父母倾其所有，借遍了亲戚，甚至背负了沉重的债务。如今，十几年的积蓄与心血在一夜之间归零，15年不得踏入欧洲，3个年幼孩子留在意大利无人照料，自己的丈夫也陷入了生活停摆的深渊。在宗族亲友与老家街坊眼中，她从原本光宗耀祖的“海外华侨”，沦为了人人耻笑避之的“倒霉特务”。

崩溃之余，她天真地以为自己是“为国出差”、“为了组织的爱国事业而牺牲”。她心想：即便当不上座上宾，组织上总该给点安家费、安排个体面的退路吧？

她颤抖着拨打当初在米兰酒桌上给她派单的商会头目和情治上线电话，听筒里传来的却是冷冰冰的空号；点开微信，平日里满嘴“祖国是你们坚强后盾”的大佬们，早已把她彻底拉黑删除。在极权的黑箱机器里，一旦一颗螺丝钉生了锈、暴露在阳光下，最迅速的处理方式就是直接丢进垃圾桶，生怕溅自己一身泥。

在多番奔走、甚至求助于地方相关统战部门后，当局最终扔给这位“海外功臣”的补偿，简直是时代最辛辣的讽刺：安排她在老家城镇担任一名基层“社区网格员”。

这份工作每个月的薪水只有区区2200元人民币，在如今地方财政濒临枯竭的内地县城，这笔微薄的工资还经常被拖欠两三个月。她每天穿着蓝马甲，在狭窄老旧的居民楼间爬上爬下，挨家挨户登记水电煤气、排查流动人口、催缴物业费，还要时刻面对邻里的冷眼。从米兰街头每月5000欧元的欧洲生活，到每个月2200元且常常欠薪的网格员，这100欧元的代价，何其惨烈！

## **极权体系下的“人肉耗材”与海外粉红的迷思**

这起看似荒诞绝伦的米兰遣返案，恰恰撕开了当下中共海外渗透体系最残酷也最丑陋的一面。正如海外社交平台上无数网友一针见血的辣评：“粉红最大的悲哀，就是用着搬砖的智商，去操着中南海的心。在自由世界，你是人人喊打的告密者；在极权眼里，你只是一块用完即扔的破抹布。”

中共海外长臂管辖的“极度廉价化与流氓化”。以往人们谈起间谍，想到的都是精心培训、领取高薪、享受外交豁免的外交官或职业特工。但今天的中共情治系统，早已把跨境镇压演变成了某种“情报拼多多”。

他们用几十、上百欧元的蝇头小利，诱使那些缺乏法治观念、对中共本质一无所知的海外底层侨民充当眼线。高层官员在报表上填写战功、贪污巨额维稳经费，而冲在最前线被抓、被审判、被驱逐的，全是这些几十欧元就出卖良知的“底层炮灰”。

而海外侨胞长期生活在自由世界，却患上了严重的“法治认知失调症”。这名女子在意大利生活了整整12年，呼吸着自由的空气，享受着民主国家的福利保障，思维却依旧停留在墙内那种“告密有理、替党分忧”的丛林逻辑里。

她以为在欧洲也可以像在中国一样，随意跟踪公民、肆意侵犯他人隐私而不受惩罚。西方社会的包容与宽容，绝不意味着毫无底线；当法治国家的安全底线被践踏时，司法的铁拳从不会手软。

意大利此番的坚决表态，是整个西方文明世界对中共海外渗透的全面觉醒。15年的驱逐禁令，意味着在整个申根信息系统（SIS）中，该女子已被列为高危管控人员。这不仅仅是她个人的悲剧，更是一记敲响的警钟，给所有海外亲共侨团、商会负责人以及潜在的告密者：任何企图将专制恶行带到自由世界的爪牙，都将付出失去身份、名誉扫地、终身无法返回自由世界的毁灭性代价。

## **用一生的自由 去赌极权的一张空头支票**

世间因果，循环不爽。100欧元，在米兰不过是一顿普通的双人晚餐；但就是这100欧元，买断了一位母亲在欧洲12年所有的生活沉淀，葬送了全家3代人砸锅卖铁换来的合法居留，更彻底切断了3个年幼子女未来的上升坦途。

这不是天意弄人，而是极权历史中反复上演的宿命剧目。凡是投靠专制、与狼共舞者，从来没有一个能获得体面的善终。但愿这100欧元买来的15年禁令，能成为所有依旧沉醉在“海外爱国”幻梦中的华人同胞，最痛切的一剂清醒剂：千万不要用自己一生的自由与子孙的前途，去为极权的长臂管辖做最下贱、最廉价的垫脚石。

title: KMT's Chiang touts mayoral record at Taipei campaign HQ opening event - Focus Taiwan
zh_title: 国民党蒋介石在台北竞选总部开幕活动上宣扬市长纪录 - 聚焦台湾
summary: 中新社台北10月26日电 台北市市长蒋万安周一在竞选总部开幕式上强调了他的政府所取得的成就，并承诺继续推动首都向前发展，以争取在11月28日的地方选举中连任。这位国民党市长在竞选总部旁边的台北敦化国中举行的集会上发表讲话，强调了台北今年早些时候获得的李光耀世界城市奖特别提及奖，以及英伟达去年决定在首都设立首个海外总部的决定。他还列举了倡议
content:
中新社台北10月26日电 台北市市长蒋万安周一在竞选总部开幕式上强调了他的政府所取得的成就，并承诺继续推动首都向前发展，以争取在11月28日的地方选举中连任。

这位国民党市长在竞选总部旁边的台北敦化国中举行的集会上发表讲话，强调了台北今年早些时候获得的李光耀世界城市奖特别提及奖，以及英伟达去年决定在首都设立首个海外总部的决定。

他还列举了一些举措，包括为学童提供免费牛奶、免费学校午餐、减少公共场所吸烟的措施以及六个捷运项目的进展。

蒋说：“作为市长，我不仅着眼于接下来几周的竞选活动，而且着眼于台北 20 年后的未来。”他呼吁继续投资人工智能 (AI) 和城市发展。

蒋介石还承认，​​一些支持者对竞选活动表示焦虑，称自己“可能有点太诚实”、“有时有点无聊”，但他表示，他不会仅仅为了赢得选票而创造新的公众形象。

他说：“四年前你们选择的蒋万安，就是今天站在这个舞台上的蒋万安。”
与蒋介石一起参加集会的还有国民党主席郑丽文、立法院院长韩国瑜和台湾人民党主席黄国昌等多位知名政治人物。

支持者的观点

参加此次活动的数千人中包括 44 岁的医疗行业工人 Edison Yang，他是三个 10 至 16 岁女儿的父亲。

杨告诉中央社，虽然他并不总是国民党的支持者，但他在这次选举中支持蒋介石，因为他认可他作为市长的表现，包括惠及像他这样的家庭的政策。

这位台北居民赞扬了该市的免费牛奶计划，该计划每周向符合条件的2至15岁儿童提供一瓶牛奶或豆奶，以及减少接触二手烟的措施，包括安装室外负压吸烟室。

杨说，蒋介石不太擅长宣传自己的成就，并补充说，网上的负面评论促使他参加集会，“以行动表示支持”。

另一位与会者、70 岁的退休政府雇员、前职业军官蒋大卫 (David Jiang) 称自己是“顽固的”国民党支持者。

这位信义区居民称赞市长上任不到一年就启用了台北巨蛋，并为吸引英伟达海外总部落户该市做出了努力。
他还大力支持蒋万安搬迁台北松山机场的建议，认为此举可以腾出土地进行重建，并缓解内湖科技园区周围的交通拥堵。

市长于 10 月 8 日宣布了该提案，概述了将约 300 公顷的机场用地及周边地区改造为“人工智能公园”的计划，以及绿地和住宅开发项目。

“如果这是一项惠及大多数人的好政策，我们就应该支持，”蒋大卫说。

由于松山机场连接台湾北部与澎湖、金门和马祖等离岛，该提议引起了跨党派政界人士和中央政府官员对交通和医疗后送的担忧。

台湾地方选举

【原文 English Original】
Taipei, Oct. 26 (CNA) Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an (蔣萬安) highlighted his administration's achievements and pledged to continue moving the capital forward at the opening of his campaign headquarters Monday, as he seeks a second term in the Nov. 28 local elections.

Speaking at a rally at Dunhua Junior High School in Taipei, next to the campaign headquarters, the Kuomintang (KMT) mayor highlighted Taipei's receipt of a Lee Kuan Yew World City Prize Special Mention earlier this year and Nvidia's decision last year to establish its first overseas headquarters in the capital.

He also cited initiatives including free milk for schoolchildren, free school lunches, measures to reduce smoking in public spaces and progress on six MRT projects.

"As mayor, I'm not just looking at the next few weeks of the election campaign, but at Taipei's future 20 years from now," Chiang said, calling for continued investment in artificial intelligence (AI) and urban development.

Chiang also acknowledged that some supporters had expressed anxiety over the election campaign, describing himself as "perhaps a little too honest" and "sometimes a bit boring," but saying he would not create a new public persona simply to win votes.

"The Chiang Wan-an you chose four years ago is the same Chiang Wan-an standing on this stage today," he said.

Chiang was joined at the rally by several prominent political figures, including KMT Chairwoman Cheng Li-wun (鄭麗文), Legislative Speaker Han Kuo-yu (韓國瑜) and Taiwan People's Party Chairman Huang Kuo-chang (黃國昌).

Supporters' views

Among the thousands attending the event was Edison Yang, a 44-year-old medical industry worker and father of three daughters aged 10 to 16.

Yang told CNA that although he was not always a KMT supporter, he backed Chiang in this election because he approved of his performance as mayor, including policies benefiting families like his own.

The Taipei resident praised the city's free milk program, which provides one bottle of milk or soy milk per week to eligible children aged 2 to 15, as well as measures to reduce exposure to secondhand smoke, including the installation of outdoor negative-pressure smoking rooms.

Yang said Chiang was not very good at promoting his achievements, adding that negative commentary online had motivated him to attend the rally to "show his support through action."

Another attendee, David Chiang, a 70-year-old retired government employee and former career military officer, described himself as a "die-hard" KMT supporter.

The Xinyi District resident praised the mayor for opening the Taipei Dome less than a year after he took office and his efforts to attract Nvidia's overseas headquarters to the city.

He also expressed strong support for Chiang Wan-an's proposal to relocate Taipei Songshan Airport, arguing that it could free up land for redevelopment and ease traffic congestion around the Neihu Technology Park.

The mayor announced the proposal on Oct. 8, outlining plans to transform approximately 300 hectares of airport land and surrounding areas into an "AI park," alongside green spaces and residential developments.

"If it's a good policy that benefits most people, we should support it," David Chiang said.

The proposal has raised concerns among politicians across party lines and central government officials over transportation and medical evacuations, as Songshan Airport connects northern Taiwan with the outlying islands of Penghu, Kinmen and Matsu.

Taiwan's local elections

Chiang Wan-an is facing Democratic Progressive Party candidate Puma Shen (沈伯洋) in the Nov. 28 mayoral election.

The elections are also known as the "9-in-1" elections because voters in Taiwan's 22 cities and counties will cast ballots for candidates vying for nine different local government posts, including city mayors, county magistrates, and city and county councilors.

Other positions being contested include township chiefs, chiefs of Indigenous districts in municipalities, township councilors, Indigenous councilors in municipalities and ward chiefs.

In total, elections will be held for 11,051 officials at all levels of local government.

(By Sunny Lai)

# Hong Kong to set up drug regulator, experts call for rare disease focus

Hong Kong will establish a drug and medical devices regulator by end of 2026. Experts urge the new agency to prioritise rare disease drug approvals, reduce patient costs, and recruit international talent to speed up reviews.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 26 Oct 2026 at 08:12 HKT · 1 min read

Hong Kong’s Drug and Medical Devices Regulatory Centre will be set up by the end of 2026, with Li Zili appointed as its director, the government announced.

Penny Peng of the Community Organisation for Social Development said Li’s connections in mainland China and overseas could help the city create an internationally recognised approval mechanism. She hopes the centre will introduce a “first-tier review” system to independently approve new drug registrations, bringing in more oncology and rare disease medicines to ease patients’ financial burden.

Lam Shun-chiu, founder of Hei Wah Pharmaceutical, recommended the centre first focus on approving new drugs for rare diseases. He also urged it to work with international drug regulators to set common standards for emerging fields such as gene therapy and cell therapy. Drug evaluation is a highly specialised field, Lam noted, and the centre should recruit talent from mainland China or abroad, including people who have worked at regulatory agencies or major pharmaceutical firms, to build a cross-disciplinary team and further shorten review times.

Chan Soo-kuen, senior executive director of the Hong Kong Research Pharmaceutical Manufacturers Association, said Hong Kong could act as a super-connector. If the centre can build an efficient and trustworthy evaluation system that serves both local and international markets, it could also help bring innovative drugs from overseas into Hong Kong.

# Police urge extra travel time as new Huanggang Port sees heavy traffic

Hong Kong police warned of severe congestion at the new Huanggang Port on Sunday evening, with travellers facing 25-minute waits to reach drop-off zones. Crowd and traffic control measures were deployed. Traffic returned to normal by early Monday morning.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 26 Oct 2026 at 02:58 HKT · updated 26 Oct, 04:25 · 1 min read

Police have urged travellers heading to the new [Huanggang Port](https://clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Huanggang-Port-congestion-prompts-calls-for-staffing-review-430465) to allow extra time, with traffic at the Hong Kong-side building very busy on Sunday night.

In a social media post, police said large numbers of travellers were using different modes of transport to reach the port, causing congestion on connecting roads, and that crowd and traffic control measures were in place.

Vehicles were waiting an average of about 25 minutes to reach the port's drop-off area, police said, urging travellers to be patient, follow instructions from officers and security staff, and allow sufficient time.

In an update around 1am, police said cross-boundary vehicle traffic at the new [Huanggang Port](https://clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Huanggang-Port-sets-record-152-000-trips-on-Chung-Yeung-Fest-7b4f6b) had returned to normal by 12.50am.

# 美國：已協助波灣國家經荷莫茲海峽出口15億桶原油

2026/10/26 04:46（10/26 07:27 更新）

[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[![Image 21](https://imgcdn.cna.com.tw/www/website/img/support.svg)](https://cna.com.tw/donate/)

請同意我們的隱私權規範，才能啟用聽新聞的功能。

荷莫茲海峽地理位置圖。（中央社製圖）

（中央社利雅德25日綜合外電報導）美軍中央司令部今天表示，自從夏季以來，已經協助波斯灣國家經由荷莫茲海峽出口15億桶原油，成功突破伊朗封鎖。

法新社報導，美軍中央司令部（US Central Command）在社群平台X上發布聲明表示：「美軍協助波斯灣盟國自從夏季以來出口超過15億桶原油，達成重要里程碑。」

聲明指出，過去6個月在中央司令部部隊支援下，已經有超過3000艘商船順利通過荷莫茲海峽（Strait of Hormuz），強調「超過95%的船隻航行荷莫茲海峽時安全通過」。

正在荷莫茲海峽視察美軍的中央司令部司令古柏（Brad Cooper）表示：「多虧我方人員的傑出努力，今天荷姆茲海峽主要航運通道依然安全無阻，未受伊朗水雷威脅。」

自從2月28日美國和以色列對伊朗發動攻擊、中東戰事爆發以來，伊朗已經對此一關鍵水道實施控制，要求通過海峽的船隻獲得相關許可。

美國國務卿盧比歐（Marco Rubio）本月曾表示，伊朗已經「完全喪失對荷莫茲海峽的控制」，宣稱德黑蘭的經濟陷入「徹底而全面的自由落體式崩潰」之中。

他說：「荷莫茲海峽是開放的，現在流出的原油幾乎和衝突開始之前一樣多。因此他們已經完全喪失對海峽的控制。」

根據海事追蹤公司Kpler數據，原油出口量於9月已經恢復至戰爭爆發前水準，不包括伊朗，當月至少有1650萬桶原油從該地區出口。（編譯：[何宏儒](https://cna.com.tw/author/0128/)）1151026

# 致命 7.0 级地震几天后，西藏和青海又发生两次地震
周日晚上，西藏那曲地区发生了5.7级地震，紧接着邻近的青海省也发生了5.6级地震。三天前，同一地区发生了 7.0 级地震，造成 16 人死亡、76 人受伤。

# Two new quakes hit Tibet and Qinghai days after deadly 7.0 tremor

A magnitude 5.7 earthquake struck Tibet's Nagqu region on Sunday evening, followed by a magnitude 5.6 quake in neighbouring Qinghai. The tremors come three days after a magnitude 7.0 earthquake killed 16 people and injured 76 in the same area.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

A magnitude 5.7 earthquake struck Baqing county in Tibet's Nagqu city at 7.25pm on Sunday, followed just a minute later by a magnitude 5.6 tremor in neighbouring Qinghai province, according to the China Earthquake Networks Center.

The shallow Tibetan quake, which had a focal depth of 10 kilometres, triggered strong tremors across the affected area. Almost simultaneously at 7.26pm, the second earthquake was recorded near Zadoi county in Qinghai's Yushu prefecture.

Sunday's seismic activity comes just three days after a devastating magnitude 7.0 earthquake rocked the region on Thursday night, leaving 16 people dead and 76 injured. Authorities had already issued warnings regarding active aftershocks following the main tremor, noting a high risk of secondary disasters such as landslides and falling rocks.

The China Earthquake Networks Center has not yet reported any casualties or damage from Sunday's quakes. Officials are continuing to monitor the situation as the region remains on alert for further seismic activity.

content:
蹊跷的是，在关键的时间点上，能够左右、扭转世界格局的重要人物要么相继死去，要么暂时失去权力。

**[第二次世界大战](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E7%AC%AC%E4%BA%8C%E6%AC%A1%E4%B8%96%E7%95%8C%E5%A4%A7%E6%88%98)**，是人类**历史**上的**灾难**。然而，二战后红色**苏联**和**红色中国**的崛起，才是人类灾难的开始。相比在战争中的死亡人数，死于共产**红魔**手中的人类数倍而不止。蹊跷的是，在关键的时间点上，能够左右、扭转世界格局的重要人物要么相继死去，要么暂时失去权力。这一切，用“**巧合**”将永远无法解释通。而与这些人物相关的预言，更让人们冥冥中，看到历史被操控的痕迹。

## [罗斯福](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E7%BD%97%E6%96%AF%E7%A6%8F)逝世 狄克逊预言共产党统治中国

1945年2月12日罗斯福总统离开雅尔达会议飞往埃及，并登上在苏伊士运河附近大苦湖航行的昆西号巡洋舰。2月18日抵港。当时罗斯福与美国驻英、法、和意大利大使会谈。在雅尔达，首相丘吉尔的医生莫兰勋爵，就罗斯福健康状况不佳表示：“他病得很重。他有所有脑血管硬化后期的症状。因此，我认为他只能活几个月。”

当罗斯福返回美国后，他在3月1日向美国国会汇报雅尔达会议。然而许多人对看到当时外表苍老又枯槁的罗斯福感到震惊。他在国会发表谈话时是坐在扶手椅上的，这是对其身体能力前所未有的让步。

[![Image 2](https://img6.secretchina.com/pic/2025/7-29/p3676411a560438137.jpg)](https://www.naturenergy.us/)

1945年3月，他措辞强烈地指责斯大林，表示他打破了在雅尔达种种对波兰、德国、战俘和其他问题的承诺。当斯大林指责西方盟国阴谋筹画一个有着[希特勒](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E5%B8%8C%E7%89%B9%E5%8B%92)独裁影子、脱离现实的和平时，罗斯福回答说：“我实在无法避免的对你的线人──不管他们是谁──对我自己或者我所信赖属下的行动，以如此下流的手段扭曲感到既悲惨又愤慨。”

 罗斯福措辞强烈地指责斯大林，“以如此下流的手段扭曲感到既悲惨又愤慨。”

1945年4月12日下午，罗斯福正在忙碌于工作，突然他说：“我头痛得要命。”之后，他被诊断为脑出血，并在当天晚上过世。

此前，1944年11月，罗斯福身体健康每况愈下，于是请私人秘书联络狄克逊，希望请她占卜一下寿命。

狄克逊仔细端详罗斯福总统的手掌后说：“6个月，或许更少。”罗斯福再次询问狄克逊：“我还有多长时间来完成我的工作，几年？”狄克逊说：“不是几年。”“总统先生，不是以年来计算，而是以月，不超过6个月。”

在与罗斯福会谈的时候，狄克逊还应罗斯福的要求，预测了国际局势。狄克逊说：“一旦战争结束，联盟即告瓦解。俄国人将和美国争夺欧洲、亚洲，争夺第二次世界大战的果实。在东欧和亚洲地区将有很多中小国家成为红色政权，俄国成为共产国家的老大，在先进武器上和美国一争高低。美俄两国将会长期处在军事对峙和军事竞争中。不过，最终我们还将同俄国结盟，对抗红色中国。”

“红色中国？这不可能！我们与中国方面绝无摩擦。我们同俄国结成联盟，是为了维持我们在世界上的地位，求得生存。”罗斯福说。

珍妮聚精会神地看着水晶球中正在形成的画面说：“我看见共产党将夺取中国政权，中国现政权将去一片树叶状的小岛（台湾）。共产党的中国将成为我们在外交上的第二大忧患。”

## 希特勒的预言及身亡

## ![Image 4: 1942年希特勒指挥作战计划。](https://img2.secretchina.com/pic/2018/6-28/p2201961a54920938-ss.jpg)
 1942年希特勒指挥作战计划。

希特勒曾对自己的私人医生预言二战结局：“苏联人会割占我们的大片领土，许多东方的日耳曼人将会被迫背井离乡，而剩下的德意志将会一分为二，成为两个敌对的国家，这种局面将会继续到本世纪末。”

第二次世界大战之后，盟军分别占领了战败国德国，后来在美苏的占领区分别成立了联邦德国和民主德国，从此德国被一分为二。

1941年6月，希特勒下令入侵苏联。至1941年年末，德国及其欧洲轴心国盟友已侵略占领欧洲和北非大部分地区。后来与苏联战事的不利局面及美国的加入导致德国由攻转守，并屡遭战略失败。在战争尾声阶段，1945年柏林战役期间，希特勒与其长期女友爱娃･布劳恩成婚。在他们成婚两日后，1945年4月30日，为避免被开坦克进城的苏联红军俘获，希特勒与布劳恩自杀身亡，其尸体被焚毁并被苏联红军找到。

## 二战即将胜利 丘吉尔落选

1945年6月，英国大选，邱吉尔落选。6年后，邱吉尔东山再起，重新登上首相宝座。

1945年6月英国大选时，正是丘吉尔在国内、国际都声名显赫的时候，却居然败给了工党，而使自己成为“反对党领袖”。

## 巴顿的使命与身亡

他在日记中提到：美军明显比苏俄强大，为何不立即与苏俄作战？但是这现在根本不可能，对日本仍在交战，苏俄仍是盟国之一，美国也不会愿意在这时把战火延烧到东欧。我只能眼睁睁地看着成千上万的难民为逃避苏俄红军进入到他的防区内寻求保护，这时的巴顿恳求盟军统帅部让自己加入太平洋战区，协助中国的战区统帅蒋中正对日本作战，然而未得到允许。

这时纳粹德国与日本已先后投降，巴顿被任命为德国北部巴伐利亚军政府首长，执行去纳粹化的任务，巴顿始终认为共产集团将是未来自由世界的头号敌人，所以主张对前纳粹德国宽大。他认为并非所有德国人都是纳粹党员，许多人加入纳粹只是为了争取表现及晋升，而非完全认同纳粹极端的民族主义及暴力作为，纳粹党就如同美国的民主党与共和党一样是个普通的政党。

巴顿在日记中提到：我想与德国人结为盟友并肩作战击败苏俄红军，以完成自己的使命。

 巴顿在日记中提到：我想与德国人结为盟友并肩作战击败苏俄红军，以完成自己的使命。（以上图片皆来源于公有领域）

虽然仅60岁，但是感到自己的大限之日已即将到来，家人劝他别胡思乱想。

巴顿在日记中如此写道：

真希望我还年轻，这样我就可以在未来与苏俄红军作战……

我越想越是忧心，终日眉头深锁着，我的身体状况越来越糟……

为何当局不允许我赶在苏俄红军之前占领柏林？眼看共产势力日益扩张，有谁能够制止？

离开美国抵达德国的巴顿接受了指挥美国第十五军团及编写战史的任务，这个职务是个闲职，巴顿上任不久后，就打算回美国过圣诞节，同时计划退伍。在出发前两天他准备到施派尔附近去打猎，在途中不幸发生车祸而受到重伤。

1945年12月21人，也就是车祸12天后，巴顿因肺水肿及心衰竭在睡梦中去世，享年60岁。

## 虚云禅师预言二战结局

据资料记载，抗战期间的1942年11月，中华民国主席林森等前往南华禅寺，迎请虚云老和尚到重庆主持“护国息灾大悲法会”。

据悉，当时有很多的中华民国政要也都皈依在虚云老和尚门下。而且虚云也是[蒋介石](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E8%92%8B%E4%BB%8B%E7%9F%B3)的座上宾。在法会期间，蒋介石问虚云抗日战争和第二次世界大战的未来战局如何？

对蒋介石的突然一问，虚云没有回答，想了想，从口袋摸出一张便签纸，请服务员找来一把剪刀，一剪刀把纸剪成了正四方形，又将纸角对角连折三次，之后横着剪下三刀。纸屑飘落，纸张打开，虚云老和尚手中的便签先后成为三个字，一个是完整的“十”字，代表十字意大利军，一个是“卐”字，代表德国，还有一个是代表正对中华领土肆意蹂躏的日本国“日”字。

虚云老和尚沉思片刻，又说道，这一次抗战胜利后，中国还会有不同的面貌出现。蒋介石疑惑，问是什么样子的不同面貌？老和尚沉默不语，不再作答。

正如虚云老和尚预测，三年后“十”字意大利最先无条件投降，德国战败，“日”本也不得不签署投降协议。紧接着，国共两党的厮杀随之而起，1949年才告平息。

## 戴笠身亡

中华民国特工负责人，创立国民政府军事委员会调查统计局（简称军统）并担任副局长（但为实际领导人）与中美特种技术合作所主任。由于其行踪不定、神出鬼没，他被美国《柯莱尔斯》杂志称为“亚洲的一个神秘人物”、“中国近代[历史](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E5%8E%86%E5%8F%B2)上最神秘的人物”。

在抗日战争中，戴笠和他领导的军统局为中华民国立下卓著功勋，1946年3月17日，戴笠因从北平起飞的专用飞机失事身亡。

1946年3月17日戴笠乘专机由青岛飞往南京时，因南京上空乌云密布、雷电交加，不得已转飞上海，但这时上海的天气也不适合飞机降落，只能改飞徐州降落，途中在南京西郊的岱山失事身亡。

蒋公迁台后曾说：“若雨农（戴笠，字雨农）不死，不至失大陆。”

 1946年3月17日，“亚洲的一个神秘人物”戴笠乘专机飞往南京，乌云密布、雷电交加，在岱山失事身亡。（图片来源：军情局提供）

## 蒋公预言一千年的尽头到来

1957年，蒋介石在《二十世纪的十字军》文中指出，共产主义是诋毁创世主的邪教：“在廿世纪的今日，同样有一个邪恶的思想，虚假的哲学，以虚假欺骗的手段渗透人心。以凶狠残暴不人道的方法剥夺人的自由，横行霸道。共产主义一日不停止，世界一日无安宁。共产主义一日不消灭，世界一日无和平。今天的共产主义，实已超过虚假的哲学，而成为虚假的宗教，共产党徒不承认创造宇宙万物的主宰，而崇拜自我，实为有史以来最卑鄙的偶像崇拜者。”

蒋介石还告诫民众，《圣经启示录》预言的一千年的尽头似乎已到来。蒋公看到共产主义在人间的表现，正好验证了《圣经启示录》中的预言：撒旦必从监狱里被释放，出来要迷惑地上的列国。蒋公提醒人类：共产主义是神造宇宙以来人类面临的最大灾祸。

1960年，蒋介石在《耶稣受难节证道词》中写道，“共产主义的狂妄匪徒们叫喊着，它们必要毁灭世界上的一切宗教，它们必能毁灭不愿崇拜它们共产主义的所有人类，它们共产主义必要统治世界。它们今日一切迫害、斗争、诬陷和公审的所作所为，正像一千九百年前的新约时代的恶魔‘撒旦’一样。”

# China's fifth plenum, Jio listing on Indian bourses, BOJ meeting

Your weekly lineup of Asia's biggest business and political events

The Chinese Communist Party's fifth plenum, scheduled to run from Oct. 26 to 29, is expected to focus on party governance and anti-corruption efforts, likely further strengthening the position of President Xi Jinping. © Reuters

English (Original)

Welcome to Your Week in Asia.

Hundreds of the Chinese Communist Party's highest-ranking officials will gather for what is known as the fifth plenum to discuss party discipline. The event is a chance for Xi Jinping, the party's general secretary and the country's president, to stamp his authority ahead of leadership changes expected next year.

Indian telecom giant Jio Platforms is set to make its market debut as the company seeks to bolster [its tech credentials](https://asia.nikkei.com/business/markets/ipo/ambani-s-tech-shift-in-focus-as-investors-pile-into-jio-s-record-ipo). The listing will mark the first public debut by a Reliance Industries group company in two decades, and investor excitement is high -- the initial public offering was fully subscribed within two hours of launching on Wednesday.

Get the best of our coverage of Asia and much more by following us on X, where our handle is [@NikkeiAsia](https://x.com/NikkeiAsia). We are also on Bluesky with the handle [@asia.nikkei.com](https://bsky.app/profile/asia.nikkei.com).

**MONDAY**

**China's fifth plenum**

Top Chinese Communist Party officials gather in Beijing for the fifth plenary session of the Central Committee, or fifth plenum. The closed-door meeting, scheduled to run until Thursday, is expected to focus on party governance and anti-corruption efforts, likely further strengthening the position of Xi.

**Vietnam Autumn Economic Forum**

Vietnam holds a four-day summit with the World Economic Forum, bringing political and business leaders from 19 countries to discuss tech, supply chain and environmental challenges. The prime minister will give a keynote speech at the Autumn Economic Forum in Ho Chi Minh City, which will feature officials from India, Qatar and the U.K. as panelists.

**Sydney's new airport opens for international travel**

The first international passenger services will commence from the new Western Sydney International (Nancy-Bird Walton) Airport, which is named after an Australian aviation pioneer, with domestic services having started on Sunday. The hub has been decades in the making and is aimed at taking pressure off Sydney's existing sole airport, Kingsford Smith, which is subject to an 11 p.m. to 6 a.m. curfew on flights.

**Bangladeshi Prime Minister Rahman visits Japan**

Bangladesh Prime Minister Tarique Rahman will visit Japan through Thursday, with a meeting scheduled with Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi. The trip comes as Dhaka pushes for [greater Japanese investment](https://asia.nikkei.com/politics/international-relations/japan-to-arrange-6bn-in-private-sector-investment-in-bangladesh) in the wake of February's signing of a bilateral economic partnership agreement, which is nearing [ratification in Japan](https://asia.nikkei.com/economy/trade/japan-set-to-move-forward-with-bangladesh-s-first-economic-pact).

**Monetary policy: Pakistan**

**Data: Singapore manufacturing index, Thailand trade**

**TUESDAY**

**Data: South Korea gross domestic product, Thailand auto sales**

**WEDNESDAY**

**Jio Platforms listing**

Telecom giant Jio Platforms is expected to begin trading on the Indian bourses, days after it completes a record $3.2 billion IPO, the country's largest ever. The listing marks a resurgent primary market that has picked up pace after a slow first half, although former parent company Reliance Industries has taken a beating on the secondary market over the past year.

**Monetary policy: Thailand**

**Earnings: SK Hynix, UMC, Adani Enterprises**

**THURSDAY**

**ASEAN defense ministers meeting**

Regional defense ministers converge on Cebu, the Philippines, this week for security talks. Top of the agenda is strengthening defense collaboration, safeguarding critical underwater infrastructure and addressing South China Sea tensions.

**Earnings: GoTo, Samsung Electronics, BYD**

**FRIDAY**

**Japan monetary policy**

The Bank of Japan is widely expected to keep interest rates [unchanged](https://asia.nikkei.com/economy/bank-of-japan/boj-to-hold-rate-at-1.25-at-meeting-next-week) following a two-day policy meeting. Markets will focus on Gov. Kazuo Ueda's comments for clues on the likelihood of a December rate hike and the pace of further monetary tightening.

**Foxconn Tech Day**

Foxconn will host its annual Tech Day, highlighting several key growth areas, including artificial intelligence, automobiles and robotics. Under the theme "Accelerating Imagination," the event will feature a lineup of global tech leaders from the likes of Nvidia, OpenAI, Alphabet, IBM, ABB Robotics, Uber and FUSO, highlighting the company's transformation into an AI-driven technology platform.

**Bangsamoro Parliament takes office**

Following historic regional elections in September, the Bangsamoro Parliament in the Philippines will hold its first session and elect its first chief minister. The move marks a crucial step toward securing long-term economic stability and enduring peace in a region shaped by decades of conflict.

**Earnings: Mediatek, Indian Oil Corporation, China Vanke**

# CUHK and Cambridge museum stage joint painted enamel exhibition in UK

The Chinese University of Hong Kong Art Museum has brought 53 sets of painted enamels to the UK for the first time, in a joint exhibition with Cambridge's Fitzwilliam Museum. The show explores the development of painted enamel in China and runs from October 20 to February 21 next year.

The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) Art Museum has brought 53 sets of treasured painted enamels to the United Kingdom for the first time, in its latest joint exhibition launched with Cambridge's Fitzwilliam Museum.

Running from October 20 to February 21 next year in the United Kingdom, the exhibition explores the development of painted enamel in China, a field that has attracted growing scholarly attention in recent years. It features 89 exceptional works and sets of works, including 53 treasured painted enamels from the CUHK Art Museum debuting in the UK and 36 from The Fitzwilliam Museum.

CUHK vice-chancellor and president Dennis Lo Yuk-ming, who graduated as a Cantabrigian in the 1980s, expressed delight at witnessing and officiating this historic union between the two institutions at an opening ceremony held at The Fitzwilliam Museum on October 19. “CUHK’s founding mission is to combine tradition with modernity and to bring together China and the West,” he added.

Beginning with the transfer of painted enamel technology from Europe to China in the late 17th century, the exhibition traces the emergence of hybrid artistic traditions that developed through interactions between China and the wider world. It offers new perspectives on Chinese painted enamel through the lenses of cross-cultural exchange, artistic innovation and global trade, revealing how Chinese craftsmen working in the imperial workshops of Beijing and the commercial workshops of Canton adapted and transformed the painted enamel technique to decorate objects made of porcelain, glass, silver and copper.

The joint exhibition builds upon the CUHK Art Museum’s acclaimed exhibition “Sparkle and Charm: Canton Enamels of the Qing Dynasty” from 2022 to 2023, which subsequently toured Shenzhen, Tianjin, Shanghai and Wuhan in the mainland.

当一个政权宣扬无神论、靠谎言立身、靠暴力维系，它最终要毁掉的就不只是一个国家的经济和制度，而且还是人之所以为人的道德根基。共产主义不是一种普通的政治主张，它的终极目的是毁灭人类：先割断人与神的联系，再摧毁传统文化与道德，让人在谎言和恐惧中失去辨别善恶的能力。从这个角度看，2026年8月115万中国人声明退出[中共](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E4%B8%AD%E5%85%B1)党、团、队组织，这不只是一组统计数字，而是115万个生命在苦难与谎言中醒来，为自己作出的选择。

## 一、数字背后：115万人解除与邪灵的誓约

根据全球退党服务中心网站统计，8月份在网站发表“[三退](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E4%B8%89%E9%80%80)”（退出中共党、团、队）声明的人数为115万4744人，平均每天3万7250人。今年1至8月“三退”人数累计931万3188人，平均每天3万8326人。截至2026年8月底，累计“三退”人数已达4亿6572万6020人。

与此同时，“打倒中共恶魔”（End CCP）联署人数截至8月底达到542万3625人，比上月增加6.8万人，比年初增加30.7万人。

[![Image 2](https://img6.secretchina.com/pic/2024/11-2/p3556881a508884777.jpg)](https://naturexcels.com/language/zh/)

中共要求入党、入团、入队者举拳宣誓“为共产主义奋斗终身”，实际上是把人的生命与这个邪灵绑在一起。“三退声明”就是在解除这份誓约。每天三万多人作出这个选择，说明中共靠意识形态控制人心的根基正在持续动摇。

## 二、觉醒的六条道路：民众为何“三退”

根据全球退党服务中心网站“三退声明”的归类分析，8月份，[中国](https://www.secretchina.com/)民众“三退”的主要原因可归纳为六类。它们从不同角度印证同一件事：中共的本质在现实生活中已无法遮掩。

**1.从权钱交易看清体制邪恶**

中共以“无神论”取代人对神的敬畏，官员失去约束，贪腐便成为体制常态。许多声明者从工作和生活的亲身经历中，看到官员贪腐，官官相护，工程腐败，司法不公。

山东济宁蒋心平在声明中说：“现在中国贪官腐败到处横行，官官相护，有冤无处伸。老百姓生活在水深火热中，愿老天快点灭掉它，我愿退出共产党的党团队组织，做个信神的善良人。”

山东李光明（化名）说：“中共越来越腐败，说得好，做得坏，权大于法，草菅人命，无法无天，是有史以来最邪恶至极的，罪恶滔天。”

桥梁建造者杜侨莱坦言：“中共体制下，工程招标腐败横行，压缩成本导致材料低劣，豆腐渣工程频出。我曾多次拒绝偷工减料，坚持质量第一，却因此遭到上级打压，项目被撤，职业生涯受阻。一次关键项目中，我因反对使用不合格钢材被威胁，甚至被诬陷贪污。”

他深刻认识到：“体制的腐朽已无法容纳职业良知”，于是选择退党，“远离这扭曲的漩涡，我不愿让我的桥梁成为隐患，不愿让无辜生命为腐败买单。”

这一类可概括为：贪官腐败，官官相护，权钱交易，工程腐败，司法不公，权大于法，以及职业良知与腐败体制的正面冲突。杜侨莱的故事尤其说明，在这个体制中，坚守良知的人反而被打压，这正是共产党颠倒善恶的体现。

**2.经济无出路，对中共体制彻底失望**

一些声明者从失业、低收入、物价上涨、欠薪、生活困难等现实处境中，对中共体制彻底失望。

冯平说：“共产党只要给平民百姓一点活路，老百姓也不会说什么，问题是没有活路可走了。我早在前些年入党，现在无情的被迫失业，每月才只有300元的低保，近几个月连这300元的低保也连续几个月没有发了，老婆、孩子还等着吃饭呢？”、“现在是官逼民反的时候了……”

山东青岛九十岁的陈安福在声明中说：“我今年九十岁了，我什么都经历过了……邓小平说让一部分人先富起来，先富的都是当官的，都是党员。咱老百姓算什么，这社会算完了，让共产党给捣鼓完了。”

钟利坤、王德凯、焦健康等47人共同声明：“扯虎皮，扛大旗，表面光鲜，到处都是用民脂民膏的活命钱堆积出的假繁荣，宽阔的大道，高楼林立，良田被强占，高房价，破产的企业，失业的工人。”

共产党曾以“让穷人翻身”为号召夺取政权。九十岁老人的一句“这社会算完了”，是对这个承诺最直接的判决。

**3.冲破党文化洗脑，认清谎言**

中共从孩童时期就开始灌输党文化，让人在不知不觉中接受它的是非标准。这一类声明正是在打破这层从小建立的思想牢笼。

署名伍万亿的声明说：“由于在中国大陆从小被中共洗脑，在不清醒的情况下被动加入了少先队及共青团。”、“在认清中共的邪恶本质后，彻底与中共邪教组织决裂。”

## 三、墙内墙外：民生抗争与海外联动

“三退”是个人内心的选择，而同一时期中国内外的社会动向，从外部印证了中共的深层危机。

**1.大陆：民生维权持续发酵**

2026年大陆社会抗争的明显特点，是经济压力与社会不满持续转化为基层抗议。中国劳动力市场承受房地产低迷，消费疲弱，就业困难等多重压力。《金融时报》8月报导，大量中国劳动者转向外卖，网约车等零工工作，一些建筑工人因长期欠薪而离开原行业；有司机一天工作15至16小时，仍难以获得稳定收入。

美国国会及行政部门的相关中国问题监测也显示，2026年中国抗议活动数量仍处于较高水平，工人，业主，农村居民等群体是主要参与者。此前公布的2026年第一季度数据记录了至少1,241起抗议事件，其中工人占近一半。

这些抗争的直接要求多数集中在：欠薪讨薪、失业与就业困难、房地产烂尾与房贷及业主权益、土地征收、企业倒闭、社会保障，以及教育，医疗等民生问题。

值得注意的是，这些事件虽然多数没有明确提出“结束中共统治”，但长期累积的经济和社会矛盾，正在不断削弱民众对现行体制的信任。海外研究也认为，目前尚无证据证明中国已经出现全国协调一致的反共起义，但社会层面的不满和抗争相当广泛。这与“三退声明”中“没有活路”的心声，形成了清晰的呼应。

**2.香港：高压之下仍坚持“结束一党专政”**

8月21日，香港高等法院裁定支联会前负责人李卓人，邹幸彤等人“煽动颠覆国家政权”罪名成立。案件核心之一是他们长期推动纪念六四及民主运动，并曾提出“结束一党专政”政治主张。

路透社报导，法院特别把他们反复和平使用“结束一党专政”这一口号，作为认定犯罪的重要依据。这起案件的象征意义十分明显：过去在香港可以公开喊出的“结束一党专政”，如今被香港国安法体系视为危害中共政权的行为。支联会过去三十多年持续举办六四纪念活动，每年吸引数以万计市民参加；2020年国安法实施后，活动被禁止，支联会最终解散。

判决后，英国、法国、德国等方面提出批评，认为和平的民主表达与纪念六四不应被刑事化。

因此，8月香港最大的反共政治事件，并不是街头大规模示威，而是民主人士在高压之下仍坚持“结束一党专政”的立场。

**3.海外声援：要求释放香港民主人士**

香港劳工权益组织8月19日报导，国际工会与人权团体在判决前发起协调性的国际声援行动，要求释放李卓人等香港民主人士。这说明香港民主运动虽在本地遭到强力压制，却已形成一个在海外持续发声的民主网络。

**4.西藏问题：海外持续反对中共同化政策**

8月12日，美国参议员杰夫・默克利与吉姆・里施共同推动加强美国对西藏的支持；西藏流亡政府相关机构称，两位参议员提出了进一步强化美国对藏政策的两党行动。

8月17日，日本华人团体“东京人文论坛”在东京举办“西藏与中国促进世界和平”论坛，邀请藏人行政中央驻日本代表等人士参加。

8月28日，西藏流亡政府发表文章，批评中共所谓“民族团结”政策，实际上是在强化对藏人语言，文化与身分的同化。从《共产主义的终极目的》的角度看，这正是中共摧毁民族传统文化与信仰的一贯手法。

**5.新疆与香港议题：反跨国镇压行动持续**

人权组织继续把新疆，西藏，香港与中共的跨国镇压联系起来。人权观察记录的一起8月事件显示，中国与泰国官员曾向曼谷一家艺术中心施压，要求撤下西藏，维吾尔及香港艺术家的作品。人权组织认为，这是中共影响力向海外文化空间延伸的表现。

这类事件的重要性在于，反共抗争已不只是“中国境内的问题”，而越来越表现为海外华人、藏人、维吾尔人、香港人与国际人权组织共同反对中共的跨国影响与言论压制。

**6.法轮功反迫害：海外抗共的重要一环**

7.20之后，海外法轮功学员的反迫害活动延续到8月。美国“法轮大法之友”8月7日报导，7月23日在华盛顿林肯纪念堂举行的2026年反迫害集会有数千人参加，主题之一是要求结束中共对法轮功的迫害。法轮功信息中心8月25日又报导了布鲁克林法轮功学员游行，并特别指出北京对法轮功的跨国镇压与海外影响问题。

从7月到8月，法轮功反迫害活动呈现三个特点：纪念27年迫害历史；要求停止中共迫害法轮功；揭露中共对海外法轮功学员的跨国镇压。

## 四、8月五个值得关注的趋势

第一，反共议题正与经济民生问题结合。过去海外反共运动较多集中在“六四”、法轮功、西藏、新疆、香港等政治与人权议题。现在则越来越多呈现这样一条链条：失业，欠薪，房地产危机，社会保障，对政府不满，最后对制度产生质疑。经济问题正在成为政治不满的重要来源。

第二，香港的“结束一党专政”并未消失。即使港版国安法大幅压缩了公共政治空间，这一口号仍是民主人士坚持的核心要求，8月支联会案件尤其突出这一点。

第三，海外反共力量呈现“多群体联合”。海外形成的不是单一组织，而是中国民运、香港民主人士、西藏人士、维吾尔人士、法轮功学员、人权组织与国际议员等多方力量，分别从民主、人权、宗教自由、民族自由与反跨国镇压等角度批评中共。

第四，中共跨国镇压成为海外抗共运动的新焦点。过去海外活动主要是抗议中共；现在增加了反中共海外渗透、反跨国镇压、保护海外异议人士与保护言论自由。这使反共议题从街头抗议进入欧美政府与议会的政策领域。人权组织及美国相关机构在2026年都持续关注这一问题。

第五，目前还不能把国内抗争称为“全国性反共运动”。8月中国大陆确实存在大量社会抗争，但公开资料尚不能证明这些事件已形成统一组织，统一目标的“反共起义”。较准确的表述是：2026年8月，中国大陆基层抗争持续，香港民主抗争受到高压，海外反共及人权运动继续扩大，多个群体围绕民主、自由、人权、宗教信仰与反跨国镇压展开行动。

## 五、黑暗中的代价：“三退”义工受迫害

“三退”运动是一场全民觉醒运动，不分男女老幼、城市乡村，无论工人、农民或知识分子，“三退”都是个人自发的行为，因此无法统计“三退义工”的详细情况。但作为“三退义工”主要群体的法轮功学员，其受迫害情况可以管中窥豹。

据明慧网报导统计，8月份已知至少391名法轮功学员退党义工遭中共不同形式的迫害。其中14人因迫害离世或含冤离世，至少52人被非法判刑入狱，191人被绑架，130人被骚扰，4人被以“办学习班”等形式强制洗脑。

**典型案例一：黑龙江齐齐哈尔79岁法轮功学员姚兴启含冤离世**

明慧网2026年8月20日消息，黑龙江齐齐哈尔市富拉尔基区79岁的姚兴启，因坚持修炼法轮大法，多次遭中共绑架、关押、抄家、勒索及骚扰。

2010年，他因讲真相被绑架、抄家并勒索5000元；2011年再次被绑架，遭非法判刑3年半，关押于泰来监狱。2020年后，警方多次上门逼迫他在“三书”上签字，均遭拒绝。2025年5月，他与妻子再次被绑架，并被勒索2000元“取保候审”。

2026年5月11日，姚兴启到北兴派出所要求归还被扣押的大法书籍，反遭再次绑架。5月21日，他在看守所被迫害致昏迷，5月29日因抢救无望被送回家。6月24日，姚兴启含冤离世。

**典型案例二：遭20年监控、劳教与流离失所，辽宁耿向武含冤离世**

明慧网2026年8月13日消息，辽宁省抚顺市东洲区法轮功学员耿向武，因坚持“真善忍”信仰，遭中共迫害二十多年，已于2019年9月12日含冤离世，终年75岁。

1999年迫害开始后，耿向武被非法劳教3年；2001年再次被抓入吴家堡教养院，遭受折磨并出现严重身体疾病，后被放回家。此后公安与小区人员长期监控骚扰，甚至在他家对面安装摄像头，并以低保相威胁，他因此被迫流离失所。2016年4月22日，他再次被绑架，因体检不合格被看守所拒收。长期的监控、骚扰、抓捕与精神高压严重摧残其身心，最终于2019年9月12日含冤离世。

**典型案例三：屡遭迫害，辽宁新宾县警察王晓明含冤离世**

明慧网2026年8月24日消息，辽宁省抚顺市新宾县公安分局警察王晓明，因修炼法轮大法遭中共迫害，于2026年6月15日含冤离世，终年58岁。

王晓明工作认真，公正廉洁，多次获得表彰，业务成绩突出。1999年中共迫害法轮功后，他因坚持信仰被辞退。2001年被非法拘留并送劳教所，绝食抗议期间遭灌食、殴打和辱骂，后被送医抢救；2002年又被绑架，送吴家堡教养院非法劳教两年。2021年，他再次被新宾县公安局辞退，此后向各级部门实名申诉、控告，要求纠正对法轮功的非法迫害。长期遭受打压后，他于2026年6月15日含冤离世。

一名公正廉洁，屡获表彰的警察，因为信仰“真善忍”而被自己服务的体制迫害致死。这正是《共产主义的终极目的》所揭示的：在共产体制下，好人被迫害，善念被当作罪行。

## 结语：觉醒，是人对魔鬼的回答

把8月的图景放在一起看：墙内，115万人以三退声明与中共划清界线，工人、业主、农民为生计抗争；香港，“结束一党专政”的主张在法庭上被定罪，却仍未被放弃；海外，多个族群与国际社会形成越来越广的联合；而在最黑暗的角落，仍有坚持信仰的人为此付出生命。

共产邪灵最害怕的，不是枪炮，而是人的觉醒；只要人明白真相，认清它的本质，并从思想上与它决裂，它所依附的躯壳就会失去力量。从杜侨莱的“为保初心”，到曹富喜的“不为仇恨，只为清醒”，再到魏志强的“收回誓言”，这些“三退声明”都在说明：当人重新找回良知，信仰与尊严，就是在为自己选择未来。

# 百工百業力挺 蘇巧慧：剩一個月要更努力

2026/10/25 17:45（10/25 18:01 更新）

[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[![Image 22](https://imgcdn.cna.com.tw/www/website/img/support.svg)](https://cna.com.tw/donate/)

請同意我們的隱私權規範，才能啟用聽新聞的功能。

民進黨新北市長參選人蘇巧慧（3排左8）25日下午在板橋區出席「百工百業挺巧慧」活動，總統府資政沈榮津（3排左7）等人到場參與，場面熱烈。中央社記者王鴻國攝 115年10月25日

（中央社記者[王鴻國](https://cna.com.tw/author/0045/)新北25日電）民進黨新北市長參選人蘇巧慧今天出席「百工百業挺巧慧」活動，她表示，今天是選前倒數34天，剩下一個月了，大家要更努力，讓新北市能夠迎接一個新時代。

蘇巧慧今天行程滿檔，她在接受媒體聯訪時針對「洋流慧聚」表示，就是大家對一個新時代、新觀念的期待。

蘇巧慧表示，她和民進黨台北市長參選人沈伯洋都是帶著正面、陽光的態度，在跟市民報告對城市的願景。「洋流慧聚」帶來希望、也帶來力量，未來會有更多合體活動。

蘇巧慧下午到板橋出席「百工百業挺巧慧」活動，包括總統府資政沈榮津及財訊雙週刊社長謝金河等人參與，幾乎把會場擠滿，場面熱烈。

蘇巧慧接受媒體聯訪時表示，今天是選前倒數34天。今天再一次集結，就是為了宣示，選前只剩下一個月了，大家要更努力，不只是支持蘇巧慧，還有議員參選人都能夠全壘打，讓新北市能夠迎接一個新時代。

[![Image 24](https://imgcdn.cna.com.tw/www/website/img/ad300x223.jpg)](https://lin.ee/tPtHlLQ)

針對上週接受媒體人趙少康節目專訪，蘇巧慧表示，那天訪談非常愉快，聊得蠻盡興的。

蘇巧慧表示，趙少康過去參選台北市長口號叫做「最壞的時代，最好的選擇」，而蘇巧慧現在是「最新的時代，最好的選擇」，讓大家能夠感受到對新北市的熱情與創意、能力、誠意。希望未來真的有機會，和大家一起為這座400萬人的城市努力。（編輯：張雅淨）1151025

# 法國各地爆發數百場抗議 41萬人上街頭表達不滿生活費高漲

2026/10/25 02:53

[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[![Image 21](https://imgcdn.cna.com.tw/www/website/img/support.svg)](https://cna.com.tw/donate/)

請同意我們的隱私權規範，才能啟用聽新聞的功能。

（中央社巴黎24日綜合外電報導）隨著全國對生活成本的不滿情緒升高，法國各地今天出現數百場抗議行動，安全部隊嚴陣以待，以防重演上週末抗議爆發的暴力衝突。法國內政部表示，估計今晚全國有41萬人走上街頭抗議，其中11萬人在巴黎。

●暴力升級 逮捕近千人

法國內政部長努涅斯（Laurent Nunez）表示，警方今天在全國抗議活動中逮捕「將近1000人」，執法人員遭遇黑衣極端分子「急劇升高的暴力」。

努涅斯向媒體表示，雖然多個城市發起的遊行「基本順利落幕」，不過「極左」團體朝警方投擲雜物並發射煙火，意圖挑起衝突，有兩人在衝突中嚴重受傷。

●巴黎爆發衝突

在巴黎東側的抗議遊行結束時，現場爆發衝突，法新社記者目睹警方使用警棍與催淚瓦斯驅趕示威者。官方表示，現場同時出動了高壓水車。

一名因警棍毆打而流血、自稱大衛（David）的示威者向法新社表示：「警察開始向大家用力推，叫我們蹲下來、往後退。他們就是一路壓制、毆打示威群眾。」

●全法41萬人上街頭

法國內政部表示，今晚估計全國有41萬人走上街頭抗議生活成本高漲，其中11萬人在巴黎。

參與籌辦遊行的法國總工會（CGT）則估計，全法共有80萬人響應，巴黎則有25萬人參與。

巴黎、里昂（Lyon）、里爾（Lille）、馬賽（Marseille）、蒙貝列（Montpellier）、南特（Nantes）、土魯斯（Toulouse）等地都有傳出衝突。

巴黎警方表示，抗議期間有超過3000人遭臨檢，65人被逮捕。

●施放催淚瓦斯

法新社記者現場目睹，法國警方在里昂、里爾、蒙貝列、南特和土魯斯施放催淚瓦斯，阻止示威者進入市中心。

努涅斯先前警告，當局「絕不容忍任何暴力或擾亂公共秩序的行為」。

[![Image 22](https://imgcdn.cna.com.tw/www/website/img/ad300x223.jpg)](https://lin.ee/tPtHlLQ)

●羅浮宮、奧塞美術館關閉

巴黎的羅浮宮（Louvre）、奧塞美術館（Musee d'Orsay）、畢卡索（Picasso）美術館及大皇宮（Grand Palais）今天均暫停開放。文化部要求各館院採取措施，確保參觀者與員工安全及館藏安全。（編譯：[徐崇哲](https://cna.com.tw/author/0197/)）1151025

# Hong Kong wins 41 medals at Asian Para Games; flag handed to Doha

Hong Kong won 41 medals at the 5th Asian Para Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, which concluded on 24 October 2026. The closing ceremony featured a handover of the Asian Paralympic Committee flag to Doha, Qatar, as the next host city.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 24 Oct 2026 at 18:58 HKT · 1 min read

Share:

[](https://wa.me/?text=Hong%20Kong%20wins%2041%20medals%20at%20Asian%20Para%20Games%3B%20flag%20handed%20to%20Doha%20https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-wins-41-medals-at-Asian-Para-Games-flag-handed-to-559d7c "WhatsApp")[](https://t.me/share/url?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-wins-41-medals-at-Asian-Para-Games-flag-handed-to-559d7c&text=Hong%20Kong%20wins%2041%20medals%20at%20Asian%20Para%20Games%3B%20flag%20handed%20to%20Doha "Telegram")[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-wins-41-medals-at-Asian-Para-Games-flag-handed-to-559d7c "Facebook")[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-wins-41-medals-at-Asian-Para-Games-flag-handed-to-559d7c&text=Hong%20Kong%20wins%2041%20medals%20at%20Asian%20Para%20Games%3B%20flag%20handed%20to%20Doha "X")[](mailto:?subject=Hong%20Kong%20wins%2041%20medals%20at%20Asian%20Para%20Games%3B%20flag%20handed%20to%20Doha&body=Hong%20Kong%20wins%2041%20medals%20at%20Asian%20Para%20Games%3B%20flag%20handed%20to%20Doha%0Ahttps%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-wins-41-medals-at-Asian-Para-Games-flag-handed-to-559d7c "Email")

The 5th Asian Para Games officially concluded on Saturday evening with a closing ceremony in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, marking the end of a campaign in which the Hong Kong delegation won 41 medals.

During the parade of national and regional flags, para fencing athlete Tong Nga-ting carried the regional flag to lead the Hong Kong, China delegation into the venue, representing the city's competitors after days of competition.

The ceremony also included the traditional handover of hosting responsibilities, as the Aichi-Nagoya organising committee formally passed the Asian Paralympic Committee flag to representatives from Doha, Qatar. Doha will stage the 6th edition of the regional sporting event.

Throughout the multi-sport tournament, Hong Kong athletes achieved 3 gold, 14 silver and 24 bronze medals.

# HKJC awards HK$5.56m to Hong Kong athletes after Asian Para Games

The Hong Kong Jockey Club is awarding over HK$5.56 million to Hong Kong athletes who won medals at the fifth Asian Para Games, which concluded on 24 October. The Hong Kong, China delegation won 41 medals across 10 sports.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 24 Oct 2026 at 19:08 HKT · 1 min read

Share:

[](https://wa.me/?text=HKJC%20awards%20HK%245.56m%20to%20Hong%20Kong%20athletes%20after%20Asian%20Para%20Games%20https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/HKJC-awards-HK-5-56m-to-Hong-Kong-athletes-after-Asian-Para-2a5d0d "WhatsApp")[](https://t.me/share/url?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/HKJC-awards-HK-5-56m-to-Hong-Kong-athletes-after-Asian-Para-2a5d0d&text=HKJC%20awards%20HK%245.56m%20to%20Hong%20Kong%20athletes%20after%20Asian%20Para%20Games "Telegram")[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/HKJC-awards-HK-5-56m-to-Hong-Kong-athletes-after-Asian-Para-2a5d0d "Facebook")[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/HKJC-awards-HK-5-56m-to-Hong-Kong-athletes-after-Asian-Para-2a5d0d&text=HKJC%20awards%20HK%245.56m%20to%20Hong%20Kong%20athletes%20after%20Asian%20Para%20Games "X")[](https://clb.org.hk/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection# "Email")

The Hong Kong Jockey Club has announced it is awarding over HK$5.56 million to athletes from the Hong Kong, China delegation following the conclusion of the fifth Asian Para Games on 24 October. The cash rewards are distributed through the Jockey Club Athlete Incentive Awards Scheme, which the Club runs in partnership with the Hong Kong Sports Institute.

The Hong Kong, China team, comprising 80 athletes competing in 10 sports, won a total of 41 medals at the week-long event: three gold, 14 silver and 24 bronze. The Club said the awards underscore its commitment to recognising athletic excellence and supporting the local sports community.

The Club warmly congratulated the delegation for their dedication, perseverance and determination to push beyond their limits. The Asian Para Games are the second major event covered under a new cycle of the incentive scheme, which the Club announced in August.

The Hong Kong Jockey Club said it remains proud to support the holistic development of athletes and contribute to the betterment of society through the scheme.

# ASIAN PARA GAMES/Taiwan wraps up Asian Para Games with 4 golds, 7 silvers, 9 bronzes

Sports Minister Lee Yang (right) poses with Taiwan's badminton player Tung Hsiao-wei in Japan. Photo courtesy of the Ministry of Sports

Taipei, Oct. 24 (CNA) Taiwan finished the 2026 Asian Para Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, with four gold, seven silver and nine bronze medals as it wrapped up its competition schedule Friday, a day before the closing ceremony.

Taiwan sent 71 athletes to compete in 12 sports at this year's Games: archery, athletics, badminton, boccia, judo, powerlifting, shooting, swimming, table tennis, taekwondo, wheelchair fencing and wheelchair tennis.

Speaking to CNA at the event, Sports Minister Lee Yang (李洋) said his biggest takeaway was hearing para athletes express their wish to be treated in the same way as athletes at the Asian Games. It prompted him to reflect more deeply on the issue, he said.

Sports Minister Lee Yang. CNA file photo

Lee said there was still room for further improvements before the 2028 Los Angeles Paralympics.

He also noted that the athletes competing at this year's Games were considerably younger, promising that his ministry's Department of Adaptive Sports would work with local governments to establish more venues where people with disabilities could participate in sports, rather than focusing solely on developing elite athletes.

Lee also thanked the support teams, saying that after the Asian Games, some staff members returned to Taiwan for just four days of rest and immediately headed back to Japan to continue working at the Asian Para Games.

"I'm really grateful for their efforts," Lee said, adding that their work allowed athletes to focus on the competition without having to worry about other things.

The closing ceremony is scheduled to take place at Mizuho Park Athletic Stadium in Nagoya Saturday evening.

(By Li Chien-chung and Ko Lin)

# Hong Kong athletes to parade through Sha Tin on Tuesday after Asian Games success

Hong Kong athletes who competed at the Nagoya Asian Games will take part in an open-top bus parade in Sha Tin on Tuesday afternoon. The event, organised by the Sha Tin Festival Committee and the district's home affairs department, will include medal winners and a souvenir giveaway.

Several Hong Kong athletes who competed at the Nagoya Asian Games will greet the public in an open-top bus parade in Sha Tin next Tuesday, the Home Affairs Department said on social media.

The athletes include multiple gold medallists, such as rower Chiu Hin-chun and windsurfer Wong Tsz-ho. Also taking part are silver medallists from rowing — Hung Wing-chun, Leung Wing-on and Cheung Yuen-shan — along with windsurfer Ma Kwan-ching and squash player Ho Tsz-lok.

The event will begin at 4pm with a kick-off ceremony at Sha Tin Town Hall Square. The parade route will pass outside Tai Wau MTR station, Kingswood Plaza in Shek Mun, and Chung On Shopping Centre.

The parade is jointly organised by the Sha Tin Festival Committee and the Sha Tin District Home Affairs Office. In addition to the bus tour, commemorative souvenirs will be distributed to the public on the day.

# Hong Kong wins third gold at Asian Para Games; official hails team effort

Hong Kong's cultural and sports official Rosalia Lo congratulated athletes after the team won three gold, 14 silver and 24 bronze medals at the fifth Asian Para Games. Lo praised the boccia and fencing teams for record-breaking performances and thanked all support staff.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 24 Oct 2026 at 15:13 HKT · 1 min read

Share:

[](https://wa.me/?text=Hong%20Kong%20wins%20third%20gold%20at%20Asian%20Para%20Games%3B%20official%20hails%20team%20effort%20https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-wins-third-gold-at-Asian-Para-Games-official-hails-fb1a0a "WhatsApp")[](https://t.me/share/url?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-wins-third-gold-at-Asian-Para-Games-official-hails-fb1a0a&text=Hong%20Kong%20wins%20third%20gold%20at%20Asian%20Para%20Games%3B%20official%20hails%20team%20effort "Telegram")[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-wins-third-gold-at-Asian-Para-Games-official-hails-fb1a0a "Facebook")[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-wins-third-gold-at-Asian-Para-Games-official-hails-fb1a0a&text=Hong%20Kong%20wins%20third%20gold%20at%20Asian%20Para%20Games%3B%20official%20hails%20team%20effort "X")[](mailto:?subject=Hong%20Kong%20wins%20third%20gold%20at%20Asian%20Para%20Games%3B%20official%20hails%20team%20effort&body=Hong%20Kong%20wins%20third%20gold%20at%20Asian%20Para%20Games%3B%20official%20hails%20team%20effort%0Ahttps%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-wins-third-gold-at-Asian-Para-Games-official-hails-fb1a0a "Email")

Hong Kong's Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism, Rosalia Lo, on 24 October congratulated athletes after the city's delegation won its third gold medal at the fifth Asian Para Games. Lo singled out the 'world number one' pair of Leung Yuk-wing and Cheung Yuen, who won gold in the mixed BC4 doubles boccia event, winning four consecutive sets in the final.

Lo also praised fencers Chung Yuen-ping, Lam Ka-man, Tong Nga-ting and Yu Chui-yee for winning silver in the women's team sabre event, as well as Lam and Tong teaming with Chan Ying and Kwong Yuen-hing to win bronze in the mixed team sabre event. In boccia, Lo hailed Lung Tsz-kin, Chan Pak-lun and Yeung Siu-lam for taking bronze in the mixed BC1/BC2 team event, and Tse Tak-wah and Chan Ho-yan for bronze in the mixed BC3 doubles event.

Lo said the athletes brought further good news on the final day of the Games, winning five medals overall. She noted that the boccia team achieved its best ever result with two gold, three silver and three bronze medals. The fencing team added one silver and one bronze, bringing its total to three silver and five bronze medals, surpassing its previous Games performance.

Hong Kong's delegation finished the Asian Para Games with three gold, 14 silver and 24 bronze medals, for a total of 41 medals. Lo expressed heartfelt thanks to all athletes for their full commitment, as well as to the coaches, medical team and support staff, saying the glory belongs to the entire team and has brought the people of Hong Kong inspiration and pride.

# Hong Kong Customs seizes over 600m illicit cigarettes in first three quarters

Hong Kong Customs seized over 600 million illicit cigarettes in the first nine months of 2026, similar to the 2025 annual total. More than 200 million were in transit. Commissioner Chan Tze-tat addressed criticism over low prosecution rates, noting most cases involved travellers with undeclared ciga

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 24 Oct 2026 at 11:10 HKT · 1 min read

Hong Kong Customs Commissioner Chan Tze-tat said on 24 October that the department seized more than 600 million illicit cigarettes in the first three quarters of 2026, roughly the same as the total for the whole of last year. Of these, more than 200 million were not destined for Hong Kong but were being transhipped to other regions.

Responding to criticism that the prosecution rate for cigarette smuggling cases is low, Chan said the criticism reflected a misunderstanding. He said Customs had detected more than 18,000 cigarette-related cases this year. Of those, more than 16,000 involved travellers who failed to declare bringing more than 19 cigarettes into Hong Kong. These cases were handled by on-the-spot fines, which he described as “prosecution with a price”.

Chan stressed that the approach was intended to reduce the workload of frontline officers and avoid the heavy social costs of court proceedings. He insisted it had nothing to do with lax enforcement or whether the Department of Justice was lenient in deciding whether to prosecute.

Customs will prosecute in full all cases involving illicit cigarette warehouses uncovered in the community or travellers caught smuggling large quantities of cigarettes in multiple suitcases, Chan said. He added that the courts treat such cases seriously, typically imposing several months’ imprisonment. He said this sends a clear message to criminals not to smuggle cigarettes.

# Hong Kong to hold three district flag-selling days on Saturday

Hong Kong's Social Welfare Department announced three district flag-selling days on 24 October. Permits and details are available online. The public is advised to report suspicious collections to police.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 24 Oct 2026 at 06:00 HKT · 1 min read

Share:

[](https://wa.me/?text=Hong%20Kong%20to%20hold%20three%20district%20flag-selling%20days%20on%20Saturday%20https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-to-hold-three-district-flag-selling-days-on-Saturd-5d7c1b "WhatsApp")[](https://t.me/share/url?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-to-hold-three-district-flag-selling-days-on-Saturd-5d7c1b&text=Hong%20Kong%20to%20hold%20three%20district%20flag-selling%20days%20on%20Saturday "Telegram")[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-to-hold-three-district-flag-selling-days-on-Saturd-5d7c1b "Facebook")[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-to-hold-three-district-flag-selling-days-on-Saturd-5d7c1b&text=Hong%20Kong%20to%20hold%20three%20district%20flag-selling%20days%20on%20Saturday "X")[](mailto:?subject=Hong%20Kong%20to%20hold%20three%20district%20flag-selling%20days%20on%20Saturday&body=Hong%20Kong%20to%20hold%20three%20district%20flag-selling%20days%20on%20Saturday%0Ahttps%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-to-hold-three-district-flag-selling-days-on-Saturd-5d7c1b "Email")

The Social Welfare Department (SWD) of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government has announced arrangements for three district flag-selling days to be held simultaneously on Saturday, 24 October. The department said it has coordinated with the participating charitable organisations to ensure the smooth running of the events and to help the public identify the three separate flag-selling activities taking place that day.

According to the SWD, details of all charitable fundraising activities licensed to take place in public places, including any updates, have been published on the Hong Kong Government's one-stop portal (www.gov.hk/tc/theme/fundraising/search). In addition, the permits for the flag-selling days have been uploaded to the SWD website (www.swd.gov.hk/tc/ngo/controlofc/flagdays), where the public can find contact information for the flag-selling organisations and the approved flag-day activities.

Members of the public with enquiries can call the SWD hotline at 2343 2255 or the 1823 call centre at 3142 2678.

A department spokesman added: 'If members of the public have any suspicions about a flag-selling activity, please do not donate and immediately notify the police.'

#台风“琼达里”在台湾造成1人死亡、350人受伤
台风“琼达里”已在台湾造成 1 人死亡、350 人受伤，已报告 3,600 起事故，其中包括倒塌的树木和电线。大约 14 万户家庭断电，截至周六晚上仍有 2 万户家庭断电。

[![图片4：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

 香港时间 2026 年 10 月 24 日 02:12 · 阅读时间 1 分钟

据救灾中心称，截至周六晚间，强台风“琼达里”袭击台湾，已造成 1 人死亡、350 人受伤。

中心表示，伤者主要集中在台中、彰化、台南、高雄等地，轻伤居多。全岛当局报告了 3,600 多起事故，大部分涉及倒下的树木、倒塌的电线和受损的建筑物。

约14万户家庭因台风停电。截至周六晚上7点，仍有超过2万户家庭断电，当局计划在夜间恢复供电。

灾害应对中心预测周日风力将略有减弱

# Typhoon Jongdari kills one, injures 350 in Taiwan

Typhoon Jongdari has killed one person and injured 350 in Taiwan, with 3,600 incidents reported including fallen trees and power lines. Around 140,000 households lost power, with 20,000 still without electricity as of Saturday evening.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 24 Oct 2026 at 02:12 HKT · 1 min read

Share:

[](https://wa.me/?text=Typhoon%20Jongdari%20kills%20one%2C%20injures%20350%20in%20Taiwan%20https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Typhoon-Jongdari-kills-one-injures-350-in-Taiwan-b5cc36 "WhatsApp")[](https://t.me/share/url?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Typhoon-Jongdari-kills-one-injures-350-in-Taiwan-b5cc36&text=Typhoon%20Jongdari%20kills%20one%2C%20injures%20350%20in%20Taiwan "Telegram")[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Typhoon-Jongdari-kills-one-injures-350-in-Taiwan-b5cc36 "Facebook")[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Typhoon-Jongdari-kills-one-injures-350-in-Taiwan-b5cc36&text=Typhoon%20Jongdari%20kills%20one%2C%20injures%20350%20in%20Taiwan "X")[](mailto:?subject=Typhoon%20Jongdari%20kills%20one%2C%20injures%20350%20in%20Taiwan&body=Typhoon%20Jongdari%20kills%20one%2C%20injures%20350%20in%20Taiwan%0Ahttps%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Typhoon-Jongdari-kills-one-injures-350-in-Taiwan-b5cc36 "Email")

Strong Typhoon Jongdari has hit Taiwan, killing one person and injuring 350 as of Saturday evening, according to the disaster response centre.

The centre said the injured were mainly in Taichung, Changhua, Tainan and Kaohsiung, with most suffering minor injuries. Authorities across the island reported more than 3,600 incidents, mostly involving fallen trees, downed power lines and damaged buildings.

About 140,000 households lost power due to the typhoon. As of 7pm on Saturday, more than 20,000 households still had no electricity, and authorities aimed to restore supply by the end of the night.

The disaster response centre forecast that winds would ease slightly on Sunday, but warned that low-lying coastal areas could still face seawater intrusion or flooding due to the low-pressure system.

Taipei Taoyuan International Airport said it would gradually resume flights on Sunday as Jongdari moved away, expecting to handle more than 600 flights. It urged passengers to check with their airlines for the latest updates.

# Wang Yi says US and China can and must manage AI together

Chinese foreign minister Wang Yi told US officials that both countries, as leading AI nations, have the ability and responsibility to develop and govern artificial intelligence together. He called for global rules to ensure AI benefits people and remains under human control.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 24 Oct 2026 at 00:11 HKT · 1 min read

Chinese foreign minister Wang Yi has said the United States and China, as the two leading nations in artificial intelligence, have both the ability and the responsibility to develop and manage the technology together. He made the remarks during a meeting with US representatives attending the 2026 Global Governance Forum in the Xiong'an New Area in Hebei province.

Wang, a member of the Politburo of the Communist Party of China, said the world faces multiple governance deficits in peace, development and security. China held the Global Governance Forum in Xiong'an, he said, in the hope of building consensus and jointly pushing forward reform of the global governance system.

Beijing advocates an inclusive, beneficial and ethical approach to artificial intelligence, Wang said. As the two countries in the top tier of AI development, the US and China are capable of and responsible for both developing and governing AI well, he added.

Wang stressed that AI development must remain under human control and serve the public good. He called on all sides not only to guard against risks but also to cooperate in drawing up globally applicable rules and standards. Such rules, he said, would allow AI to promote shared prosperity and maintain common security.

content:
2017年10月18日，在北京举行的中共第十九次全国代表大会上，中共党魁习近平发表讲话后，中共军方代表团成员离场。（图片来源：FRED DUFOUR/AFP via Getty Images）

【看中国2026年10月24日讯】（看中国记者李德言综合报导）日前，中共举行纪念长征90周年大会，出现五个反常的地方，包括[习近平](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E4%B9%A0%E8%BF%91%E5%B9%B3)讲话稿的严重缩水，胡春华的罕见缺席等。而习近平走进会场时走路的速度明显比之前快了很多，也成为外界关注的焦点。网友还对此进行热议，甚至质疑习近平的健康状态，有人直指他是回光返照。

## **长征纪念会出现五个异常**

据中共党媒新华社报导称，2026年10月22日上午，在北京人民大会堂举行高规格的所谓纪念长征90周年大会，大约有3000人参加，中共党魁习近平出席会议并做讲话，中共中央政治局常委[李强](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E6%9D%8E%E5%BC%BA)、赵乐际、王沪宁、蔡奇、丁薛祥、李希和中共国家副主席韩正出席。

这次[长征](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E9%95%BF%E5%BE%81)纪念会也出现一些异常现象。

[![Image 2](https://img6.secretchina.com/pic/2025/7-29/p3676411a560438137.jpg)](https://www.naturenergy.us/)

首先，对比2016年召开的纪念80周年大会，中共党媒有全程直播。但这次纪念会则没有全程直播。

其次，2016年召开的纪念长征80周年大会，习近平的讲话内容超过9700字，这次则只有3000字左右。10年前讲话中的“强军”内容有600字左右，今年只有200字左右。

10年前习近平刚刚完成中共军改，他当时组建的军方领导层，已经在这几年中大量落马，其中包括中央军委的多名成员。

第三个异常是，在此前，按惯例通常是由中共二号人物主持这种大会。但10月22日召开的纪念会则是由中共三号人物、全国人大常委会委员长赵乐际主持。据中共党媒新华社报导称，10月22日上午，中共总理李强已结束访俄行程回到北京。在流出的现场视频显示，习近平与李强等中共七常委依次进入会场，但却不是李强主持会议，引发猜测。

第四，中共全国政协副主席胡春华罕见缺席会议。近日，网上传出胡春华已经全家失联的说法。但目前还无法证实，在五中全会上，胡春华是否正常出席，也成为观察他真实处境的风向标。

第五，习近平的身体状况也引发关注。

## **习近平走路速度突变化**

从现场视频中可以发现，习近平走起路来显得比较轻快，一反此前步履蹒跚的常态。

2026年10月22日，旅居欧洲的前内蒙古官员杜文在X平台发帖表示，不装了！今天上午，习近平在人民大会堂，迈着六亲不认的步伐，甩开众小弟直接入座，意思很明确：告诉全党和各界，我身体很好，仍可继续掌权。这个细节很有意思……

同一天，旅美独立时评人蔡慎坤在X平台发帖表示：“就在外界热议习近平健康出状况甚至有可能让权交权时，习近平在五中全会前，频频公开亮相，走路的姿势完全不像在美国国家博物馆台阶上。这一幕，着实耐人寻味。

过去两个月习近平公开露面的画面让外界误以为他的身体状况不佳，甚至传出一轮接班人的猜测，而此前出席全国卫生健康大会，今天出席长征90周年大会，似乎是有意传递一个政治信号：我身体好得很，精力依然充沛，权力仍牢牢在手中，谁也别急着接班！”

## **评论区热议习近平身体状况**

2026年9月13-15日，习近平与彭丽媛出访美国，期间，习近平多次被拍到上下楼梯举步艰难且需要彭丽媛搀扶借力的情况。9月15日，美国总统[川普](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E5%B7%9D%E6%99%AE)夫妇陪同习近平夫妇参观美国国家档案馆，网上流出的视频显示，习近平在上楼梯和下楼梯期间，步履沉重，而川普也一度放缓下楼梯的速度，与习近平保持相同的步速。

而美媒也发文指习近平需要白宫为他专门提供一间休息室，习近平在活动间隙，保持4至5个小时的空档，疑似休息；习近平也缺席与川普的工作午宴。习近平出访印度参加金砖峰会也缺席9月12日的晚宴。

X平台网友评论说：“回光返照？！”“打点鸡血出场，撑不了多久”；“刘欢也能忍痛走100米不打颤，矽肺病晚期的病人也能拔了二楼的吸氧机，挪下楼，接上一楼的吸氧机。[毛泽东](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E6%AF%9B%E6%B3%BD%E4%B8%9C)最后一次在大会上公开露面也能走到座位，但是散场时必须清场后才能在周围人的帮助下离开。”“当年老腊肉（毛泽东）要释放这个信息是去游了长江的。”“前阵子大家猜接班人，最近本人赶紧出来走两步。看来（中共）最高层最忙的不是处理国事，而是亲自辟谣：我还在，我没退，这位置谁也别惦记！”

有人注意到习近平与李强之间的距离：“我更注意的是他后面的李强，距离也是拉开的足够的”；“有了毛渣的1样子了，第二名李强远远跟在后面，不敢靠近，”“（李强）远远的跟在后面，表示自己和习差距甚远，无意取代他”；“也可以说现在没人跟他了，他现在就是光杆司令”；

有人仍对习近平的健康状况存疑：“难道前阵子的‘衰微’是引蛇出洞？这剧情，连走路都能拍成权谋片”；“现在连走路都成了政治学课件，大家看视频的重点已经从‘他说了什么’变成‘这一步迈得稳不稳’了。”“走楼梯就不行了”；“走平路与上下飞机舷梯不是一回事！”“从入场一侧紧挨着主席台有个118厅，领导人专属休息厅，走几步就进会场”；“你让他下楼梯试试看”；“在自己家里好装，在别人地方，都有媒体”；“有时我们自己痛风那几天都走路不利索，吃几天药就生龙活虎”；“看过美国之音解密时刻，林副主席（林彪）当时公众活动也是神采飞扬，回家后就是另一个人。说是打兴奋剂。”

也有人表示：“为啥老是歪着脖子，不能治好吗？”

有人注意到习近平的表情：“板着脸也不正常呀！”“表情像是很不开心。”有人怀疑这个视频是经过加工处理的：“这个都看不出来？这是二倍快进镜头拍的”；“速度还可以再加速一倍”；

有人猜测习近平这次没有穿“内增高”鞋，所以走路快：“访美是因为配合川普198要穿增高鞋，踩着高跷下楼梯怕摔了才扶着彭丽媛”；“不穿内增高肯定利索”；

此外，也有网友注意到一个现象：“台上欢迎鼓掌的官员，好像没一个人对习注目礼，这里面有点说法……”“台上的大员们不看习，向队列的末尾看，看谁呢？被行注目礼的那个人，一定是最重要的人！除了村花，还会有谁？”有西班牙网友留言表达类似的看法：“仔细看那个影片，你们会注意到人们并没有用眼神追随它，所有人都朝右边看，而不是看它去的方向，这完全不寻常。”

## **习近平讲话提到惊涛骇浪**

习近平在讲话中提到，要“随时准备经受风高浪急甚至惊涛骇浪的重大考验，”让人猜测中共内斗的激烈程度。他还说要坚持中共对军队的绝对领导，这不禁让人联想到，今年1月，原中共中央军委副主席张又侠、原中央军委联合参谋部参谋长刘振立落马后，习近平在2026年开年至今，都没有到各大军区视察。此前屡屡有传闻说，中共军方对习近平抓捕张又侠、刘振立十分不满。

2026年10月22日，X平台博主“三票先生Mr.3rights”发帖总结习近平这次讲话说：

1、党的领导要有核心，长征胜利的核心是毛泽东，现在是新的长征，核心就是习近平；

2、马克思主义基本原理同[中国](https://www.secretchina.com/)具体实际紧密结合，之前产生了毛泽东思想，后面新长征路上即将推出习近平思想；

3、新长征路上要“持之以恒推进全面从严治党”，过几天五中全会要做决定，先预告一下。

X平台网友表示：“搞好经济比啥都强谁有兴趣和平时代新长征，没苦硬吃，好日子不过去找苦吃”；“他们忽悠多难兴邦，苦难辉煌”；“长征和转进是同义词”；“坐山观党斗，哈哈哈。”“这次中共大概率要亡在习近平手上。”

## **被中共美化的长征真相 绕不开的张国焘**

据悉，中共官方定义的所谓“长征”，是在1934年至1936年期间，中共红军在国民政府第五次“围剿”下，被迫撤离中央苏区的一场大逃亡。但中共却无法绕开一个人的名字--张国焘。在长征途中，中共内部在军事路线上产生严重分歧，1935年1月15日至17日，在贵州省遵义召开的遵义会议成为转折点，毛泽东确立了其在中共党内的领导地位；而中共红一、红四方面军会师后，还出现张国焘“另立中央”的说法。

1935年4月，张国焘带领红四方面军放弃了川陕根据地。1935年6月在懋功会师后，他反对中共继续“北上”的决定，同年10月他率部南下川康，在卓木碉宣布另立“中央”，后来被迫取消。

1937年3月，张国焘在中共政治局扩大会议受到批判。1938年4月初，他乘祭黄帝陵之机逃出陕甘宁边区，投靠中国国民党。

而习近平上台后，中共党媒多次点名批判张国焘，称他是所谓“野心家”、“阴谋家”，并指责他“挟兵自重、另立中央”等等。

在张又侠、刘振立落马后，中共军报至少四次发表批判张国焘的文章，包括2026年2月2日的《政治建军专刊．淬火要论丨组织强则军队强》，2月3日的《新征程上永葆闯关的劲头》，2月9日的《政治建军专刊．淬火要论丨人才自古要养成》，《政治上强是最根本的强》。

其中，《政治上强是最根本的强》提到“张国焘进行分裂党和红军的活动”内容，并说当时朱德虽然面对“威逼利诱”，但没跟随张国焘。该文也再次向中共军队喊话，要“一切行动听从党中央、中央军委和习主席指挥”云云。虽然这些文章都没有点名张又侠及刘振立。但发表时间正值两人刚刚落马的敏感时刻，不免引发猜测。

在长征90周年纪念会上，习近平再次提到“随时准备经受风高浪急甚至惊涛骇浪的重大考验，”以及要坚持中共对军队的绝对领导，背后的动机引发关注。

《九评共产党》中对中共极力美化的长征做出精准的描述：中共把“长征”说成是北上抗日，把“长征”炒成了中国革命的神话：长征是“宣言书”，“宣传队”，“播种机”，以我们的胜利、敌人的失败而告结束。

北上抗日是中共掩盖失败的一个无耻谎言，史实是1933年10月至1934年1月共产党的第五次反围剿遭到惨败，中共农村政权相继丧失，根据地日益缩小，中央红军被迫逃亡。这才是“长征”的起因。

向西突围，曲线接近外蒙和苏联是真正的长征路线意图。当时中共步履维艰，西进靠近外蒙，不至腹背受敌遭聚歼，兵败则进入苏联。选择走山西和绥远，一方面可以高举抗日大旗争得民心，另一方面是这一带安全，没有日本人，日军侵占的是长城一线。一年后共产党长征逃亡到陕北时，中央红军主力由8万多人减至6000人。

# Seven candidates nominated for Labour Advisory Board employee representative election

Hong Kong's Labour Department announced on 23 October 2026 that seven candidates have been nominated for the Labour Advisory Board employee representative election. Voting will take place on 28 November at Mei Foo Community Hall.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

Hong Kong's Labour Department on 23 October 2026 announced the list of seven candidates nominated for the employee representative election of the Labour Advisory Board (LAB). The candidates, listed in order of nomination receipt, are: Sze Sze-kit, chairman of the Hong Kong Construction Industry General Workers Union; Tang Tze-on, chairman of the Hong Kong Government Lifeguards General Union; Yeung Hoi-kuen, vice-chairman of the Hong Kong Seamen's Union; Lik Na, president of the Hong Kong Social Welfare Services Employees Association; Tam Kam-lin, vice-chairman of the Hong Kong and Kowloon Federation of Labour; Lo Wai-kit, vice-chairman of the Hong Kong Nurses Association; and Lam Kwan-ho, chairman of the Marine Inspectors and Senior Assistant Shipping Officers Association.

A total of 804 registered trade unions serving as electoral units have appointed authorised representatives to vote in this election. The Labour Department will notify these units in writing of the candidate list and detailed voting arrangements. Authorised representatives can cast their ballots on election day, 28 November, from 9:00 am to 5:00 pm at the polling station in Mei Foo Community Hall.

Candidates may monitor the vote count on election day. The returning officer is the Assistant Commissioner for Labour (Development). The candidate list, the register of electoral units that have appointed authorised representatives, and the election rules and procedures are available on the Labour Department's website (www.labour.gov.hk/tc/news/LAB_Election2026.htm). Enquiries can be directed to 2852 4022.

The LAB is a tripartite advisory body that provides advice to the Commissioner for Labour on labour matters. Its members include representatives of both employees and employers.

# Tibet earthquake kills 16, emergency response raised to level 3

A magnitude 7.0 earthquake in Baqing County, Tibet, has killed 16 people and injured 54. China's emergency response has been upgraded to level 3, with a working group led by Wang Kun, head of the China Earthquake Administration, dispatched to the area.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 23 Oct 2026 at 08:54 HKT · 1 min read

Share:

[](https://wa.me/?text=Tibet%20earthquake%20kills%2016%2C%20emergency%20response%20raised%20to%20level%203%20https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/china/Tibet-earthquake-kills-16-emergency-response-raised-to-level-645ba2 "WhatsApp")[](https://t.me/share/url?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/china/Tibet-earthquake-kills-16-emergency-response-raised-to-level-645ba2&text=Tibet%20earthquake%20kills%2016%2C%20emergency%20response%20raised%20to%20level%203 "Telegram")[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/china/Tibet-earthquake-kills-16-emergency-response-raised-to-level-645ba2 "Facebook")[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/china/Tibet-earthquake-kills-16-emergency-response-raised-to-level-645ba2&text=Tibet%20earthquake%20kills%2016%2C%20emergency%20response%20raised%20to%20level%203 "X")[](mailto:?subject=Tibet%20earthquake%20kills%2016%2C%20emergency%20response%20raised%20to%20level%203&body=Tibet%20earthquake%20kills%2016%2C%20emergency%20response%20raised%20to%20level%203%0Ahttps%3A//clb.org.hk/en/china/Tibet-earthquake-kills-16-emergency-response-raised-to-level-645ba2 "Email")

A magnitude 7.0 earthquake struck Baqing County in Tibet on the evening of 22 October, killing 16 people and injuring 54, according to state broadcaster RTHK.

The Ministry of Emergency Management has raised the disaster emergency response from level 4 to level 3. A working group led by Wang Kun, deputy commander of the State Council's earthquake relief headquarters and head of the China Earthquake Administration, has been sent to the affected area to provide guidance and assistance. The ministry has also deployed a Wing Loong drone to the disaster zone for reconnaissance missions.

The Western Theatre Command has activated its emergency response mechanism for rescue and disaster relief operations. It has verified the extent of the damage and assessed the geographical and climatic conditions of the affected region, and has directed troops stationed near the disaster area to deploy to affected villages and towns.

National Highway 317 in Tibet, where a section near Nyingchi was blocked by falling rocks, was cleared in the early hours of 23 October after emergency repairs.

The earthquake struck at 10:33 pm local time on 22 October, with the epicentre located in Maryu Township, Baqing County, at a depth of 10 kilometres.

# 海关在机场检获价值170万港元大麻，两名内地男子被捕
香港海关周四在香港国际机场拘捕两名内地男子，检获约8公斤怀疑大麻芽，价值170万港元。嫌疑人年龄分别为 30 岁和 36 岁，分别从曼谷抵达，随身行李中装有大麻。调查仍在继续。

在第一起案件中，一名从曼谷抵达的30岁男子在其随身行李箱中被发现携带约5公斤疑似大麻芽。

# Customs seizes HK$1.7m cannabis at airport, two mainland men arrested

Hong Kong Customs arrested two mainland men at Hong Kong International Airport on Thursday, seizing about 8kg of suspected cannabis buds worth HK$1.7 million. The suspects, aged 30 and 36, arrived separately from Bangkok with cannabis in their carry-on luggage. Investigations continue.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 23 Oct 2026 at 01:11 HKT · 1 min read

Share:

[](https://wa.me/?text=Customs%20seizes%20HK%241.7m%20cannabis%20at%20airport%2C%20two%20mainland%20men%20arrested%20https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Customs-seizes-HK-1-7m-cannabis-at-airport-two-mainland-men-1277d4 "WhatsApp")[](https://t.me/share/url?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Customs-seizes-HK-1-7m-cannabis-at-airport-two-mainland-men-1277d4&text=Customs%20seizes%20HK%241.7m%20cannabis%20at%20airport%2C%20two%20mainland%20men%20arrested "Telegram")[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Customs-seizes-HK-1-7m-cannabis-at-airport-two-mainland-men-1277d4 "Facebook")[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Customs-seizes-HK-1-7m-cannabis-at-airport-two-mainland-men-1277d4&text=Customs%20seizes%20HK%241.7m%20cannabis%20at%20airport%2C%20two%20mainland%20men%20arrested "X")[](mailto:?subject=Customs%20seizes%20HK%241.7m%20cannabis%20at%20airport%2C%20two%20mainland%20men%20arrested&body=Customs%20seizes%20HK%241.7m%20cannabis%20at%20airport%2C%20two%20mainland%20men%20arrested%0Ahttps%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Customs-seizes-HK-1-7m-cannabis-at-airport-two-mainland-men-1277d4 "Email")

Hong Kong Customs arrested two incoming mainland Chinese male passengers at Hong Kong International Airport on Thursday in separate drug trafficking cases. Officers seized about 8 kilogrammes of suspected cannabis buds with a total estimated market value of about HK$1.7 million.

In the first case, a 30-year-old man arriving from Bangkok was found with about 5 kilogrammes of suspected cannabis buds in his carry-on suitcase. In the second case, a 36-year-old man also arriving from Bangkok was found with about 3 kilogrammes of suspected cannabis buds in his carry-on suitcase.

Both investigations are ongoing. Customs reminded the public that drug trafficking carries a maximum penalty of a HK$5 million fine and life imprisonment.

# Hong Kong para-swimmers win bronze in mixed S14 relay at Asian Para Games

Hong Kong's mixed S14 4x100m freestyle relay team won bronze at the Asian Para Games, finishing in 3 minutes 53.77 seconds behind gold medalists Japan and silver medalists Thailand. The quartet of Chan Yui-lam, Lau Chiu-yee, Cheung Tsun-lok and Wong Hon-yin will receive HK$125,000 under the Jockey C

Hong Kong para-swimmers captured a bronze medal in the mixed S14 4x100-metre freestyle relay at the Asian Para Games, adding to the city's podium tally in the pool following a closely contested four-way final.

The quartet of Chan Yui-lam, Lau Chiu-yee, Cheung Tsun-lok, and Wong Hon-yin clocked a combined time of 3 minutes and 53.77 seconds to finish third overall. Hong Kong entered the final facing competition from three other regional sides, including Thailand, host nation Japan, and South Korea.

Setting an assertive tempo over the opening legs, the Hong Kong squad established themselves near the front of the pack, holding second place behind early pacesetter Thailand through the initial stages of the race. Japan launched a powerful surge over the closing legs of the relay, overtaking both Hong Kong and Thailand to touch the wall first and claim the gold medal.

Despite the late change in the running order, the Hong Kong swimmers maintained their rhythm over the remaining distance to stop the clock at 3 minutes and 53.77 seconds, securing the bronze medal ahead of fourth-placed South Korea.

The relay squad will be rewarded for their third-place finish through local athlete support initiatives. Under the Jockey Club Athlete Incentive Awards Scheme, Hong Kong, China athletes who claim bronze medals in team events at the Asian Para Games are eligible to receive HK$125,000, providing financial recognition for the four swimmers' collective accomplishment on the regional stage.

_为台湾和蒙古的运动员演奏伊朗国歌，促使名古屋市长道歉。_

本周在日本名古屋举行的亚残运会上，三度奏错国歌，促使市长在该市举办[饱受事故困扰的亚运会]几周后道歉(https://www.aljazeera.com/sports/2026/9/28/athletes-criticise-organizational-logistical-mishaps-at-sad-asian-games)。

名古屋市市长广泽一郎周三为最新的错误道歉，尽管官员们承诺采取措施防止错误，包括演奏正确的国歌。

## 推荐故事

4 项清单
* 列表 1（共 4 项）[一部错误喜剧如何在亚运会上为运动员“毁了一切”](https://www.aljazeera.com/sports/2026/9/28/athletes-criticise-organizational-logistic-mishaps-at-sad-asian-games)
* 列表 2 of 4[亚运会：韩国排球队最近被带到错误的场地](https://www.aljazeera.com/sports/2026/9/29/asian-games-2026-aichi-nagoya-south-korea-volley-team-bus-wrong-location)
* list 3 of 4[台湾性别排拳手林宇廷赢得亚运会金牌](https://www.aljazeera.com/sports/2026/10/2/asian-games-aichi-nagoya-2026-boxing-taiwan-lin-yu-ting-gold)
* 列出 4 项，共 4 项[印度在亚运会上击败巴基斯坦，没有握手，仪式也被推迟](https://www.aljazeera.com/sports/2026/10/3/india-beat-arch-rivals-pakistan-to-win-asian-games-t20-cricket-gold)

列表末尾
市长在新闻发布会上表示：“这些事情在亚运会期间发生，因此，当然，我们根据吸取的教训对行动进行了审查和检查。这样的事情再次发生，实在令人无法接受。”

亚洲残疾人运动会将于周六在日本中部中心城市举行，共有 18 个大项的约 4,000 名运动员和官员参加。

名古屋市官员在市长新闻发布会上表示，周一，一名台湾运动员赢得了男子残疾人跆拳道比赛，但全程演奏了伊朗国歌。

他们说，仪式结束后，官员们意识到了自己的错误。

据该市称，当天，在女子残疾人跆拳道仪式上，蒙古选手获得金牌时再次演奏了伊朗国歌。

蒙古代表团指出错误后，不正确的音乐被停止。

名古屋官员表示，代表团提供音乐后，组织者随后演奏了蒙古国歌。

另外，周一，在中国和伊朗的坐式排球比赛之前，官员们播放了大约五秒钟的韩国国歌，而不是中国国歌。

市长说：“这是不可接受的，或者更确切地说，这是痛苦的。我对此感到非常抱歉。”他补充说，他认为比赛进展顺利。

根据您的兴趣获取即时警报和更新。成为第一个知道重大事件发生的人。
十月初结束的亚运会因运动员住宿条件不足、国歌演奏错误等问题而受到严厉批评。

9月18日，组织者为韩国曲棍球队演奏朝鲜国歌。

_The Iranian national anthem was played for athletes from Taiwan and Mongolia, prompting Nagoya’s mayor to apologise._

Wrong national anthems were played three times at the Asian Para Games in Japan’s Nagoya this week, prompting the mayor to apologise weeks after the city hosted the [mishap-plagued Asian Games](https://www.aljazeera.com/sports/2026/9/28/athletes-criticise-organisational-logistical-mishaps-at-sad-asian-games).

Nagoya Mayor Ichiro Hirosawa apologised on Wednesday for the latest error, which occurred despite officials’ pledges to implement steps to prevent mistakes, including playing the correct national anthems.

*   list 2 of 4[Asian Games: South Korea volleyball team latest to be taken to wrong venue](https://www.aljazeera.com/sports/2026/9/29/asian-games-2026-aichi-nagoya-south-korea-volley-team-bus-wrong-location)

*   list 4 of 4[No handshakes and a delayed ceremony as India beat Pakistan at Asian Games](https://www.aljazeera.com/sports/2026/10/3/india-beat-arch-rivals-pakistan-to-win-asian-games-t20-cricket-gold)

end of list
“These things happened during the Asian Games, so, of course, the operations were reviewed and examined based on the lessons learned. The fact that it happened again is really just unacceptable,” the mayor said at a news conference.

The Asian Para Games is taking place in the central Japanese hub city through Saturday, featuring about 4,000 athletes and officials in 18 sports.

On Monday, a Taiwanese athlete won a men’s para taekwondo competition, but the Iranian anthem was played in its entirety, according to Nagoya officials at the mayor’s news conference.

Officials realised their mistake after the ceremony, they said.

The Iranian anthem was played again that day during a women’s para taekwondo ceremony as a Mongolian competitor was receiving the gold medal, according to the city.

The incorrect music was stopped after the Mongolian delegation pointed out the error.

Organisers then played the Mongolian anthem after the music was provided by the delegation, Nagoya officials said.

Separately on Monday, officials broadcast the South Korean anthem for about five seconds instead of the Chinese one before a sitting volleyball match between China and Iran.

“It is unacceptable, or rather, it’s painful. I am very sorry about it,” the mayor said, adding that he felt the tournament was otherwise progressing smoothly.

On September 18, organisers played North Korea’s national anthem for the South Korean hockey team.

# Hong Kong cyber security centre urges organisations to audit all PHP systems after critical flaws found

Hong Kong’s cyber security coordination centre has called on businesses and institutions to conduct a comprehensive audit of all products and services that may use PHP, after two critical vulnerabilities were patched. The flaws could allow remote attackers to execute unauthorised code, and the risks

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 22 Oct 2026 at 18:03 HKT · 1 min read

Share:

[](https://wa.me/?text=Hong%20Kong%20cyber%20security%20centre%20urges%20organisations%20to%20audit%20all%20PHP%20systems%20after%20critical%20flaws%20found%20https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-cyber-security-centre-urges-organisations-to-audit-f9e6d8 "WhatsApp")[](https://t.me/share/url?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-cyber-security-centre-urges-organisations-to-audit-f9e6d8&text=Hong%20Kong%20cyber%20security%20centre%20urges%20organisations%20to%20audit%20all%20PHP%20systems%20after%20critical%20flaws%20found "Telegram")[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-cyber-security-centre-urges-organisations-to-audit-f9e6d8 "Facebook")[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-cyber-security-centre-urges-organisations-to-audit-f9e6d8&text=Hong%20Kong%20cyber%20security%20centre%20urges%20organisations%20to%20audit%20all%20PHP%20systems%20after%20critical%20flaws%20found "X")[](mailto:?subject=Hong%20Kong%20cyber%20security%20centre%20urges%20organisations%20to%20audit%20all%20PHP%20systems%20after%20critical%20flaws%20found&body=Hong%20Kong%20cyber%20security%20centre%20urges%20organisations%20to%20audit%20all%20PHP%20systems%20after%20critical%20flaws%20found%0Ahttps%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-cyber-security-centre-urges-organisations-to-audit-f9e6d8 "Email")

Hong Kong’s cyber security incident coordination centre has urged local businesses and institutions to conduct a full inventory of all systems that may use PHP, after the PHP security team released an emergency update to patch two critical vulnerabilities. The flaws could allow remote attackers to execute unauthorised code, and affected PHP systems must be updated as soon as possible.

The centre highlighted that the potential risks from these vulnerabilities are not limited to general web servers. Many enterprise applications, network and security devices, storage and surveillance systems embed PHP in their management consoles or operational components. The version of PHP embedded in such equipment may not match the version shown by the operating system, creating a blind spot in enterprise network security management.

Institutions should therefore not only check their web servers but immediately conduct a comprehensive audit of all products, services and external-facing systems that may use PHP. They should proactively contact suppliers to confirm the scope of the impact and arrange for patches.

The centre also noted that the incident reflects how artificial intelligence is accelerating the speed of cyber security attacks and defences. According to publicly available information, the PHP vulnerabilities were discovered as early as August this year by security researchers using AI technology, who then reported them to the PHP team for patching.

The centre called on organisations to take multiple countermeasures, including auditing all systems running PHP across the organisation, with particular attention to internet-facing servers, and upgrading PHP to the patched version.
