# 近百名基督徒齊聚王美惠競總 為台灣、參選人祈福

2026/10/22 17:33

[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[![Image 21](https://imgcdn.cna.com.tw/www/website/img/support.svg)](https://cna.com.tw/donate/)

請同意我們的隱私權規範，才能啟用聽新聞的功能。

（中央社記者[黃國芳](https://cna.com.tw/author/0117/)嘉義市22日電）民進黨嘉義市長參選人王美惠競選總部今天聚集近百名基督徒參加「基督徒感恩祝福祈禱會」，由牧師洪智信主禮，現場透過詩歌、禱告與祝福，共同為台灣、嘉義及王美惠祈福。

王美惠競選總部今天發布新聞稿表示，祈禱會由洪智信帶領牧師團共同禱告，感謝上帝長久以來守護台灣，讓台灣歷經民主抗爭，走到今日享有民主自由的社會，並祈求上帝持續守護台灣民主。

現場同時為王美惠祈禱，祈求上帝賜予憐憫的心、智慧、勇氣與膽識，勇敢向前，繼續為嘉義市民服務。王美惠也在眾牧師的按手祝福與禱告中，接受來自教會的勉勵。

[![Image 22](https://imgcdn.cna.com.tw/www/website/img/ad300x223.jpg)](https://lin.ee/tPtHlLQ)

王美惠表示，一路走來，始終有教會牧師及會友陪伴，每當遇到困難、挫折，甚至感到疲憊時，教會總會給予溫暖，這份長久以來的關懷與支持，始終銘記在心。

王美惠表示，從政多年，始終認為政治就是要關心人民、照顧需要幫助的民眾，未來也會秉持謙卑、感恩與服務的心，將這份愛化為實際行動，讓溫暖與照顧深入嘉義市基層。（編輯：張雅淨）1151022

#屯门店附近怀疑持刀袭击 男子受伤
周二晚间，屯门一间便利店附近发生疑似持刀袭击事件，一名61岁男子受伤。警方在现场发现一把15厘米的水果刀。受害者是一名持有香港身份证的越南公民，被送往医院。尚未逮捕任何人。

初步调查显示该男子遭到持刀袭击，但动机尚不清楚。警方在现场发现一把长约15厘米的水果刀

# Man injured in suspected knife attack near Tuen Mun store

A 61-year-old man was injured in a suspected knife attack near a convenience store in Tuen Mun on Tuesday evening. Police found a 15cm fruit knife at the scene. The victim, a Vietnamese national with a Hong Kong ID, was taken to hospital. No arrests have been made.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

A 61-year-old man was injured in a suspected knife attack near a convenience store in Tuen Mun on Tuesday night, according to police.

Police received a report from a passer-by at 8.42pm that someone appeared to be injured outside a convenience store on Yan Oi Tong Circuit. Officers found the man with injuries to his abdomen and hand. He was conscious and taken to Tuen Mun Hospital.

Initial investigations suggest the man had been attacked with a knife, though the motive is unknown. Police found a fruit knife about 15cm long at the scene, believed to be related to the case. The case has been classified as wounding and handed to the Tuen Mun police district crime investigation team. No arrests have been made.

The injured man is understood to be a Vietnamese national holding a Hong Kong identity card.

_以下是 2026 年 10 月 14 日国会研究服务部报告《俄罗斯的北极军事态势：国会的考虑因素》。_

## 摘自报告

北极是俄罗斯的重要战略地区，具有重大的军事和经济影响。俄罗斯是北极地区面积最大的国家，海岸线绵延24,000多公里。根据美国情报界的 2026 年年度威胁评估，北极是俄罗斯战略和军事问题的核心，也是俄罗斯北方舰队的所在地，该舰队指挥着俄罗斯约三分之二的潜艇核威慑力量。北极在俄罗斯能源和经济发展计划中也发挥着重要作用。冷战结束后、2022年俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰之前，北极是一个多边合作地区，但此后俄罗斯与其他北极国家之间的紧张局势加剧。俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京在2025年3月于摩尔曼斯克举行的北极论坛上发表演讲时表示，“北极对于俄罗斯乃至整个世界的作用和重要性明显在增长。遗憾的是，该地区的地缘政治竞争和地位争夺也在不断升级。”
十多年来，俄罗斯增强了其在北极的军事能力，包括重建苏联时代的旧军事基地、建设新的基地和基础设施、宣布组建新部队并扩大现有部队规模、重组指挥和控制结构，以及采取新的努力实现北方舰队（包括其潜艇部队）的现代化。目前尚不清楚俄罗斯是否有财力和人力资源来实施其在北极的军事现代化努力和计划，或者可以在什么时间范围内实施。此外，随着芬兰和瑞典加入北约（分别于 2023 年和 2024 年）以及乌克兰地面部队遭受重大损失，俄罗斯在北极的军事态势变得越来越不稳定。美国国防情报局局长詹姆斯·亚当斯中将在 2026 年 4 月在国会作证时表示，“随着北极成为国际竞争的焦点，克里姆林宫越来越担心该地区北约部队的增长及其对俄罗斯经济利益构成的威胁。作为回应，莫斯科正在该地区实现军事力量现代化，以对抗北约，捍卫这些经济利益，并确保其对北方海航道的主导地位，尽管乌克兰的要求受到限制专门用于这些努力的资源。”

_The following is the Oct. 14, 2026, Congressional Research Service report, Russia’s Arctic Military Posture: Considerations for Congress._

## From the Report

The Arctic is a key strategic region for Russia with significant military and economic implications. Russia is the largest of the Arctic states in terms of territory, stretching over 24,000 kilometers of coastline. The Arctic is central to Russian strategic and military concerns and is home to Russia’s Northern Fleet, which operates about two-thirds of Russia’s submarine-based nuclear deterrent, according to the U.S. intelligence community’s 2026 Annual Threat Assessment. The Arctic also plays an important role in Russia’s energy and economic development plans. After the Cold War and prior to Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022, the Arctic was a region of multilateral cooperation, but tensions have since grown in the region between Russia and the other Arctic states. In a March 2025 speech at the Arctic Forum in Murmansk, Russian President Vladimir Putin stated, “the role and importance of the Arctic for Russia and for the entire world are obviously growing. Regrettably, the geopolitical competition and fighting for positions in this region are also escalating.”

For over a decade, Russia has increased its military capabilities in the Arctic, including reestablishing old Soviet-era military bases, building new bases and infrastructure, announcing the creation of new units and increasing the size of existing forces, reorganizing command and control structures, and undertaking new efforts to modernize the Northern Fleet—including its submarine forces. It remains unclear whether Russia has the financial and personnel resources to carry out its military modernization efforts and plans in the Arctic, or in what time frame it could do so. Additionally, the Russian military posture in the Arctic has become increasingly precarious with the accession of Finland and Sweden into NATO (in 2023 and 2024, respectively) and heavy ground-force losses suffered in Ukraine. According to Lieutenant General James Adams, Director of the Defense Intelligence Agency, in April 2026 testimony before Congress, “As the Arctic becomes a focal point of international competition, the Kremlin is increasingly concerned by the growth of NATO forces in the region and the perceived threat they pose to Russia’s economic interests. In response, Moscow is modernizing its military forces in the region to counter NATO, defend these economic interests, and ensure its dominance over the Northern Sea Route, though requirements in Ukraine constrain resources devoted to these efforts.”

Depending on Russia’s military modernization efforts in the Arctic, Congress may assess U.S. national security priorities in the region. Congress also may consider how increased Russian military capabilities could threaten U.S. and allied interests; evaluate allied and NATO plans and military posture; and deploy various legislative and oversight tools to support, reject, or otherwise modify the Administration’s approach to the region. Potential considerations for Congress include:

*   the scale and speed of Russian military posture adjustments in the Arctic and the feasibility of Russia achieving those goals, including how those adjustments could affect U.S. and allied security and strategic objectives in the region;
*   how to exercise oversight of plans to increase and/or modify the U.S. military presence in the Arctic;
*   the state of current and future appropriations for Arctic-capable military assets, such as icebreakers; and
*   how U.S. strategic and military plans for the region incorporate and synchronize with other allied partners and NATO.

# Hong Kong Correctional Services drills simulate fire, riot at prison

The Correctional Services Department held a large-scale emergency drill at Lo Wu Correctional Institution, simulating inmate brawls, hostage-taking, fire, collective riot and discovery of explosives. Over 150 personnel from the department, police and fire services took part.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

The Correctional Services Department (CSD) conducted a large-scale emergency response drill at Lo Wu Correctional Institution on 21 October, simulating a series of incidents including inmate brawls, hostage-taking, a fire, a collective riot and the discovery of explosives.

The drill was designed to test the department's ability to respond to emergencies, including on-scene command and information transmission, activation of emergency response systems at various levels in line with the developing situation, and the effectiveness of departmental response measures and information dissemination, the CSD said.

It also tested coordination between the CSD and other government departments during an incident, and included procedures for emergency evacuation after the discovery of explosives within the prison grounds.

More than 150 personnel participated in the exercise, including the CSD's Emergency Response Team and Regional Response Team, as well as officers from the Hong Kong Police Force and the Fire Services Department.

summary: Wrongly Accused Abroad Help Me Afford Legal Defense and Survival. Hi to everyone, my name is Julian! I'm an Italian and American national, I used to work as a substitute teacher in an Italian high school. On 26th of August I went to China t
content:
Wrongly Accused Abroad Help Me Afford Legal Defense and Survival.

Hi to everyone, my name is Julian! I'm an Italian and American national, I used to work as a substitute teacher in an Italian high school.

On 26th of August I went to China to start traveling. Some weeks later, on September 28th, I arrived in Thailand. Since then, I had been traveling mostly in northern Thailand.

It was an incredible experience — honestly, probably the best of my life.

But then… something completely unexpected happened to me.

On Wednesday, November 26th, very early in the morning around 5:30 a.m., I booked a Grab taxi from where I was staying, in Nothanburi (a province northwest of Bangkok), to go to Suvarnabhumi Airport. I had a flight with Etihad Airways at 8:55 a.m. to Italy, where I live.

I arrived at the airport two hours before departure, as recommended by the airline. The check-in process went smoothly, and everything seemed normal until I reached immigration.

There were two sections: one with officers and one automatic lane. The automatic lane was moving faster, so I chose that. When it was my turn, I tapped my passport on the scanner, but a red message appeared. I tried again—same result.

A security guard came to help me and tried scanning my passport himself, but it still didn’t work. He then told me to go to the manual lane.

The immigration officer took my passport, typed something on her computer, smiled, and said, “Sorry, just wait here for a moment.” She left and returned a few minutes later with another officer who looked serious. They escorted me to the immigration desk and told me to wait.

At that moment I started to feel anxious. I thought maybe I had overstayed my visa. My visa was expiring that same day, November 26th, so I was worried I might be in trouble.

After about 15 minutes, I approached the desk to ask what was happening, but they just told me to sit down and wait. Ten minutes later, another officer came with a paper showing a photocopy of my passport and asked me to confirm that it was mine. I said yes.

Most of the staff did not speak English, which made everything more frightening.

Then, using a translation app on his phone, the officer showed me a message saying that I was being charged with possession of indecent content and distribution of that material on websites accessible to the public.

I was completely shocked and confused. I thought there must be a mistake.

There was no opportunity to explain anything. Two immigration officers escorted me to another office inside the airport.

Inside, I was told to sign many documents, all in Thai. No one explained them to me in English. They took photos of me with officers behind me. Later, they took more photos from the front, left, and right. That’s when I realized: they were taking a mugshot.

Everything felt surreal. I was exhausted because I hadn’t slept much the night before. It felt like a nightmare.

“Did you tell your family that you have been arrested?”

That was the moment it truly hit me. I had never imagined being arrested in my life, especially not in a foreign country. I was terrified and confused.

I called my embassy, but it was still closed. Later, they contacted me and explained the situation. The embassy told me that creating and distributing certain types of videos can be a crime in Thailand, as in many countries, and that if I believed I was innocent, the Thai legal process would take its course.

They asked me for two emergency contacts and sent me a list of lawyers, advising me to find legal representation.

Eventually, we arrived at a police station in Samut Prakan province, in a town called Khlong Dan.

At that point, I was officially placed under arrest and faced the risk of jail if I was unable to pay bail.

My Italian passport was confiscated by the police and is currently being held by them. This happened on November 26th.

I am writing this today, February 24, 2026. I am creating a YouTube channel to explain in more detail what is happening to me. I am currently safe and living in a hostel in Bangkok. The last three months have been the most stressful of my life.

In December, I struggled to obtain a visa extension, which I was finally able to secure on January 8, 2026. This visa must be renewed every 45 days.

I am asking for your help to raise funds for legal fees, living expenses, and possible bail that may be requested by the judge if the case goes to court. I cannot legally work in Thailand because that requires a work visa. My family is helping me at the moment, but they cannot sustain these expenses for much longer. I do not know when I will be able to return to my country, as I must wait for the Thai legal process to run its course.

**I want to state clearly that I have never uploaded any indecent content on the internet. The accuser, a woman, has claimed to provide “evidence” of this. At the police station, I was shown the alleged evidence, which consisted of screenshots from an OnlyFans profile belonging to a couple: a Thai woman and a Caucasian man. The man’s face was blurred, and I was accused of being that person.**

The case will soon be handed over to the prosecutor, and according to police officers at Khlong Dan Police Station, it will most likely proceed to court (that's what they said). This is extremely distressing, especially because my lawyer has told me that cases with weak evidence are usually dropped by the police or the prosecutor.

Thank you for taking the time to read my story. Any help or support during this very difficult time would mean a great deal to me.

Julian

國民黨台中市長參選人江啟臣（右2）21日赴北區東興市場掃街，爭取民眾支持。江啟臣認為，傳統市場不僅是市民日常生活的核心，更是城市經濟活力的重要縮影。（江啟臣辦公室提供）中央社記者趙麗妍傳真 115年10月21日

（中央社記者[趙麗妍](https://cna.com.tw/author/0036/)台中21日電）國民黨籍台中市長參選人江啟臣今天持續市場掃街，提及打造「20分鐘生活圈」均衡城市生活機能。民進黨籍台中市長參選人何欣純到大學演講，分享自己從政經過，憶及亡母眼眶泛淚。

江啟臣今天一早前往台中市北區東興市場掃街拜票。江啟臣說，傳統市場不僅是市民日常生活的核心，更是城市經濟活力的重要縮影。北區文教資源豐沛、人口高度密集且商圈成熟，隨著城市轉型，更需要前瞻且細緻的公共建設與政策配套支持。

江啟臣提出建構「20分鐘生活圈」，針對北區高密度的就學、就醫、採買與托育需求，強化公共運輸與微循環接駁，補足社區生活機能，讓居民在日常20分鐘生活圈內就能滿足各項日常生活需求，減少奔波、把更多時間留給家人。

何欣純今天下午到東海大學演講，主題為「從政之路與城市未來」。何欣純提到，她在求學時有一部電影「阿甘正傳」，主角有一句名言，人生就像一盒巧克力，裡面有很多不同口味，你永遠不知道拿到那一顆味道是什麼。她以此為例表示，其實從政都不是她的人生規劃。

何欣純分享，她前往英國留學、政黨選擇及女性權益等理念，和媽媽發生許多衝突，媽媽中風病倒後，語言傳達受限，但當她第一次當選議員，她仍感受到媽媽為她能服務社會而驕傲。何欣純提及她和媽媽和解的過程，忍不住落淚。（編輯：李亨山）1151021

title: Insurance Authority calls for cross-sector collaboration to support Hong Kong’s ageing population
zh_title: 保险业监管局呼吁跨界别合作支援香港人口老化
summary: 香港保险业监管局表示，保险业必须与政府和医疗保健提供者合作，应对人口老龄化带来的挑战。由于到 2046 年，65 岁或以上的居民数量预计将达到 274 万，官员们强调需要创新的长期目标 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 21 日 17:28 香港时间 · 阅读 2 分钟 香港保险业监管局 (IA) 呼吁加强合作
content:
香港
香港保险业监管局表示，保险业必须与政府和医疗保健提供者合作，应对人口老龄化带来的挑战。预计到 2046 年，65 岁或以上的居民数量将达到 274 万，官员们强调需要创新的长期政策

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 21 日 17:28 香港时间 · 阅读 2 分钟

香港保险业监管局（IA）呼吁保险业、政府、政策制定者和医疗保健提供者之间加强合作，以应对人口老龄化带来的挑战。 IA执行董事Clement Lau在聚焦健康、财富和科技的跨境会议“香港健康老龄化2026”的启动仪式上发表讲话，他将保险描述为补充性的保护层，就像房子的屋顶，其地基是由政府和医疗保健提供者建造的。
刘指出，随着人们寿命的延长，私人医疗保险提供足够医疗保健和退休保障的能力变得有限。他表示，随着持续的医疗通胀加剧了情况，私人市场需要更多的长期护理产品。他补充道：“我们确实希望促进良性循环，让创新产品弥补保障缺口，扩大消费者选择，并为保单持有人及其家人提供真正的安心。”

预计到2046年，香港65岁或以上的人口将达到274万，占总人口的三分之一以上。上个月公布的政府第一个五年计划和行政长官2026年施政报告，强调以更加积极主动和战略性的方式应对人口老龄化和出生率问题。
政务司副政务司长卓永兴在会上表示，政府上月公布了老龄化社会策略报告，包括11个范畴的73项策略措施。涵盖长者住宿照顾服务、跨境养老、长者友善城市规划设计、长者旅游、银发经济等。 Cheuk还强调了数字诈骗的威胁，并指出，为了遏制老年人接触欺诈内容，香港警方将于2027年与科技和电信运营商一起发起网络卫生计划，利用人工智能主动删除社交媒体上的诈骗帖子。

根据政府统计处的数据，香港是世界上预期寿命最高的国家之一，到 2025 年，男性预期寿命将达到 83.3 岁，女性将达到 88.7 岁。香港精算学会会长马克·桑德斯(Mark Saunders)表示：“我们的代价是世界上最长的预期寿命，但我们还不能真正庆祝，因为我们还没有弄清楚如何支付这个代价。一个既保障寿命长度又保障老年疾病费用的社会将在老龄化方面引领世界。我们希望香港成为这样的国家。”

Hong Kong
Hong Kong’s Insurance Authority says the insurance sector must work with the government and healthcare providers to tackle challenges from an ageing population. As the number of residents aged 65 or above is projected to reach 2.74 million by 2046, officials highlight the need for innovative long-te

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

21 Oct 2026 at 17:28 HKT · 2 min read

The Insurance Authority (IA) of Hong Kong has called for closer collaboration between the insurance sector, the government, policymakers and healthcare providers to address the challenges posed by an ageing population. Speaking at the launch of Ageing Well Hong Kong 2026, a cross-border conference focused on health, wealth and technology, IA executive director Clement Lau described insurance as a supplementary layer of protection, akin to a roof on a house whose foundation is built by government and healthcare providers.

Lau noted that as people live longer, private health insurance has become limited in its ability to provide adequate healthcare and retirement protection. With persistent medical inflation intensifying the situation, he said the private market needs more long-term care products. “We do want to stimulate a virtuous circle where innovative products reach the protection gaps, wider consumer choices and provide genuine peace of mind for policyholders and their families,” he added.

Hong Kong’s population aged 65 or above is projected to reach 2.74 million by 2046, accounting for more than one third of the population. The government’s First Five-Year Plan and the Chief Executive’s 2026 Policy Address, unveiled last month, underscored a more proactive and strategic approach to tackling population ageing and the birth rate.

Deputy Chief Secretary for Administration Cheuk Wing-hing told the conference that the government had announced a report on ageing society strategies last month, including 73 strategic measures across 11 areas. These cover elderly residential care services, cross-boundary elderly care, elderly-friendly urban planning and design, elderly travel, and the silver economy, among others. Cheuk also highlighted the threat of digital scams, noting that to curb elderly exposure to fraudulent content, the Hong Kong police will launch a cyber-hygiene initiative in 2027 alongside tech and telecom operators, using artificial intelligence to proactively remove scam posts on social media.

Hong Kong has one of the world’s highest life expectancies, standing at 83.3 years for men and 88.7 years for women in 2025, according to the Census and Statistics Department. Mark Saunders, president of the Hong Kong Actuarial Society, said: “Our price is the longest life expectancy in the world, but we cannot truly celebrate yet because we have not yet worked out how we are going to pay for that price. A society that protects both the length of life and the cost of illness in old age will lead the world in aging well. We want that to be Hong Kong.”

# Audemars Piguet to open flagship store in Central, Bloomberg reports

Swiss watchmaker Audemars Piguet plans a flagship store in Hong Kong's Central district. Sources told Bloomberg the brand will lease a 13,000 sq ft space at New World Tower for over HK$2 million monthly rent, and an additional 7,000 sq ft experience store nearby.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 21 Oct 2026 at 17:30 HKT · 1 min read

Luxury Swiss watchmaker Audemars Piguet is set to open one of its largest Asian flagship stores in a prime Hong Kong tower owned by New World Development, betting on resilient demand from the city's growing ranks of wealthy residents, Bloomberg reported.

Citing sources, the report states that the brand will occupy a 13,000 square-foot space at New World Tower in Central, paying more than HK$2 million in monthly rent. Audemars Piguet will replace Emperor Watch & Jewellery, whose lease is due to expire in February next year.

According to the report, Audemars Piguet will also take up another store of about 7,000 sq ft in the nearby Henley Building developed by a separate Hong Kong business family, paying around HK$1 million a month. Sources indicated that this location will serve as an “experience store”, designed to showcase the brand’s heritage and its rare, exclusive collections.

# MPF confidence hits 15-year high; 28% of HK workers target HK$8m retirement

Hong Kong's MPF Confidence Index reached a 15-year high of 5.1 out of 10. A GUM survey found 28% of respondents expect to need at least HK$8 million for retirement, up from 21% in 2025. The average retirement target rose 12% to HK$6.48 million.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

Hong Kong employees' confidence in the Mandatory Provident Fund (MPF) system has reached a 15-year high, while the proportion expecting to need at least HK$8 million for retirement has risen sharply, according to a survey by MPF consulting firm GUM.

The MPF Confidence Index rose to 5.1 out of 10 in October, up from 4.0 in 2025 and rebounding from a record low of 2.8 in 2022, GUM said. The firm surveyed 808 Hong Kong residents aged 18 to 64 who participate in the MPF system between 13 and 15 August.

GUM attributed the improved confidence to better market returns in recent years, greater member engagement, and an enhanced digital experience on the eMPF platform. Michael Chan, managing director of GUM, said: “As confidence improves, members are placing greater emphasis on retirement savings adequacy, fund performance and investment choices, signaling a shift from passive participation to more active management of retirement assets.”

The survey found that 75 per cent of respondents review their MPF performance at least once a year, and about 30 per cent had switched funds in the past six months. The proportion expecting to need HK$8 million or more for retirement rose from 21 per cent in 2025 to 28 per cent in 2026. The average retirement savings target increased 12 per cent year on year, from HK$5.79 million in 2025 to HK$6.48 million in 2026.

GUM also noted growing demand for decision-making support. Among respondents, 51 per cent expressed interest in artificial intelligence-empowered investment analysis and fund selection tools, and an equal proportion said regular market updates would be most valuable. A further 35 per cent hoped for tools to assess their risk tolerance, highlighting members' increasing desire for guidance in retirement investment decisions, GUM said.

content:
**习近平**为什么对**江派太子党**网开一面？与20多年前一桩政治交易有关。（图片来源：Lintao Zhang/Getty Images）

中共二十大之后，[习近平](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E4%B9%A0%E8%BF%91%E5%B9%B3)的人马，所谓的**习家军**，全面占据党政军重要位置，但当时随之爆发严重内斗，如时任中央军委副主席**张又侠**斗倒另一名军委副主席**何卫东**后，自己也被拿下，中纪委书记李希打下自己主政广东时的副手马兴瑞等等。然而在这段时间，江派太子党悄然在经济上“夺城”。

## 江志成 刘乐飞“经济夺城”触发猜想

 江泽民孙子江志成。（图片来源：网络图片）

正当中国经济整体萧条、外资撤离之际，一些有中共特权背景的资本大佬却在逆向攻城掠地。

[![Image 3](https://img6.secretchina.com/bigpic/2024/11-4/p3557701a911506510.jpg)](https://naturexcels.com/language/zh/)

因在中国的经营压力，全球最大的连锁咖啡店品牌星巴克（Starbucks），2025年11月宣布与中国另类资产管理公司博裕资本达成协议，成立一家合资企业，共同经营星巴克中国市场零售业务，博裕资本持有至多60%股权；星巴克保留40%股权，将继续作为星巴克品牌与智慧财产权的所有者和授权方，向合资企业授权。

4月初，星巴克与博裕资本完成合资交易，目前星巴克中国门市约8000家，双方共同长期目标为扩展门市数量达2万家。

表面看这是一桩正常的生意，却不寻常，因为星巴克的合作方博裕资本，是前中共领导人[江泽民](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E6%B1%9F%E6%B3%BD%E6%B0%91)的孙子江志成创办的。

差不多同期，另一名[江派太子党](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E6%B1%9F%E6%B4%BE%E5%A4%AA%E5%AD%90%E5%85%9A)，前中共政治局常委刘云山之子刘乐飞也有动作。

2025年11月10日，全球大型连锁快餐企业“汉堡王”（Burger King）母公司RBI，与中国私募股权公司CPE源峰达成战略合作，双方将成立合资企业：汉堡王中国。

协议显示，CPE源峰将向汉堡王中国注入3.5亿美元的初始资金，用于支持其餐厅门店扩张等。交易完成后，CPE源峰将持有汉堡王中国约83%的股权，RBI将保留约17%的股权。

2026年2月2日，CPE源峰和RBI宣布此前达成的合资交易已顺利完成交割。

CPE源峰，前身为国有的中信产业投资基金，这家基金现在基本上私有化了，实控人是刘云山的儿子刘乐飞。而刘云山是江泽民是亲信之一。

2025年以来，江志成已大举投资中国，除了收购星巴克股权，还包括收购北京SKP（高端百货）约42-45%股权；参与蜜雪冰城、宁德时代、恒瑞医药等基石投资；控股金科服务等。刘乐飞则除了注资汉堡王，还与方源资本携手完成对全球领先RFID和品牌识别方案提供商SML集团的控股投资，交易估值或超6亿美元。

江派太子党这些动作引发海外网民议论：“会向财阀政治的道路上前进吗？”“俄罗斯政治寡头模式。”意思是中国的政治未来或受资本操控。

这些猜想也不是没来由的。

## “逆天计划”传闻

2014年8月中共北戴河会议期间，海外网上热传阿里巴巴创办人马云与江志成、刘乐飞等人金融界和网际网络夺城，他们都有政治野心，他们联手的背后，夹杂着不为人知的逆天计划──精心在网际网络和金融等核心行业布局，一旦时局有变，能迅速推出自己人登顶政坛，接掌中共政权。

这些传言最初来源是一些被认为属于中共大外宣的人士，怀疑与中共内斗放风有关。

中共各大权贵家族历来都在特权体制保护下大肆敛财，江派太子党当然也不例外。上述传闻虽然传闻未必属实，但显然会引起掌权者的不安。2020年10月，马云在上海外滩的演讲中批评金融监管，随后遭到当局连番整肃，真正原因或与那些所谓“逆天计划”的惊人传闻有关。

2020年11月，蚂蚁集团IPO在正式上市前突然被喊停，马云长时间“失踪”。

《华尔街日报》随后揭露，习近平亲自撤回蚂蚁在上海和香港两地上市的申请，是因调查马云创办的蚂蚁集团股权结构后，发现江泽民之孙及江派前政治局常委贾庆林女婿等人，都是蚂蚁的秘密投资者。这些中共权贵家族对习及其核心圈子构成潜在挑战。

毕业于哈佛大学的江志成，2010年在香港创立私募基金博裕资本（Boyu Capital）。靠着江家的权势，2011年，他以约8000万美元收购日上免税行40%控股权，收获“第一桶金”，而中国免税业务是中共国资垄断领域。

江志成与马云早就结交。2011年5月，马云不惜得罪雅虎，把支付宝股权从香港上市公司阿里巴巴集团转出来时，就有人怀疑有太子党力量介入支付宝股权重组。马云或得到太子党对支付宝牌照的保证，才敢重组支付宝。

博裕资本于2012年联同中国投资有限责任公司、国家开发银行和中信集团组成财团，集资71亿元美元，协助购回由雅虎持有的阿里巴巴股份。该财团购入阿里约5%股份后，阿里两年后在美国上市，财团获利甚丰。

至于博裕资本2016年投资蚂蚁，手法也非常迂回，是透过投资私募基金北京京管投资中心出面。

因为这些背景，马云被指是太子党的“白手套”。不过，有必要为中国的民营企业家说句公道话，在中国这种不自由的体制下，如果没有特权人士照应，是很难有大作为的。在我看来，聪明绝顶且较有思想的马云，也不得不借助权贵之力发家，但等到有难之时，却只有自己去承担，这本身也是一种悲哀。

接下来除了阿里巴巴被以市场垄断为由遭重罚约27.5亿美元。蚂蚁集团被要求重组业务，切割与阿里巴巴的股权与管理层关联，杭州国资加入。2023年初，马云对蚂蚁集团的投票权从53.46%大幅降低至6.208%。马云作为蚂蚁集团实际控制人的时代终结。

之前在2015年，曾有一位有“国师”称号的中国学者，指控马云可以通过大数据挖掘建立起中国要害人员的个人档案，建立起中国战略资源的流转及节点图，堪称可以作为瓦解政权安全的导航图。这可能引起当局不安。最终到马云交出手中的大数据──蚂蚁集团消费者信用资料，他才平安着陆。

在出手整肃马云之后，习近平2021年1月的十九届中央纪委五次全会明确指出，“政治问题和经济问题交织，威胁党和国家政治安全。”这其实是对江派太子党“经济夺城”的警告。

作为民营企业家的马云受到严厉打压，差点流亡国外，但江派太子党们仅仅是受到警告。

习近平对江派太子党网开一面，与22年前一桩政治交易有关。

## 三次政治交易

中共从邓小平时代起，搞起了一个隔代指定接班人的把戏，这既是权力斗争的需要，也事关家族利益安全，指定隔代接班人至少可以确保下两代领导人能保护自己的家族利益。比如邓小平隔代指定了胡锦涛，江泽民隔代指定了习近平，胡锦涛隔代指定了胡春华。但习近平为了长期执政，直接将胡春华废掉了，可能后患无穷。

江泽民隔代指定习近平接班，这件事其实比较隐秘。

网上流传2005年6月30日的《茅台酒报》一篇题为《浙江省委书记习近平接见季克良、袁仁国一行》的报导显示，2005年6月20日，时任浙江省委书记习近平在西湖国宾馆接见并宴请茅台集团董事长季克良、总经理袁仁国等一行。

在会面时，习自曝自己特别喜欢喝茅台，他在2004年还用80年的茅台酒接待了江泽民夫妇。

据当地官媒报导，江泽民在2004年7月21日至23日曾第七次视察浙江。

江泽民至2004年9月才卸任军委主席，他卸任前到浙江，就是要亲自考察习近平。在习近平拿出80年茅台陪喝酒聊天后，江就钦定了习为胡锦涛之后的中共总书记。而习获得指定隔代接班的关键条件，就是上台后要保住江家利益。

2007年，习近平调到上海过渡几个月，就和时任辽宁省委书记李克强一起，在中共十七大上同时直接从中央委员跳级成为政治局常委。

这是习江的第一次交易。习近平由此认为，他的权力来源来自于江泽民（注意，不是中国人民），这也是他在江泽民死后喊出要“继承遗志”的原因。

习近平上台后，在第一任期打着救党旗号反腐，拉下了周永康、徐才厚、郭伯雄等江派人物，当时的确有要清算“腐败总后台”江泽民的态势，但这只是一个假动作。主要是因为，动江虽然是利国利民，但等于要从党章中删除江的“三个代表”，动作太大，震荡之下可能亡党。习选择了保党，再次和江泽民做交易，让“打虎”的王岐山退居二线，而江派则支持习近平在2018年修宪废除连任限制，以便习可以终身掌权。

2021年11月，网球名将彭帅公开举报江派前常委张高丽性侵，引发国际关注。但事件最终以彭帅被消声结束，张高丽没有受到任何处理，可能连党内警告也没有。这是因为，在江派支持习近平修宪之后，习要保护江派人马。

到了2022年中共二十大，习与江派进行第三次交易。习近平顺利连任总书记，蔡奇、李强等一帮习派人马上位。李克强、汪洋两大团派人物出局，甚至在闭幕会上发生前领导人胡锦涛被架出会场的事件，胡锦涛隔代指定的接班人胡春华也被踢出政治局，团派被正式清除出权力中心。这背后就是江派与习的联手操作。

中共二十大换届后，江派背景官员仍占据高层，包括留任二十届政治局常委的王沪宁和赵乐际，留任国家副主席的韩正。

故此，我们可以看到，中共二十大后，江派太子党在经济领域再度活跃，江志成和刘乐飞连续在经济上夺城。本身有特权背景，再加上有高层政治交易的保护，他们就更加放开手脚。与江志成、刘乐飞密切的马云，在2021年之后一度低调在海外生活，到2024年底、2025年初，马云再度在中国“复出”，并高调现身中南海的民营企业家座谈会，与习近平握手。

## 第四次交易 打死人牌？

 江绵恒长期掌控上海联和投资有限公司。（图片来源：网络图片）

最近三年，[习家军](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E4%B9%A0%E5%AE%B6%E5%86%9B)中发生罕见的大规模内讧，先是习近平军改后建立的军中重器火箭军爆发窝案，接着在军备调查中，习着力培植的军工帮密集倒台，全军数十将领被拿下，包括军委高层的张又侠、何卫东、苗华、李尚福和刘振立。

这些人都是习自己提拔的，如今却由他自己拿下来，无论他如何辩解说是搞“自我革命”，也说不过去。越搞大清洗，习越陷入有权力而无权威的统治危机中。

在这个背景下，习近平可能要和江家做第四次政治交易，为了保自己在二十一大连任，他准备打死人牌。

中共官方已宣布，北京的[毛泽东](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E6%AF%9B%E6%B3%BD%E4%B8%9C)纪念堂将从3月16日至8月31日进行内部维修改造施工，在此期间暂停对外开放。

香港《明报》报导，中共今年8月将以顶级规格纪念江泽民的百年冥诞。中共领导人中，只有6人享受过纪念大会的顶级规格，包括：毛泽东、周恩来、刘少奇、朱德、邓小平、陈云，而江泽民将是第7人。

有猜测指，毛纪念堂装修，或因要在二楼原有的毛泽东、周恩来、刘少奇、朱德、邓小平、陈云纪念室之外，增加江的位置。

在当局要“抬江保习”的政治需要下，在这几年的整肃党政军期间，虽已触及江泽民长子、江志成之父江绵恒，但却不会真正去动他。

江绵恒1999年11月出任中国科学院副院长，一直到2011年11月。因其父的关系，没有航天专业背景的江绵恒，染指航天军工产业，2004年曾担任神舟五号副总指挥，在2007年担任绕月探测工程领导小组副组长、嫦娥工程副总指挥。2008年出任神舟七号副总指挥。

众多航天系统出身的落马高官，比如政治局委员马兴瑞（长期在航天科技集团任职）和上海市委常委、浦东新区区委书记朱芝松（曾掌上海航天局）等，当年都是江绵恒的亲信。另外，最近一批有军工背景的中科院和工程院院士被除名，许多都是花钱买来的院士头衔，江绵恒当年在中科院，正是院士们都要攀附的人物。

江绵恒长期掌控的上海联和投资有限公司，表面上是国企，实际上已沦为江家俬企。江绵恒跨系统腐败，无人不知，只是习近平不查。

习近平不查江绵恒，和之前不查江泽民一样，一是因为当年有作为隔代接班人的政冶交易；二是因为他还要藉纪念江泽民，来为自己连任增加政治资本。

不过，在政治高压和经济下行，中国民怨沸腾，官场也在反复整肃之下怨气冲天。习欲借死人为其壮胆，但江本人名声不佳，习高举江的招魂幡，只会带来霉运。

summary: 香港 最新的居者有其屋计划于 10 月 21 日开始销售，买家抢购启德启阳苑的高层海景单位。尽管价格上涨，但需求依然强劲，而一些买家由于富裕租户政策而选择了更便宜的项目。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 21 日 13:59 香港时间 · 3 分钟阅读 新一轮出售居屋计划（居屋）单位周三开始选楼
content:
香港
最新的居者有其屋计划于10月21日开始销售，买家抢购启德启阳苑高层海景单位。尽管价格上涨，但需求依然强劲，而一些买家由于富裕租户政策而选择了更便宜的项目。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 21 日 13:59 香港时间 · 阅读时间 3 分钟

新一轮居者有其屋售楼选楼周三展开，买家将目光投向启德启阳苑的顶楼海景单位。

广受追捧的启德项目是本轮推出的五个新居屋发展项目之一，其他项目包括锦田汇禧苑、东涌裕丰苑、屏山朗丰苑和将军澳英辉苑。启阳苑的需求在开盘后半小时内就明显可见，售价超过 480 万港元的 B 座单位被抢购一空，其他高层单位也紧随其后。
在该屋苑找到单位的买家中，有一位是首次申请者，他选择了中高层单位，并表示很高兴能拥有一套房子。另一位选择中层单位的买家则称赞其位置较其他项目更为便利。尽管该地区每平方英尺的价格较高，但买家表示，相对市场价值 30% 的折扣仍然合理。另一位买家表示，他已经考虑到新资助公寓可能出现的渗漏和外墙油漆剥落的情况，并预留了额外的防水预算。他相信补贴单位的质量可与私人住房相媲美。

陈女士也在排队申请住房，他一家五口住在公共住房中。她一早到达，以便在下午 2.30 预约预约之前了解有关这些单位的更多信息。她表达对市区启阳苑的兴趣，并表示不太担心自己的选择会被采纳，因为A座仍有不少单位可供出售。尽管标价较高，但她表示，鉴于其便利设施，包括启德体育公园、购物中心和附近的地铁站，该地产还是值得的。
然而，价格上涨的城市房地产促使一些买家转向其他项目。卢先生选择了锦田汇熹苑的一套公寓。他有两至三名家庭成员，希望购买一个超过300平方尺的中型单位，理由是邻近港铁站是一个优势。不过，他表示该地区的便利设施仍然缺乏，预计至少需要三年时间才能开发。罗补充说，由于三薪家庭的总收入超过限额，他是在小康政策的推动下申请资助住房的。虽然对于公屋家庭来说，提升房产水平是件好事，但他指出，目前的政策让像他这样的租户陷入了困境。他说，许多租户年龄在40至50岁左右，即将达到退休年龄，如果没有家庭成员承担抵押贷款，将面临巨大压力。

最新一轮遴选提供近7,000个新资助单位，面积约281至560平方尺，售价为市价70%，以及400个转售居屋单位。房屋委员会已编配约2,800个单位予参与「长者家庭优先分配计划」及「新生儿家庭优先编配计划」的家庭

Hong Kong
The latest Home Ownership Scheme sales began on 21 October, with buyers snapping up high-floor sea-view units at Kai Yeung Court in Kai Tak. Demand was strong despite higher prices, while some buyers opted for cheaper projects due to the Well-off Tenants Policy.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

21 Oct 2026 at 13:59 HKT · 3 min read

A new round of flat selection for the Sale of Home Ownership Scheme (HOS) flats began on Wednesday, with buyers setting their sights on top-floor sea-view units at Kai Tak's Kai Yeung Court.

The sought-after Kai Tak project is one of five new HOS developments on offer this round, alongside Wui Hei Court in Kam Tin, Yu Fung Court in Tung Chung, Long Fung Court in Ping Shan and Ying Fai Court in Tseung Kwan O. Demand at Kai Yeung Court was evident within half an hour of sales starting, when a Block B unit priced at more than HK$4.8 million was snapped up, and other high-floor units followed.

Among the buyers who secured a flat in the estate was a first-time applicant who picked a mid-to-high-floor unit, saying he was happy to own a home. Another buyer who picked a mid-floor unit praised its convenient location compared with other projects. Although prices per square foot in the area are higher, the buyer said the 30 per cent discount to market value still makes them reasonable. Another buyer said he had already factored in potential leaks and peeling exterior paint at new subsidised flats, and had set aside extra budget for waterproofing. He was confident subsidised flats were comparable in quality to private housing.

Also in line for a home was Chan, whose family of five lives in public housing. She arrived early in the morning to learn more about the units before her 2.30pm selection appointment. Expressing interest in the urban Kai Yeung Court, she said she was not too worried that her preferred choice would be taken, as many units in Block A were still available. Despite the higher price tag, she said the estate was worth it given its amenities, which include the Kai Tak Sports Park, shopping malls and a nearby MTR station.

Yet, the pricier urban estate has pushed some buyers toward other projects. Lo, for one, opted for a flat at Wui Hei Court in Kam Tin. With two to three family members, he hopes to buy a medium-sized unit of more than 300 sq ft, citing its proximity to an MTR station as an advantage. However, he said amenities in the area were still lacking and expected it would take at least three years to develop. Lo added that he was prompted to apply for subsidised housing by the Well-off Tenants Policy, given their combined income as a three-earner household exceeds the limit. While it was good for public housing families to move up the property ladder, he noted that the current policy has caught tenants like him in between. Many tenants, he said, are around 40 to 50 years old and will soon reach retirement age and would face heavy pressure if no family member takes over mortgage payments.

The latest round of selection offers nearly 7,000 new subsidised units of about 281 to 560 sq ft at 70 per cent of market value, along with 400 resale HOS flats. The Housing Authority has allocated around 2,800 units for families participating in the “Priority Scheme for Families with Elderly Members” and “Families with Newborns Allocation Priority Scheme”, while 700 units are reserved for one-person applicants.

# Hong Kong records 23 elderly pedestrian deaths in first three quarters

Hong Kong's Transport Department reported over 600 elderly pedestrians were injured or killed in traffic accidents in the first nine months of the year, with 23 deaths, up from last year. The department issued road safety tips for seniors.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

The Hong Kong Transport Department said that more than 600 pedestrians aged 65 or older were injured or killed in traffic accidents in the first three quarters of this year, with 23 fatalities, an increase compared with the same period last year.

In a social media post, the department reminded elderly people not to rush when crossing roads and stressed that safety is the most important consideration. It also offered safety tips for crossing roads, including wearing glasses or hearing aids before leaving home if needed, planning routes in advance and choosing the safest way to cross, and using footbridges, pedestrian tunnels, zebra crossings or signalised crossings where possible.

The department noted that some vehicles, such as electric cars, are quieter when running and advised seniors to be aware of this. It also warned against walking between gaps in stationary or slow-moving vehicles.

民進黨桃園市長參選人黃世杰（前中）21日出席與桃園市議員魏筠（前右）的中壢聯合競總成立時表示，距離11月28日投票日剩下約1個月，他將持續深入桃園各區，透過市場掃街、路口拜票及地方座談等方式爭取支持，並向市民說明桃園未來規劃。（民進黨桃園市長參選人黃世杰競選總部提供）中央社記者吳睿騏桃園傳真 115年10月21日

（中央社記者[吳睿騏](https://cna.com.tw/author/0077/)桃園21日電）選戰進入倒數，民進黨桃園市長參選人黃世杰收到一份特別的助選禮物，歌手林佳美自發創作助選歌曲「有一個人叫黃世杰」，黃世杰除分享這段緣分也感謝年輕支持者以音樂表達認同。

黃世杰競選總部今天發布新聞稿表示，23歲的創作歌手林佳美，9月初在Threads分享參與政治的心得，獲黃世杰的留言鼓勵，林佳美特別將支持化為行動，親自創作歌曲。競總說明，這首歌並非競選團隊邀約或委託，而是林佳美自發創作，從社群平台互動延伸為音樂應援。

黃世杰也在臉書（Facebook）發文指出，年輕支持者透過創作參與公共事務讓他感到驚喜與感動，從社群平台的留言互動延伸成一首助選歌曲，讓他看見年輕世代參與公共事務的不同方式。桃園仍有許多需要改善之處，他也特別寫下「我們都知道，或許桃園的某些地方還不夠美，11/28我們一起改變」。呼籲選民一起關心、參與並付諸行動，城市才有持續改變的力量。

黃世杰今天出席與桃園市議員魏筠的中壢聯合競總成立時表示，雙方母親曾共同創立「新世紀婦女協會」，兩人也同樣具有法律專業背景。將延續兩代情誼結合專業與地方經驗，為中壢注入新的發展動能。距離11月28日投票日剩下約1個月，他將持續深入桃園各區，透過市場掃街、路口拜票及地方座談等方式爭取支持，並向市民說明桃園未來規劃。（編輯：林恕暉）1151021

# Helsing rolls out Contra air defense design, plus two new inteceptors

The company claims the Contra system can track and engage “hundreds or thousands of drone and missile threats at the same time.”

By [Aaron Mehta](https://breakingdefense.com/author/amehta-2/) on October 26, 2026 2:39 pm

**Share**

*   Copy Link Copy Link

*   [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/cws/share?url=https://breakingdefense.com/2026/10/helsing-rolls-out-contra-air-defense-design-plus-two-new-inteceptors/)
*   [X](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=https://breakingdefense.com/2026/10/helsing-rolls-out-contra-air-defense-design-plus-two-new-inteceptors/)

 Helsing's The AD-1 Inferno and AD-2 Ambush interceptors. (Helsing)

WASHINGTON — Helsing, Germany’s highest-profile defense tech startup, today announced a new air defense system and a pair of new interceptor missiles.

Dubbed Contra, the company is billing its design as an “AI-controlled autonomous air defence system designed to protect countries from scaled drone and missile attacks,” according to a [press release](https://helsing.ai/newsroom/helsing-unveils-contra-autonomous-air-defence-alongside-missile-interceptors-ad-1-inferno-and-ad-2-ambush). Helsing also claims the system can track and engage “hundreds or thousands of drone and missile threats at the same time.”

The company says Contra can integrate with existing air defense interceptors and counter-drone systems. However, the firm also rolled out two new, container-launched interceptor designs it hopes customers will purchase with Contra. The AD-1 Inferno is jet-powered, “capable of aerial loitering, swarming, and repeated re-engagements.” The AD-2 Ambush uses a solid-rocket motor and can reach Mach 2.5, with a 20 km (around 12.5 miles) range, per the release.

The company did not provide hard cost estimates for the two missiles, saying only that the price will “significantly [undercut] those of existing missile interceptors.” There is currently a major push across NATO nations for lower-cost interceptors, with [Anduril](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/10/anduril-unveils-steelfin-interceptor-as-cheaper-option-to-pac-3-missiles/), [Lockheed Martin](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/10/lockheed-unveils-pac-3-edge-its-next-gen-patriot-interceptor/) and [CHAOS Industries](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/10/chaos-industries-joins-low-cost-interceptor-parade-with-vespid-design/) all rolling out options in the last few weeks.

“Our AI links existing sensors and effectors in real time and adds our interceptors, AD-1 and AD-2,” Helsing President and co-Founder Niklas Köhlersaid in the announcement. “With jet and rocket propulsion, a low-cost all-weather radar seeker, and two independent European supply chains, they deliver autonomous fire superiority up to ten kilometres high – affordable and at industrial scale.”

content:
香港
香港计划以新的产学合作模式设立海事学院，扩大学校海事教育，并与中国商飞合作开发C919培训课程。运输及物流司司长公布了今年施政报告中的措施。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 24 日 11:04 香港时间 · 阅读 2 分钟

正如今年施政报告所述，香港运输及物流局局长陈美宝宣布，计划以新的“产学合作”人才培养模式成立香港海事学院。该计划将与领先的海事学术机构和全球航运企业合作，旨在创造跨界别的职业发展道路，吸引年轻人才加入该行业，从而巩固香港作为国际航运枢纽的地位。

陈在社交媒体上写道，政府还将海事和物流行业信息带入学校。 2025年3月，政府推出“校本物流课程”，并于2026年10月扩展到海事领域，设立“海事专业教育资源中心”，加深中小学生对现代物流和航运业的了解。
陈先生还谈到了航空人才培训。她表示，香港国际航空学院将于2026/27年度迈入第十学年。自2017年4月推出以来至2026年8月，已有超过45万名学员参加了涵盖机场管理、安保和航空服务等领域的专业培训课程。

学院正在与中国商飞公司及相关维修机构合作，开发C919国产飞机的飞行、维修、航空管理等专业课程。这些课程旨在支持 C919 的全球推广。大约40名当地维修技术人员已具备C919飞机维修资格。

政府于2014年设立海事及航空培训基金，经过多年注资，承诺总额已达5亿港元。截至2026年9月，该基金已惠及超过24,000名学生和在职人员，并吸引超过14万名参与者参加各类行业推广活动。

Hong Kong plans to set up a maritime college with a new industry-academia collaboration model, expand maritime education in schools, and develop C919 training courses with Comac. The transport and logistics secretary announced the measures under this year's policy address.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

24 Oct 2026 at 11:04 HKT · 2 min read

Hong Kong's Secretary for Transport and Logistics, Mable Chan, has announced plans to establish a Hong Kong Maritime College under a new "industry-academia collaboration" talent training model, as outlined in this year's policy address. The initiative will involve partnerships with leading maritime academic institutions and global shipping enterprises, aiming to create cross-sector career development paths and attract young talent to the industry, thereby strengthening Hong Kong's position as an international shipping hub.

Writing on social media, Chan said the government is also taking maritime and logistics industry information into schools. In March 2025, the government launched a "school-based logistics curriculum", and in October 2026 it expanded into the maritime field with a "Maritime Professional Education Resource Centre" to deepen primary and secondary school students' understanding of the modern logistics and shipping industries.

Chan also addressed aviation talent training. She noted that the Hong Kong International Aviation Academy will enter its tenth academic year in 2026/27. Since its launch in April 2017 until August 2026, more than 450,000 participants have taken professional training courses covering airport management, security and aviation services.

The academy is working with China's Commercial Aircraft Corporation (Comac) and relevant maintenance organisations to develop professional courses for the C919 domestic aircraft, covering flight, maintenance and aviation management. These courses are intended to support the global rollout of the C919. Around 40 local maintenance technicians are already qualified to service the C919 aircraft.

The government established the Maritime and Aviation Training Fund in 2014, with total commitments reaching HK$500 million after years of injections. As of September 2026, the fund had benefited more than 24,000 students and in-service workers, and attracted over 140,000 participants to various industry promotional activities.

zh_title: 家庭和谐互动剧场在香港小学首演
summary: 香港 香港家庭议会推出小学互动戏剧表演，宣扬家庭和谐、传统美德和跨代共融。该节目将于 10 月至 3 月在约 70 所学校巡演。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 23 日 18:46 香港时间 · 2 分钟阅读家庭委员会香港特别行政区剧场举行互动剧场《家庭·和谐·包容·爆裂》首映式
content:
香港
香港家庭议会推出小学互动戏剧表演，宣扬家庭和谐、传统美德和跨代共融。该节目将于 10 月至 3 月在约 70 所学校巡演。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 23 日 18:46 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

香港特别行政区家庭议会举办互动剧场《家庭·和谐·共融·爆旋！》首映式于2026年10月23日在一所小学举行。该节目是该委员会“家庭·和谐·共融”活动的一部分，旨在促进家庭接纳、文化包容和跨代团结，并将良好的家庭价值观传播到更广泛的社区。
互动剧场围绕“Bid Bird Family”和他们在小学陀螺比赛中的经历展开。角色从对胜利的关注演变为学习倾听、同理心和承担责任，从对失败的恐惧演变为愿意尝试和肯定自己。这个故事凸显了家庭成员互相陪伴、互相支持的力量。礼、节、廉、仁、和平共处等中华传统美德贯穿全剧。通过互动技术，鼓励观众走进角色的情境，了解尊重差异、建立共识的重要性。

民政青年局妇女事务专员陈乐雅在首映礼上表示：“这部互动剧场将传统美德与创意融为一体，引起观众的兴趣和共鸣。我们希望这部剧除了弘扬家庭美德外，也能启发家长引导孩子从小建立积极、自立的价值观。”她补充，行政长官在2026年施政报告中宣布，政策局及家庭议会将再次举办全港性的“好家庭选举”，以弘扬良好家庭价值观，传承优良家庭传统。
家庭议会主席彭万佳先生在活动上表示：“互动剧场旨在向年轻一代弘扬传统美德和和谐共处的重要性，让良好的家庭价值观扎根家庭、延伸到校园、丰富社会。”

“家庭·和谐·包容·爆发旋转！”互动剧场将于2026年10月至2027年3月期间巡演全港约70所小学，向学生宣扬家庭的力量以及和谐共融的文化。

Hong Kong's Family Council launched a primary school interactive theatre show promoting family harmony, traditional virtues and cross-generational inclusion. The show will tour about 70 schools from October to March.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

23 Oct 2026 at 18:46 HKT · 2 min read

The Family Council of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region held the premiere of its interactive theatre show “Family · Harmony · Inclusion · Burst Spin!” at a primary school on 23 October 2026. The show is part of the council’s “Family · Harmony · Inclusion” campaign, which aims to promote family acceptance, cultural inclusion and cross-generational unity, and to extend good family values into the wider community.

The interactive theatre revolves around the “Bid Bird Family” and their experience in a primary school spinning-top competition. Characters evolve from a focus on winning to learning to listen, empathise and take responsibility, and from a fear of failure to a willingness to try and affirm themselves. The story highlights the power of family members accompanying and supporting one another. Traditional Chinese virtues such as propriety, integrity, shame, benevolence and peaceful coexistence run throughout the play. Through interactive techniques, the audience is encouraged to step into the characters' situations and understand the importance of respecting differences and building consensus.

Speaking at the premiere, Ms Chan Lok-nga, Commissioner for Women's Affairs of the Home and Youth Affairs Bureau, said: “This interactive theatre integrates traditional virtues with creativity to arouse the interest and resonance of the audience. Besides promoting family virtues, we hope this play can inspire parents to guide children to build positive, self-reliant values from an early age.” She added that the Chief Executive had announced in the 2026 Policy Address that the bureau and the Family Council would again organise a territory-wide “Good Family Election” to promote good family values and pass on quality family traditions.

Mr Pang Wan-kai, Chairman of the Family Council, said at the event: “The interactive theatre aims to promote traditional virtues and the importance of harmonious coexistence to the younger generation, so that good family values can take root at home, extend to the campus and enrich society.”

The “Family · Harmony · Inclusion · Burst Spin!” interactive theatre will tour about 70 primary schools across Hong Kong from October 2026 to March 2027, promoting the power of family and a culture of harmony and inclusion to students.

title: Game sales in jeopardy over Addo’s foot-and-mouth disease
summary: As South African National Parks (SANParks) confirmed that foot and mouth disease (FMD) has probably spread beyond the [Addo Elephant National Park’s](https://www.sanparks.org/parks/addo-elephant) kudu herds, neighbouring landowners are fumi
content:
As South African National Parks (SANParks) confirmed that foot and mouth disease (FMD) has probably spread beyond the [Addo Elephant National Park’s](https://www.sanparks.org/parks/addo-elephant) kudu herds, neighbouring landowners are fuming at the park’s lack of communication about the disease and have questioned the measures officials have put in place.

At the same time, the park is at risk of losing its spot at a major fundraising event – the annual game auction at the Kirkwood Wildsfees – due to the recent outbreak and the lengthy quarantine periods usually enforced on FMD cases.

The animal disease has become a growing concern in the Eastern Cape in recent months, particularly after outbreaks were reported in several locations across Nelson Mandela Bay.

Suspicions that FMD was present among the antelope in the Eastern Cape national park, which borders the metro, first surfaced early in August when guests noticed kudus exhibiting symptoms, particularly lameness in their hind legs.

At the time, park officials confirmed that they were aware of cases of lameness among the kudu herds at Addo, but said test results came back negative for FMD. They said they would continue to monitor the animals and investigate the cause.

At the same time, due to the spread of FMD outside the park, officials decided to implement biosecurity measures, including spraying vehicles entering the park, in an effort to “safeguard its wildlife and ecological integrity”.

However, in a statement last week, SANParks head of communication JP Louw said a second set of samples collected from kudus in the park confirmed the presence of FMD.

SANParks confirmed last week that lameness in several kudu at the Addo Elephant National Park was a symptom of foot and mouth disease, which has been a growing concern among cattle and other cloven-hoofed species across the Eastern Cape. (Photo: SANParks)

“The Department of Agriculture was notified after SANParks’ wildlife health surveillance detected an increase in lameness among kudu. Although the initial tests were negative, follow-up investigation and testing confirmed FMD in kudu within the park.

“SANParks is working closely with the Department of Agriculture and other relevant stakeholders to assess the extent of the occurrences, monitor animal health and implement appropriate disease-management measures. Any future animal movement of susceptible animals will be subject to veterinary risk assessment, statutory requirements and formal approval.”

Louw added that normal park and tourism operations would not be affected.

### **More species infected**

Earlier this week, SANParks veterinarian Dr David Zimmerman confirmed that between 5% and 10% of Addo’s kudu population was probably infected, the majority of them being older bulls and cows.

He added that additional species, such as red hartebeest and eland, had also shown clinical signs.

SANParks veterinarians have confirmed that foot-and-mouth-disease symptoms have been spotted in other species, including eland and red hartebeest, leading to a belief that the disease has spread beyond the initial outbreak in kudu. (Photo: SANParks)

“Park authorities are continuing to monitor susceptible species for clinical signs, particularly lameness associated with lesions. As FMD generally has a low mortality rate in wildlife, management efforts focus on surveillance and understanding the disease’s progression within free-ranging populations.

“However, affected animals may face an increased risk of predation due to reduced mobility,” Zimmerman said.

FMD is a highly contagious disease that affects cloven-hoofed animals, but holds no danger for humans.

Symptoms include hypersalivation, loss of appetite, lameness and ulcers and lesions on the tongue and around the hooves.

Fatalities are rare, and in domestic livestock, such as cattle, younger animals are more susceptible with most fatalities occurring among newborns.

SANParks has confirmed that foot-and-mouth-disease symptoms have been spotted in eland. (Photo: SANParks)

Among wildlife such as kudu and other antelope, older animals become easier targets for predators. And while these animals cannot contract the disease, they can spread it by carrying the saliva of infected animals on their fur.

Similarly, humans and vehicles can spread the disease, which necessitates the implementation of biosecurity checkpoints where wheels and shoes are decontaminated.

### **Lack of communication**

Despite Louw’s statement that SANParks was maintaining communication with neighbouring landowners, several neighbours have said this is in fact not the case, and that they had heard about the FMD outbreak from media reports.

Peter Bean, owner of [Schotia Safaris](https://schotiasafaris.co.za/) that shares its entire western boundary fence with Addo, said they had heard unofficial reports of animals showing symptoms for some time, but it was only confirmed when someone sent him the SANParks media statement.

“The statement claims that the Addo Park is working with neighbours and the surrounding communities. Schotia’s entire western boundary is against the Addo Park. We have not received any notification whatsoever with regards to the FMD.”

He said that while they had heard kudu had been limping and dying in Addo for more than three months, there had been no communication from park officials.

“I’m not blaming the park management for the outbreak or negligence in any way, but it’s extremely unethical to not even notify your neighbours and then make false statements publicly.

“Thankfully the disease has not affected Schotia in any way, yet,” Bean said.

He added that ground crews did daily inspections and repairs to fences in and around their farm, and while this was an intensive process costing them about R3-million annually, it was their best chance to curb the spread of the disease.

In addition, Bean said they had also implemented strict biosecurity protocols at their gate to decontaminate any vehicles entering and leaving the property.

“While we acknowledge that certain natural factors, such as bird movement or occasional fence breaches by stray wildlife, cannot be entirely controlled, we are minimising risks wherever possible. We believe that proactive action is vital during times like these,” he said.

Nearby, the co-owner of the Essendene Game Farm, Ayesha Cantor, questioned whether the measures the park had put in place were adequate to prevent the spread of the disease.

“Sure, Addo’s main gates are covered. But there are several other smaller access points. Are vehicles using those gates also being cleaned?

“I respect their approach to keep the park as natural as possible and to limit human intervention and interference under normal circumstances. But these are no longer natural or normal circumstances. Maybe they need to consider more direct treatments and vaccinations, or perhaps culling the diseased animals before they spread it further.”

Cantor said game species were hardy and could easily weather the storm, but consideration should be given to cattle farmers and dairy producers in the area, particularly large herds of cattle in the Nanaga area.

### **SANParks’ potential losses**

The affected species are not rare or endangered, and are actually quite prevalent within the park. While mortalities are scarce, any losses would likely be negligible for the park.

However, the disease could prevent Addo from participating in a significant income generator on SANParks’ annual calendar – a specialised game auction that coincides with the Kirkwood Wildsfees.

The auction, usually held around June, offers prospective buyers the opportunity to bid on wildlife from private sellers as well as various national parks under the SANParks banner.

In 2026, animals from Addo Elephant National Park, Karoo National Park, Mokala National Park and Mountain Zebra National Park were up for auction. Addo brought in R1.28-million from the sale of 10 buffalo bulls, each fetching between R105,000 and R155,000.

But if Addo is subject to the same regulations and protocols normally implemented on dairy and cattle farms, officials will have to submit samples for testing on a regular basis, and animals will only be available for transport after one year of clean results.

Auction organiser Garth Saville said the auction would still go ahead, with or without Addo’s participation.

“All animals are subject to a quarantine period of up to 45 days after the auction is concluded. At this stage, the auction will continue as planned with SANParks participation until we hear otherwise,” Saville said.

Regions SANParks spokesperson Fayroush Ludick said the FMD outbreak would probably exclude Addo from the auction.

“It will certainly have an impact on the auction. No animals sales or commercial culling can happen under the current circumstances,” Ludick said. **DM**

title: U.K. Committee Report on Defense in the High North - USNI News
zh_title: 英国委员会关于高北地区国防的报告 - USNI 新闻
summary: _以下是英国下议院委员会的报告“高北地区的防御”。该报告向英国政府提出建议，英国政府将在两个月内对该报告做出回应。该报告于 2026 年 10 月 22 日公开发布。_ ## 报告摘自 ​​高北地区，包括大北极和北大西洋部分地区，近年来已成为英国国防和安全问题的核心。气候变化增加了该地区开采石油、天然气和关键矿产等原材料的机会，但也使中国的生产时间尤其缩短。
content:
_以下是英国下议院委员会的报告“高北地区的防御”。该报告向英国政府提出建议，英国政府将在两个月内对该报告做出回应。该报告于 2026 年 10 月 22 日公开发布。_

## 摘自报告

高北地区包括大北极和北大西洋部分地区，近年来已成为英国国防和安全问题的中心。气候变化增加了该地区开采石油、天然气和关键矿产等原材料的机会，同时也为中国提供了亚洲和欧洲市场之间更短的海上运输路线。这些因素正在加速该地区的商业竞争。

融化的冰盖和海冰也暴露了此前基本上无法进入的俄罗斯高北基地，该基地部署了三分之二的战略核导弹，以及北方舰队的潜艇、间谍船和水下破坏部队。这加剧了国防和安全紧张局势，因为俄罗斯既寻求保护其基地，又将其部队投射到大西洋和英国领海。这不仅威胁到从美国到欧洲的北约供应线，还威胁到海底能源管道和数据电缆以及陆上关键的国家基础设施，包括核威慑力量。
最近，美国在该地区的行动更加单方面，特别是在加拿大和格陵兰岛的主权问题上。这意味着加拿大和欧洲北约盟国将需要承担更多责任来捍卫其在高北地区的利益。

英国已经承认自己可以发挥核心作用。它接管了北约诺福克联合部队司令部的领导权，负责保卫高北地区，并领导由10个国家组成的联合远征军（JEF），其中包括波罗的海国家和北欧国家以及荷兰。它还进行了大量的国家和双边演习，包括最近向该地区部署的航空母舰编队。

在威胁方面，时任总理基尔·斯塔默爵士在 2026 年 6 月表示，“……根据我们的情报评估以及北约其他国家的评估，俄罗斯最早可能在 2030 年对北约发起攻击”。英国国防部 (MOD) 也在制定“大西洋堡垒”战略，通过皇家海军转型来应对俄罗斯的威胁，并在 2030 年之前投资 13 亿英镑发展“混合海军”概念——将有人和无人船只连接起来。
然而，尽管国防部有明确的时间表、战略和国防投资计划，但目前反潜护卫舰和两栖运输舰的短缺，以及驱逐舰和潜艇等其他海军舰艇的可用性不足，可能会破坏其方法。此外，与其他欧洲北约国家一样，英国缺乏一些主要依赖美国提供的关键军事能力，例如弹道导弹防御、远程打击以及情报和监视资产，这些能力需要大量投资和时间来复制。

如果英国要领导一个有效的联盟，就必须解决其现有海上力量的明显差距，并确保与该地区的欧洲盟友制定商定的计划，以阻止并在必要时击败2030年代起对高北地区的任何侵略。

【原文 English Original】
_The following is the U.K.’s House of Commons committee report, “Defense in the High North.” The report provides recommendations to the U.K. government, which will respond to the report within two months. This report was publicly released Oct. 22, 2026._

## From the Report

The High North, encompassing the Greater Arctic and parts of the North Atlantic, has become central to the U.K.’s defense and security concerns in recent years. Climatic changes are increasing access to the region to exploit raw materials, such as oil, gas and critical minerals, but also offer China particularly a shorter maritime transit route between Asian and European markets. These factors are accelerating commercial rivalry in the region.

Melting ice sheets and sea ice are also exposing the previously largely inaccessible Russian bases in the High North, containing two-thirds of their strategic nuclear missiles, as well as the submarines, spy ships and underwater sabotage forces of their Northern Fleet. This is driving greater defense and security tensions, as Russia seeks to both protect its bases but also project its forces into the Atlantic and U.K. territorial waters. This threatens NATO supply lines from the U.S. to Europe, but also undersea energy pipelines and data cables and onshore critical national infrastructure, including the nuclear deterrent.

Recently, the U.S. has acted more unilaterally in the region, particularly regarding Canada’s and Greenland’s sovereignty. This means Canada and European NATO allies will need to take more responsibility for defense of their interests in the High North.

The U.K. has accepted it has a central role to play. It has taken over leadership of NATO’s Joint Force Command Norfolk, responsible for defending the High North, and leads the 10-nation Joint Expeditionary Force (JEF), which includes the Baltic and Nordic nations, plus The Netherlands. It also undertakes numerous national and bilateral exercises, including a recent aircraft carrier group deployment to the region.

In terms of the threat, in June 2026 the then Prime Minister Sir Keir Starmer said “…it is our intelligence assessment, and the assessment of other countries in NATO, that there could be an attack by Russia on NATO as soon as 2030”. The Ministry of Defense (MOD) is also developing its Atlantic Bastion strategy to counter these Russian threats through a transformation of the Royal Navy and is investing £1.3 billion up to 2030 in its Hybrid Navy concept – linking crewed and uncrewed vessels.

However, despite the MOD having a clear timeline, strategy and a Defense Investment Plan, current shortages of anti-submarine frigates and amphibious shipping, and poor availability of other naval vessels such as destroyers and submarines, could undermine its approach. Further, along with other European NATO countries, the U.K. lacks some critical military capabilities that it has largely relied on the U.S. to provide, such as ballistic missile defense, long range strike and intelligence and surveillance assets, which will take considerable investment and time to replicate.

If the U.K. is to lead an effective coalition, it must address glaring gaps in the availability of its current maritime forces and ensure it has an agreed plan, integrated with European allies in the region, to deter and, if necessary, defeat any aggression in the High North from 2030s.

这张插图中可以看到中国和台湾国旗，摄于 2022 年 8 月 6 日。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration [购买许可权，打开新的标签](https://www.reutersconnect.com/item/illustration-shows-chinese-and-taiwanese-flags/dGFnOnJldXRlcnMuY29tLDIwMjI6bmV3c21sX1JDMjFSVjlIMlpBQw%3D%3D/?utm_medium=rcom-article-media&utm_campaign=rcom-rcp-lead)

* 总结

* 台湾下月底举行地方选举
* 中国否认干预台湾选举
* 台湾称中国对其使用“灰色地带”策略

路透台北 10 月 21 日 - 台湾最高情报机构表示，今年前 9 个月，中国在网上传播了超过 250 万条针对台湾的有争议或虚假的网络信息，指责北京在地方选举前加强行动。

台湾国家安全局在本周向立法者提交的一份报告中表示，此类信息在 2026 年前 9 个月增加了约 48%，从一年前的超过 169 万条增至超过 250 万条。

《错误信息监测》时事通讯汇集了国际错误信息叙述，并以“真还是假？”为主题。每个版本都有测验。 [此处注册。](https://www.reuters.com/newsletters/misinformation-monitor/?location=article-paragraph&redirectUrl=%2Fbusiness%2Fmedia-telecom%2Ftaiwan-security-agency-flags-rise-chinese-disinformation-ahead-local-elections-2026-10-21%2F)
声明称，源自中国的内容重点关注能源、食品安全和国防政策，以及特定候选人的政纲和形象，试图影响台湾11月的市长和县长选举。

中国台湾事务办公室没有立即回应置评请求。北京不顾台湾的反对，将台湾视为自己的领土，此前曾否认干涉台湾选举或散布虚假信息。

台湾一再抱怨中国的“灰色地带”策略——从日常军事演习到网络攻击——而此时北京正在加大军事和政治压力，迫使台北接受其主权主张。

报告称，北京经常通过官方媒体编造故事，然后通过“网络巨魔大军”和公关公司放大这些故事，在台湾民众中挑拨离间。该公司表示，这些策略包括内容农场、人工智能生成的视频、虚假账户和协调一致的评论泛滥。

报告称：“中国扩大了人工智能技术的使用来操纵信息，试图影响选民的支持和选举结果。”

该局表示，中国正在利用人工智能技术收集有关台湾时事、候选人政策和民调数据的信息，以影响行动并扩大人工智能驱动的信息操纵，旨在“影响选民偏好和选举结果”。
该公司表示，这些消息主要在 Facebook、Threads、YouTube 和在线论坛等社交媒体平台上传播。

路透社与台北研究组织 IORG 进行的一项调查发现，中国官方媒体在信息战中越来越多地放大了台湾对执政的民进党的批评，其中包括与反对派国民党有联系的影响者和政客。

中国对台湾政府机构的网络攻击平均为 258 万次

Chinese and Taiwanese flags are seen in this illustration, August 6, 2022. REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration [Purchase Licensing Rights, opens new tab](https://www.reutersconnect.com/item/illustration-shows-chinese-and-taiwanese-flags/dGFnOnJldXRlcnMuY29tLDIwMjI6bmV3c21sX1JDMjFSVjlIMlpBQw%3D%3D/?utm_medium=rcom-article-media&utm_campaign=rcom-rcp-lead)

*   Summary

*   Taiwan to hold local elections late next month
*   China has denied interfering in Taiwan's elections
*   Taiwan says China using 'grey-zone' tactics against it

TAIPEI, Oct 21 (Reuters) - China spread more than 2.5 million pieces of disputed or false online ​information targeting Taiwan in the first nine months of this year, the island's top intelligence ‌agency said, accusing Beijing of stepping up operations ahead of local elections.

In a report to lawmakers this week, Taiwan's National Security Bureau said such information rose by about 48% in the first nine months of 2026 to more than 2.5 million ​items from more than 1.69 million a year earlier.

The Misinformation Monitor newsletter rounds up international misinformation narratives, with a "Real or Fake?" quiz in every edition. Sign up [here.](https://www.reuters.com/newsletters/misinformation-monitor/?location=article-paragraph&redirectUrl=%2Fbusiness%2Fmedia-telecom%2Ftaiwan-security-agency-flags-rise-chinese-disinformation-ahead-local-elections-2026-10-21%2F)

It said the China-originated content focused on energy, ​food security and defence policy, as well as the platforms and images of specific ⁠candidates, in an effort to influence Taiwan's elections for city mayors and county magistrates in November.

China's Taiwan Affairs ​Office did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Beijing, which views Taiwan as its own territory ​over the island's objections, has previously denied interfering in Taiwanese elections or spreading disinformation.

Taiwan has repeatedly complained about what it sees as China's "grey-zone" tactics - from daily military drills to cyberattacks - at a time when Beijing is ramping up military and political pressure ​to force Taipei to accept its sovereignty claims.

The report said Beijing often created narratives through official media ​outlets before amplifying them through "online troll armies" and public relations firms to sow discord among Taiwanese people. It said the tactics ‌included ⁠content farms, AI-generated videos, fake accounts and coordinated comment flooding.

"China has expanded the use of AI technology to manipulate information, seeking to influence voter support and election results," the report said.

China was using AI technology to gather information on Taiwanese current affairs, candidates' policies and polling data to shape influence operations and expand AI-driven information ​manipulation aimed at "affecting voter ​preferences and election outcomes," ⁠the bureau said.

It said the messages were mainly distributed on social media platforms including Facebook, Threads, YouTube and online forums.

Chinese state media have increasingly amplified Taiwanese critics of ​the ruling Democratic Progressive Party in an information war, including influencers and politicians ​linked to ⁠the opposition Kuomintang, a [Reuters investigation](https://www.reuters.com/world/china/china-turns-taiwans-own-voices-against-it-information-war-2026-04-17/) conducted with Taipei-based research group IORG found.

Chinese cyberattacks on Taiwanese government agencies averaged 2.58 million a day in the first nine months of 2026, with detected threats surging from June and reaching 185.6 ⁠million in ​July and 106.4 million in August, data from the National Security ​Bureau showed.

"It cannot be ruled out that this was advance intelligence-gathering and harassment preparation aimed at interfering in Taiwan's year-end 'nine-in-one' elections," the ​report said.

Reporting By Yimou Lee; Additional reporting by Ben Blanchard and Liz Lee in Beijing; Editing by Thomas Derpinghaus

Yimou Lee is a Senior Correspondent for Reuters covering everything from Taiwan, including sensitive Taiwan-China relations, China's military aggression and Taiwan's key role as a global semiconductor powerhouse. A three-time SOPA award winner, his reporting from Hong Kong, China, Myanmar and Taiwan over the past decade includes Myanmar's crackdown on Rohingya Muslims, Hong Kong protests and Taiwan's battle against China's multifront campaigns to absorb the island.

# 西藏强震后37个半小时余震892次(图)

【看中国2026年10月24日讯】（看中国记者李木子综合报导）**西藏那曲**市**巴青**县发生7级**[地震](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E5%9C%B0%E9%9C%87)**后，**余震**不断，随后的13个半小时发生余震501次，紧接着在后续的24小时内又发生391次余震。合计3.0级及以上68次，最大**震级**4.5级。引发关注。此外，中共央视记者现场汇报情况被批“废话文学”。 [看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。](https://www.secretchina.com/)

中共官媒报导，10月22日22时33分许，[西藏](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E8%A5%BF%E8%97%8F)那曲市巴青县发生7.0级地震。截至23日13时，已造成16人遇难、76人受伤，房屋倒塌及受损339户。

中共官媒23日曾一度引述西藏自治区应急指挥部消息称，地震造成18人死亡。但随后的官方通报中却将死亡人数改成16人。截止目前，未见官方说明两组数据不同的原因。

[![Image 15](https://img6.secretchina.com/pic/2025/7-29/p3676411a560438137.jpg)](https://www.naturenergy.us/)

[![Image 16](https://img6.secretchina.com/pic/2024/11-2/p3556881a508884777.jpg)](https://naturexcels.com/language/zh/)

[![Image 17](https://img6.secretchina.com/bigpic/2024/11-4/p3557701a911506510.jpg)](https://naturexcels.com/language/zh/)

[![Image 18](https://img6.secretchina.com/pic/2025/7-29/p3676411a560438137.jpg)](https://www.naturenergy.us/)

[中国](https://www.secretchina.com/)专家研究分析认为，此次地震为一次拉张型破裂。原震区及附近地区，近几日仍存在发生有感地震的可能。

截至10月23日12时，西藏[那曲](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E9%82%A3%E6%9B%B2)市巴青县共记录到余震501次，其中3.0级以下474次，3.0级及以上27次：3.0-3.9级22次，4.0-4.9级5次。最大余震4.3级。

但在过去24小时，监测到的[余震](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E4%BD%99%E9%9C%87)又增加了391次。中国地震台网速报，截至10月24日12时，共记录到余震892次，其中3.0级以下851次，3.0级及以上41次：3.0-3.9级33次，4.0-4.9级8次。目前最大余震4.5级。

中共官媒中青网报导，西藏这次震中核心区域[巴青](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E5%B7%B4%E9%9D%92)县玛如乡二村受灾严重。二村总共有800多人，在这次7.0级地震当中，有6人遇难、10人受伤。整个二村在丘陵地带，温度非常低。二村受损较严重的一户人家，房屋已经塌陷得很厉害。整个墙体错位非常明显，主屋左侧的房顶和窗户也垮了。

10月23日，有网友转发了中共央视关于西藏地震现场救援的报导，记者空话连篇。视频显示，现场记者直播汇报情况时，频繁地说出“呃”、“这一块”等，比如“我想应该在呃临时安置点这一块”、“路程这一块”、“整体这一块”等等。该网友称：“听了三分钟全程绕来绕去，几乎没传递出有效信息，典型的废话文学”。

10月23日，旅居海外的藏人X博主萨格尔扎西分享多段视频表示，失去家园和亲人的藏人在哭泣，地震造成“没留下一口吃的”，一切都毁了；当地一位老大哥在安慰地震中失去亲人的小伙子；在医院里的大姐的两个孩子都遇难了。

据视频显示，寒冷的天气中，一名男子在痛哭，痛苦的不能自拔；还有一对夫妻在对劝慰他们的人在哭诉。另一画面中，一间医院的病房里住了多名伤者，有的看似较重，躺在病床上输液，有的坐在轮椅上输液。

西藏那曲市巴青县发生7级地震造成重大伤亡后，西藏慈善总会呼吁民众捐款，遭到大陆网民集体抵制。中国各地慈善总会虽被冠以“非营利公益社会团体”之名，实则隶属于当地中共民政部门。有网友表示：“普通人不是傻子，有好处那群顶头的拿大头，有事了找普通人献爱心。”

今天，西藏巴青县、新疆乌恰县又发生了地震。据中国地震台网正式测定，10月24日11时34分，在西藏那曲市巴青县发生3.3级地震，震源深度10公里；24日12时39分在，新疆克孜勒苏州乌恰县发生3.7级地震，震源深度18公里。

zh_title: 张建宗创下本地选手香港公开赛最佳成绩
summary: 香港 香港高尔夫球手张弘海于 10 月 25 日星期日在 LINK 香港公开赛上获得并列第二名，创下了该赛事历史上本地选手的最高成绩。此次赛事还创纪录地有五名本地选手晋级，官方宣布扩大联合赞助 [![图片 1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 25 2026 年 10 月，香港时间 20:19 · 2 分钟阅读 香港高尔夫球手张建宗 (Matthew Cheung Hung-hai) 创造历史性表现
content:
香港
香港高尔夫球手张弘海于 10 月 25 日星期日在 LINK 香港公开赛上获得并列第二名，创下了该赛事历史上本地球员的最高成绩。此次赛事还创纪录地见证了五名本地选手晋级，官方宣布扩大联合制裁范围

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 25 日 20:19 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

香港高尔夫球手张建宗周日在LINK香港公开赛上打出了历史性的表现，在粉岭获得并列第二名，创下了该赛事历史上本地球员的最高成绩。

美国高尔夫球手约翰·卡特林在最后一轮打出低于标准杆 6 杆 64 杆的成绩，最终以低于标准杆 20 杆的 260 杆成绩夺得冠军头衔。

张在粉岭高尔夫球场的比赛中表现出色，前两天以令人印象深刻的 126 杆成绩独占领先地位，但在进入最后一轮时滑落至第五位。周日，这位本地热门选手继续保持稳定发挥，抓到4只小鸟，打出67杆，低于标准杆3杆。他以低于标准杆15杆的265杆总成绩与芬兰选手萨米·瓦利马基(Sami Valimaki)并列亚军，超越了1996年由多米尼克·博莱特(Dominique Boulet)创下的香港选手纪录。
回顾他在家乡取得的突破性表现，张描述了最后几个洞的激动人心的气氛。 “当我走上第 18 洞，听到每个人都喊我的名字时，我起了鸡皮疙瘩；这确实是一次令人难以置信的经历，”张说。

在强调香港高尔夫的未来时，张指出，许多人并不期望像香港这样的小城市能够培养出顶尖人才，但本地球员已经证明他们可以在大舞台上表现。 “我希望我能够向人群中的孩子们展示什么是可能的，并激励下一代高尔夫球手，”他说。

此次比赛具有里程碑意义，五名本地选手晋级 36 洞，创纪录。香港高尔夫球会队长吕庆尧宣布，2027年香港公开赛将与亚洲巡回赛一起续签与DP世界巡回赛的共同认可协议，扩大赛事规模和奖金。

文化体育及旅游局局长罗淑佩联同财政司司长陈茂波出席决赛并颁奖。罗致远在元朗、湾仔等以当地地区命名的拍照点留影，并赞扬香港赛马会支持的扇村气候宜人、气氛活跃，以及大批家庭和游客在享受扇村乐趣。罗在脸书发文祝贺张，同时重申政府对本地体育发展的支持。
[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
Hong Kong golfer Matthew Cheung Hung-hai tied for second place at the LINK Hong Kong Open on Sunday, 25 October, achieving the highest finish ever by a local player in the tournament's history. The event also saw a record five local players make the cut, and officials announced an expanded co-sancti

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

25 Oct 2026 at 20:19 HKT · 2 min read

Hong Kong golfer Matthew Cheung Hung-hai delivered a historic performance on Sunday at the LINK Hong Kong Open, finishing tied for second place at Fanling to record the highest finish ever by a local player in the tournament's history.

American golfer John Catlin captured the championship title after firing a final-round 6-under-par 64, finishing with a 20-under 260 total.

Cheung impressed throughout the event at Fanling Golf Course, taking sole possession of the lead after the first two days with an impressive total of 126 before slipping into fifth place entering the final round. On Sunday, the local favourite maintained his solid play, carding four birdies for a 3-under 67. His 15-under 265 total tied him with Finland's Sami Valimaki for runner-up honours, surpassing the previous record for a Hong Kong player set in 1996 when Dominique Boulet finished fourth.

Reflecting on his breakthrough performance on home soil, Cheung described the electric atmosphere during his final holes. "When I walked up the 18th hole and heard everyone shouting my name, I got goosebumps; it was truly an incredible experience," Cheung said.

Highlighting the city's golf future, Cheung noted that many people do not expect a smaller city like Hong Kong to produce top talent, but local players have proven they can perform on the big stage. "I hope I can show the kids in the crowd what is possible and inspire the next generation of golfers," he said.

The tournament marked a milestone as a record five local players made the 36-hole cut. Hong Kong Golf Club captain Bryant Lu Hing-yiu announced that the 2027 Hong Kong Open will renew its co-sanctioning agreement with the DP World Tour alongside the Asian Tour, expanding the event's scale and prize purse.

Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law Shuk-pui attended the final round with Financial Secretary Paul Chan Mo-po to present the awards. Law posed at photo spots named after local districts, including Yuen Long and Wan Chai, and praised the pleasant weather, vibrant atmosphere, and large crowds of families and tourists enjoying the fan village supported by The Hong Kong Jockey Club. In a Facebook post, Law congratulated Cheung while reaffirming government support for local sports development.

# Excluding cancer deaths, Taiwan's life expectancy could rise by 3.7 years

Taipei, Oct. 24 (CNA) If deaths from cancer are excluded, Taiwan's average life expectancy in 2025 would be raised by 3.7 years, the Ministry of the Interior (MOI) said on Saturday.

In a news release, the MOI said it calculated life expectancy after excluding deaths from each of the 10 leading causes of death in 2025 and compared the results with the overall average. The greater the difference, the greater the cause's impact on life expectancy.

According to Ministry of Health and Welfare statistics, the 10 leading causes of death in Taiwan in 2025 were cancers, heart disease, pneumonia, cerebrovascular disease, diabetes, hypertensive diseases, accidents, nephritis, nephrotic syndrome and nephrosis, chronic lower respiratory diseases, and suicide.

The MOI said cancers had been Taiwan's leading cause of death for 44 consecutive years, accounting for 54,838 deaths, or 27.48 percent of all deaths, in 2025.

Taiwan's average life expectancy was 81.27 years in 2025, but could have been higher by 3.7 years to 84.97 years if deaths from cancers were excluded, the MOI explained.

Meanwhile, excluding deaths from heart disease and pneumonia would have raised average life expectancy by 1.54 years and 1.13 years, respectively, the MOI said.

The gap between average life expectancy and the figure calculated excluding cancer deaths narrowed from 4.10 years in 2015 to 3.70 years in 2025, suggesting that cancer's impact on life expectancy had eased slightly, it added.

The MOI said men lost more years of life than women to most of Taiwan's 10 leading causes of death in 2025, except for diabetes, hypertensive diseases and kidney diseases.

Men lost 0.75 years of life expectancy to accidental injuries, compared with 0.36 years for women. It said the differences may be related to occupation, physiological factors, diet and health care, or lifestyle habits.

The MOI said the statistics help show how different causes of death affect life expectancy.

More information is available on the ministry's website under the section on "Statistics."

(By Wu Shu-wei and Ko Lin)

# Wipe Away Su Lee's Tears from her Composing Nights

Dear friends, music lovers, and new music supporters,It’s me, Su Lee, and I am currently working on my dissertation concert (for my Ph.D. in composition) which will be held on Sept. 9th 2019 Monday at 7:30pm in Lippes Concert Hall in Slee Hall at University at Buffalo.The title of my dissertation composition and concert is Die Radikalen Tasten (The Radical Keys) in terms of aesthetics, Klang (sound), and theme.I am writing a concerto for organ with keyboard ensemble, namely for our own tremendous Fisk Op.95 organ at UB. It will involve organ soloist with 1 assistant, 2 pianos (1 quarter-tone flat piano), 2 harpsichords (1 quarter-tone flat harpsichord), and 2 vibraphones which is a very rare instrumentation for microtonal new music. The 1st half of the program features significant keyboard works from the 20th century such as Messiaen's solo organ work and Ives's quarter-tone piano pieces. As a special request from Dr. Fuller, who was in charge of the installation of the Fisk Op.95 organ at UB, I'm playing my very first organ transcription of Wagner's orchestral work.The 2nd half of the program features my own 'radical' politically inspired compositions including a choral piece with organ accompaniment (dedicated to the UUCB Choir family) and my dissertation organ concerto. Both works are based on the Korean Democratic Uprising in May 1980 and the protest song written for the victims of the subsequent Gwangju massacre - a song that has became widely popular for activists and protesters, including those participating in the on-going Hong Kong protests.Overall, it is a very colorful and unique combination and a rare program which is a you-don’t-want-to-miss concert.I am modestly asking you for a little or big help in making my dissertation concert happen smoothly, especially given my financial struggles in not being able to even work legally for money off campus in America due to my visa status.Your generous donation will be spent towards, (besides helping me wipe away all my tears and whining from composing numerous nights over the past few months and rehearsing in the upcoming days and nights):Nine Musicians’ Performance Fee, about $3,000 – 3,300Rent/Labor for Lippes Concert Hall in Slee Hall, about $1,000Other concert related costs; buying performing materials, copying/binding score/parts, printing poster/program book, audio/video recording, photographing, tuning, reception, etc. about $1,200 – 1,500In Total $5,200 – 5,800Fortunately, I got awarded the MDRF (research fund) for $3,000 at UB so that I can be reimbursed afterwards, but I need money upfront now to pay first, and possibly more, to pay my dream team musicians fairly and to cover other costs.Your genuine help means SO MUCH to me being an international Ph.D. student with many restrictions on earning money (3 months summer break without job, seriously!), as it will lighten my financial burdens and psychological anxiety when I absolutely need to focus more on my creative activities. Simply speaking, you are contributing to a potentially "fabulous" new music piece, stimulating my further musical activities and making me believe that life (and the world) is so beautiful!Every single one of your names will be acknowledged in my concert program book, and to thank you all, but not nearly enough, I like to give you in return as below:$1~$49: a thank-you-card with a cover of a handwritten excerpt of my score$50~$99: a thank-you-card like above AND a dvd of my dissertation concert (after my concert)$100~$199: a thank-you-card AND a dvd like above, PLUS the autographed full score of my dissertation composition$200~$299: EVERYTHING above AND one additional dvd of my Masters organ recitals (your choice of “Über den Namen B-A-C-H” or “Celebrating Lou Harrison’s 100th Birth-Year at Thunder Night”)$300 or more: EVERYTHING above, PLUS a gift pack of Korean snacks/sweets/tea etc.Please write me an email with your home address!I am really excited to prepare my dissertation concert. Though I feel like this is sadly going to be my last self designed concert during my time in Buffalo (at UB), so I cannot wait to see many of you there!Thank you so much for reading this and considering your donation. I promise to pay you back with my "fabulous" new compositions and my performance, with the great help of my dream team of musician fellows!Please feel free to spread the link to your social pages like Facebook, Instagram, or Twitter, or to emails, to help get the word out! FYI, I am collecting your donations from now till October and GoFundMe takes 2.9% for transaction fee plus $0.30 PER Donation.
