title: Market Theatr's Queer Fest celebrates LGBTQ+ stories
summary: The Market Theatre’s inaugural Queer Fest, running from 21 to 25 October, arrives as both a celebration and a challenge. Coinciding with the theatre’s 50th anniversary, the festival continues The Market’s legacy of platforming South African
content:
The Market Theatre’s inaugural Queer Fest, running from 21 to 25 October, arrives as both a celebration and a challenge. Coinciding with the theatre’s 50th anniversary, the festival continues The Market’s legacy of platforming South African stories, while placing a dedicated spotlight on LGBTQ+ experiences.

As artistic director Greg Homann explained, the festival aims to be both “a place of celebration and joy” as well as a “place of activism”, acknowledging queer victories while confronting ongoing struggles.

The festival opened with a special appearance by legendary satirist Pieter-Dirk Uys, who brings his iconic alter ego to the stage in _Evita @ 91_. It also features Guillaume Apollinaire’s provocative new play, _The Breasts of Tiresias_.

One of the highlights of Queer Fest is Chantal Stanfield’s play, _Shockwave_, which runs until 8 November.

(From left to right) Sister Debbie (Renate Stuurman) and Sister Susan (Lois du Plessis) in ‘Shockwave’, by Chantal Stanfield at The Market Theatre Queer Fest. (Photo: Thandile Zwelibanzi)

Set in 1980s Cape Town during the State of Emergency, _Shockwave_ examines the reality of living in a society where apartheid, religious conservatism and prejudice dictate who is allowed to exist openly. The political unrest, heavy police presence and restrictions imposed under apartheid create an atmosphere of uncertainty.

Yet despite the weight of its themes, the production never succumbs to despair. As director David Dennis observes, “There is no wedding without tears and no funeral without laughter.” It’s a philosophy reflected in the play’s blend of humour, music and human connection.

What makes _Shockwave_ particularly effective is how it intertwines personal struggles with broader political realities. Through immersive sound design – off-stage police vehicles, barking dogs and exploding canisters – the production makes the historical threat feel immediate.

If apartheid controlled where people could live and move, the fear surrounding the HIV/Aids epidemic – the so-called “gay plague” – exposed the emotional cost of hiding one’s identity. Hearing discriminatory words directed at characters on stage is unsettling not because they belong to the past, but because they still echo attitudes that exist today.

Lead actress Renate Stuurman, who plays Sister Debbie, notes there is still “a young person right now for whom this is their reality”. Watching this isolation unfold, I thought about activists like [Simon Nkoli](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/opinionista/2023-10-24-simon-nkoli-remembering-a-true-hero-of-equality/) and how the fight for acceptance and belonging continues today.

Lois du Plessis, Trevor Lynch, Renate Stuurman, Dwayne Behrens star in Chantal Stanfield’s Shockwave at the Market Theatre. (Photo: Thandile Zwelibanzi)

The play also tackles religious hypocrisy, showing how faith can be both a source of comfort and a tool of exclusion. As Stuurman observes, it can be heartbreaking when “loving your fellow man and following rules set out by religion or church go in opposite directions”.

Unfortunately, theatre spaces such as The Market Theatre are rarely given the recognition they deserve for cultivating and showcasing original South African work. Watching _Shockwave_ reinforced the important role theatre plays in preserving stories, challenging perspectives and creating space for voices that are often overlooked.

Homann says The Market Theatre is “very much about the diversity of the South African voice”, and _Shockwave_ is a powerful example of that commitment. More importantly, it demonstrates what he describes as theatre’s greatest strength: its ability to foster empathy.

In a time when many local stories struggle for visibility, productions such as this remind us why theatre remains an essential space for reflection, understanding and dialogue.

Queer Fest runs from 21-25 October 2026. (Photo: Market Theatre)

The inaugural Queer Fest offers a vibrant and multifaceted programme across The Market Theatre precinct. There are bold new theatrical works, including Bruce J Little’s adult comedy, _Bum Stuff: A Cheeky Cabaret_, and a groundbreaking physical performance from Thamsanqa Tshabalala.

Music and live entertainment also feature prominently, with performances by Chris Chameleon, The Luyanda Madope Trio and duo Adrian & Emma-Jean. Together, these varied offerings create a space for radical joy, artistic expression and community gathering.

Ultimately, _Shockwave_ offers transformation over despair, leaving audiences with hope and a deeper appreciation for human resilience. By fostering empathy and understanding, it exemplifies why Queer Fest matters. **DM**

title: 中共五中全会前瞻：高层清洗持续，习近平如何将政治控制转化为治理能力？

content:
中共即将召开以加强党内治理为主题的二十届五中全会。分析人士说，在一系列高层官员遭到清洗、习近平为继续执政布局之际，这次会议不仅将提供观察人事变化的窗口，也将显示他准备如何解决一个持续困扰其执政的问题：如何让官员既服从中央，又能有效落实政策。

这次全会定于10月26日至29日在北京举行，将审议《中共中央关于持之以恒推进全面从严治党若干重大问题的决定》。

两位研究中国政治的学者在接受美国之音采访时表示，他们将重点关注哪些官员出席、哪些处分获得正式确认，以及中央委员会的空缺是否得到填补。这些变化可能为预计于2027年召开的中共二十一大提供人事线索。

与此同时，亚洲协会政策研究所(ASPI)发表的一篇分析指出，习近平能够主导北京高层政治，却未必能确保庞大的党政体系按照他的要求运转。加强政治控制能否带来更好的治理，将是此次会议的重要观察点。

**人事变动：谁出席，谁递补？**

“我在这次全会上最关注、也认为影响最大的，是人事变动，”布鲁金斯学会约翰·桑顿中国中心研究员秦江南(Jon Czin)告诉美国之音。

秦江南说，习近平正在为下一个任期铺路，但近年来的清洗也大幅改变了党内高层的构成，军队尤其如此。全会将帮助外界判断，这轮震荡究竟波及了多大范围。

长期研究中国政治的加州大学圣迭戈分校政治学教授史宗瀚(Victor Shih)认为，另一个重要看点是，中央候补委员是否会递补进入中央委员会。

“过去几年，很多中央委员和中央候补委员因为反腐清洗而被撤职，”他说，“其中许多人的空缺一直没有填补。”

史宗瀚说，在下一次党代会筹备工作成为主要任务之前，这次全会是处理人事空缺的重要机会。他表示，中共二十一大前还会召开一次全会，但届时工作将主要围绕二十一大的安排展开。

亚洲协会政策研究所中国分析中心高级研究员牛犇(Neil Thomas)及共同作者在文章《习近平控制力的局限：中共五中全会观察重点》中指出，除了观察谁获得递补，还应关注哪些符合递补顺序的候补委员被跳过，因为这可能提供有关其政治处境的线索。

不过，文章也提醒，官员没有出席会议，并不能单独证明其已经遭到清洗。

秦江南说，军方人事值得特别关注，因为变化不仅涉及掌握军队指挥权的中央军事委员会，也波及更广泛的军方中央委员。

“受到冲击最严重的确实是军队。”他说。秦江南表示，多名军方中央委员长期未公开露面，使外界难以确认他们的状况。全会的出席名单和人事决定，将有助于判断清洗的范围。

牛犇等人的文章同样将军队领导层列为重点。他们认为，全会可能提供补充中央军委成员的机会，但习近平也可能选择到下一次党代会时再重组军委。

**严格纪律能否解决执行难题？**

北京将全面从严治党视为增强执政能力的重要条件。中共中央政治局在讨论全会筹备工作时强调，要维护党中央集中统一领导，并增强党的长期执政能力。

牛犇等人的分析认为，习近平当前面对的难题，不只是官员是否表态忠诚，而是他们能否将中央要求转化为实际成果。

文章指出，基层官员面对不断增加的任务和紧张的财政资源，可能更倾向于避免犯错、展示合规，而不是尝试新办法。因此，政策执行不力既可能来自推诿，也可能反映现有考核机制和资源约束。

作者认为，判断全会成效的一个关键，是新规定能否为官员提供更清楚的工作重点，并保护合理探索，还是主要增加新的处罚依据。

史宗瀚说，他将关注习近平在已经强化国家监察体系、巡视地方和国有企业等机制之后，还会提出哪些制度措施，使党内纪律成为持久安排。

他同时认为，高压反腐也可能给治理稳定带来问题。官员之间仍然存在激烈的晋升竞争，腐败指控可能成为相互举报的工具，而接连撤换官员又会造成较高的人事流动。

“他对反腐败的高度强调，在某种程度上也已经成为中国稳定治理的一个问题。”史宗瀚说。

史宗瀚还指出，对公务支出的严格限制可能产生经济代价，尤其影响依赖政府会议、差旅及其他相关需求的服务业企业。

他认为，公务支出收紧，加上房地产市场疲弱和外资减少，已经给服务业经营和就业带来压力。他强调，解决办法不是放弃反腐，而是区分违法行为与合法的行政支出。

这些判断也意味着，全会提出的纪律要求如何落实，可能影响地方政府的支出和经济活动，而不只是党内管理。

**为2027年布局，接班信号仍不明朗**

尽管人事安排受到关注，史宗瀚并不预期此次全会将明确习近平的潜在接班人。

“至少从公开信息来看，我们确实还不知道这些人可能是谁。”他说。

牛犇等人的文章也认为，习近平很可能在下一次党代会上寻求第四个任期，但不太可能在这次全会上释放明确的接班信号。作者指出，推迟选择有助于维持习近平眼下的权威，却也让长期权力交接问题继续悬而未决。

**对美中关系的影响**

秦江南认为，习近平对党代会和国内政治的关注，也可能影响外交安排。他说，随着习近平将更多精力投入新任期的准备工作，未来与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)会面的时间安排可能变得更不确定，而领导人会面一直被认为为美中关系提供一定程度的稳定。

9月25日，美中峰会结束，习近平在携夫人彭丽媛离开华盛顿时曾确认，他与特朗普总统在年底前还有两次会晤的机会。“我们预期接下来今年和总统先生还有两次的会面。 一次就是在中国举行的APEC会，再一次呢，就是在美国举行的G20会，我们欢迎总统先生和夫人到中国去访问。”

对观察人士而言，五中全会的看点因此不仅在于对习近平权威的再次确认，也在于具体的人事和制度安排：哪些空缺得到填补，哪些官员仍然缺席，以及新的纪律要求能否改善政策执行。这些将为判断习近平如何准备下一阶段的执政提供线索。

title: Hong Kong leader hails New Territories Rural Advisory Committee centenary, backs Northern Territories development
zh_title: 香港特首庆祝新界乡事咨询委员会成立一百周年 支持北领地发展
summary: Hong Kong Hong Kong Chief Executive John Lee praised the New Territories Rural Advisory Committee on its 100th anniversary, pledging to deepen cooperation on the accelerated Northern Territories development, which aims to integrate with the Greater Bay Area and boost innovation. [![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief 23 Oct 2026 at 19:09 HKT · 2 min read Image: [香港特区政府新闻公报](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202610/23/P2026102300697.htm) 香港行政长官
content:
香港
香港行政长官李家超赞扬新界乡郊咨询委员会成立100周年，承诺深化北领地加速发展合作，旨在与大湾区融合、推动创新。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 23 日 19:09 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

 图片：[香港特区政府新闻公报](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202610/23/P2026102300697.htm)

香港行政长官李家超周五在新界乡郊咨询委员会成立100周年之际赞扬了新界乡事咨询委员会，并发誓要在政府加快北领地（占香港土地三分之一的地区）开发之际加强联系。

李在香港举行的百年庆典晚宴上表示，该委员会成立于1926年，长期以来一直是政府与新界居民之间的重要桥梁，秉承爱国主义和服务社区的原则。他承认该组织对该地区的稳定和繁荣做出的贡献。
李显龙强调，政府最近公布的第一个五年计划优先将北领地打造成与大湾区深度融合的平台和生产力增长的新引擎。该计划的目标是发展大学城、科技园和深港创新及科技区香港部分。

首席执行官概述了北领地的四个目标：大学城、科技、工业以及宜居、宜业和宜游的环境。他表示，政府的目标是通过工业园区、大学和研究机构之间的合作，打造一个融合教育、技术和人才的创新生态系统。

李呼吁乡村咨询委员会在北领地发展中发挥三个作用：继续充当政府与乡村社区之间的沟通桥梁、促进城乡融合并保护乡村遗产、团结居民支持政府计划。

李说：“百年地方关系奠定了新界的基础；今天的北界将为香港谱写新的篇章。”他表示相信委员会将帮助将发展机遇转化为居民的实实在在的利益。

Hong Kong Chief Executive John Lee praised the New Territories Rural Advisory Committee on its 100th anniversary, pledging to deepen cooperation on the accelerated Northern Territories development, which aims to integrate with the Greater Bay Area and boost innovation.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

23 Oct 2026 at 19:09 HKT · 2 min read

 Image: [香港特區政府新聞公報](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202610/23/P2026102300697.htm)

Hong Kong Chief Executive John Lee on Friday praised the New Territories Rural Advisory Committee on its 100th anniversary, vowing to strengthen ties as the government accelerates development of the Northern Territories, a region covering one-third of Hong Kong's land.

Speaking at a centenary dinner in Hong Kong, Lee said the committee, founded in 1926, has long served as a key bridge between the government and residents of the New Territories, upholding principles of patriotism and service to the community. He acknowledged the group's contributions to the territory's stability and prosperity.

Lee highlighted the government's recently announced first five-year plan, which prioritises building the Northern Territories into a platform for deeper integration with the Greater Bay Area and a new engine for productivity growth. The plan targets development of a university town, science parks, and the Hong Kong section of the Shenzhen-Hong Kong Innovation and Technology Zone.

The chief executive outlined four goals for the Northern Territories: university town, technology, industry, and a liveable, workable and visitable environment. He said the government aims to create an innovation ecosystem through collaboration among industrial parks, universities and research institutions, integrating education, technology and talent.

Lee called on the Rural Advisory Committee to play three roles in the Northern Territories development: continue to serve as a communication bridge between the government and village communities, promote urban-rural integration while preserving rural heritage, and unite residents to support government plans.

“Century-old local ties have laid the foundation of the New Territories; today's Northern Territories will write a new chapter for Hong Kong,” Lee said, expressing confidence that the committee will help turn the development opportunities into tangible benefits for residents.

香港
财政司司长陈茂波表示，香港目前拥有超过 1,400 家金融科技公司，其中包括八家数字银行和四家虚拟保险公司。他强调了数字资产监管、代币化债券和即将推出的仓单区块链平台方面的进展。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 23 日 13:22 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

Hong Kong's Financial Secretary Paul Chan said the city now hosts more than 1,400 fintech enterprises, including eight digital banks, four virtual insurers and 12 licensed virtual-asset trading platforms. Speaking at a press conference for the upcoming Hong Kong Fintech Week, Chan said the city's success in the field was not accidental, but the result of sustained policy vision, robust regulatory guidance and a firm commitment to implementation.

The Fintech Week, to be held from 2 to 6 November under the theme “Fintech Hub: Connecting the World, Building the Future”, follows the recent conclusion of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) finance ministers' meeting in Hong Kong, where digital infrastructure financing was a core topic.陈茂波表示，是次活动契合香港第一个五年规划和未来发展的施政报告蓝图。
陈表示，政府和香港金融管理局已完成对香港固定收益市场使用分布式账本技术（DLT）的初步审查。他们已发布澄清，确认使用 DLT 维护的债券持有人名册可被视为满足《公司条例》（第 622 章）规定的记录保存要求。

截至去年底，香港银行托管的数字资产超过140亿港元，代币化存款达到290亿港元。政府上个月还完成了第四次数字绿色债券发行，筹集了约200亿港元，创下了全球数字债券发行规模的新纪录。陈说，这也是世界上第一个将代币化港元存款纳入结算流程的数字债券。

证券及期货事务监察委员会将完善其监管框架，以促进以黄金和其他实物资产为支持的代币化产品在持牌平台上的发行和交易。香港交易及结算所将于明年与指定银行合作推出代币化仓单融资试点，并正在开发基于区块链的多资产代币化平台，其中将包括来自伦敦金属交易所认可仓库的商品仓单。

Hong Kong
Financial Secretary Paul Chan said Hong Kong now hosts over 1,400 fintech companies, including eight digital banks and four virtual insurers. He highlighted progress in digital asset regulation, tokenised bonds and a forthcoming blockchain platform for warehouse receipts.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

23 Oct 2026 at 13:22 HKT · 2 min read

Hong Kong's Financial Secretary Paul Chan said the city now hosts more than 1,400 fintech enterprises, including eight digital banks, four virtual insurers and 12 licensed virtual-asset trading platforms. Speaking at a press conference for the upcoming Hong Kong Fintech Week, Chan said the city's success in the field was not accidental, but the result of sustained policy vision, robust regulatory guidance and a firm commitment to implementation.

The Fintech Week, to be held from 2 to 6 November under the theme “Fintech Hub: Connecting the World, Building the Future”, follows the recent conclusion of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) finance ministers' meeting in Hong Kong, where digital infrastructure financing was a core topic. Chan noted that the event aligns with Hong Kong's first five-year plan and the Policy Address blueprint for future development.

Chan said the government and the Hong Kong Monetary Authority had completed an initial review of the use of distributed ledger technology (DLT) in the city's fixed-income market. They had issued clarifications confirming that a register of debenture holders maintained using DLT could be treated as meeting record-keeping requirements under the Companies Ordinance (Chapter 622).

As of the end of last year, digital assets held in custody by Hong Kong banks exceeded 14 billion Hong Kong dollars, while tokenised deposits reached 29 billion Hong Kong dollars. The government also completed its fourth digital green bond issuance last month, raising about 20 billion Hong Kong dollars and setting a new global record for the size of a digital bond issuance. It was also the world's first digital bond to integrate tokenised Hong Kong dollar deposits into the settlement process, Chan said.

The Securities and Futures Commission will refine its regulatory framework to facilitate the issuance and trading of tokenised products backed by gold and other physical assets on licensed platforms. The Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing will launch a pilot for tokenised warehouse receipt financing next year in cooperation with designated banks, and is developing a blockchain-based multi-asset tokenisation platform that will include commodity warehouse receipts from London Metal Exchange-accredited warehouses.

Dakar, Senegal (file photo)

22 October 2026

By Mame Maïmouna Sy

Dakar — Senegal's labour unions have called for a 72-hour general strike, from October 21 to 23, 2026. The government disputes the legality of the strike, saying the notice filed by the unions doesn't comply with the procedures. This standoff comes amid ongoing tensions surrounding the reform of the Labor Code and the Social Security Code.

The confrontation between the government and the trade unions has entered a new phase. At the call of the Trade Union Front for the Defense of Labor (FSDT) and the mobilized trade union federations, workers are invited to observe three days of strike action to protest, in particular, against the conditions under which the new labor and social protection laws were adopted.

For several months, unions have been denouncing a process they deem insufficiently consultative. On July 10, the FSDT had already announced a general strike to express its opposition to the approach taken by the authorities. Despite this protest, the two texts were promulgated on September 3, 2026, under laws no. 2026-18 and no. 2026-19, before their publication in the Official Journal on September 18th.

A disagreement over the legality of the movement

Faced with this new call for mobilization, the Ministry of Public Service, Labor, and Public Service Reform considers the strike order unlawful. According to information reported by PressAfrik, the administration contests the use of a single strike notice to cover the public, semi-public, and private sectors, which are subject to separate procedures.

In the private and semi-public sectors, the Labor Code stipulates that the dispute must be notified to the Labor and Social Security Inspector or the relevant Director General, as applicable. If no agreement is reached, or in the event of partial conciliation, a thirty-day notice period may then be given to the company's management.

For civil servants, the ministry reminds them that written notice must specify the reasons for and duration of the strike, with one month's notice given before the action begins. Local government employees, for their part, must notify the president of the departmental council or the mayor concerned of their strike notice.

The administration warns that failure to comply with these formalities may result in salary deductions for days not worked and disciplinary action. It also mentions potential consequences for the right to compensation and damages in the event of termination of the employment contract.

# Strong earthquake strikes China’s remote Tibet region

At least 16 people have died and dozens more injured after a major earthquake measuring 7.0 on the Richter scale shook China’s remote Tibet region on Thursday, state media said. Hundreds of houses collapsed in the tremor.

Issued on: 22/10/2026 - 23:09 Modified: 23/10/2026 - 15:16

 1 min Reading time

Share

 By:

 The earthquake measured 7.0 on the Richter scale. © Science Photo Library via Reuter/ Illustration picture

At least 16 people were killed and 32 more injured when a strong 7.0-magnitude earthquake struck [China](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/china/)’s remote [Tibet](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/tibet/) region, state news agency Xinhua said, citing local authorities.

More than 300 houses collapsed in the earthquake, which struck Thursday at 10:33pm (1433 GMT). Officials were still evaluating the damage, and disaster relief work was ongoing, Xinhua said.

Read more[Scores killed in powerful earthquake in Tibet](https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20250107-earthquake-tiibet-shigatse)

The quake’s epicentre was located in a mountainous area about 190 kilometres east-northeast of Nagqu, and 390 kilometres northeast of the regional capital Lhasa, the US Geological Survey said.

It struck at a shallow depth of 10 kilometres.

A level-II earthquake disaster emergency response was activated in the area, Xinhua said.

The epicentre was located in Maru township in Baqen county. Township deputy head Lhawang Dagpo said the quake was clearly felt at the township office, which sustained cracks in the walls, according to Xinhua.

Power and telecoms services were disrupted in the county seat, the agency said.

Earthquakes in China are relatively common.

In January 2025, at least 126 people were killed in [an earthquake in Tibet’s rural Tingri county](https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20250107-earthquake-tiibet-shigatse).

# Strong earthquake strikes China’s remote Tibet region

At least 16 people have died and dozens more have been injured after a major earthquake measuring 7.0 on the Richter scale shook China’s remote Tibet region on Thursday, state media said. Hundreds of houses collapsed in the tremor.

Issued on: 22/10/2026 - 23:09 Modified: 22/10/2026 - 23:30

 1 min Reading time

Share

 By:

 The earthquake measured 7.0 on the Richter scale. © Science Photo Library via Reuter/ Illustration picture

At least 16 people were killed and 32 more injured when a strong 7.0-magnitude earthquake struck [China](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/china/)’s remote [Tibet](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/tibet/) region, state news agency Xinhua said, citing local authorities.

More than 300 houses collapsed in the earthquake, which struck Thursday at 10:33pm (1433 GMT). Officials were still evaluating the damage, and disaster relief work was ongoing, Xinhua said.

Read more[Scores killed in powerful earthquake in Tibet](https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20250107-earthquake-tiibet-shigatse)

The quake’s epicentre was located in a mountainous area about 190 kilometres east-northeast of Nagqu, and 390 kilometres northeast of the regional capital Lhasa, the US Geological Survey said.

It struck at a shallow depth of 10 kilometres.

A level-II earthquake disaster emergency response was activated in the area, Xinhua said.

The epicentre was located in Maru township in Baqen county. Township deputy head Lhawang Dagpo said the quake was clearly felt at the township office, which sustained cracks in the walls, according to Xinhua.

Power and telecoms services were disrupted in the county seat, the agency said.

Earthquakes in China are relatively common.

In January 2025, at least 126 people were killed in [an earthquake in Tibet’s rural Tingri county](https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20250107-earthquake-tiibet-shigatse).

_(FRANCE 24 with AFP)_

content:
华盛顿 —

台湾政府星期三(10月21日)对北京当局企图以暴力威胁，侵害台湾人民的人身安全及言论自由的做法发出严厉谴责。台湾检方当天起诉五名被告，指控他们受中国大陆人士委托，策划驾车冲撞曾于去年12月在社交媒体发布讽刺中国领导人习近平段子的台湾相声演员黄逸豪。台湾外交部也呼吁民主伙伴正视中国跨国镇压，共同捍卫民主自由与人权。

新北地方检察署说，检调查出大陆地区人士“K”涉嫌以新台币45万元为报酬，委托郑姓、游姓、黄姓、范姓及廖姓等五名被告搜集特定人士的个人资料，预谋驾车冲撞使其受伤住院，以阻止其参加原定演出。检方侦查终结，依重伤害未遂、违反《个人资料保护法》等罪嫌提起公诉，具体求刑2年7个月至5年6个月。

黄逸豪去年12月在社交媒体贴出讽刺中国领导人习近平的段子，上个月在自家住处附近遭车辆撞伤，经检调人员侦查后发现是涉案人受中国人士指使，意图制造假车祸让他无法上台演出。

新北地检署说，“本案系中共涉嫌透过跨境镇压手段，指挥我国不法分子以极端暴力手段打压政治立场相左声音之严重事件。被告等人甘为境外敌对势力效劳，意图在我国社会制造寒蝉效应，严重挑衅我国民主法治底线，恶性极重。”

**台湾外交部、陆委会发表声明谴责**

台湾外交部和陆委会同日发表声明，同声谴责中国此一“跨国镇压”暴力行为。

外交部说，言论自由是民主社会不可侵犯的基石，“任何人都不该因发表评论而遭受暴力报复”，中国涉嫌收买在地人士意图使艺文工作者无法登台，“是恶劣的政治噤声行径”，外交部呼吁国际社会共同正视中国跨国镇压的威胁，拒绝威权整体利用民主社会的开放与自由，从事恐吓、渗透及暴力迫害。

陆委会说，中共不但在其境内无法容忍不同意见，也不容许中国以外的地方有人提出政治批评，“更可耻的是，以跨国镇压手法伤害台湾网民众，企图钳制台湾的言论自由，严重挑战台湾的民主法治秩序”，台湾必将依法究责，追缉到底。

**国际人权组织：台湾缺乏界定跨国镇压的法律工具**

总部在巴黎的国际人权组织“第19条”(Article 19)亚洲项目专员刘以正在接受美国之音采访时说，台湾政府对跨国镇压已有一定认识,也有相应的应对机制。他举例说,日裔媒体人矢板明夫在台湾遭香港人士攻击后，执法人员能在机场迅速逮捕涉案者。

不过，刘以正说，对于涉及政治意图的案件,台湾仍缺乏合适的法律工具。他说：“我们目前没有一个好的法律工具来定义跨国镇压。因为如果只是A打了B，两个人都没有任何政治意图，它就只是一个伤害罪，可是今天他具有某种特别政治意图，就需要要以不同形式去处理，它的背后可能有国家级的行动者。”

刘以正认为，民主国家需要提高对跨国镇压的理解，让其执法单位理解这种行为才能提前作出防范措施。

“因为很多单位其实不知道中国这样的做法，他们需要人权团体去倡议，可是很多时候这样的倡议都是在有人受害之后才发生，所以提前围堵，增加大家对跨国镇压的了解，然后准备好合适的法律工具，”他说，跨国镇压与欧洲目前非常注意的FIMI (foreign information manipulation and interference，外国信息操纵与干预)有重叠之处，大家应该携手合作，共同思考如何有效应对中国的新形态威胁。

“因为越来越多这种混合型威胁行为难以单一放在某一个法律概念框架下，像欧洲人会讲FIMI，它与跨国镇压又有一些交集的地方，所以它们是两个有交集的象限概念群，所以到底要怎么样好好的来描述中国可能对所有人造成的混合型威胁，这件事情是我们组织下一个想要探讨的东西。我们现在想要看到就是其实我们大家需要更多的串联，来把这些不同的框架一起放进来，不然的话，我们都会用一人处理一个小的框架，那永远没有办法对抗我们的对手，”刘以正说。

**美国近期案件与北京回应**

美国司法部月初才起诉居住在加州尔湾的女子张婉莹，指控她涉嫌在美国境内充当中国政府未登记代理人。检方指控她曾按照中国政府官员的指示，在美国对台湾总统赖清德的儿子进行秘密监视，这起案件也再度引发外界对中国政府在美国开展跨国监视活动的关注。

台湾方面表示，赖清德的家人遭到监视显示，所谓的跨国镇压已经影响到台湾民众及其家属。中国国台办发言人陈斌华则表示，坚决反对民进党政府“勾连外部势力”信口雌黄，操弄‘反中抗中’，挑起两岸对立。

**美国智库学者：非国家行为者如何接受指令值得关注**

全球台湾研究中心(GTI)研究员本·桑度(Ben Sando)在接受美国之音采访时说，在涉及中国在全世界影响力的行为方面，无论是间谍、窃取商业秘密或恐吓异议人士等，人们会见到许多非国家行为者参与各种活动，以赖清德的例子来说，它涉及的是一个政治人物的儿子可能被恫吓，他认为这些涉案者的背景值得仔细观察。

全球台湾研究中心(Global Taiwan Institute, GTI)研究员本·桑度(Ben Sando)接受美国之音采访时说，在涉及中国全球影响力的行为方面，无论是间谍活动、窃取商业机密还是恐吓异议人士，常有许多非国家行为者参与其中。以赖清德之子的案例而言，涉及的是一名政治人物的儿子可能受到恫吓，他认为这些涉案者的背景值得仔细观察。

桑度说:“有意思的是去看这些不同行为者如何从中国政府接收指令。我非常好奇的是，是否有人事先采取这些行为来作为向中国政府建立可信度或名声的方式。人们都知道，中国有非常复杂的系统--统战系统--来奖赏这种忠诚。”

他说，只要能执行北京当局的指令或作出有利它的行为，即便人不住在中国都有可能因此得到奖赏。

“即便你不是住在北京或与中国高级领导人有关系，即便你只是住在香港、福建或甚至是海外，中国都有办法能奖赏你，像是恫吓政治人物的子女都可能得到小小的奖赏，”桑度说，这种奖赏或许是拍完一张照片后回到中国，就有可能被邀请去与某人合做生意，或是从地方政府得到好处真的赚到一些钱。

“中国尤其将经济武器化，以此来奖赏忠诚，”他说。

content:
中共二十届五中全会本周一（10月26号）到周四在北京召开。这次会议锁定的主题简单说是“推进全面从严治党”，距离中共二十一大召开约一年时间之际，五中全会也成为了观察中共如何整顿干部队伍、强化权力的监督，为下一届换届建立政治纪律的一个重要窗口。

如何解析这次会议的议程，以及近期中美领导人互动带来的一些影响。本期节目就采访流亡美国的政治活动家王军涛先生。

**王军涛**： 我觉得五中全会“推进全面从严治党”的主题，可以分三个方面谈。如果要从严治党的话，实际上就是要进一步强化自己的独裁体制。其实从共产党提出“四个意识”、“两个维护”开始 ，就已经结束了邓小平时期的所谓“集体领导”制——其实那也不是集体领导，叫以某人为核心 ，就是有一个人有最后否决权。虽然大事上大家表决，但是一把手有最后否决权。到了江泽民时候，实际上说是“九龙治水“，其实就是一条老龙在背后操纵了六条到七条龙，也是一个“准集权体制”，但是还是有一个变化空间。那习近平上来之后就变成了一锤定音的专制独裁体制。

他现在进一步说要强化，说明他还是要高调唱。我觉得有三个方面的原因。第一，可能要进一步进行清洗，就是给这些共产党员敲警钟，我们就可以说权力斗争永远在路上。这一点不奇怪，民主国家、专制国家都有，民主国家不过是依一定的程序，谁也消灭不了谁，大家用程序来决定胜负。专制体制就是一个人或者一个小集团说了算， 决定大家命运。这个是一个原因，就是继续在造势；第二个可能性，就是为了下一步在干部上做比较大的调整，用来打压不同的意见。其实邓小平时期考察干部有两条标准，一个就是对美关系，另一个是经济，这两项指标习近平都不及格，实际上大家的意见很大，那就用这个方式进一部压制不同的意见，做进一步清洗；第三，我觉得在他后来反腐之后 ，由于什么事都要他说了算，底下人有点儿不知道该干什么。习近平前段时间已经下达了一些文件，都在强调各级干部要履职，其实他不知道不能履职是他自己造成的，在独裁体制下，什么事都要由他说了算，他不去表态的话，谁也不敢干，干错了就要被摘帽子。

所以他现在发这样一个条文，想整顿一下官场风气，那到底为什么原因？我觉得要看这个文件到底对从严治党提出了什么，当然作为一个规定来说，从法律和规则的角度，或者从行政管理角度来说，也有三个看点。第一，他是否提出了新的罪名？比如说如果谁犯了什么问题，这个问题就要处理，有什么新的强调重点。第二，处理这些人有什么程序，程序上是否从简 ？是否给一些办案机关更大的权力？如果不是权力斗争，贪腐可能还是按程序来。但是假如权力需要，就是逼供，逼他们要承认一些罪名，也可能有罪名，查不到证据，也可能没有给他们罗列罪名，要看程序上是不是有进步，会不会有进一步的简化，或者把原来的中纪委办案的这些按照过去旧方式、违法的方式都当作一个合法方式给固定下来。当然最后一个就是看有什么样的惩罚，惩罚是不是又升级了。在习近平任期内，经济犯罪判死刑可能不超过五个或十个吧。那么现在下一步是不是要把这个法律严明一些。

我觉得三个方面是看点。一个是有没有新的罪名，比如说像在习近平那个时候有过什么“团团伙伙”等罪，这些实际上都不是中纪委，既不是国法，也不是党章应该查的，那这次会不会入中央的规定？当然最后一个看点还是人事，这是现在大家比较关心这个问题——其实我倒不关心，因为实际上在习近平独断独裁情况下，不管谁上去都是他的木偶，都是他的“军机处”，是落实他重大决定的一个办事班子。对国家大的决策来说，这个其实没有太大必要研究。在国家大政方针上研究习近平就够了，用不着去研究他底下谁上谁下。

**法广**：五中全会，还有接下来的六中，七中全会，都是为明年二十一大习近平可能要第四次连任在做一定的准备？

**王军涛**：**这不是可能，我觉得肯定（要连任）。**

**法广**：他还是要做准备吗？

**王军涛**：当然要做准备，因为习近平这个人做事很仔细，你可以看出来他已经大权在握，绝对统治的时候，还是很小心地把各个细节都处理好。胡平先生说过一句话，我觉得非常好，他说实际上中共就是：大会议小事，小会议大事，决事不开会，开会不决事。什么意思呢？比如89年那么大的决定是在邓小平家里做出的，基本上就是没开会。所以共产党是一个无法无天的党，在这个国家的正常运作，没什么大变化时候按程序走可以，即使这样，很多决定也是在小的场合已经做决定了，所谓的大会不过是落实。

那我们可以看出，习近平在第一届之后，他已经在终结的会议通过了一个决议可以废除任期制以后，已经是大权独揽了，在这个时候，怎么摆都是他自己的事。

唯一对他的制约就两个，一是国家的形势，经济形势太不好的时候，要做点让步。第二就是如果中美关系太恶化的时候，要对国内一些东西做一些调整，除此之外，对他现在没有任何的制约和威胁。随着坊间传说的什么他的权利受到威胁等，都是不准确的。因为都是对共产党的基本权利机制，甚至是对于中国二千年中央集权控制官员的机制不了解。从中共毛泽东开始担任领导之后，中共就没有成建制的叛变的事，他的这一套控制干部的机制非常好。所以我觉得在这点上，习近平应该没有什么悬念。

他想干的事，其实一上来就说的很清楚，就是两件事，他想用新理念打造新格局。现在人类要有一批科技已经发展起来了，但现在发明这些科技的国家没有钱落地，习近平就想借中国的国力让他落地。第二，他知道做这件事有点像过去灾荒年搞原子弹一样，一般的老百姓是不干的，所以他搞了一个集权，乾纲独断了一个独裁体制来进行落实。二十一大也是要讨论怎么进一步落实。

只有一个情况下，习近平会从一线上退下来，那就是他身体已经严重不行了。这个我们可以看出来，就是有些重大的国事都已经受影响了。这次就到美国来，其实最初选9月24号到美国进行国事访问，我当时就想他可能会像江泽民当初那样，先参加联合国会议，因为联合国会议第一天会是两个大国，中国和美国都要在，一个在上午，一个在下午，要进行阐述自己对人类命运的看法，开完了联合国会议之后，他再去进行这个国事访问。但是，你可以看这次联合国会议问题上，中国非常反常，22号开会，中国开会前的四个小时才公布了自己的名单，就是韩正带队，而且是24号才开始参加会议，几乎和习近平到美国来是同一个时间，晚了两天来参加会议，而习近平只是去了美国。在美国期间，我们看到《华尔街日报》报道，说他中间很多的时间都在休息，而且有几个仪式都没有进行，都是象征性的做完就走了，这说明他的健康可能确实有严重问题。

如果到了这样重大的国事访问，他的健康都有问题，那当然在一线继续待下去的可能有问题。所以如果在二十一大他能从一线退下来，那也是他的健康问题，但是他可以继续操纵，就像毛泽东晚年时候，说话都说不清，好像说只有张玉凤能听懂，别人都听不懂的情况下，他仍然还是一言九鼎，能够控制中国的全局，习近平现在也还可以做到这一点。

**法广**：那你刚才说到，考核中国领导人有两个标准，一个是对美关系，另外一个是经济。那今年他和特朗普的交往特别频繁，这对他有利的？

王军涛：这个考核标准已经废掉了。但我觉得特朗普把习近平耍了。前一段时间我跟AI就习近平的健康进行对话，AI经常收集习近平健康的信息，我认为《华尔街日报》是在给特朗普洗地。为什么呢？特朗普让习近平来，俩人要谈，他给习近平的接待规格极高，但是基本上是习近平被他牵着走，各方面话题，包括台湾什么都没有展开，全都压着习近平。特朗普所要谈的全都谈了，包括贸易和伊朗都上桌了，（我觉得）习近平实际上是心情不好，不想再谈，所以他就跑到旁边去了。

特朗普带着习近平去看国家历史档案馆，是想让习近平看美国建国文件不是他真正的目的。他给习近平讲这个干什么？江泽民也去过，是到费城原地去看了原件，特朗普到国家档案馆是看中美关系的几个历史文件，就是告诉习近平，他自己动不了这个东西。其实特朗普想动啥就动他，我们也知道他的性格，实际上他也不想动台湾问题，他想跟习近平解释为什么不能动，但是习近平没有兴趣，在那儿晃了一下就走了。所以这一次习近平是铩羽而归，基本上他想要的都没有要到，而特朗普要的东西都上谈判桌了，而且都说在11月继续落实。特朗普是个谈判高手，他确实在这点上他把习近平给耍了，那么高规格接待的时候当然都一片非议，但是这一次从议题的掌控……还有习近平这次来，本来说想见什么工商界，还想在大学演讲，特朗普就说你想见谁，我就把他请到咱们的饭桌上来，跟咱俩坐一桌。但特朗普的气场压着，谁还敢跟习近平互动？习近平这次什么都没有达到，最后等于就是在白宫里被关了几天回去了。其实他就是想去的地方都不让他去。当时还说俩人有个什么茶叙，俩人散步，这些都没了……

一个解释是健康，我觉着不是健康问题，关键是他的议题，包括到后来联合国迟迟不能来，也是议题的问题，因为不能满足他要求。因为一般中国领导人到联合国访问，同时在纽约，纽约世界的钱都，都会在那儿接见工商代表、侨团代表，这两件事一定要做的，可能特朗普都不让他做，而特朗普不让做的理由就是对等接待。你在北京是没让我做，你在北京就给我一个皇帝的待遇的话，跑到皇宫里吃饭，那我就给你一个历史上我只给教皇的待遇 。所以，实际上这次习近平中美关系是铩羽而归，他并没有得到他想要的东西。

非常感谢王军涛接受法广的专访。

content:
_以下是上周西太平洋主要舰船活动和演习的摘要。_

## **在菲律宾海**

2026 年 10 月 21 日，美国海军、日本海上自卫队、澳大利亚皇家海军、加拿大皇家海军和法国海军舰艇在菲律宾海举行的“锐剑 27”(KS27) 演习中齐头并进。美国海军照片

作为美日“利剑 27”演习的一部分，西奥多·罗斯福号航母打击群周三在菲律宾海。

航空母舰西奥多·罗斯福号 (CVN-71) 搭载第 11 舰载机联队 (CVW) 和巡洋舰 USS_Chosin_(CG-65) 领先日本海上自卫队直升机驱逐舰 JS _Ise_(DDH-182)、驱逐舰 JS _Kongo_ (DDG-173) 和 JS _Asahi_(DD-119)、澳大利亚皇家海军护卫舰 HMAS _Stuart_ (FFH153)、加拿大皇家海军护卫舰 HMCS _Regina_ (FFH334) 和一艘法国护卫舰在进行海军演习。

## 在西里伯斯海

中国人民解放军海军辽宁舰舰艇 [周五被发现](https://x.com/bncdotph/status/2113486033795068415?s=46&t=E74_DbuPOhFRAs5RyI-Miw) 正在穿越位于菲律宾巴西兰市和三宝颜市之间的巴西兰海峡。该打击群包括航空母舰辽宁号 (16)、巡洋舰鞍山号 (103) 和无锡号巡洋舰 (104) 以及驱逐舰怀宁号 (123)。

## **在日本**
2026 年 10 月 21 日，日本岩国海军陆战队航空站举行的“锐剑 27”（KS27）演习中，一艘台风无人水面舰艇展示了海军拦截技术。美国海军陆战队照片

美日双边“锐剑27”演习将于周一至10月29日在日本举行。大部分活动将在日本西南部地区进行。

大约 45,000 名日本自卫队、11,000 名美国军人以及来自澳大利亚、加拿大、法国、德国、荷兰、新西兰和菲律宾的部队以及来自韩国和英国的观察员参加了此次活动。

包括西奥多·罗斯福号航母战斗群在内的总共 260 架飞机和 40 艘舰艇正在部署参加演习，演习于周一在石垣岛举行[正式仪式](https://www.dvidshub.net/image/10031703/keen-sword-27-opening-ceremony)。

与海上[演习](https://www.dvidshub.net/image/10038745/uss-theodore-roosevelt-cvn-71-participates-keen-sword-27)、海军陆战队和日本陆上自卫队一起(日本陆上自卫队)[反舰](https://www.dvidshub.net/image/10034230/ks-27-us-marines-with-12th-lct-embark-jltv-and-nmesis)和防空导弹部队将部署到先岛群岛进行岛屿防御演习。[](https://www.dvidshub.net/image/10042298/mcas-iwakuni-drone-demo)
[无人机演示](https://www.dvidshub.net/image/10042298/mcas-iwakuni-drone-demo) 将在岩国海军陆战队航空站 (MCAS) 进行，美国空军 F-22 猛禽战斗机将部署到日本航空自卫队筑城空军基地。 A[机场维修训练](https://www.dvidshub.net/image/10038599/us-marines-airmen-train-airfield-damage-repair-during-keen-sword-27)将在嘉手纳空军基地进行，[网络演习](https://www.dvidshub.net/image/10041549/us-japan-and-partners-strengthen-cyber-readiness-during-keen-sword-27)在相模基地，[联合战斗机航班](https://www.dvidshub.net/image/10042468/us-marines-us-air-force-jasdf-conduct-photo-exercise-during-keen-sword-27) 和[“大象行走”](https://www.dvidshub.net/video/1027108/1st-maw-japan-ground-self-defense-force-aircraft-s

【原文 English Original】
_The following is a summary of major ship movements and exercises in the Western Pacific over the last week._

## **In the Philippine Sea**

U.S. Navy, Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force, Royal Australian Navy, Royal Canadian Navy, and French Navy ships steam together during Exercise Keen Sword 27 (KS27), Oct. 21, 2026, in the Philippine Sea. US Navy photo

The Theodore Roosevelt Carrier Strike Group was in the Philippine Sea as of Wednesday as part of U.S.-Japan Exercise Keen Sword 27.

Aircraft carrier USS _Theodore Roosevelt_ (CVN-71) with embarked Carrier Air Wing (CVW) 11 and cruiser USS _Chosin_(CG-65) is leading Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force helicopter destroyer JS _Ise_(DDH-182),destroyers JS _Kongo_ (DDG-173) and JS _Asahi_(DD-119), Royal Australian Navy frigate HMAS _Stuart_ (FFH153), Royal Canadian frigate HMCS _Regina_ (FFH334) and a French frigate in the naval drills.

## In the Celebes Sea

The People’s Liberation Army Navy Liaoning CSG [was spotted Friday](https://x.com/bncdotph/status/2113486033795068415?s=46&t=E74_DbuPOhFRAs5RyI-Miw) transiting the Basilan Strait, which is between Basilan and Zamboanga City, Philippines. The strike group includes aircraft carrier CNS _Liaoning_ (16), cruisers CNS _Anshan_ (103) and CNS _Wuxi_ (104) and destroyer CNS _Huainen_ (123).

## **In Japan**

A Typhoon unmanned surface vessel demonstrates naval interception techniques during Exercise Keen Sword 27 (KS27), at Marine Corps Air Station Iwakuni, Japan, Oct. 21, 2026. US Marine Corps photo

The U.S.-Japan bilateral Exercise Keen Sword 27 is being carried out in Japan from Monday to Oct. 29. The majority of activities will take place in Japan’s southwest region.

Approximately 45,000 Japan Self-Defense Force, 11,000 U.S. service members and forces from Australia, Canada, France, Germany, the Netherlands, New Zealand and the Philippines are participating alongside observers from the Republic of Korea and the United Kingdom.

A total of 260 aircraft and 40 ships, including the Theodore Roosevelt Carrier Strike Group are being deployed for the drills, which opened Monday with a[formal ceremony](https://www.dvidshub.net/image/10031703/keen-sword-27-opening-ceremony) on Ishigaki Island.

Along with at-sea[drills](https://www.dvidshub.net/image/10038745/uss-theodore-roosevelt-cvn-71-participates-keen-sword-27), Marine Corps and Japan Ground Self-Defense Force (JGSDF)[anti-ship](https://www.dvidshub.net/image/10034230/ks-27-us-marines-with-12th-lct-embark-jltv-and-nmesis) and anti-air missile units will be deployed to the Sakishima Islands for island defense drills.[](https://www.dvidshub.net/image/10042298/mcas-iwakuni-drone-demo)

[Drone demonstrations](https://www.dvidshub.net/image/10042298/mcas-iwakuni-drone-demo) will occur at Marine Corps Air Station (MCAS) Iwakuni,and U.S. Air Force F-22 Raptor fighters will deploy to Japan Air Self-Defense Force Tsuiki Air Base. A[irfield repair training](https://www.dvidshub.net/image/10038599/us-marines-airmen-train-airfield-damage-repair-during-keen-sword-27) will take place at Kadena Air Base,[cyber exercises](https://www.dvidshub.net/image/10041549/us-japan-and-partners-strengthen-cyber-readiness-during-keen-sword-27) at Sagami Depot, [joint fighter aircraft flights](https://www.dvidshub.net/image/10042468/us-marines-us-air-force-jasdf-conduct-photo-exercise-during-keen-sword-27) and an[“elephant walk”](https://www.dvidshub.net/video/1027108/1st-maw-japan-ground-self-defense-force-aircraft-stage-elephant-walk-during-keen-sword-27) of Marine Corps and JGSDF rotary wing and tiltrotor aircraft will be at MCAS Futenma.

## **In U.S. 7th Fleet**

U.S. Navy Ensign Elijah Arcusa, assigned to San Antonio-class amphibious transport dock USS New Orleans (LPD-18), stands look out watch while sailing alongside Republic of Korea Navy Rincon-class tanker ROKS Soyang (AOE 51) in the Western Pacific, Oct. 19, 2026. US Navy photo

Amphibious assault ship USS _Makin Island_(LHD-8) is transiting the Pacific westward on deployment after a port visit to Hawaii. The Makin Island Amphibious Ready Group includes _Makin Island,_ USS _Anchorage_(LPD-23), USS _John P. Murtha_(LPD-26), and the embarked 13th Marine Expeditionary Unit.

Destroyer USS _Howard_ (DDG-83)[is operating](https://www.dvidshub.net/image/10036613/uss-howard-conducts-weapons-familiarization) in the Pacific Ocean. _Howard_ is forward-deployed to Japan and assigned to Destroyer Squadron (DESRON) 15.

Amphibious transport dock USS _New Orleans_ (LPD-18) carried out a replenishment-at-sea with Republic of Korea Navy fast combat support ship ROKS _Soyang_ (AOE-51)[on Monday](https://www.dvidshub.net/image/10039559/uss-new-orleans-conducts-ras-with-roks-soyang). _New Orleans,_ assigned to Expeditionary Strike Group 7, Task Force 76, is currently underway conducting routine operations in the U.S. 7th Fleet area of operations.

## **In Malaysia and Singapore**

Five Power Defence Arrangements (FPDA) Exercise Bersama Lima ran from Oct. 5-23, 2026. The exercise included joint urban operations, shown here, shared Oct. 22, 2026. FPDA photo

Five Power Defense Arrangements (FPDA) Exercise Bersama Lima concluded on Friday, having begun on Oct. 5.

A total of 1900 personnel from Australia, Malaysia, New Zealand, Singapore and the U.K. participated with seven ships, one submarine and 42 aircraft in Malaysia and Singapore. Activities included[surface-to-air defense](https://www.facebook.com/photo?fbid=122146993407031462&set=pcb.122146993905031462),[joint urban operations](https://www.facebook.com/photo?fbid=122146993683031462&set=pcb.122146993905031462),[Combined Anti-Submarine Exercises (CASEX)](https://www.facebook.com/permalink.php?story_fbid=pfbid0rCKP2sK2scWEqJcCYGWNHiAiPr78AHtDVBWp34kjSUa79VJidvEUNddLPrV7yzC2l&id=61580943887244),[Dissimilar Air Combat Training (DACT)](https://www.facebook.com/permalink.php?story_fbid=pfbid029Bq42WQAe9yH58kRXM1hayk9U38JNhYqEoaZibUgNA2wG3K8ubpzJKqvEC3ttCMql&id=61580943887244),[Boarding Exercise](https://www.facebook.com/permalink.php?story_fbid=pfbid02Sd1HR1VSR7xQ4MuSxL9zeS7KDt5LxANMEGrxHfKTBmPmChmZmdbp4vDPA3SAGUsLl&id=61580943887244) and[replenishment at sea](https://www.facebook.com/photo?fbid=122146993323031462&set=pcb.122146993905031462).

Naval vessels that participated included Royal Australian Navy fleet oiler HMAS _Stalwart_ (A304), Republic of Singapore Navy frigate RSS _Intrepid_, littoral mission vessel RSS _Dauntless_ (21) and an Invincible-class submarine, Royal Malaysian Navy corvette KD _Lekir_(FSG26) and offshore patrol vessel KD _Pahang_ (172) and Royal Navy offshore patrol vessels HMS _Tamar_ (P233) and HMS _Spey_ (P234).

The FPDA has released[a video](https://www.facebook.com/reel/1493372142848501) of the exercise’s highlights.

## **In Bayuwangi, East Java, Indonesia**

Australian Defense Force and Indonesian National Armed Forces personnel dismount from a landing craft mechanized mark 8 during an amphibious assault rehearsal as part of Exercise Keris Woomera in East Java, Indonesia, released Oct. 20, 2026. Australian Defense Force photo

Indonesia-Australia joint bilateral exercise Keris Woomera 26 concluded[on Tuesday](https://www.defence.gov.au/news-events/news/2026-10-20/australia-indonesia-conclude-major-exercise), having begun on Oct. 12. The exercise saw 1,000 Australian Defense Force personnel and more than 1,200 members of the Indonesian National Armed Forces carry out complex training across maritime, land, air and cyber domains.

There were nine days of combined joint training in East Java, the Bali Sea and surrounding maritime areas.

The[joint naval task group](https://images.defence.gov.au/assets/Home/Search?Query=20261014ran8649366_0643.jpg&Type=Filename) included Indonesian Navy corvette KRI _Sultan Iskandar Muda_ (367) and Royal Australian Navy frigate HMAS _Perth_ (FFH157), amphibious dock landing ship HMAS _Choules_(L100) and fleet oiler _Stalwart_. The fleet oiler then moved on to Singapore for Exercise Bersama Shield.

## **In the South China Sea**

Littoral Combat Ship USS Charleston (LCS-18) was operating near Sabina Shoal on Oct. 20, 2026. PLAN photo

Littoral Combat Ship USS _Charleston_ (LCS-18) was operating near Sabina Shoal on Tuesday. The maritime feature is claimed by China.

“The U.S. action infringes upon China’s sovereign rights and interests, jeopardizes maritime security, and is detrimental to regional peace and stability. The U.S. side should immediately cease such activities,” reads a[statement](https://x.com/ChinaMilBugle/status/2112430130232709295) on the People’s Liberation Army (PLA) official social media account China Military Bugle.

## **In Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam**

Royal Navy offshore patrol vessel HMS Spey docked Oct. 23, 2026, in Nha Rong Port in Ho Chi Minh City for a port visit. U.K. government photo

Royal Navy offshore patrol vessel HMS _Spey_[docked Friday](https://www.facebook.com/photo?fbid=1614583514037776&set=pcb.1614584654037662) in Nha Rong Port in Ho Chi Minh City for a port visit. _Spey_ previously operated in the waters off Malaysia and Singapore for Five Power Defence Arrangements Exercise Bersama Lima.

## **In Qingdao, China**

Chinese fleet oiler CNS Taihu (889) on Oct. 23, 2026. PLAN image

The People’s Liberation Army Navy 48th Escort Task Group [arrived Friday](https://x.com/ChinaMilBugle/status/2113580842757075404) at its homeport of Qingdao, China. The task group includes destroyer CNS _Tangshan_ (122), CNS frigate _Daqing_ (576) and fleet oiler CNS _Taihu_(889).

During its 378-day mission, the task force sailed more than 150,000 nautical miles and escorted 423 Chinese and foreign vessels in the Gulf of Aden and waters off Somalia. The PLAN has conducted the rotational deployments of escort task groups to the Gulf of Aden and waters off Somalia since 2008.

JMSDF P-1 Maritime Patrol Aircraft tracked the task group sailing northeast 220 kilometers – 137 miles – south of Miyako Island on Oct. 16 and subsequently sailing between Okinawa and Miyako Island to enter the East China Sea on Saturday.

## **In the Yellow Sea**

ROKS Seoae Ryu Seong-ryong (DDG-993), ROKS Gang Gam-chan (DDH-979) and ROKS Eulji Mundeok (DDH-972) participate in the Republic of Korea Armed Forces Hoguk annual field training exercise from Oct. 20-22, 2026, in the Yellow Sea. ROKN photo

The ROKN conducted joint and combined maritime operations training in the Yellow Sea from[Tuesday to Friday](https://www.facebook.com/photo?fbid=1539946261511893&set=pcb.1539946301511889) as part of the larger Republic of Korea Armed Forces Hoguk annual field training exercise. The exercise will run from Monday to Oct. 30 and involves participation from U.S. forces in South Korea.

A total of 20 ROKN surface ships – including destroyers ROKS _Seoae Ryu Seong-ryong_ (DDG-993), ROKS _Gang Gam-chan_ (DDH-979) and ROKS _Eulji Mundeok_ (DDH-972) – along with U.S. and ROKN MPA and Republic of Korea Air Force fighter aircraft participated in the drills from Tuesday to Friday.

Participating forces carried out a range of drills, including maritime maneuvers, live-fire naval gunnery, maritime interdiction operations, anti-submarine warfare and combined Maritime Counter-Special Operations Force operations.

## **In Sasebo, Japan**

Destroyer JS Kirisame (DD-104) departed Oct. 17, 2026, from JMSDF Sasebo Naval Base for a deployment to the Gulf of Aden. JMSDF photos

JMSDF destroyer JS _Kirisame_ (DD-104) [departed Saturday](https://www.facebook.com/photo?fbid=1438246741777791&set=pcb.1438246865111112) from JMSDF Sasebo Naval Base for a deployment to the Gulf of Aden as the 55th Deployment Surface Force for Counter Piracy Enforcement.

The deployment is JMSDF’s ongoing rotational deployment for counter-piracy and escort missions in the Gulf of Aden and waters off Somalia and began in 2009.

## **In Yokosuka, Japan**

香港立法会议员于2026年10月23日在立法会综合大楼与湾仔及屯门区议会议员会面，就社区发展及公众关心的议题交换意见。

议员及议员在与湾仔区议会会面时，讨论如何发挥湾仔区的商业及旅游优势，举办特别活动吸引旅客及创造商机。他们还探索完善无障碍设施、组织康乐活动等，支持老年人建设老年友好社区。升级现有开放空间和扩大滨水用地，提供更多具有新元素的休闲场所也被提上日程。
立法会议员表示，会就刺激湾仔经济、加强安老服务、营造友善居住环境、进一步发展海滨等事宜与区议会及政府部门保持紧密联系，同时积极反映公众意见。会议由李浩然召集，陈星丽、孙明升等32名议员出席。

在与屯门区议会举行的另一次会议上，讨论重点是优化交通基建，以及引进科技以减少意外造成的交通挤塞及疏导车辆。议员们还研究了龙鼓滩填海和将屯门西重建为“智慧绿色工业港”的影响。会议还讨论了增加社区设施，特别是体育场馆和卫生服务。

立法会议员表示会跟进屯门的交通规划、龙鼓滩填海及屯门西发展的进展，以及增设社区及体育设施。他们将继续通过相关委员会反映公众意见。会议由周浩顿召集，出席议员包括陈鸿健、何君尧等33人。

Hong Kong
Hong Kong lawmakers met Wan Chai and Tuen Mun district councillors on 23 October 2026 to discuss community development. Topics included boosting local economies, improving accessibility for the elderly, and planning the 'Smart Green Industry Port' in Tuen Mun West.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

23 Oct 2026 at 18:25 HKT · 2 min read

Hong Kong lawmakers met with councillors from Wan Chai and Tuen Mun district councils at the Legislative Council Complex on 23 October 2026 to exchange views on community development and issues of public concern.

In the meeting with Wan Chai District Council, lawmakers and councillors discussed leveraging the district’s commercial and tourism advantages by organising special events to attract visitors and create business opportunities. They also explored improving barrier-free facilities and organising recreational activities to support the elderly in building an age-friendly community. Upgrading existing open spaces and expanding waterfront land to provide more leisure venues with new elements were also on the agenda.

Lawmakers said they would maintain close contact with the district council and government authorities on stimulating Wan Chai’s economy, strengthening elderly services, creating a friendly living environment, and further developing the waterfront, while actively reflecting public views. The meeting was convened by Li Haoran, with 32 lawmakers in attendance, including Starry Chan, Michael Sun, and others.

In the separate meeting with Tuen Mun District Council, discussions focused on optimising transport infrastructure and introducing technology to reduce traffic congestion caused by accidents and to divert vehicles. Councillors also examined the implications of land reclamation at Lung Kwu Tan and the redevelopment of Tuen Mun West into a “Smart Green Industry Port”. Increasing community facilities, particularly sports venues and health services, was also discussed.

Lawmakers said they would follow up on Tuen Mun’s transport planning, progress on the Lung Kwu Tan reclamation and Tuen Mun West development, and the addition of community and sports facilities. They would continue to reflect public opinion through relevant committees. The meeting was convened by Holden Chow, with 33 lawmakers attending, including Chan Hung-kin, Junius Ho, and others.

title: Theodore Roosevelt Carrier Strike Group Sails in the Philippine Sea for Keen Sword Drills - USNI News
zh_title: 西奥多·罗斯福号航母战斗群在菲律宾海航行进行锐剑演习 - 美国海军学院新闻
summary: 2026 年 10 月 21 日，美国海军、日本海上自卫队、澳大利亚皇家海军、加拿大皇家海军和法国海军舰艇在菲律宾海举行的“锐剑 27”(KS27) 演习中齐头并进。美国海军照片 西奥多·罗斯福号航母战斗群以及日本、澳大利亚、加拿大和法国军舰齐聚菲律宾海，参加“利剑 27”演习。周三，西奥多·罗斯福号航母打击群与日本海上自卫队、澳大利亚皇家海军、加拿大皇家海军和法国海军的舰艇一起在菲律宾海航行。
content:
2026 年 10 月 21 日，美国海军、日本海上自卫队、澳大利亚皇家海军、加拿大皇家海军和法国海军舰艇在菲律宾海举行的“锐剑 27”(KS27) 演习中齐头并进。美国海军照片

西奥多·罗斯福号航母打击群以及日本、澳大利亚、加拿大和法国军舰齐聚菲律宾海，参加“利剑27”演习。

据五角大楼发布的图像显示，西奥多·罗斯福号航母打击群周三在菲律宾海与日本海上自卫队、澳大利亚皇家海军、加拿大皇家海军和法国海军的舰艇并肩航行。图像显示旗舰西奥多·罗斯福号 (CVN-71) 和美国海军_朝鲜号 (CG-65) 与日本海上自卫队直升机驱逐舰 JS _Ise_ (DDH-182)、驱逐舰 JS _Kongo_ (DDG-173) 和驱逐舰 JS _Asahi_ (DD-119)、RAN 护卫舰 HMAS _Stuart_ 一起航行(FFH153)、RCN 护卫舰 HMCS _Regina_ (FFH334) 和一艘法国护卫舰。

西奥多·罗斯福 CSG 包括搭载第 11 舰载机联队 (CVW) 的西奥多·罗斯福号航空母舰、巡洋舰_Chosin_ 和驱逐舰 USS_Decatur_ (DDG-73)。该打击群于周五驶入横须贺司令舰队活动司令部（CFAY）进行港口访问，并于周一出发。

为期 10 天的演习从周一开始，一直持续到 10 月 29 日。
2026 年 10 月 21 日，美国海军、日本海上自卫队、澳大利亚皇家海军、加拿大皇家海军和法国海军舰艇在菲律宾海举行的“锐剑 27”演习 (KS27) 中列队。美国海军照片

据美国海军新闻稿称，约有 45,000 名日本自卫队人员与 11,000 名美军以及其他伙伴国和盟国部队一起参加“利剑”活动。此次演习将有 260 架飞机和 40 艘舰艇参加，其中包括西奥多·罗斯福 CSG 号。来自澳大利亚、加拿大、法国、新西兰和菲律宾的人员参加了此次演习，韩国和英国也派出了观察员。

据美国海军新闻稿称，周二，美国海军上尉、第 9 信息战中队 (IWRON) 指挥官爱德华·麦克莱伦在西奥多·罗斯福号上会见了日本海上自卫队和澳大利亚皇家海军人员。 IWRON 是美国海军的一个新单位，旨在整合信息战能力。其主要目的是通过将信息战职能统一到一个负责的指挥官身上，为航母打击群指挥官提供决策优势。

麦克莱伦与同行讨论了这种新的信息战方法，作为协调美国及其盟国在信息领域作战方式的更广泛努力的一部分。日本海上自卫队的水手也登上航母观察飞行甲板的运作情况。
海军陆战队第12濒海联队和日本陆上自卫队西军正在日本西南诸岛同步开展远征先进基地作战。日本航空自卫队的C-2和C-130飞机正在将美国海上防空综合系统（MADIS）移动近程防空和反无人机系统、海军陆战队远征舰艇拦截系统（NMESIS）导弹系统和TPS-80地面/空中任务定向雷达（GATOR）运送到先岛参加演习。

10 月 21 日，日本海上自卫队 (JMSDF) 的水手在第 27 次“锐剑”演习 (KS27) 期间在尼米兹级航空母舰西奥多·罗斯福号 (CVN-71) 的飞行甲板上观看飞行操作

【原文 English Original】
U.S. Navy, Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force, Royal Australian Navy, Royal Canadian Navy, and French Navy ships steam together during Exercise Keen Sword 27 (KS27), Oct. 21, 2026, in the Philippine Sea. US Navy photo

The Theodore Roosevelt Carrier Strike Group, as well as Japanese, Australian, Canadian and French warships, have gathered in the Philippine Sea to participate in exercise Keen Sword 27.

The Theodore Roosevelt CSG steamed alongside ships from the Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force Royal Australian Navy, Royal Canadian Navy and French Navy on Wednesday in the Philippine Sea, according to a Pentagon imagery release. The imagery shows flagship USS _Theodore Roosevelt_ (CVN-71) and USS _Chosin_ (CG-65) sailing with JMSDF helicopter destroyer JS _Ise_ (DDH-182) and destroyers JS _Kongo_ (DDG-173) and destroyer JS _Asahi_ (DD-119), RAN frigate HMAS _Stuart_ (FFH153), RCN frigate HMCS _Regina_ (FFH334) and a French frigate.

The Theodore Roosevelt CSG includes aircraft carrier Theodore Roosevelt with embarked Carrier Air Wing (CVW) 11, cruiser _Chosin_, and destroyer USS _Decatur_ (DDG-73). The strike group pulled into Commander Fleet Activities Yokosuka (CFAY) on Friday for a port visit, departing on Monday.

The 10-day exercise began Monday and runs through Oct. 29.

U.S. Navy, Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force, Royal Australian Navy, Royal Canadian Navy, and French Navy ships steam in formation during Exercise Keen Sword 27 (KS27), Oct. 21, 2026, in the Philippine Sea. US Navy photo

Approximately 45,000 Japan Self-Defense Force personnel are taking part in Keen Sword alongside 11,000 U.S. troops and forces from other partner and allied nation forces, according to a U.S. Navy news release. The exercise will include 260 aircraft and 40 ships, including the Theodore Roosevelt CSG. Personnel from Australia, Canada, France, New Zealand and the Philippines are participating in the exercise, with observers from the Republic of Korea and the United Kingdom.

On Tuesday, U.S. Navy Capt. Edward McLellan, commander of Information Warfare Squadron (IWRON) 9, met JMSDF and RAN personnel aboard _Theodore Roosevelt_, according to the U.S. Navy news release. IWRON is a new U.S. Navy unit designed to integrate information warfare capabilities. Its primary purpose is to provide a decision-making advantage to carrier strike group commanders by unifying information warfare functions into a single, accountable commander.

McLellan discussed this new approach to information warfare with his counterparts as part of the broader effort to align how the U.S. and its allies fight in the information domain. JMSDF sailors are also embarked on the carrier to observe flight deck operations.

The 12th Marine Littoral Regiment and the Japan Ground Self-Defense Force Western Army are carrying out synchronized expeditionary advanced base operations across Japan’s southwest islands. The Japan Air Self-Defense Force’s C-2 and C-130 aircraft are transporting U.S. Marine Air Defense Integrated System (MADIS) mobile short-range air defense and anti-drone system, the Navy-Marine Expeditionary Ship Interdiction System (NMESIS) missile system and the TPS-80 Ground/Air Task Oriented Radars (GATOR) to the Sakishima Islands to participate in the exercise.

Sailors from the Japanese Maritime Self Defense Force (JMSDF) watch flight operations on the flight deck of the Nimitz-class aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN-71) during Exercise Keen Sword 27 (KS27), Oct. 21, 2026. US Navy photo

“By utilizing Japanese strategic transport to position mobile U.S. rocket systems, missile launchers, and air-defense radars at key maritime chokepoints, this evolution validated our combined ability to rapidly project a lethal, integrated stand-in force to defend the region and secure remote islands,” reads the release.

U.S. troops from Marine Wing Support Squadron 172 and the U.S. Air Force 18th Wing, and members from the JGSDF worked together to perform rapid airfield damage repair at Kadena Air Base on Okinawa on Tuesday. Leveraging both manual and machine tactics from the two nations, U.S. and Japanese partners are training to expedite processes that would individually take much longer. By sharing and integrating tactics, equipment, manpower and materials, the combined forces are working to develop new ways to approach the critical mission of airfield damage repair under contested conditions, reads the release.

U.S. Air Force F-22 Raptors fighters assigned to the 525th Expeditionary Fighter Squadron deployed to JASDF Tsuiki Air Base, Japan, as part of Keen Sword to conduct joint fighter training. Other U.S. aircraft arriving in Japan for Keen Sword 27 include KC-135 Stratotankers and a C-130J Super Hercules.

Air combat training is also being conducted in a hybrid format that combines both virtual and live elements for a defensive counter-air demonstration that links U.S. virtual F-35 Lightning II fighter simulators with live Japanese F-35 fighters and E-2 airborne early-warning aircraft. Enabled by the Pacific Multi-Domain Training and Experimentation Capability, the event allowed allied forces to form a shared tactical scenario while operating across separate live and simulated environments.

A U.S. Air Force C-130J Super Hercules aircraft assigned to the 36th Airlift Squadron lands at Tsuiki Air Base, Japan in support of Exercise Keen Sword 27 (KS27), Oct. 19, 2026. US Air Force photo

“The deployment of these cutting-edge warfighting technologies as part of Keen Sword 27 is part of the larger objective of familiarizing U.S. and Japanese allies with each others’ equipment, tactics and procedures to enhance U.S.-Japanese interoperability, information sharing and defensive coordination across domains under realistic training conditions,” reads the release.

Meanwhile, Chinese drones were operating in Japan’s southwest region on Monday, where part of the Keen Sword drills are taking place, Japan Defense Minister Shinjiro Koizumi said Tuesday [during a regular press release](https://www.mod.go.jp/j/press/kisha/2026/1020a.html). One Chinese BZK-005 military reconnaissance Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) and a Y-9 Electronic Intelligence (ELINT) aircraft flew in from the East China Sea and passed between Okinawa and Miyako Island to enter the Philippine Sea. Later, the drone and aircraft passed between Okinawa and Miyako Island.

Additionally on Monday, a Chinese TB-001 military reconnaissance/attack UAV flew in from the East China Sea and passed between Yonaguni Island and Taiwan to enter the Philippine Sea. The drone flew as far as the waters off the island of Amami Oshima, and then passed between Okinawa and Miyako Island to enter the East China Sea.

A Chinese TB-001 military reconnaissance/attack UAV on Oct. 19, 2026. Japan Joint Staff Office photo

Drone activity around Japan has intensified in recent years with 23 Chinese military drone incidents in Japan’s Fiscal Year 2024, approximately three times the eight incidents reported in Fiscal Year 2023, Koizumi said. A total of 16 incidents were reported in FY2025.

“This recent drone incident clearly demonstrates the need to adapt to new methods of warfare and to address the threat posed by drones. We intend to carefully explain these changes in the security environment to the public and seek their understanding,” said Koizumi.

When asked whether the Chinese Y-9 and UAVs were conducting surveillance on the Keen Sword drills, Koizumi said that in dealing with parties whose intentions are uncertain to assess, assumptions should not be made.

“We must approach such situations with caution – questioning even our own initial impressions and conduct a calm, objective analysis and assessment. For now, we have made the facts public, specifically, that these incidents, including the flight of unmanned aerial vehicles, have occurred,” Koizumi said.

He said the information was disclosed to foster public understanding of the current situation as it underscores the necessity of developing Japan’s defense capabilities.

# Putin and Chinese Premier Li Qiang reaffirm strategic ties ahead of APEC summit

3 hours ago

Photo: Xinhua

Russian President Vladimir Putin met with Chinese Premier Li Qiang on Wednesday, highlighting that relations between Moscow and Beijing continue to develop successfully and dynamically amid an evolving global landscape. The high-level talks also come as the Kremlin floats the prospect of a potential three-way meeting involving Putin, US President Donald Trump, and Chinese President Xi Jinping during the upcoming APEC summit in China.

Premier Li stated during the meeting that close strategic coordination between China and Russia represents an invaluable stabilizing force in an increasingly turbulent international environment. He noted that Beijing is ready to enhance strategic communication, deepen mutual political trust, and expand comprehensive, mutually beneficial cooperation to foster greater well-being for both populations.

Addressing international governance, Li warned that unilateralism and hegemonism remain prevalent worldwide, urging both countries to strengthen coordination on major global issues. He emphasized the need for close collaboration within multilateral frameworks such as the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation and BRICS, aiming to rally broader support across the Global South to safeguard shared interests and uphold international fairness and justice.

According to a Chinese readout of the discussion, Putin affirmed that China-Russia relations are founded on mutual respect, equality, and reciprocity, remaining resilient against third-party interference and global fluctuations. Describing China as Russia's closest and most dependable partner, Putin expressed Moscow's intent to deepen practical cooperation in energy, agriculture, aerospace, civil nuclear power, information technology, artificial intelligence, and transportation. The Russian leader also pledged support for China’s hosting of this year’s APEC gathering and its upcoming chairmanship of the BRICS grouping next year.

title: China says COP31 should focus on tariffs against its clean tech
zh_title: 中国称COP31应重点讨论对其清洁技术征收关税
summary: 中国 中国敦促下个月在土耳其举行的COP31峰会解决其所谓的全球气候行动的新问题：对其清洁技术征收关税。李高副部长批评单边主义和保护主义，并表示北京将对袭击事件作出坚决回应。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 21 日香港时间 14:45 · 2 分钟阅读中国已致电下个月在土耳其举行的 COP31 峰会将重点讨论所谓的新问题
content:
中国
中国敦促下个月在土耳其举行的第三十一届联合国气候变化框架公约(COP31)峰会解决其所谓的全球气候行动的新问题：对其清洁技术征收关税。李高副部长批评单边主义和保护主义，并表示北京将对袭击事件作出坚决回应。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 21 日 14:45 香港时间 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

中国呼吁下个月在土耳其举行的 COP31 峰会重点讨论全球气候行动的一个新问题：针对其清洁技术的关税。

生态环境部副部长李高周三在新闻发布会上表示，将于下个月在安塔利亚举行的第31届缔约方大会（COP）应讨论发展中国家的气候融资等问题，以及单边主义和保护主义的“新问题”，这是对美国和欧盟贸易政策的常见间接批评。

他说：“我们认为，这次会议应深入讨论发达国家减排不足、资金支持不足的老问题，以及单边主义和保护主义破坏全球集体努力的新问题。”
中国是迄今为止世界上最大的减排所需太阳能电池板、风力涡轮机、电池和电动汽车生产国。然而，对于担心对其当地产业产生竞争影响的国家来说，这项技术越来越被视为威胁，而不是机遇。

美国对中国太阳能和电动汽车征收高额关税，欧盟对汽车也采取了同样的做法，对一些太阳能零部件实施了限制，并正在调查中国一家大型风电公司的不公平贸易行为。

李说，在地缘政治冲突“加剧”的背景下，会议应讨论绿色技术的自由流动，并补充说，中国将对针对绿色技术的抹黑或攻击给予“坚决回应”。

李说，会议的其他优先事项应包括在 2024 年承诺每年为发展中国家提供 3000 亿美元气候融资的路线图。当被问及中国是否支持土耳其推动全球电气化协议时，李表示，这一目标符合中国政策，但没有明确支持这一推动。 “我们建议主席继续充分听取各方意见，寻求最大公约数，争取最广泛支持，”他说。

China
China urges next month's COP31 summit in Turkey to address what it calls a new problem for global climate action: tariffs on its clean technology. Vice minister Li Gao criticised unilateralism and protectionism, and said Beijing would give a firm response to attacks.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

21 Oct 2026 at 14:45 HKT · 2 min read

China has called on the COP31 summit in Turkey next month to focus on what it described as a new problem for global climate action: tariffs against its clean technology.

The 31st Conference of the Parties (COP) meeting, which begins in Antalya next month, should address issues such as climate finance for the developing world as well as the “new problem” of unilateralism and protectionism, a common indirect criticism of US and EU trade policy, Li Gao, vice minister of the Ministry of Ecology and Environment, told a press conference on Wednesday.

“We believe the conference should discuss in depth the old problems of developed countries’ insufficient emission reductions and insufficient financial support, as well as the new problem of unilateralism and protectionism undermining global collective efforts,” he said.

China is by far the world’s largest producer of solar panels, wind turbines, batteries and electric cars needed to cut emissions. However, that technology is increasingly seen as a threat, rather than an opportunity, for countries concerned about the competitive impact on their local industries.

The United States has imposed steep tariffs on Chinese solar and electric cars, while the European Union has done the same for autos, imposed restrictions on some solar components and is investigating a major Chinese wind company for unfair trade.

Against a backdrop of “intensifying” geopolitical conflicts, the conference should discuss the free flow of green technology, said Li, who added that China would give a “firm response” to smears or attacks against it.

Other priorities for the conference should include a roadmap for a pledge made in 2024 to marshal US$300 billion of climate finance a year for the developing world, Li said. Asked whether China supported Turkey’s push for a global agreement on electrification, Li said the objective was in line with Chinese policy but stopped short of explicitly supporting the push. “We suggest the presidency continue to listen fully to views from all sides, seek the greatest common denominator, and work to win the broadest possible support,” he said.

# Taiwan semiconductor electricity use hits record high in Sept.

10/21/2026 03:15 PM

[](jsvscript:)[](jsvscript:)[](javascript:void(0))[Listen](javascript:)

[Link](javascript:)[Whatsapp](javascript:)[Reddit](javascript:)[Line](javascript:)[Email](javascript:)

To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.

Taipei, Oct. 21 (CNA) Electricity consumption by Taiwan's semiconductor industry topped 4.5 billion kilowatt-hours (kWh) for the first time in September, a record high driven by stronger-than-expected demand for artificial intelligence (AI), the Taiwan Research Institute (TRI) said Wednesday.

As AI technologies develop rapidly and demand for computing power grows, global demand for cutting-edge chips, advanced packaging and high-performance chips continues to rise, pushing up the industry's electricity consumption, the TRI said in a statement.

Nationwide, electricity consumption by high-voltage and extra-high-voltage industrial users rose 1.76 percent year on year in September, while consumption by manufacturers rose 1.96 percent, the TRI said.

Electricity consumption in the semiconductor industry rose 11.55 percent year on year in September, returning to double-digit growth. The economic monitoring indicator for the power industry remained at "red," signaling robust activity, for the 18th consecutive month, the institute said.

Strong production in the high-tech sector has gradually spurred investment demand in other industries, boosting exports, production and corporate investment and supporting rapid economic growth, the TRI said. It estimated Taiwan's economic growth in September at 12.6 percent.

The TRI estimated that the semiconductor industry's annual electricity consumption will exceed 50 billion kWh this year, as AI-related business opportunities expand from high-end chips to servers, equipment, materials and key components, benefiting investment and production across the supply chain.

The chemical materials and textile industries continued to show "blue" monitoring readings, signaling contraction, though for different reasons. The chemical materials industry remained under pressure from global petrochemical overcapacity and a slow recovery in demand, while the textile industry faced weak international end-market demand and price competition, which continued to weigh on orders and production.

(By Pan Tzu-yu and Sean Lin)

## 蔡康永称“没有支持过台独”后出席蒋万安造势活动 两岸舆论仍未息

图像来源，Lok Lee/ BBC Chinese

图像加注文字，蔡康永（右）出席蒋万安造势活动。

Published 2026年10月26日上午9点17分

阅读时间: 4 分钟

台湾主持人蔡康永因月初出席民进党台北市长候选人沈伯洋竞选总部成立大会，在华人舆论圈引发广泛关注，并遭到中国官方点名及部分合作品牌切割。

10月25日深夜，他在微博与小红书发表长文，强调自己“一直希望两岸友好来往，我没有支持过台独”。

这篇声明被视为兼具澄清与告别意味，但未能平息对岸舆论的不满。前《环球时报》总编辑胡锡进持续发文批评，台湾舆论则有人将此事与2016年周子瑜事件类比。

26日下午，身穿黑色西装、白色上衣的蔡康永如期出席蒋万安的竞总成立活动。

图像来源，Getty Images

图像加注文字，蒋万安（中）寻求台北市长连任。

## 蔡康永说了什么？

蔡康永的声明以“致关心此事的你”为题，条列三点。他在开头直接重申：“我一直希望两岸友好来往。我没有支持过台独。”

现年64岁的蔡康永回顾，自1998年主持访谈节目至今，累积访问近万名立场各异的来宾，但“我从来没有成为其中任何一位的信徒”。他强调，“拜访对方并不表示会认同对方”，并就“误会”对合作方及曾经喜欢他的人造成的困扰致歉。

声明末段，他提到来自上海的父母原本互不相识，直到搬迁台北才相遇。“如果不是时代动荡形成的缘分，世上根本不会有我这个人。”他写道，所有曾让他被看见、被听见的缘分，即使已告一段落，他永远感激，并祝愿一切安好。

图像来源，Getty Images

图像加注文字，沈伯洋（中）本月初举行竞选总部成立大会，总统赖清德（右）与前总统蔡英文到场站台。

## 蓝绿阵营如何回应

针对蔡康永贴文，蒋万安则于今日上午出席活动时[受访表示](https://tw.news.yahoo.com/%E8%94%A1%E5%BA%B7%E6%B0%B8%E5%86%8D%E7%99%BC%E6%96%87-%E6%BE%84%E6%B8%85%E7%AB%8B%E5%A0%B4%E7%9B%BC%E5%85%A9%E5%B2%B8%E5%8F%8B%E5%A5%BD-%E8%94%A3%E8%90%AC%E5%AE%89%E4%BB%8A%E6%97%A9%E5%9B%9E%E6%87%89%E4%BA%86-021500454.html)，欢迎蔡康永参加他的竞总成立活动。“其实不论蔡康永先生支持或不支持我，我都尊重他的言论还有政治立场”。

蒋万安进一步强调，他反对任何人因言论或政治立场不同，就动辄出征、抵制或杯葛他人。“我绝对不允许、绝不接受这样反民主的威胁。”他并呼吁对岸尊重台湾自由民主的生活方式，不要因政治倾向而有差别待遇。

沈伯洋同日上午接受台媒[联访时称](https://tw.news.yahoo.com/%E8%94%A1%E5%BA%B7%E6%B0%B8%E5%BE%AE%E5%8D%9A%E8%A1%A8%E6%85%8B-%E6%B2%92%E6%94%AF%E6%8C%81%E9%81%8E%E5%8F%B0%E7%8D%A8-%E6%B2%88%E4%BC%AF%E6%B4%8B%E7%97%9B%E5%BF%83-%E7%99%BC%E6%96%87%E6%99%82%E9%96%93%E5%83%8F-%E8%A2%AB%E6%B1%BA%E5%AE%9A-035911978.html)，蔡康永当天已把话说得十分明白，走访现场纯粹是为访问不同阵营的政治人物、深入探讨政见。

“这在民主社会的台湾本是再普通不过的日常，然而台湾人行使最平凡的自主权利，却换来中国以这种手段施压干预，令人深感痛心。”沈伯洋说。

来自学界、长期研究中国认知作战、近年遭中国公开“通缉”的沈伯洋特别指出，蔡康永的发文时间点“绝非自主决定，而是被决定的”。他认为，该贴文发出后随即登上微博热搜榜首，而微博热搜前三名本质上由中国官方掌控，“无论被迫或另有隐情，中国企图干涉台湾民众自主抉择的痕迹极为明显”。

蔡康永在微博有约3500万粉丝。

图像来源，Getty Images

图像加注文字，2024年台湾歌手安溥（张悬）经纪公司于中国国庆当天在微博上上载了一张手写的祝贺，在其歌迷之间引发激烈的分裂意见。

## 大陆网友：不领情

然而，这篇声明并未获得对岸舆论领情。在小红书上，大批网民涌入蔡康永的留言区，质疑他玩弄“双面手法”，要求他将声明同步发到Threads等台湾常用社交平台。

“把这篇‘不支持台独’搬到台湾大众最常用的平台再说”、“依旧不敢说一句‘我是中国人’”、“大玩说话的艺术：我爸妈是上海人，但我不是”，部分留言写道。也有人直接建议：“发一个中国国旗得了，根本不用举例子。”

中国国台办之前已表态，任何人都不能一边赚取大陆发展红利，一边与“台独”分裂势力勾连纠缠，做“两面人”。

《环球时报》前总编辑胡锡进26日凌晨发文指出，蔡康永并未就其行为道歉，只是对合作方及粉丝因“误会”产生的困扰表达歉意。他形容蔡康永“态度不软、身段挺软”，并未摆出对抗姿态，字里行间透露出他自感难以重回大陆主持或参加综艺节目，“这篇帖子有向粉丝告别的意味”。

胡锡进直言，这篇帖子若用来与合作方和粉丝“好合好散”则已足够，若想扭转舆论态度“那么差远了”。他还附上“蔡康永依旧没有说一句我是中国人”的标签。这篇贴文随后被删除。此前，胡锡进已多次批评蔡康永为“台独顽固分子”沈伯洋站台，是“主动招惹是非、犯了大忌”。

图像来源，Getty Images

图像加注文字，蔡康永离开主流电视圈后，多以出席书籍艺文活动和举办画展为主。右为日本作家吉本芭娜娜。

## 台湾舆论：周子瑜事件翻版？

在台湾，有网友将此事与2016年周子瑜事件类比，认为蔡康永是在商业压力下被迫低头。风波发酵之初，已有人预言：“要把康永当成周子瑜了吗？”

曾在杭州阿里巴巴工作多年的台湾财经网红胡采苹在脸书评论，这是“威逼厂商以迫使当事人‘下跪’的手法”。

不过，中央大学中文系助理教授胡川安有不同解读。他认为，这篇文字没有“一丝讨好或讨饶的委屈，反倒充满蔡康永一贯的冷静与体面”。在他看来，蔡康永很清楚风波的终局，“这根本不是一封求饶的‘道歉信’，而是一封向特定市场与群众温柔清算的‘道别信’”。

台湾也不乏批评蔡康永的声音。拥有百万订阅的网红“Cheap”（郑才暐）在脸书个[人专页](https://www.facebook.com/share/p/1KXEQdgFSy/)表示，蔡康永这次“三头不讨好”，一口气得罪了“小粉红、绿粉、蓝粉”。

他认为此事与周子瑜事件不同：“演艺圈靠话术和高情商确实能够吃得开，但在政治圈可没这么容易。康永哥是主动搞这出，真的很难把他当成‘无辜受害者’来同情。”

另一位知名网红陈沂则批评蔡康永“晚节不保”，称“中国网友只会觉得你想要风骨又没骨气，文人之耻莫过于此”。这则贴文累积近万人点赞。

[跳过 YouTube 帖子](https://bbc.com/zhongwen/articles/ckq6nve0my4ro/simp#end-of-youtube-content)

告知: BBC 不对外来网站内容负责 YouTube 内容可能含有广告

结尾 YouTube 帖子

## 夹缝中的台湾艺人

蔡康永风波并非孤立个案，而是台湾艺人在两岸穿梭之间，言行被放大检视、自愿表态或“被表态”的缩影。

新加坡《联合早报》刊出[评论称](https://www.zaobao.com/news/china/story20261010-9804802?ref=article-sidebar-more-read)，就在沈伯洋竞总成立前一天，台北警方搜查一家[同志夜店](https://bbc.com/zhongwen/articles/cmz98p0x525xo/trad)，因执法争议，蒋万安事后出面道歉。台湾政论圈有人猜测，早已公开同志身分的蔡康永因为同志人权，才“愤而”现身沈伯洋造势现场，暗示此事与统独无关。

但评论也指出，即使蔡康永接着出席蒋万安的活动，恐怕也难以安抚对岸舆情，因为两岸舆论已陷入“非此即彼”的僵局。

与此同时，台湾陆委会正在收紧对相关言论的容忍范围。2026年中国“十一”国庆前后，陆委会副主委梁文杰表示，掌握约19名艺人发文祝贺中国国庆，多为转发央视模板，并重申两条红线：不能宣扬对台动武、不能宣扬消灭中华民国主权，踩线即查处。

台湾艺人吴奇隆近日高调在微博手持五星红旗庆祝中国国庆，其后原定出席的台湾棒球赛[开球活动因球迷抗议取消](https://udn.com/news/story/7332/9800428)，主办单位称吴奇隆因身体因素无法出席。

根据台湾《两岸人民关系条例》第33条之1，未经许可不得与中共党政军合作。

随着年底地方选举逼近，两岸政治敏感度升高，台湾艺人与公众人物无论主动表态或被动切割，这类风波的循环与升级可能成为常态，持续考验当事人、代言品牌与台湾社会对相关言论的承受力。

# 美国拟延长中国关联船舶港口费豁免至明年1月

美国贸易代表署（USTR）提议，将针对中国关联船舶及部分中国制港口装卸设备的费用措施暂停期延长两个月，至2027年1月9日，为美中继续协商海事、物流及造船业贸易争端争取时间。若提案获批，相关港口费及部分设备额外关税将继续暂停，避免航运公司及出口商短期内承担额外成本。

发表时间： 26/10/2026 - 21:16

 9 分钟 浏览时间

 中美 網絡照片

 作者： [华盛顿特约记者 陈米亚](https://rfi.fr/cn/%E4%BD%9C%E8%80%85/%E9%99%88%E7%B1%B3%E4%BA%9A/ "华盛顿特约记者 陈米亚")

广告

继续浏览后续

美国贸易代表署10月26日在《联邦公报》公布提案，并邀请业界及公众提交书面意见。现行暂停措施将于11月9日到期，若延长获批，新期限将由11月10日起至2027年1月9日。这项提议尚未正式生效，当局将考虑各方意见后作出决定。

美国贸易代表署在公告中表示：“美国正继续与中国接触，目标是促使中方消除调查中涉及的行为、政策及做法。因此，贸易代表提议将本次调查所采取的应对措施再暂停两个月，至2027年1月9日。”

相关措施源自美国根据《1974年贸易法》第301条展开的调查。美方指控中国在海事、物流及造船业的产业政策和补贴措施影响市场竞争，损害美国商业利益，因此提出对中国企业拥有或营运的船舶、中国建造船舶，以及部分外国建造的汽车运输船征收港口费，并对部分中国制港口装卸设备加征关税。

依照美方修订后的收费安排，中国企业拥有或营运的船舶原定每次航程按每净吨50美元计费；中国建造船舶则按每净吨18美元，或每个卸下的货柜120美元计费，实际适用方式依相关规定而定。净吨是衡量船舶容量的计量单位。相关安排已较美方最初提出、最高每次进港收取150万美元的方案宽松。

美国于2025年10月14日开始征收相关港口费，但美国总统特朗普（Donald Trump）与中国国家主席习近平同年11月达成贸易安排后，美方自11月10日起暂停执行措施一年。中国也暂停针对美国关联船舶的报复性港口费。

特朗普与习近平今年9月曾会晤，两人预计11月再次会面。此次延长暂停期的提议，将为双方继续磋商中国在全球造船业的地位，以及美国如何振兴本土造船业提供更多时间。

航运公司及出口商普遍关注相关费用可能带来的成本压力。美国煤炭出口业尤其担心，额外港口费可能推高运输成本、减少可用船舶，削弱美国煤炭在国际市场的竞争力。美国国家煤炭委员会在2026年7月发布的报告中，建议特朗普政府永久暂停相关港口费。

美国航运公司马特森（Matson）表示，在相关费用短暂实施期间，公司曾承担640万美元的中国港口反制费。中国国有航运企业中远海运（COSCO）则据估计，若美国港口费持续实施，每年可能面临约15亿美元的相关费用。

不过，美国部分国会议员及海事劳工团体主张恢复征费，认为相关措施有助振兴美国商业造船业。民主党参议员马克·凯利（Mark Kelly）及伊丽莎白·沃伦（Elizabeth Warren）今年6月致函美国贸易代表格里尔（Jamieson Greer），要求政府恢复措施，并指出中国船厂占全球商业船舶产量一半以上，美国所占比例则约为0.1%。

除针对中国船舶的措施外，特朗普政府今年提出的海事行动计划也涉及对外国建造商业船舶征费，并将收入用于支持美国造船业。国际航运公会（ICS）警告，广泛征费可能增加运输成本、干扰全球贸易，令美国进口商、出口商及消费者承受额外负担。

美国贸易代表署表示，将在10月30日的意见提交期限过后，审阅各方回应，再决定是否延长暂停措施。即使提案获批，也不代表美方永久撤销港口费及相关关税，未来是否恢复执行，仍取决于美中谈判进展及美国后续贸易政策。中国是否同步延长对美国关联船舶的反制费暂停安排，目前也尚未确定。
