content: 刘军宁   X @liujunning · Oct 21, 2026 自由·平等·博爱：这个观念坏在哪里？ “自由平等博爱”的由来 法兰西启蒙与法国大革命降生了一句著名的口号，叫做“自由平等博爱”。从此这个口号及其信条及其价值观声名大响、经久不衰，回荡至今。在每个中国有文化的人心中也非常受欢迎。 “自由平等博爱”已经变成了法兰西共和国的国家格言。首次把这三个词放在一起使用的是著名的政治人物－罗伯斯庇尔，他是法国大革命的最著名的政治领袖－雅各宾派的首领。他在1790年的一次正式的演讲中提出了“自由平等博爱”这个口号。第二次世界大战之后，“自由平等博爱”被写进了1946年的法国宪法和1958年的法国宪法。现在这个口号成了法国的国家格言，法国的三色国旗也是这个口号的象征。 在中国没有几个政治口号像“自由平等博爱”得到了那么广泛的认同，那么政治正确，那么有道德与情操的感染力。在中国的官方教科书中，“自由平等博爱”被认定为是一个进步的口号，离革命的口号只差一步。这个口号在英美一些进步左倾的知识分子中也很有影响力，但却被英美文明与英美保守主义所拒绝。 这次读书会所读的是斯蒂芬先生的《自由·平等·博爱》一书。斯蒂芬从站在维护自古以来的英国自由制度出发，指出“自由平等博爱”是一种非常错误的价值，即便这个口号在一些英国人中也很有感召力。要是没有斯蒂芬的这本书，在中国从保守主义的角度批评“自由平等博爱”将是非常非常困难的。这样的批评肯定会被视为极端的政治不正确，甚至会被认为是反动的，因为这个口号是进步的。所以，在中国的普遍共识中，“自由平等博爱”还是一个政治正确的口号。 对于密尔先生主张的“自由平等博爱”，斯蒂芬先生在书中做了深度的梳理与批判，王建勋老师已经开始辅导大家阅读这本书。为了深化大家对“自由平等博爱”的理解，我今天将结合该书谈谈保守主义对自由的看法，谈谈保守主义与法兰西启蒙各自的自由观。因为自由是一个充满歧义的范畴，自由的字样已经写在一切的相互对立的意识形态的旗帜上，若不对自由的含义做明确的界定，仅仅说说自由的好话是没有多少实质意义的。 自由的源头 我想先从自由的源头说起。人的自由是从哪里来的？保守主义认为答案只有一个，我们的自由来自作为造物主的耶和华，自由是他赠给人类的礼物。个人不能赋予自己以自由，国家不能赋予国民以自由，君主不能赋予臣民以自由，自然也不能赋予人类以自由，科学更不能给人类制造出自由。人的自由权不是统治者所给予的，也不是统治者有权界定的，只有造物主主才有资格、有能力、有善意赋予人类的自由。 美国宪政的基础 我上面这个说法的依据是美国宪法。美国宪法与宪政就是建立在“造物主赋予人类以自由”这个基础之上的。美国的《独立宣言》是这么说的，“我们认为这些真理是不证自明的：每个人都平等受造，造物主赋予他们若干不可剥夺的权利，其中包括生命权、自由权和追求幸福的权利。”这里讲的很清楚，为什么要制定美国宪法？美国为什么要独立？美国人凭什么要自由？因为造物主赋予的他们自由权。我们再看看美国宪法是怎么写的。其序言中写道，“我们合众国人民为建立更完善的联盟，树立正义，保障国内安宁提供共同防护，促进公共福祉，并保障祂（造物主）赐福给我们以及我们后代的自由，特此为美利坚合众国订立本宪法。”换句话说，如果自由不是造物主赋予的，我们的独立就是没有理由的，制定美国宪法是没有必要的。所以，这两个引证讲得很清楚：美国宪法完全是建立在造物主赋予每个人自由这样的一个基础之上的。 我们再看看杰斐逊是怎么说的。他说的甚至更加明确：“赋予我们生命的造物主也把自由赐给了我们。在人们的心田中，自由是来自造物主的礼物。这个信念是国民自由权的唯一坚实的基础。如果我们移去了这个基础，我们还能认为国民们的自由权仍将稳固持久吗？”如果自由不是来自造物主，那么国民的自由权是不会稳固持久的。后来美国的政治实践表明，美国的自由权迄今为止还是稳固持久的，这也恰恰证成了他们当初争取独立和制定宪法时的看法－那就是人的自由权来自造物主。所以，当造物主把选择的自由作为礼物送给亚当夏娃的时候，他们的全部后代都享有这个礼物。正如我们今天所看到的，就像原罪是不可撤回的一样，造物永远也不会撤回祂赋予人类的自由。这是祂赐给人类的礼物。自由是造物主许诺给人的，对自由的追求也被造物主植入到每个人的心中。所以我们今天所看到的，不论是不是认耶和华为主的国家，都能看到每个人对自由的追求。他们也许时而放弃，也许时而妥协，但是，对自由追求是永远存在的。这也就是说，不探讨自由的神圣源头，就不能理解自由的真谛，也不可能真正获得并享有自由。 历史的验证 当一国之民忘掉造物主的时候，暴君就锻造好了奴役民众的锁链。不信看看那些无神论、唯物论国度的自由状况，就知道自由有其神圣源头。在中国的历史上自由定期归零，是因为中国人不认识造物主，不相信耶和华，不相信自由是来自祂的礼物，因而也毫不珍惜，结果是各种自由频频得而复失。 这个论断也同样适用于耶和华的选民以色列。犹太人的命运在历史上跌宕起伏的缘故也在于此。当以色列人信仰耶和华、恪守十诫时，当他们珍惜雅威的礼物时，他们就得到雅威的赐福，享受自由、安宁与繁荣。当以色列人不再信造物主，崇拜他神，悖逆十诫时，他们就失去自由、遭受奴役，甚至遭受耶和华重重的惩罚。可见，对耶和华的态度决定了对耶和华礼物的态度，也就决定了犹太人的命运－幸福、自由，还是奴役、苦难？这两个主题在以色列历史上不断地交替出现。 所以，保守主义所主张的是有序的自由及神定秩序之下的自由。因为造物主按照自己的形象创造了人，并赋予人以自由的厚礼，就是要让人去自由地思想，自由地言说，自由地创造，自由地实现自我。当耶和华授权人类去统领大地以及上面的万物时，其中也包含让人类去享有自由，也包含着人类应该为享有这样的自由而承担责任。所以自由不是放纵。 自由与律法 被人们所忽视的是，终极的自由宪章是耶和华所写的十诫。这个十诫后来成为祂与祂的选民之间的圣约。表面上看，十诫是对个人的要求，其实十诫上也是对国家的要求。当一个国家不盗窃民众的财产、不侵犯民众的自由、不谋杀民众的生命，并制止任何盗窃财产、侵犯自由和谋杀生命的这些行为的时候，个人的生命权、自由权、财产权就得到了充分的保障。所以，我们看到自由是以上帝所制定的律法为前提的，是受到雅威的律法所约束的。所以，柏克才说，自由必须被约束，才能被拥有，否则，自由就是放纵。 所以，自由是有序的，是秩序之下的自由。有序的自由服从于雅威的律法和人的法律，服从于传统与道德。在信仰和道德、法律传统之外谈论自由毫无意义。对人类而言，只有在信仰与道德、法律与传统的体系之内，才有做出自由选择的可能。因此，自由的性质与价值存在于规范自由的限制之中，没有限制，如柏克所言，就没有自由。因而，保守主义只支持合乎道德的传统的法律的自由。 保守主义要保守的是有序的自由，是习俗与传统中的自由。这种自由是在历史与现实中的具体的自由，不是文人脑袋中抽象出来的自由。保守主义主张给每个人以同等的最大限度的自由，即在法律与传统之下的有序的自由。在政治上，在商业上，在个人生活上，放纵的、不受节制的自由，必然要损害到每个人的自由。在许多保守主义者看来，自由的价值不仅仅在于它有种种的效用，以及达到其他目的的价值，自由本身就是终极价值，是人类的天赋本性的必然要求。 自由作为选择 自由在根本上是个选择，是一个在不同的可能性之间的一个抉择。当自由被当作礼物给人类的时候，耶和华冒了很大很大的风险，因为祂知道人一定会滥用自由。但是，祂却依然让人类享有这份礼物。人们在自由选择中学会分辨善恶，并体验到自由选择的不同后果。耶和华也借此考验人类的领悟自由的能力、自由选择的能力，运用自由的能力以及承担后果的能力。所以，自由事关选择。没有选择就没有自由，有选择才有自由。自由是做出选择、承担责任与接受后果的机会，自由与责任是联系在一起的。 法兰西启蒙对自由的理解 上面我们谈的是保守主义对自由的看法，下面我们再谈一谈“自由平等博爱”背后的法兰西启蒙对自由是怎么理解的。法兰西启蒙所主张的自由是无限的自由，摆脱一切约束的自由。法兰西启蒙认为自由不是造物主的礼物，而是人的产物，是人的大脑自身的产物，特别是由一些政治家和思想家思考出来的。他们认为人本身而不是造物主，是自由的源头，如让·雅各·卢梭所言，“人生而自由，却无往不在枷锁中。” 卢梭认为自由是无限的，是从一开始就拥有的，但是，实现自由需要突破枷锁。卢梭所谓的枷锁特别是指教会的权威，也是实现自由所要反抗的对象；其他的枷锁还包括习俗、传统和道德，都被认为是个性解放与个人自由的敌人。这种自由观也被中国的新青年一代以及后来的追随新青年的人－五四运动乃至文革所继承。在这些运动中，我们都看到了打碎一切传统与枷锁的诉求和行动。 法兰西启蒙不是基于雅威的律法与传统来确定自由的范围，而是依据所谓的“伤害原则”。雅各宾党人主导的1789年《人权与公民权宣言》规定，“自由即所有人皆拥有的，做一切不伤害其他人的自主权。除了保障社会上其他人享受同样权利外，此自然权利不应有任何限制。”所谓的“伤害原则”指的是，凡是不伤害他人的行为都应该在自由的范围之内，而不应该受到任何限制。所以，“自由平等博爱”中的自由意味着每个人有权各行其是，只要不给他人造成伤害就行。自由指向的是个性解放，即按照自己意志进行活动的权利。这一点也体现在密尔的观点中。在密尔那里，这个说法叫“自行其乐无妨，伤害他人莫为（Do as you please, but harm none）。这句话在斯蒂芬的《自由·平等·博爱》一书中可以见到。 自由观背后的人性论 关于自由，保守主义和法兰西启蒙的另外一个重大差异是人性论。因为，每一种政治思想主张、每一种对自由的看法，都基于各自对人性的看法。对人性的看法，决定了对自由的看法。保守主义的人性论基于人的原罪，对人性持悲观的看法。所以，一定要给人的自由设定一个框架，以免自由变成放纵，这就是像水需要容器一样。保守主义认为人性是不完善的，所以，一方面要给人自由，另外一方面要把人的自由放到特定的框架之内，而不能没有框架。 法兰西启蒙持乐观主义的人性论。他们认为人性是向善的，是可完善的，甚至能够达到至善的。既然人性本善，就没有必要对人类设防，就不要严格的约束，只要有可能就给人以无限的自由。这种观点在卢梭的《论人类不平等的起源》中，以及中国人所熟悉的诗句－“六亿神州尽舜尧”这样的语言中，让大家都能感受到：通过政治学习与政治教育，人是可以成为舜尧的，是可以变得极其完美的。 所以，小结一下：保守主义主张有序的自由，法兰西启蒙和“自由平等博爱”的价值观，主张无限的不受约束的自由。 自由的条件 人们在讨论自由的时候，常常忽略一个重要的维度，这就是自由的条件。具体的说，是实现自由需要什么样的条件？或者说如何人才配得自由？ 如果想享受自由，这对人的秉性是有要求的。在法国的革命者们捣毁了巴士底监狱之后，1789年英国的保守主义先驱柏克给友人写了一封信。他在信中写道，“这种革命精神根本不值得称道。如果这种革命精神不是一个偶发事件，而是一个品格的话，那么法国人是不配得自由的。”法国革命者用事实证明，他们的确不配得自由。后来发生的事情充分证明了柏克与保守主义对自由的洞见。在法兰西启蒙思想结出的第一个果实，就是腥风血雨的法国大革命，接在断头台下高高的尸堆上雄起了独裁者拿破仑。他的军国主义把整个欧洲都拖入了战争。此后的法国也一直在共和与帝制的漩涡中挣扎，在一系列的大小战争中连尝败绩，两次被德国占领，靠被英美解救才成为战胜国，直到1958年通过第五共和，法兰西才走上相对稳定的正轨。 前面提到罗伯斯庇尔是“自由平等博爱”口号的极力倡导者，但他竖起的却是断头台，留下的是无头尸，也包括他自己。诗人赫尔德林曾经说过，通向地狱的路是鲜花铺就的。如果法国大革命带来的是腥风血雨的恐怖统治（Reign of Terror）的话，那么，“自由平等博爱”就是通向这种恐怖统治之路上的鲜花，而且是非常美丽的鲜花。 如果要想配得自由，那些追求的自由的人们就必须把美德、勇气、正确的判断在审慎和良知结合起来。这样的自由要求每个人对其自由意志，以自由的行动承担后果。所以，有序的自由是反思性的自由，而不是为所欲为的自由。正如柏克所言，“我要自诩我爱的是一种有气概、有道德、有规矩的自由。”只有爱这样自由的人才是配得自由的人。 人类要想真的配得自由，就意味着人类不可以为所欲为，意味着人类的自由是耶和华与其律法之下的自由。耶和华给人类自由，并用十诫来保护这些自由。这是对人的要求，而不是对其他物种的要求。动物不享有自由权，因为他们不需要十诫与律法，没有必要对狮子说不要谋杀，没有必要对老鼠说不要盗窃。是否享有自由这份礼物，是否恪守十诫是人与动物的一个根本区别。对造物主律法的态度，决定了一个国度的人们是否配得自由。中国的历史同样证明了这一点：自由必须争取，但只有配得自由的国度与人民才能得到自由。 自由的实现 当我们讨论完自由的条件之后，再来谈谈如何实现自由，这个是非常关键的一步。自由分成两个不一样的类型，一个是我们通常所说的自由的权利（liberty），一个叫自由的状态（freedom），这两个区分仅仅适用于英语国家。在拉丁语国家，只有前面一个，即自由权利（liberty），这里既包含自由的权利，也包含自由的状态。这个区分是非常非常重要的。理解了这两个区分，更有利于我们去追求自由，也更有利于理解为什么自由首先在英国和美国得以成功实现,并且持久存在。我们可以这么去想,既然造物主给了我们自由（指自由权），为什么不自由的情形却普遍存在？因为造物主给了我们自由权，不等于我们就有了自由，更不等于我们就可以不用努力坐享其成。就像造物主给了每个人财产权一样，不等于我们不用努力就可以家财万贯。不自由与贫困，常常独立于自由权与财产权而独立存在而普遍存在。 我们如何在自由权与自由的状态之间建立关联？既然造物主给了我们自由权的大礼，就意味着我们还必须去争取自由，而且是在雅威的引导下。就像当年《出埃及记》里所展示的，一方面造物主（耶和华）给了他们自由权，同时又一步一步地引导他们去争取进入自由的状态，这样他们才真正地走出埃及，成为配得自由并且享有自由的人。法国大革命也是以追求自由的名义所发动，但是他们不寻求造物主的领导，而是要自行其是。而且他们还以“自由平等博爱”的名义去诉诸暴力，用暴力拆除阻挡他们的一切藩篱，以追求不是比任何约束的自由。 小结一下，“自由平等博爱”对自由的理解在根本上是错误的，是错误的自由观。它对自由的源头、自由的性质、由与人性的关系，自由的条件与自由的实现等一系列问题上的看法都是错误的。“自由平等博爱”对人性评价过高，因而也给了人类其所不能承受的自由，因为这个自由在本质上是是放纵而不是自由。熟悉美国政治人都知道，今天美国的左派被称作自由派。争取自由原本是件好的事情，为什么在美国左派却被称为自由派？因为他们追求造物主没有赋予人类的自由，他们要按照自己的意志，确定其所要追求的自由，他们按照自己的方式实现他们的自由，他们要通过议会道路、街头路线和文化战略来获得造物主没有赋予他们的那些自由。他们所要的是作为放纵的自由，是摆脱一切束缚的自由。这一点从变性运动，从“黑命贵”，从放任非法移民这些事情上，都可以看到自由派所要追求的自由究竟是什么。 如果评选世界上最动听的口号，我肯定会投票给“自由平等博爱”。我也承认这些都是好字眼。但另一方面，“自由平等博爱”不仅是三个口号，而且是一个完整的更大口号，三个1相加大于3。这个口号出自人，却以造物主的姿态取代造物主所给予人类的“自由平等爱”。这个口号成了新的教义，并且试图取而代之。王建勋老师在课中也提出，密尔特别推崇法国人孔德，他是社会主义的先驱。孔德就试图创立新的宗教来取代对雅威的信靠，提倡“自由平等博爱”的人，他们想把这个价值观抬高到与基督教分庭抗礼，甚至取而代之的层面，可见这个口号的背后是一个乌托邦，一旦彻底实践将会产生灾难性的后果。 我们看一看法国的历程，法兰西启蒙拒绝了亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各的神，他们找到了自己所发明的神，这就是“自由平等博爱”。他们对重塑人类的追求，甚至超过了重塑法国的追求。所以，在法国信仰自由，变成了不信仰雅威的自由。这在其他国家的宪法中也能看到。法国巴黎也随之成了培养世界各国革命家的圣地和摇篮。我不反对分别的自由、平等与博爱，但是反对作为特定价值观的“自由平等博爱”，反对作为乌托邦的“自由平等博爱”。 未来的国度是雅威的国度 斯蒂芬在对该书总结时说到，管理和引导人类的全部生活有赖于对是否存在造物主和未来国度（future state，书中译为“来世”，有误对于未来国度最详细的描述是在《新约·启示录》中）。斯蒂芬认为，有雅威而没有未来的国度，雅威对我们是没有意义的，因为雅威要把我们带到未来的国度，因为未来的国度是雅威的国度。什么叫做未来的国度？那是雅威亲自掌权的国度，是耶稣亲自掌权的国度，那就是雅威的国度。如果我们只承认雅威的存在而不认为是雅威在掌权，那雅威对我们来说毫无意义。如果有未来国度但没有雅威，我们又不知道谁来掌权，所以我们就不可能对这个未来国度是好是坏产生任何合理的推测。所以，如果既没有雅威也没有未来国度，会出现什么情形？就会出现“自由平等博爱”这样一个基于个人好恶的，基于人所制定的功利主义来规制人的行为的一种情形。 （演讲整理稿）

title: Budget agency yet to discuss funding for CPC's Alaska LNG investment - Focus Taiwan
zh_title: 预算机构尚未讨论中油阿拉斯加液化天然气投资的资金问题 - 聚焦台湾
summary: 中新社台北10月21日电 台湾预算机构负责人周三表示，尚未讨论为国有中油公司提供资金的问题，该机构计划投资阿拉斯加液化天然气(LNG)项目。预算会计统计司司长陈淑姿在立法听证会上告​​诉立法者，由于该项目的谈判正在进行中，因此尚未咨询她的机构。她表示，资金是否来自年度预算或特别预算将取决于中共的财务结构，但她否认拟议的2,338亿新台币
content:
中新社台北10月21日电 台湾预算机构负责人周三表示，尚未讨论为国有中油公司提供资金的问题，该机构计划投资阿拉斯加液化天然气(LNG)项目。

预算会计统计司司长陈淑姿在立法听证会上告​​诉立法者，由于该项目的谈判正在进行中，因此尚未咨询她的机构。

她表示，资金是否来自年度预算或特别预算将取决于中油集团的财务结构，但她否认拟议向该公司注资2,338亿元新台币的目的是为阿拉斯加交易提供资金。

经济部(MOEA)上周宣布，CPC计划在该项目上投资至多44亿美元，投产后每年采购600万吨液化天然气，大约相当于台湾目前年需求的四分之一。

该部表示，如果该项目的开发按计划进行，最早可能于 2032 年开始交付，不过购买和投资细节仍在谈判中。

[● CPC将投资至多44亿美元阿拉斯加液化天然气项目](https://focustaiwan.tw/business/202610140011)

陈在周三的听证会上表示，拟议对中油集团和国有公用事业台电公司进行注资和补贴的目的是缓解它们在政府稳定价格政策下吸收更高能源成本所造成的财务压力。
自2020年以来，由于2021年COVID-19后需求激增、俄罗斯2022年入侵乌克兰以及2026年2月开始的伊朗战争，CPC已吸收了6740亿元新台币（207.6亿美元）的进口原油和天然气成本增加。

公司数据显示，截至9月底，累计亏损达新台币910亿元。

经济部的数据显示，台电虽然吸收了大致相同的较高成本，但自 2020 年以来累计亏损已达新台币 3,712 亿元。

内阁提出的6076亿元追加预算，包含对两家公司的补贴。立法者指出，如果年底前未获得通过，该提案将失效。

陈警告说，如果不通过，中油公司的损失将达到新台币1,276亿元，占其1,301亿元实收资本的90%以上。

她表示，这可能会阻碍银行融资，并可能影响原油供应，从而增加通胀压力，并敦促立法者支持预算，以帮助稳定生活成本。

自2016年民进党执政以来，在立法院占多数的反对党因反对民进党的能源政策，一直不愿为中国共产党和台电提供额外资金。

该政策强调逐步淘汰核电，同时支持可再生能源发展，同时严重依赖化石燃料，特别是液化天然气。
根据能源管理局的数据，2026 年前 8 个月，化石燃料占台湾发电量的 85% 以上。

经济部上周表示，阿拉斯加伙伴关系将使台湾液化天然气供应多元化并加强能源安全。报告称，跨太平洋直接运输将提供替代供应路线，有助于降低地缘政治风险。

【原文 English Original】
Taipei, Oct. 21 (CNA) Taiwan's budget agency has yet to discuss funding for state-owned CPC Corp., Taiwan's planned investment in an Alaska liquefied natural gas (LNG) project, its chief said Wednesday.

Chen Shu-tzu (陳淑姿), head of the Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics, told lawmakers at a legislative hearing that her agency had not yet been consulted because negotiations on the project were ongoing.

Whether funding would come through the annual budget or a special budget would depend on CPC's financial structure, she said, but she denied that a proposed NT$233.8 billion capital injection into the company was aimed at financing the Alaska deal.

The Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) announced last week that CPC planned to invest up to US$4.4 billion in the project and purchase 6 million metric tons of LNG annually, or roughly a quarter of Taiwan's annual needs at present, once production begins.

Deliveries could start as early as 2032 if the project's development proceeds on schedule, though purchase and investment details were still being negotiated, the ministry said.

[● CPC to invest up to US$4.4 billion in Alaska LNG project](https://focustaiwan.tw/business/202610140011)

At Wednesday's hearing, Chen said the proposed capital injection and subsidies for CPC and state-owned utility Taiwan Power Co. were intended to ease financial pressure caused by their absorption of higher energy costs under the government's price-stabilization policy.

Since 2020, CPC has absorbed NT$674 billion (US$20.76 billion) in increases in the cost of imported crude oil and natural gas due to a post-COVID 19 surge in demand in 2021, Russia's invasion of Ukraine in 2022, and the war in Iran that began in February 2026.

That has led to accumulated losses of NT$91 billion as of the end of September, company data showed.

Taipower has absorbed roughly the same in higher costs, but its accumulated losses since 2020 have totaled NT$371.2 billion, according to the MOEA.

A supplementary budget of NT$607.6 billion proposed by the Cabinet includes subsidies for the two companies. Lawmakers noted that the proposal would lapse if not passed by year-end.

Without passage, CPC's losses would reach NT$127.6 billion, more than 90 percent of its NT$130.1 billion paid-in capital, Chen warned.

That could hamper bank financing and potentially affect crude oil supplies, adding inflationary pressure, she said, urging lawmakers to support the budget to help stabilize living costs.

Opposition parties, which hold a majority in the Legislative Yuan have been reluctant to provide additional funding for CPC and Taipower because of their objections to the Democratic Progressive Party's energy policy since it took power in 2016.

The policy stressed phasing out nuclear power while supporting the development of renewable energy while relying heavily on fossil fuels, especially LNG.

Fossil fuels have accounted for over 85 percent of Taiwan's electricity generation in the first eight months of 2026, according to Energy Administration figures.

The economics ministry said last week that the Alaska partnership would diversify Taiwan's LNG supplies and strengthen energy security. Direct shipments across the Pacific would provide an alternative supply route that could help reduce geopolitical risks, it said.

(By Pan Tzu-yu and Chao Yen-hsiang)

title: APEC财长会议闭幕，财长们就应对外部挑战达成共识，但未提出具体措施
summary: 亚太经合组织(APEC)财长会议10月20日至21日在香港举行。此次会议正值在亚太地区面临地缘政治局势紧张、不断攀升的债务和技术变革等重要问题之际，各成员经济体财长们探讨了如何在公共财政收紧的情况下支持经济增长，并就如何应对外部挑战达成共识。不过，各方并未就具体政策调整作出承诺。 财长们在会后发布的[联合声明](https://www.apec.org/meeting-papers/sectoral-ministerial-meetings/finance/2026-apec
content:
亚太经合组织(APEC)财长会议10月20日至21日在香港举行。此次会议正值在亚太地区面临地缘政治局势紧张、不断攀升的债务和技术变革等重要问题之际，各成员经济体财长们探讨了如何在公共财政收紧的情况下支持经济增长，并就如何应对外部挑战达成共识。不过，各方并未就具体政策调整作出承诺。

财长们在会后发布的[联合声明](https://www.apec.org/meeting-papers/sectoral-ministerial-meetings/finance/2026-apec-finance-ministers'-meeting)表示，各国重申致力于到2040年构建一个开放、充满活力、具有韧性、和平的亚太共同体；财长们讨论的优先事项包括支持家庭的财政政策、数字基础设施融资、全民享有金融服务和机会，以及青年金融人才对话等等。

联合声明指出，虽然全球和区域经济展现出韧性，快速的技术发展和产业转型成为经济增长的重要引擎，但是，“持续的地缘经济紧张局势、供应链脆弱性、大宗商品价格波动、融资环境趋紧、极端天气事件和自然灾害以及政策不确定性等因素，仍然构成下行风险”。

声明重申了致力于“维护具有韧性的供应链的重要性”，并指出各国都认识到保持区域互联互通和贸易通道畅通符合大家的共同利益。

在数字基础设施融资方面，联合声明强调财长们认识到“稳健的数字基础设施是经济韧性和金融稳定的基石”，但是，一些经济体仍存在巨大的融资缺口，且这一问题正在逐步加剧。

对此，财长们鼓励公共部门为数字基础设施发展“营造清晰、透明且可预期的政策与监管框架”，也鼓励私营部门在提供资金和技术专长方面开发和采用创新的融资方式。

**APEC各经济体财长达成的共识**

中国财政部长、APEC财长会议主席蓝佛安星期三(10月21日)在新闻发布会上表示，亚太经合组织各成员经济体的财政部长已达成共识，将加强宏观经济政策的沟通协调，以应对外部风险和挑战；另外，各成员国也将深化区域一体化进程，推动构建亚太共同体。

APEC的官网新闻报道说，国际货币基金组织(IMF)和亚洲开发银行(ADB)分别提交了对全球和区域经济状况的评估报告，为各国部长审视经济增长和金融稳定面临的风险提供了依据。

另外，世界银行(World Bank)在会议上提交的一份报告探讨了财政政策如何增强家庭抵御能力，同时支持长期增长。报告强调了平衡家庭短期需求与人力资本投资和可持续公共财政的重要性。

APEC财长会是下月APEC领导人非正式会议召开前的最后一个部长级会议，

APEC组织第三十三次领导人非正式会议将于11月18日至19日在深圳举行，主题是“建设亚太共同体，促进共同繁荣”。这是继2001年上海和2014年北京之后，中国第三次举办APEC峰会。

美国总统唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)预计将前往深圳出席本次会议。届时他将可能与中国国家主席习近平及俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京(Vladimir Putin)举行双边和三边领导人会谈。

# HELP BRING MY SON BACK HOME

My name is Nelson Wells, Sr. and I write to you on behalf of my wife, Cynthia Wells, and our family, asking for your assistance in our fight to bring home our son, Nelson Wells, Jr., who has been unjustly imprisoned in China for more than eight years. We are natives of Louisiana, who have served our country for decades. I served in the United States Army for more than 20 years, and Cynthia, served at the Department of Defense for nearly 28 years. We’ve traveled all over the United States and world and have a host of extended family and friends, who join us in the fight for our son. This includes Nelson’s wife and three children, who are desperate to have him returned to our family unit. Like us, Nelson, Jr. loved to travel, and it was this love of travel that inspired him to live in Japan and visit China. Unfortunately, it was on one of these visits there that Nelson was arrested and later convicted on a drug charge with little evidence of his guilt, opportunity to defend himself, or due process prior to this conviction and incarceration. He was stripped of his freedom without the opportunity to tell his story. Indeed, it took months for us to learn what happened to him. We’ve fought for years to help our son, working behind the scenes with advocates, lawyers and diplomatic officials in the United States and China. We were told that this quiet strategy was the best strategy to keep him safe, but after nearly a decade with little progress, we’ve decided to tell our story, Nelson’s story. It breaks our heart to say it, but Nelson is now sick. The weight of incarceration has taken a toll on his physical and mental health. As you can see from the photos, our child has gone from a healthy man to an emaciated one, who has lost more than 100lbs and is in poor health. He is suffering from life-threatening medical problems in a prison in Chongqing Southwest China far from us, far from his wife and children. Indeed, we have not seen him during these eight long years. We are sustained by periodic calls from him, and for that, we are thankful to God, the United States State Department, and the Chinese government and prison officials. Still, we fear that he will not last much longer. It is time to bring Nelson home, perhaps through medical parole. Whatever the pathway, getting help for him is more urgent now than ever and so we are turning to the public for help with legal fees and welfare support on his behalf. No amount is too small, and we promise that your donations will only be used to directly secure the release and return of our son. We also invite you to leave a comment alongside your donation with a note of inspiration that we can share with Nelson, a personal reflection about Nelson for those who know him, or a testimonial about why you are deciding to join our fight. Thank you for considering this request. Thank you for your thoughts and prayers for Nelson. Thank you, in advance, for your generosity. Even the act of creating this go fund me page and sharing our story publicly has given us – including Nelson – purpose and hope for the future when we can be reunited. Until then we are heartbroken, but we fight on. Mr. Nelson Wells, Sr. and Mrs. Cynthia Wells Louisiana

content:
中国
根据内地、香港和澳门监管机构四月份达成的协议，香港民航处处长出席了在上海举行的首次 C929 型号联合认证会议。 C929是中国第一架自主研发的远程宽体客机，设计座位数高达290个，

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 21 日 17:05 香港时间 · 更新于 10 月 21 日 17:19 · 阅读时间 1 分钟

 图片：[香港特区政府新闻公报](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202610/21/P2026102100334.htm)

香港政府宣布，香港民航处处长黄家华周三（10 月 21 日）出席在上海举行的首次 C929 型号联合认证会议。

会议落实了中国民航局、香港民航处、澳门民航局4月签署的C929飞机型号合格审定合作安排。

与主要用于短途航线的C909和C919喷气式飞机不同，C929是中国第一架自主研发的双通道远程宽体客机，设计最大载客量为290个，航程12000公里，可实现跨洋和长途洲际飞行。
黄说，自2007年以来，应内地监管机构的邀请，她的部门积极参与C909和C919飞机的适航审定审查。她对再次受邀参加C929型号认证表示荣幸，并补充说香港将借鉴C909和C919的成功经验，运用适航认证方面的专业知识来支持C929计划。

会上香港代表分享了国际飞机认证经验，并确定了后续支持工作组的蓝图和合作安排。

香港民航处表示，支持国家民航业在各个领域的高质量发展，并表示此次合作将显着深化香港航空业与国家航空航天业的融合，让香港抓住国家“十五五”规划的发展机遇。

黄原定于同日返回香港。

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

21 Oct 2026 at 17:05 HKT · updated 21 Oct, 17:19 · 1 min read

 Image: [香港特區政府新聞公報](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202610/21/P2026102100334.htm)

Hong Kong Civil Aviation Department Director Carmen Wong Ka-wah attended the first joint C929 type certification meeting in Shanghai on Wednesday (21 October), the Hong Kong government announced.

The meeting implemented a cooperation arrangement signed in April by the Civil Aviation Administration of China, the Hong Kong Civil Aviation Department and the Macau Civil Aviation Authority concerning type certification of the C929 aircraft.

Unlike the C909 and C919 jets mainly used for short-haul routes, the C929 is China's first domestically developed twin-aisle long-range wide-body passenger aircraft, designed to carry up to 290 seats with a range of 12,000 kilometres, enabling transoceanic and long-distance intercontinental flights.

Wong said her department has actively participated in airworthiness certification reviews for the C909 and C919 aircraft since 2007, at the invitation of the mainland regulator. She expressed honour at being invited again for the C929 type certification, adding that Hong Kong would build on its successful experience with the C909 and C919 and deploy expertise in airworthiness certification to support the C929 programme.

Hong Kong representatives at the meeting shared international aircraft certification experience and finalised a blueprint and cooperation arrangements for subsequent support working groups.

The Hong Kong Civil Aviation Department said it supports high-quality development of the national civil aviation sector in various areas, adding that the cooperation would significantly deepen integration between Hong Kong's aviation industry and the national aerospace sector, allowing the city to seize development opportunities under the country's 15th Five-Year Plan.

Wong was scheduled to return to Hong Kong on the same day.

title: China’s Communist Party elite gather for closed-door governance talks
zh_title: 中国共产党精英齐聚闭门谈治国理政
summary: 中国国家主席习近平和其他高层领导人周一在北京举行一次重要聚会，密切关注有关国家发展方向和未来领导力的线索。 2021年11月，中国共产党第十九届中央委员会第六次全体会议。资料图片：中国共产党。据官方媒体报道，大约有 300 名执政的共产党中央委员会成员出席了这次被称为五中全会的会议，他们将寻求加强内部纪律。其中包括减少腐败和提高干部效率的措施
content:
中国国家主席习近平和其他高层领导人周一在北京举行一次重要聚会，密切关注有关国家发展方向和未来领导力的线索。 2021年11月，中国共产党第十九届中央委员会第六次全体会议。资料图片：中国共产党。据官方媒体报道，大约有 300 名执政的共产党中央委员会成员出席了这次被称为五中全会的会议，他们将寻求加强内部纪律。其中包括减少腐败、提高干部效率和忠诚度的措施。这次在严密安保下举行的闭门会议在周四结束之前几乎不会公开，但会议的时机至关重要。另请参阅：关于中国共产党五中全会的信息五中全会在明年举行的一次重要党代会上召开，73岁的习近平几乎肯定会获得历史性的第四个任期并监督领导层改组。历次全会都是习近平巩固权威的关键时刻。这位中国领导人开展了长达14年的反腐败运动，清洗了数千名官员，其中包括数十名中央委员会官员。然而，他仍然对他认为干部没有执行他的命令感到沮丧。
官方媒体在全会前发表了一篇文章，内容是习近平一月份的一次讲话，其中他谴责了“两面派”官员，他们表面上遵守中央指令，但“内心抵制”，追求“个人主义”，而且是“政治机会主义”。 投票率低的分析人士告诉法新社，习近平正试图通过加强监督和规则来最大限度地提高干部的效率和忠诚度。但由于他的大规模清洗，预计今年的全会投票率将是前领导人毛泽东 1976 年去世以来的最低水平。中央委员会的 8 个席位空缺，另有 15 名成员正在接受调查并面临被替换的风险。习近平的反腐败运动还针对军队，推翻了党的最高武装部队机构中央军事委员会（CMC）七名委员中的五名。 2022年11月，习近平视察中央军委联合作战指挥中心。图片：中共新闻。据亚洲协会政策研究所称，2022 年任命的 44 名中央委员会军事成员中，只有两人没有被清洗或失踪。全会可能会任命新的中央军委委员；该党可以等到明年的代表大会来补充资金；或者习近平甚至可能重组党对其庞大军队的控制。
此次会谈也是在这个世界第二大经济体不稳定的时期举行的，该国一直在努力解决持续低迷的国内支出和关键房地产行业旷日持久的危机。与美国动荡的政治和经济关系也给中国领导人带来了压力。预计当局将在周四会议结束后发布结果摘要。

【原文 English Original】
China’s President Xi Jinping and other top leaders meet in Beijing on Monday at a key gathering watched closely for clues as to the country’s direction and future leadership. The sixth plenary session of the 19th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party in November 2021. File photo: Communist Party of China. Roughly 300 members of the ruling Communist Party’s Central Committee in attendance at the meeting, called the fifth plenum, will be looking to tighten discipline within their ranks, according to state media. That includes measures to reduce corruption and make cadres more effective and loyal. Little of the closed-door gathering, held under tight security, will be made known until it concludes on Thursday, but the timing of the meeting is crucial. See also: What to know about the Chinese Communist Party’s Fifth Plenum The fifth plenum comes ahead of a major party congress next year, where 73-year-old Xi is almost certain to secure a historic fourth term and oversee a leadership reshuffle. Previous plenums have represented key moments for Xi to cement his authority. The Chinese leader has waged a 14-year campaign against corruption that has purged thousands of officials, including dozens of the Central Committee. Yet he remains frustrated with cadres he deems are not implementing his orders. State media published an article ahead of the plenum, based on a speech Xi gave in January in which he railed against “two-faced” officials who appear to comply with central directives but “inwardly resist”, pursue “individualism” and are “politically opportunistic”. Low turnout Analysts told AFP that Xi is trying to maximise efficiency and loyalty among cadres by imposing more supervision and rules. But as a result of his expansive purges, this year’s plenum is expected to have the lowest turnout since former leader Mao Zedong’s death in 1976. Eight of the Central Committee’s seats lie vacant, with another 15 members under investigation and at risk of being replaced. Xi’s anti-corruption drive has also targeted the military, toppling five of the seven members of the Central Military Commission (CMC), the party’s top armed forces body. Xi Jinping inspects the Central Military Commission Joint Operations Command Center in November 2022. Photo: CPC News. Of 44 military members appointed to the Central Committee in 2022, only two have not been purged or disappeared, according to the Asia Society Policy Institute. The plenum could see new members appointed to the CMC; the party could wait until next year’s congress to replenish it; or Xi might even restructure party control over its vast military. The talks also come at an unsteady time for the world’s second-largest economy, which has struggled to address persistently sluggish domestic spending and a protracted crisis in the crucial property sector. Turbulent political and economic ties with the United States are also weighing on China’s leaders. Authorities are expected to release a summary of the outcomes after the meeting concludes on Thursday.

content:
学生抗议近两年，“中国人民的老朋友”武契奇承认败选

10月25日晚，塞尔维亚前总统武契奇承认，他领导的前进党联盟在提前举行的议会选举中败给学生运动支持的“学生名单”，表示接受结果，今后将转为反对党。

这场抗议运动始于2024年11月1日诺维萨德火车站雨棚坍塌事故，最终造成16人死亡。
该站此前由中资企业联合体承包翻修。学生要求追究事故责任、反对腐败，抗议持续近两年，并逐渐发展为要求提前选举的全国性运动。

武契奇于今年9月27日提前辞去总统，原本打算通过议会选举转任总理、延续执政。
就在他辞职前三天，中国国家副主席韩正会见他时，还称他是“中国人民的老朋友、好朋友”。

Taipei, Oct. 24 (CNA) Game 5 of the Taiwan Series has been postponed for a second time because of Typhoon Champi and will now be held Sunday, giving the CTBC Brothers' key pitchers more time to rest as they fight to avoid elimination.

The Chinese Professional Baseball League (CPBL) rescheduled the game for 5:05 p.m. Sunday after Taipei announced school and office closures for both Friday and Saturday. Originally scheduled for Friday, the game had initially been moved to Saturday.

The Wei Chuan Dragons lead the best-of-seven championship series 3-1. If necessary, Game 6 will take place at 3:05 p.m. Monday, followed by Game 7 at 6:35 p.m. Tuesday.

All seven games were originally scheduled for Taipei Dome. However, due to a booking by another event, a deciding Game 7 would require a different venue, which has yet to be announced. Wei Chuan will be the designated home team for all remaining games.

Before the second postponement was announced Friday evening, the Brothers had already changed their Game 5 starter from Wu Li-chen (伍立辰) to Félix Peña, taking advantage of the additional downtime provided by the first delay.

Peña started Game 2 last Sunday, throwing 71 pitches over 4 2/3 innings. With CTBC facing elimination Wednesday, he returned in relief to pitch a scoreless 11th inning, throwing 14 pitches and earning the win when Chan Tzu-hsien (詹子賢) delivered a walk-off single for a 5-4 victory.

The two postponements also give fellow Brothers starter Mario Sanchez more recovery time after he worked extensively in both Games 1 and 4.

Sanchez pitched seven innings in the opener last Saturday before throwing another 73 pitches over 4 1/3 scoreless innings out of the bullpen Wednesday. Across the two appearances, he allowed three runs in 11 1/3 innings.

CTBC's Game 4 victory prevented a sweep after its offense managed only one run in the first three games, including two shutout defeats.

Unless either team changes its announced starter again, Sunday's Game 5 will pit Peña against Wei Chuan's John Gant, who threw eight scoreless innings in the series opener.

(By Chao Yen-hsiang)

content:
朝鲜最高领导人金正恩星期六(10月24日)对中国边境城市丹东进行了一次事先未作预告的访问，并于当天访问结束后立即返回平壤。

根据中国官媒新华社的报道，中共中央政治局常委、全国政协主席王沪宁在丹东的“抗美援朝纪念馆”广场迎接金正恩，先陪同他向纪念塔献花篮，然后陪同他参访纪念馆。

王沪宁还在丹东与金正恩举行了会谈。

本月稍早，中朝两国开通了边境上已经完工12年之久的新鸭绿江大桥。新鸭绿江大桥于2014年建成，但由于朝方一侧缺乏连接道路和海关设施，其开通时间被推迟。其间还遭遇两国关系不睦和新冠疫情等因素的干扰。

路透社在报道中指出，新鸭绿江大桥的开通标志着中朝双方都有意重振双边贸易与商业往来。新鸭绿江大桥的开通，距离朝鲜与俄罗斯之间首座公路大桥的启用也仅有一个多月的时间。双桥的开通或许标志着平壤为摆脱其在国际间的孤立处境，正致力于强化与中俄这两个最重要盟友的政治、军事和经贸关系。

金正恩正是通过这座新鸭绿江大桥进出中国的。

金正恩上一次公开的访华行程是在2025年9月，当时他前往北京出席了二战“胜利日”80周年庆祝活动，并与中国国家主席习近平举行了会晤。习近平后于今年6月对朝鲜进行国事访问，此举被外界广泛视为双方关系改善的信号。

“中方愿同朝方一道，坚定不移贯彻两党两国最高领导人重要共识，以共同的社会主义事业为纽带，推动中朝关系进一步升华发展，”新华社援引王沪宁在会晤中的话说。

金正恩在会谈时则表示，要与中方一道，拓展务实合作，“为两国人民带来实实在在福祉”。

中共中央政治局委员、中国外长王毅与王沪宁一道，陪同金正恩参观了丹东的汽车工厂和生产车间。

新华社报道说，金正恩当天离开丹东时，王沪宁特别前往新鸭绿江大桥为他送行。

中国军方曾于1950年10月19日从丹东跨过冰冻的鸭绿江，秘密进入朝鲜，直接介入朝鲜战争，与美国主导的联合国军进行抗衡。金正恩访问丹东之际，正值中国入朝参战76周年。

美国总统唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)在第一任期内，曾经与金正恩有过多次面对面的互动与交流。但是最后双方在朝鲜弃核问题上无法达成共识，特朗普的努力功亏一篑。特朗普重返白宫后，一直希望与金正恩重启对话，但是平壤漫天要价，声称美国必须承认朝鲜是一个拥核国家。

路透社星期五援引美韩官员的话说，特朗普今年与金正恩举行会晤的可能性正变得日益渺茫。

中国是亚太经合组织(APEC)今年的轮值主席国，下个月将在深圳举办亚太经合组织非正式领导人峰会，特朗普不仅决定出席这次会议，而且还要与习近平举行今年的第三次双边峰会。

特朗普会不会在深圳与同样出席亚太经合组织领导人峰会的金正恩举行会晤是目前外界观察和揣测的一个重点。

韩国朝鲜大学院大学前校长梁茂进(Yang Moo-jin)向法新社表示，金正恩此次突访丹东可能是为了“敦促中国加快落实”在习近平今年访问朝鲜期间双方所达成的承诺，而且也可能在为日后与特朗普会晤铺路。

“在可能与特朗普在深圳举行会晤之前，他也可能是在寻求北京的积极支持与配合，” 梁茂进对法新社说。

朝鲜尽管长期受到联合国制裁，但仍通过法律形式确立自己为拥核国家，并多次声明其核武库是永久且不可逆转的。

对朝立场温和的韩国总统李在明(Lee Jae Myung)上个月曾建议，华盛顿可以寻求让朝鲜“冻结”而非立即“销毁”其核计划，以此作为放宽对平壤制裁的交换条件。

但批评人士指出，这种做法可能会被视为默认朝鲜的拥核国家地位，并让平壤在无需放弃核武库的情况下获得制裁措施的松绑。

分析人士认为，中国似乎也已对朝鲜的拥核地位转向某种程度上的“默认”。

今年6月，金正恩在平壤接待了习近平之后，平壤和北京在各自的官方声明中均未提及朝鲜无核化--专家们认为，这一遗漏表明中国对朝鲜拥核可能已持默许态度。

title: 澳洲紧急召回 13 款保健品，致千人不良反应及死亡，强制下架并彻底拉黑
source: 澳洲唐人街 – Australia ChinaTown News 中文华人新闻
summary: 澳大利亚常见的针对感冒流感的热门保健品成分，被确认存在极高风险，13款产品紧急召回！ 不仅上千人服用后出现不良反应，还有人吃药后死亡！ 一种常用于治疗感冒和流感的草药补充剂，紧急召回！ 此前，澳洲治疗用品管理局（TGA）安全审查就已经发现，穿心莲这种成分可引发严重过敏反应甚至导致死亡，因此提议取消其“低风险”分类并禁止流通。 刚刚，澳洲药品监管机构TGA发布紧急召回通知，要求消费者立即停止使用13款免疫系统保健品，原因就是这些产品含有穿心莲。 此次受影响的产品包括： BioC
content: 澳大利亚常见的针对感冒流感的热门保健品成分，被确认存在极高风险，13款产品紧急召回！ 不仅上千人服用后出现不良反应，还有人吃药后死亡！ 一种常用于治疗感冒和流感的草药补充剂，紧急召回！ 此前，澳洲治疗用品管理局（TGA）安全审查就已经发现，穿心莲这种成分可引发严重过敏反应甚至导致死亡，因此提议取消其“低风险”分类并禁止流通。 刚刚，澳洲药品监管机构TGA发布紧急召回通知，要求消费者立即停止使用13款免疫系统保健品，原因就是这些产品含有穿心莲。 此次受影响的产品包括： BioCeuticals ArmaForce 30、60及120粒装 BioCeuticals Clinical ImmuneForce 60粒装 Faulding Immune Combat 100粒装 PM Lung Support II Immune Support Echinacea Plus 60片装 Chemists’ Own Provance Immune Defence 28 Plus Immune Defence Nourex Professional Immune Defence 30及60粒装 Nourex Professional Immune Force 30及60粒装 此次召回由BioCeuticals公司发起，该公司以其ArmaForce穿心莲片而闻名，该产品用于缓解普通感冒/流感和轻度上呼吸道感染(URTI)。公司同时召回BioCeuticalsClinicallmmuneForce，该产品符合退款条件。 “经与澳大利亚药品管理局(TGA)协商，BioCeuticals正在澳大利亚召回其含有穿心莲的产品，”品牌声明道。 上个月，TGA刚刚宣布，穿心莲今后不得用于进入澳洲市场的新药。 TGA强烈鼓励供应商自愿停产含有该成分的补充剂，并展开面向消费者的召回行动，这次召回就是行动的一部分。 如果企业不自行召回产品并停止生产，TGA将从10月中旬起采取监管行动，停止这类药物的供应。 图片来源：ABC News 虽然穿心莲不能再用于新上市的药品，但含有这种草药的产品仍然可以通过注册药品途径进入澳大利亚市场，前提是TGA对其质量、安全性和有效性进行评估后才能批准。 一些品牌也在探索产品配方改良，将益生菌和其他植物成分视为潜在的替代品。 当局建议消费者检查自己的药物是否含有穿心莲，再考虑是否继续使用。 预计这一成分将转入注册药物途径。该途径监管更严格，并要求提供消费者用药信息。 相关保健品超千人不良反应 穿心莲在印度和中国传统医学中使用了数百年的草本植物，常被宣传有助于缓解感冒和流感症状。 澳大利亚免疫学家Connie Katelaris指出，穿心莲可能是导致严重过敏反应的罪魁祸首。 根据TGA的数据，目前澳大利亚市场上含有穿心莲的药物多达84种，这些药物占补充剂相关过敏和过敏性休克报告的40%。 值得警惕的是，即便此前服用过该成分且未出现异常，过敏性休克仍可能毫无征兆地发生，目前发病机制尚不明确。此前，含有穿心莲的产品在各大超市和药房均可无需处方直接购买。 Katelaris和同事接诊的患者中，多人因服用含有穿心莲的药物而出现严重过敏反应，包括全身荨麻疹、剧烈瘙痒，甚至危及生命的过敏性休克。 TGA 已收到上千份有关含有穿心莲的药物不良反应的报告，其中包括858份针对 ArmaForce 产品，也就是此次召回产品的报告。 根据澳大利亚治疗用品管理局（TGA）的统计数据，已有超过1000例服用含有该成分的药物后出现不良反应的报告，其中包括一例死亡病例！ 45岁的Carmen Wells就是出现不良反应的患者之一。 2019年，她因为感冒服用了朋友推荐的ArmaForce，却由此开始了漫长的健康噩梦…… 我每天早晨醒来都感到恶心，后来发现眼白变成了可怕的黄色。 在做了一系列检查后，她被诊断为药物诱发的肝损伤。 由于她之前还患有自身免疫性疾病，这可能会增加患上其他疾病的风险。 医生认为，这一疾病与她服用的ArmaForce补充剂有关，而Wells在确诊后不得不终身服用免疫抑制药物。这种治疗不仅令她的头发大量脱落，还增加了患皮肤癌的风险。 前年6月，昆士兰一位父亲Cale Agosta因疑似服用ArmaForce后发生过敏性休克不幸去世。 这种药物的危害程度，可想而知。 对于这次最新的召回，专家提醒消费者：如果你家也有类似的感冒药物或者增强免疫类补充剂，千万不要服用，警惕过敏风险！ 面对市场上种类繁多的保健品，在购买前，大家应充分了解产品成分及其潜在风险，并在必要时咨询专业医生或药剂师，千万不要再自己乱吃！ 面对市场上种类繁多的保健品，在购买前，大家应充分了解产品成分及其潜在风险，并在必要时咨询专业医生或药剂师，千万不要再自己乱吃！

title: Lin urges Taiwan-Europe cooperation on trusted AI, drone supply chains - Focus Taiwan

content:
中新社台北10月24日电 外交​​部长林佳龙周六呼吁台湾和欧洲在人工智能和无人机领域建立可信的供应链，称更紧密的合作可以加强经济和国家安全。

林在连接欧洲亲台议员的福尔摩沙俱乐部年度会议开幕式上表示，台湾的半导体、人工智能服务器和新兴无人机产业补充了欧洲在精密制造和工业技术方面的专业知识。

“这些需要值得信赖的合作伙伴，因为它们直接涉及国家安全和关键基础设施，”他说。

林说，俄罗斯对乌克兰的战争表明，过度的经济依赖可能成为一种胁迫工具，并认为台湾提供了一种基于信任和共同价值观的伙伴关系。

他补充说，台湾正在开发一个完整的无人机供应链，包括硬件、关键部件和网络安全标准。

作为产业合作的例子，林引述了台湾电机电子工业同业公会计划在波兰筹建的科技园区。他表示，该项目将重点关注人工智能数据中心、智能城市和电动汽车。

林将经济合作描述为台湾“一体化外交”的支柱之一，并与其他民主国家建立伙伴关系。
他敦促志同道合的国家共同抵制跨国镇压，指责中国利用国内立法将管辖权延伸到海外并威胁言论自由。

他说：“不应允许任何国家利用国内法作为向境外输出寒蝉效应的工具。”

主持这次会议的欧洲议会议员迈克尔·加勒(Michael Gahler)呼吁议会对台湾的支持转化为各国政府更广泛、制度化的合作。

他主张促进双向投资的安排，并表示其实质内容比是否称为双边投资协议更重要。

加勒表示，欧洲可以深化与台湾的实际接触，同时维持其“一个中国”政策，并将这些政策与北京的“一个中国”原则区分开来。

他说，民主国家需要协调应对来自俄罗斯和中国的战争、混合战争和经济胁迫的长期威胁。

外交部和成立于 2019 年的俱乐部定于周二共同举办论坛，重点讨论台湾与欧洲在人工智能和无人机技术方面的合作。

（赵彦祥摄）

尾项/ls

【原文 English Original】
Taipei, Oct. 24 (CNA) Foreign Minister Lin Chia-lung (林佳龍) called Saturday for Taiwan and Europe to build trusted supply chains in artificial intelligence and drones, saying closer cooperation could strengthen economic and national security.

Speaking at the opening of the annual conference of the Formosa Club, which connects pro-Taiwan parliamentarians across Europe, Lin said Taiwan's semiconductor, AI server and emerging drone industries complemented Europe's expertise in precision manufacturing and industrial technology.

"These require trusted partners because they directly involve national security and critical infrastructure," he said.

Russia's war against Ukraine had demonstrated how excessive economic dependence could become an instrument of coercion, Lin said, arguing that Taiwan offered a partnership grounded in trust and shared values.

Taiwan was developing a complete drone supply chain encompassing hardware, critical components and cybersecurity standards, he added.

As an example of industrial cooperation, Lin cited a proposed technology park in Poland planned by the Taiwan Electrical and Electronic Manufacturers' Association. The project would focus on AI data centers, smart cities and electric vehicles, he said.

Lin described economic cooperation as one pillar of Taiwan's "integrated diplomacy," alongside partnerships with fellow democracies.

He urged like-minded countries to jointly resist transnational repression, accusing China of using domestic legislation to extend its jurisdiction overseas and threaten freedom of expression.

"No country should be allowed to use domestic law as an instrument for exporting a chilling effect beyond its own borders," he said.

Michael Gahler, a member of the European Parliament who chaired the conference, called for parliamentary support for Taiwan to translate into broader, institutionalized cooperation by governments.

He advocated arrangements facilitating investment in both directions, saying their substance mattered more than whether they were called bilateral investment agreements.

Europe could deepen practical engagement with Taiwan while maintaining its "one China" policies, Gahler said, distinguishing those policies from Beijing's "one China" principle.

Democracies needed to coordinate their responses to the long-term threats of war, hybrid warfare and economic coercion from Russia and China, he said.

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the club, which was founded in 2019, are scheduled to co-host a forum Tuesday focusing on cooperation between Taiwan and Europe on AI and drone technology.

(By Chao Yen-hsiang)

# South China Sea Code of Conduct: A Deal Is Not Enough

A COC that lacks credible enforcement mechanisms would do little to address security challenges.

By **Abdul Rahman Yaacob**

October 23, 2026

[](https://www.linkedin.com/shareArticle?url=https%3A%2F%2Fthediplomat.com%2F2026%2F10%2Fsouth-china-sea-code-of-conduct-a-deal-is-not-enough%2F&title=South+China+Sea+Code+of+Conduct%3A+A+Deal+Is+Not+Enough "Share on LinkedIn")[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Fthediplomat.com%2F2026%2F10%2Fsouth-china-sea-code-of-conduct-a-deal-is-not-enough%2F "Share on Facebook")[](https://bsky.app/intent/compose?text=South+China+Sea+Code+of+Conduct%3A+A+Deal+Is+Not+Enough%0Ahttps%3A%2F%2Fthediplomat.com%2F2026%2F10%2Fsouth-china-sea-code-of-conduct-a-deal-is-not-enough%2F "Share on Bluesky")[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=South+China+Sea+Code+of+Conduct%3A+A+Deal+Is+Not+Enough&url=https%3A%2F%2Fthediplomat.com%2F2026%2F10%2Fsouth-china-sea-code-of-conduct-a-deal-is-not-enough%2F "Share on X")

Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi delivers a speech on China-ASEAN relations at the ASEAN Secretariat in Jakarta, Indonesia, on July 11, 2022.

Credit: [ASEAN Secretariat/Kusuma Pandu Wijaya](https://www.flickr.com/photos/aseansecretariat/52207569412/in/album-72177720300452587/)

Ad

As ASEAN and China work toward concluding a Code of Conduct (COC) for the South China Sea in 2026, the central question is not simply whether an agreement can be reached, but whether it will meaningfully reduce tensions. A deal is not enough if it does not address the underlying drivers of tension and shape actors’ behaviors.

The South China Sea is a contested maritime zone, involving China and ASEAN members Brunei, Malaysia, the Philippines, and Vietnam. To address the overlapping maritime claims and disputes, ASEAN and China have been negotiating a COC to establish a rules-based framework to manage maritime disputes, reduce miscalculations, and prevent armed conflict.

After nearly [two decades](https://www.lowyinstitute.org/the-interpreter/code-conduct-won-t-solve-south-china-sea-crisis) of negotiations, Manila, as the current ASEAN chair, has recently signaled that [agreement](https://www.inquirer.net/492236/marcos-says-good-progress-made-on-south-china-sea-code-of-conduct/) on the COC is at hand. A COC would represent an important diplomatic achievement.

Yet an agreement that lacks credible enforcement mechanisms, preserves ambiguity over compliance, or constrains Southeast Asian countries’ strategic autonomy could do little to address the region’s underlying security challenges.

The substance of the agreement matters more than announcing its completion. A COC that primarily reiterates commitments to dialogue, restraint, and peaceful dispute resolution – like those contained in the [existing Declaration of Conduct](https://asean.org/declaration-on-the-conduct-of-parties-in-the-south-china-sea-2/) – would have limited practical value. The COC needs clear procedures for managing incidents, resolving disagreements, and addressing violations.

The South China Sea has seen increased military activities. China has built a network of military facilities in the [Spratly and Paracel Islands](https://amti.csis.org/island-tracker/china/), some of which are now equipped to host [bombers](https://www.janes.com/defence-intelligence-insights/defence-news/defence/chinese-bombers-deployed-to-south-china-sea-in-september-2025). In 2025, Vietnam commenced its own reclamation work on occupied features, building [infrastructure](https://amti.csis.org/no-islet-left-behind-vietnam-reclaims-land-at-every-remaining-spratly-outpost/) to support a larger military presence.

Naval confrontations between China and the [Philippines](https://maritime-executive.com/article/video-china-coast-guard-uses-water-cannon-during-philippine-medevac) continue, highlighting the fragility of stability in the contested waters. Diplomatic commitments alone cannot guarantee responsible behavior

If the COC is to improve regional stability, it must include practical measures to prevent escalation and hold parties accountable for their conduct.

This raises a second challenge: ASEAN’s ability to ensure compliance. Even if the agreement includes specific obligations, its effectiveness will depend on whether parties are willing to implement them when doing so conflicts with their strategic interests. ASEAN’s consensus-based approach, while essential to maintaining regional unity, can complicate collective responses to violations, particularly when member states have different economic and security relationships with China.

A credible COC should therefore establish transparent procedures for reporting incidents, conducting consultations, and addressing alleged breaches. Regular reviews and clearly defined dispute-management channels could help prevent disagreements from escalating. Without a meaningful accountability mechanism, the COC risks just becoming a declaration of intent.

The agreement must also protect Southeast Asian states’ strategic autonomy. China may seek arrangements that limit activities it considers [destabilizing](https://manilastandard.net/news/314509420/china-accuses-us-as-biggest-source-of-instability-in-scs.html), such as joint [military exercises](https://www.thinkchina.sg/politics/bridge-too-far-thucydides-trap-and-limits-middle-powers) with the United States. Provisions governing military exercises, defense partnerships, or cooperation with external powers could create constraints that extend beyond managing disputes in the South China Sea. If drafted too broadly, the COC could inadvertently restrict ASEAN members’ ability to pursue their own security interests.

香港食物环境卫生署公布2026年10月第三批白纹伊蚊诱捕指数数据。该署报告在葵青区及元朗区发出三份关于积水的法定通告，并呼吁公众合作灭蚊，减少蚊患。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 23 日 18:56 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

香港食物环境卫生署（食环署）于2026年10月23日公布10月份第三批白纹伊蚊妊娠诱集指数数据。该指数监测可传播基孔肯雅热和登革热的蚊子种类。

食环署表示，会继续实施多管齐下的灭蚊措施，包括与相关部门及建筑地盘承建商、学校和物业管理公司等持份者举行特别专责小组会议，进行跨部门协调。该署还对蚊患较严重的地区进行有针对性的风险评估，加强巡查，清除现有和潜在的孳生地，使用杀蚊剂、喷雾杀死成蚊并设置诱捕器。
宣传和教育工作包括展览、传单和海报，以提高公众的认识。快速通报系统向已认购的小区发出警报，敦促物业管理人员和居民保持警惕，配合做好防控措施。

在跟进行动中，食环署向葵青区一个公共屋村及元朗区一个公园的责任人发出三份法定通知，要求限期清除积水或盛水容器。

卫生署呼吁公众参与防蚊工作，包括检查处所有无积水、清除水源、每周检查垃圾桶、花盆、冷气机托盘和晾衣架等家居用品、每周更换花瓶水和擦洗内部、盖上盛水容器、处理外卖盒和空罐等可盛水的物品，以及每周用碱性清洁剂擦洗排水沟和明渠以清除蚊卵。
自2025年8月起，食环署在完成调查后，会尽快透过新闻稿、网站及社交媒体公布个别监测区域最新的诱蚊器指数及密度指数，让市民更清楚掌握蚊患情况，加强灭蚊工作。该部门在社区的62个监测区域设置了陷阱，监测为期两周，每周收集陷阱，并在第一周和第二周后计算指数。

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

23 Oct 2026 at 18:56 HKT · 2 min read

Hong Kong's Food and Environmental Hygiene Department (FEHD) on 23 October 2026 released its third batch of Aedes albopictus gravid trap index figures for October. The index monitors the mosquito species that can transmit chikungunya and dengue fever.

FEHD said it continues to implement multi-pronged mosquito control measures, including inter-departmental coordination through special task force meetings with relevant departments and stakeholders such as construction site contractors, schools and property management companies. The department also conducts targeted risk assessments at areas with heavier mosquito infestations, carrying out intensified inspections, removing existing and potential breeding grounds, applying larvicide, fogging to kill adult mosquitoes and setting traps.

Publicity and education efforts involve exhibitions, leaflets and posters to raise public awareness. A rapid notification system alerts subscribed housing estates, urging property managers and residents to stay vigilant and cooperate on prevention and control measures.

During follow-up actions, FEHD issued three statutory notices to responsible parties at a public housing estate in Kwai Tsing district and a park in Yuen Long district, requiring removal of standing water or water containers within a specified period.

The department urged public participation in mosquito prevention, including checking premises for standing water, removing water sources, inspecting household items such as bins, flowerpots, air-conditioner trays and laundry racks weekly, changing vase water and scrubbing interiors weekly, covering water containers, disposing of items that can hold water such as takeaway boxes and empty cans, and scrubbing drains and open channels weekly with alkaline detergent to remove mosquito eggs.

Since August 2025, FEHD has been releasing the latest gravid trap index and density index for individual surveillance areas via press releases, its website and social media as soon as surveys are completed, to enable the public to better grasp the mosquito situation and strengthen control efforts. The department sets traps in 62 surveillance areas across the community, monitoring over a two-week period, collecting traps weekly and calculating indices after the first and second weeks.

zh_title: 官方媒体称西藏地震已造成16人死亡、46人受伤
summary: 中国官方媒体援引当地政府的消息称，西藏发生7.0级地震，造成至少16人死亡、46人受伤、300多间房屋倒塌。救援行动正在进行中，部署了数百名人员。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 23 日 12:54 香港时间 · 阅读 2 分钟 强烈地震官方媒体援引地方当局的消息称，该事件在中国偏远的西藏地区造成至少 16 人死亡、46 人受伤。
content:
中国
据中国官方媒体援引西藏地方当局的消息称，西藏发生7.0级地震，造成至少16人死亡、46人受伤、300多间房屋倒塌。救援行动正在进行中，部署了数百名人员。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 23 日 12:54 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

官方媒体援引地方当局的消息称，中国偏远的西藏地区发生强烈地震，造成至少 16 人死亡、46 人受伤。周四晚上 10:33（格林威治标准时间 1433）发生的 7.0 级地震中，超过 300 栋房屋倒塌。

官方通讯社新华社称，官员们仍在评估损失情况，救灾工作正在进行中。中国中央电视台（CCTV）援引当地官员的话说，受伤人数为 46 人，其中 11 人伤势严重，339 间房屋倒塌或损坏。

美国地质调查局称，震中位于那曲地区东北偏东约190公里、自治区首府拉萨东北390公里的山区。撞击深度约为10公里。震中位于巴庆县马如乡。据新华社报道，镇副镇长拉旺达波表示，镇政府明显有震感，办公室墙壁出现裂缝。
据央视报道，该地区已启动三级地震灾害应急响应。该机构表示，县城的电力和电信服务中断。据新华社报道，已派出300多名警力参与救灾工作，自治区消防救援总队已调集347名人员前往灾区。

中央电视台发布的视频显示，地震发生时，餐厅里的工作人员纷纷逃离，超市货架上的物品纷纷掉落。闭路电视画面显示，救援人员爬过受损的建筑物，其中一些建筑物的屋顶已经倒塌，并载着一名人员。它还显示救援人员用手电筒照射其他受损的建筑物，士兵们排队准备部署。

中国的地震比较常见。 2025年1月，西藏定日县发生地震，造成至少126人死亡。据官方媒体报道，2023 年 12 月，中国西北部偏远的甘肃省发生地震，造成至少 127 人死亡。

China
A 7.0 magnitude earthquake in Tibet killed at least 16 people and injured 46, with more than 300 houses collapsed, Chinese state media reported, citing local authorities. Rescue operations are underway with hundreds of personnel deployed.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

23 Oct 2026 at 12:54 HKT · 2 min read

A strong earthquake killed at least 16 people and injured 46 in China's remote Tibet region, state media said, citing local authorities. More than 300 houses collapsed in the 7.0 magnitude quake, which struck on Thursday at 10:33 pm (1433 GMT).

Officials were still evaluating the damage, and disaster relief work was ongoing, state news agency Xinhua said. China Central Television (CCTV) put the number of injured at 46, 11 of them seriously, with 339 houses collapsed or damaged, citing local officials.

The epicentre was located in a mountainous area about 190 kilometres east-northeast of Nagqu, and 390 kilometres northeast of the regional capital Lhasa, the US Geological Survey said. It struck at a shallow depth of around 10 kilometres. The epicentre was in Maru township in Baqen county. Township deputy head Lhawang Dagpo said the quake was clearly felt at the township office, which sustained cracks in the walls, according to Xinhua.

A level-III earthquake disaster emergency response was activated in the area, CCTV reported. Power and telecoms services were disrupted in the county seat, the agency said. More than 300 police officers have been dispatched for relief work while the regional fire and rescue corps has mobilised 347 personnel to the affected areas, Xinhua reported.

Videos posted by CCTV showed workers running out of restaurants and objects falling off shelves at supermarkets when the quake struck. Rescue workers clambered through damaged buildings, some with collapsed roofs, and carrying one person, footage on CCTV showed. It also showed rescue workers shining flashlights on other damaged buildings and soldiers lining up ready to be deployed.

Earthquakes in China are relatively common. In January 2025, at least 126 people were killed in an earthquake in Tibet's rural Tingri county. In December 2023, a quake in remote Gansu province in northwest China killed at least 127 people, according to state media.

title: China-Linked Hackers Use ARTEX AI Agents in ConnectWise Supply Chain Attack
zh_title: 与中国有关的黑客在 ConnectWise 供应链攻击中使用 ARTEX AI 代理
summary: [![图片1](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEgBGpr0x4Dn4VV8YVCO_s3CzzGvwmVUceHbt0llcvrzvBmWFaJcu9E9v3WntJGdez3PZ-53GAVSRiYc5FdSO gmyeCSXvpL2t5nCjhzJC50kTLhQygW8cCeFHqtZtDYHSG7Vx2uf1vVdobBbKJ5fcCKSNZDKpV 00GRQKVlD444srM9L4rcPnTe28nABZ3pon/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/chinese-ai.jpg )](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEgBGpr0x4Dn4VV8YVCO_s3CzzGvwmVUceHbt0llcvrzvBmWFaJcu9E9v3WntJGdez3PZ-53GAVSRiYc5FdSOg myeCSXvpL2t5nCjhzJC50kTLhQygW8cCeFHqtZtDYHSG7Vx2uf1vVdobBbKJ5fcCKSNZDKpV0 0GRQKVlD444srM9L4rcPnTe28nABZ3pon/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/chinese-ai.jpg) 显微
content:
[！[图片1](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEgBGpr0x4Dn4VV8YVCO_s3CzzGvwmVUceHbt0llcvrzvBmWFaJcu9E9v3WntJGdez3PZ-53GAVSRiYc5FdSO gmyeCSXvpL2t5nCjhzJC50kTLhQygW8cCeFHqtZtDYHSG7Vx2uf1vVdobBbKJ5fcCKSNZDKpV 00GRQKVlD444srM9L4rcPnTe28nABZ3pon/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/chinese-ai.jpg )](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEgBGpr0x4Dn4VV8YVCO_s3CzzGvwmVUceHbt0llcvrzvBmWFaJcu9E9v3WntJGdez3PZ-53GAVSRiYc5FdSOg myeCSXvpL2t5nCjhzJC50kTLhQygW8cCeFHqtZtDYHSG7Vx2uf1vVdobBbKJ5fcCKSNZDKpV0 0GRQKVlD444srM9L4rcPnTe28nABZ3pon/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/chinese-ai.jpg)

微软周三披露，一个被称为 **Storm-0940** 的中国国家合作者是 ConnectWise 云备份应用程序最近的[供应链泄露](https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/connectwise-resets-credentials-as-cloud.html) 的幕后黑手。

事件期间，Storm-0940 使用了 [ARTEX](https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/artex-ai-pentesting-tool-used-in-data.html)，这是一个基于 Go 的代理 AI 渗透测试框架，该框架在针对韩国金融机构的网络攻击中被滥用后已成为闭源，以加快对下游受害者的扫描和侦察、密码喷洒和 OAuth 应用程序滥用。
这家科技巨头表示，自 2026 年 9 月以来，威胁行为者以“机器速度”使用人工智能工具，对全球多个领域的数百个组织进行自动攻击。目标包括航空航天和国防、汽车、化学品、能源、金融服务、政府、法律、制造、媒体、军事、半导体、软件、技术、智囊团和非营利组织。

“Storm-0940 使用 ARTEX 加快了受感染应用程序滥用的速度，通过已被授予访问权限的应用程序对目标环境进行身份验证，从而允许威胁行为者无需交互式用户登录即可进行操作，”微软[说](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2026/10/21/storm-0940-uses-artex-agentic-ai-connectwise-supply-chain-compromise/)。

“人工智能加速的后续活动包括侦察、应用程序凭据更改以及尝试修改可实现扩展或持久访问的权限。”

Storm-0940 [首次由 Microsoft 详细介绍](https://thehackernews.com/2024/11/microsoft-warns-of-chinese-botnet.html) 于 2024 年 11 月，显示威胁行为者一直在利用名为 Quad7（又名 CovertNetwork-1658）的僵尸网络进行高度规避的密码喷射攻击。据评估，该威胁行为者至少自 2021 年起就处于活跃状态。
[！[图片 2：网络安全](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEh-69Sxi6ukfnlM_EpqEB_hRVymcXAcWTNAJetA9huKutPZuG0OOBUvByDCtP_HokC-gM-AzjX0ZhgneUFVzjCyIduRINFj6Yf0JX RFE17_z82UioyT9eoxH2-XQDoD_hInCxc8V2bQrmtnMN-GUR63bseKn7pLRISqlvUJlfuJq8pgCL-Fot7sQDas9 D05/s728-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/nudge-3-d.png)](https://thehackernews.uk/ai-agent-methods-d)

据称，攻击者还利用面向互联网的应用程序来获得初始访问权限，然后使用受感染的帐户在目标环境中移动。人们还观察到，通过向云基础设施中的现有 OAuth 应用程序添加凭据来建立持久性，以确保对 Microsoft 365 资源的访问。

据微软称，这些由 ARTEX 驱动的攻击中有很大一部分已导致对手获得对组织云基础设施的特权访问权限，包括严重的攻击。

【原文 English Original】
[![Image 1](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEgBGpr0x4Dn4VV8YVCO_s3CzzGvwmVUceHbt0llcvrzvBmWFaJcu9E9v3WntJGdez3PZ-53GAVSRiYc5FdSOgmyeCSXvpL2t5nCjhzJC50kTLhQygW8cCeFHqtZtDYHsG7Vx2uf1vVdobBbKJ5fcCKSNZDKpV00GRQKVlD444srM9L4rcPnTe28nABZ3pon/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/chinese-ai.jpg)](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEgBGpr0x4Dn4VV8YVCO_s3CzzGvwmVUceHbt0llcvrzvBmWFaJcu9E9v3WntJGdez3PZ-53GAVSRiYc5FdSOgmyeCSXvpL2t5nCjhzJC50kTLhQygW8cCeFHqtZtDYHsG7Vx2uf1vVdobBbKJ5fcCKSNZDKpV00GRQKVlD444srM9L4rcPnTe28nABZ3pon/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/chinese-ai.jpg)

Microsoft on Wednesday disclosed that a China state-aligned actor dubbed **Storm-0940** was behind the recent [supply chain compromise](https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/connectwise-resets-credentials-as-cloud.html) of the ConnectWise Cloud Backup application.

During the incident, Storm-0940 used [ARTEX](https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/artex-ai-pentesting-tool-used-in-data.html), a Go-based agentic AI penetration testing framework that was made closed-source in the wake of its abuse in cyber attacks targeting South Korean financial institutions, to speed up scanning and reconnaissance, password spraying, and OAuth application abuse at downstream victims.

The tech giant said the threat actor used the AI tool at "machine speed" to automate attacks targeting hundreds of organizations across the world spanning a broad range of sectors since September 2026. Targets include aerospace and defense, automotive, chemicals, energy, financial services, government, legal, manufacturing, media, military, semiconductor, software, technology, and think tanks and non-profits.

"Storm-0940's use of ARTEX accelerated the speed of compromised application abuse to authenticate to target environments through applications that had already been granted access, allowing the threat actor to operate without requiring an interactive user sign-in," Microsoft [said](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2026/10/21/storm-0940-uses-artex-agentic-ai-connectwise-supply-chain-compromise/).

"AI-accelerated follow-on activity included reconnaissance, application credential changes, and attempts to modify privileges that could enable expanded or persistent access."

Storm-0940 was [first detailed by Microsoft](https://thehackernews.com/2024/11/microsoft-warns-of-chinese-botnet.html) in November 2024, revealing that the threat actor has been leveraging a botnet called Quad7 (aka CovertNetwork-1658) to conduct highly evasive password spray attacks. The threat actor is assessed to be active since at least 2021.

[![Image 2: Cybersecurity](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEh-69Sxi6ukfnlM_EpqEB_hRVymcXAcWTNAJetA9huKutPZuG0OOBUvByDCtP_HokC-gM-AzjX0ZhgneUFVzjCyIduRINFj6Yf0JXRFE17_z82UioyT9eoxH2-XQDoD_hInCxc8V2bQrmtnMN-GUR63bseKn7pLRISqlvUJlfuJq8pgCL-Fot7sQDas9D05/s728-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/nudge-3-d.png)](https://thehackernews.uk/ai-agent-methods-d)

The adversary is also said to exploit internet-facing applications to gain initial access, followed by using compromised accounts to move through targeted environments. It has also been observed establishing persistence by adding credentials to existing OAuth applications within cloud infrastructures to ensure access to Microsoft 365 resources.

According to Microsoft, a chunk of these ARTEX-driven attacks have resulted in the adversary gaining privileged access to an organization's cloud infrastructure, including several instances where the time frame from initial targeting to privileged access was less than 3 hours.

In the case of the ConnectWise incident, Storm-0940 has been observed using ARTEX to attempt to sign in to more than 2,250 tenants at 2,900 sign-in attempts per minute, a pace the company said gives defenders a short window to detect and respond.

"Between October 10 and 14, 2026, Storm-0940 infrastructure at 144.172.64[.]99 conducted an automated cross-tenant password-spray campaign targeting 327 accounts across eight organizations to gain access to Microsoft 365 and Exchange Online," Microsoft said.

[![Image 3](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEh3Xc6KzPMPQKO3RtYF_6JEqjdfIY1bg3X-U2zaKO7_TwQzBDY6fsps3qphDQw-9EzTGDGM3kriLuztm4LxzE60yFDE3NVH3LV9p5VUg-oMLpBoPMrk38Uinn18tou_8tiBS6Gc4xO3W8COBOXGFkbkBgkli7YL8txxGUa6wZGNNVuEuM0fADa0cfkuZm2E/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/ar.jpg)](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEh3Xc6KzPMPQKO3RtYF_6JEqjdfIY1bg3X-U2zaKO7_TwQzBDY6fsps3qphDQw-9EzTGDGM3kriLuztm4LxzE60yFDE3NVH3LV9p5VUg-oMLpBoPMrk38Uinn18tou_8tiBS6Gc4xO3W8COBOXGFkbkBgkli7YL8txxGUa6wZGNNVuEuM0fADa0cfkuZm2E/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/ar.jpg)

During this window, Microsoft said it captured over 151,000 failed logon events. The activity peaked on October 11 at 2,900 failures per minute, resulting in more than 111,000 failures in a single day. Of these, 48 accounts received more than 1,000 failures. No successful authentication, token issuance, Graph call, or directory change was detected, it noted.

That changed on October 15, 2026, when the AI agents gained access to the identities of multiple ConnectWise cloud applications and began to use them to authenticate to customer environments.

"Additionally, after acquiring control of the identities of multiple ConnectWise cloud applications, the AI agents operating on behalf of the threat actor continued to use the same IP range to authenticate to customer environments using the illicit access acquired through these stolen app credentials, effectively taking advantage of the already established trust by these apps within a tenant," the tech giant added.

In some of these cases, the AI agents are assessed to have progressed beyond authentication to Microsoft Graph and directory operations. This included reconnaissance, application credential modifications to establish persistence, and changes involving identities, groups, and privileged roles.

[![Image 4](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEihyvW6Vi5XS9EzEem8mWZ6I1vdQwHj9pQWyIdJMAgk2HxEegqxF3tCKtOw7REdJ_V27mKU6pm6LbGcSKl5zkvy3wdEoNS3hbdGj9LnNXTuuR-g5cWisW5tp7YTHPJTJWEkyl2iDQAF2oAA9IU7tlw7d5n8hNuHwlSq49zCctuAkuI-omxB8NMByUzipUnd/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/zz.jpg)](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEihyvW6Vi5XS9EzEem8mWZ6I1vdQwHj9pQWyIdJMAgk2HxEegqxF3tCKtOw7REdJ_V27mKU6pm6LbGcSKl5zkvy3wdEoNS3hbdGj9LnNXTuuR-g5cWisW5tp7YTHPJTJWEkyl2iDQAF2oAA9IU7tlw7d5n8hNuHwlSq49zCctuAkuI-omxB8NMByUzipUnd/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/zz.jpg)
The TAG-217 attack chain | Source: Zscaler

"The application credential modification made by Storm-0940’s associated agents in the targeted victims' environments can lead to persistence through other identities, credentials, and cloud services," Microsoft said. "These changes can remain active as a backdoor even after the original compromised application is mediated."

Storm-0940 is far from the only hacking crew to rely on ARTEX. Microsoft said it has observed threat actors across multiple geographic regions weaponizing the framework in their operations.

Recorded Future Insikt Group, which is tracking the threat cluster behind the attacks on South Korean financial institutions under the moniker [TAG-217](https://www.recordedfuture.com/blog/tag-217-artex-south-korean-banks), said it identified activity linked to the hacking group dating back to August 17, 2026, when it "tested infrastructure designed to maintain remote access to computers and conducted internet scanning."

Over the next few weeks, the Chinese-speaking threat actor is said to have put together tools to attack cryptocurrency mining operations using the YiiMP platform, as well as set up a workspace for testing weaknesses in iPhones and modifying Android system software.

Zscaler ThreatLabz has since revealed that the attack's footprint extends beyond South Korea, and that it opportunistically targeted organizations around the globe and across multiple industry sectors. The findings come from a custom ARTEX deployment that included AI assistant configurations, synchronization scripts, network routing tools, and a Claude Code prompt history.

[![Image 5: Cybersecurity](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEjVV2rRkX8tRMF6gCzemvQNpwFwGxRWxY1cJEYfoLLSj1EZYJOlj5WTR77t0i6kELXujYcaHTpRDqTjCbVHH5Pnh7wzxUiKP5j4dsDkWIMlp2bmpZsL0jeAsA_19pHH5UPtyBvNkZdyGEULOAsXPcraMP5CYjQRFefhXRSdEjYkrdcpUnc4ILcvcdEfAauE/s728-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/tl-d.jpg)](https://thehackernews.uk/network-defense-d)

"ARTEX was configured to use a DeepSeek model through an OpenAI-compatible gateway, but other configurations also specified DeepSeek, GLM, and Grok," security researcher Seongsu Park [said](https://www.zscaler.com/blogs/security-research/inside-global-ai-assisted-hacking-campaign). "Prompts directed AI models to divide investigation tasks and review one another's findings, including instructions for GLM to review work performed by DeepSeek and its subagents."

An analysis of the prompt histories has revealed requests for bulk personal and transaction data, along with questions about selling stolen data, suggesting the attacks were likely financially motivated. Other prompts related to extracting payment gateway API keys, exploiting NFT minting workflows, and gaining unauthorized administrative privileges.

The findings once again highlight how threat actors are increasingly integrating agentic AI tools into their offensive security workflows to quickly carry out attacks at scale.

"Agents are not constrained by factors affecting humans – they can work around the clock, on weekends, and on holidays and attempt multiple breach paths simultaneously, enabling significantly reduced time from selecting a target to achieving objectives, increasing the speed and impact of complex attacks like supply chain compromises," Microsoft said.

In response to the findings, ConnectWise [said](https://www.connectwise.com/company/trust/advisories) the activity "describes a campaign that reaches well beyond any one company," adding "nation-state actors are increasingly targeting the software supply chain, because one trusted connection can open the door to many organizations."

"AI now lets them test those connections at [...] 'machine speed.' MSPs are in the middle of that chain. They are targets in their own right, and they are also a path into every client they serve. Every vendor and every MSP must defend itself with both of those risks in mind."

ConnectWise, which temporarily shut down services following the attacks, has been restoring services in phases, a process that it said will take several days.

title: China's election interference in Taiwan becomes more targeted: NSB - Focus Taiwan
zh_title: NSB：中国对台湾选举的干预变得更有针对性 - 聚焦台湾
summary: 中新社台北10月22日电 国家安全局(NSB)高级官员周四表示，中国对台湾的选举干预现在更多地集中在特定群体和受众上。例如，国安局局长蔡明彦表示，北京正在动员航空公司向部分居住在中国的台湾公民提供折扣机票，让他们回国参加 11 月份地方政府选举，为其支持的候选人投票。此外，蔡英文在立法院听证会前对记者表示，据信中国正在向其支持的候选人和政治团体提供非法资金
content:
中新社台北10月22日电 国家安全局(NSB)高级官员周四表示，中国对台湾的选举干预现在更多地集中在特定群体和受众上。

例如，国安局局长蔡明彦表示，北京正在动员航空公司向部分居住在中国的台湾公民提供折扣机票，让他们回国参加 11 月份地方政府选举，为其支持的候选人投票。

此外，蔡英文在立法院外交国防委员会举行听证会之前对记者表示，据信中国正在向其支持的候选人和政治团体提供非法资金，他计划于 2026 年下半年报告国家安全局的情报工作和运作情况。

蔡英文表示，国家安全局和其他情报机构正在积极调查涉嫌干扰案件，并确定了中国使用的几项关键策略，包括涉嫌贿赂台湾选民，为他们提供廉价的中国观光旅游机会。

他说，另一种可疑的策略是传播虚假信息和有争议的内容、经营非法投注池以及黑客攻击特定目标以窃取与选举相关的情报以进行有针对性的干扰。

蔡说，目前，国家安全局正在使用人工智能工具追踪虚假信息和相关内容的来源。
他补充说，国家安全局正在收集涉嫌干扰选举的证据，并希望在11月28日地方政府选举之前将其移交给司法当局进行调查。

蔡英文在周四向立法委员会提交的报告中表示，截至 9 月份，台湾政府服务网络 (GSN) 平均每天处理约 258 万次网络入侵尝试，比 6 月份报告的数字大幅增加。

他表示，国家安全局不排除活动增加与准备干预地方政府选举有关的可能性。

与此同时，当记者问到最近发生的以取笑中国国家主席习近平而闻名的喜剧演员黄逸豪因一场涉嫌编造的交通事故受伤事件时，蔡英文表示，这已经突破了台湾民主法治社会的严重底线。

新北检察官表示，这起事件是中国为了阻止黄的表演而煽动的。周三，几名人员在新北被起诉，其中包括一名据称策划了这起事故的中国公民，身份仅被称为“K”。

蔡英文周四告诉记者，中国的跨国镇压正在加剧，其策略从监视和暴力恐吓转向其他形式的骚扰，旨在逃避台湾的法律，包括涉嫌上演交通事故。
目前，该案的当务之急是加强对受害人的保护，确保责任人受到严惩。

（余明和柯林）

成品/件

【原文 English Original】
Taipei, Oct. 22 (CNA) China's election interference in Taiwan is now focusing more on specific groups and audiences, a senior National Security Bureau (NSB) official said Thursday.

For example, Beijing is mobilizing airlines to offer discounted tickets to select Taiwan citizens living in China to return home to vote in the November local government elections for candidates it backs, NSB Director-General Tsai Ming-yen (蔡明彥) said.

In addition, China is believed to be providing illicit funding to candidates and political groups it supports, Tsai told reporters ahead of a hearing in the Legislature's Foreign Affairs and National Defense Committee, where he was scheduled to report on the NSB's intelligence work and operations in the second half of 2026.

The NSB and other intelligence agencies are actively investigating the suspected interference cases and have identified several key tactics used by China, including suspected bribery of Taiwanese voters by offering them cheap sightseeing visits to China, Tsai said.

Another suspected tactic is spreading disinformation and controversial content, operating illegal betting pools, and hacking specific targets to steal election-related intelligence for targeted interference, he said.

Currently, the NSB is using artificial intelligence tools to trace the sources of disinformation and related content, Tsai said.

The NSB is collecting evidence of suspected election interference and hopes to hand it over to judicial authorities for investigation before the Nov. 28 local government election, he added.

In his report to the legislative committee on Thursday, Tsai said Taiwan's Government Service Network (GSN) was dealing with an average of about 2.58 million cyber intrusion attempts per day as of September, a sharp increase from the figure reported in June.

The NSB does not rule out the possibility that the increased activity was linked to preparations for interference in the local government elections, he said.

Meanwhile, when asked by reporters about a recent incident in which comedian Huang Yi-hao (黃逸豪), who is known for making fun of Chinese President Xi Jinping (習近平), was injured in an allegedly staged traffic accident, Tsai said it had crossed a serious line in Taiwan's democratic and rule-of-law society.

Prosecutors in New Taipei have said that the incident was instigated by China to stop Huang from performing. Several people, including a Chinese national identified only as "K" who allegedly planned the accident, were indicted in New Taipei on Wednesday.

Tsai told reporters Thursday that China's transnational repression was intensifying, with its tactics shifting from surveillance and violent intimidation to other forms of harassment intended to evade Taiwan's laws, including the alleged staging of traffic accidents.

At the moment, the priority in that case is to strengthen protection for the victim and to ensure that those responsible face severe punishment, he said.

(By Matt Yu and Ko Lin)

Enditem/pc

title: Hong Kong Star Ferry fares to rise by up to HK$1.80 from January
zh_title: 香港天星小轮票价一月起上涨至1.80港元
summary: 香港已批准上调票价，从明年 1 月开始，天星小轮乘客每次行程将多付 1.8 港元。 2020 年 8 月，一艘宣传黑白淡奶的天星小轮。照片：Ryan Ho Kilpatrick/HKFP。根据行政会议上周二批准并于周三公布的建议，平日票价将上涨0.60至1港元，而周末及公众假期的过海行程将上涨1至1.80港元。平日成人票价上限为港币 6 元，周末及公众假期上限为港币 8.30 元。
content:
香港已批准上调票价，从明年 1 月开始，天星小轮乘客每次行程将多付 1.8 港元。 2020 年 8 月，一艘宣传黑白淡奶的天星小轮。照片：Ryan Ho Kilpatrick/HKFP。根据行政会议上周二批准并于周三公布的建议，平日票价将上涨0.60至1港元，而周末及公众假期的过海行程将上涨1至1.80港元。平日成人票价上限为6港元，周末及公众假期上限为8.30港元，而月票票价则维持190港元不变。票价调整将适用于穿越维多利亚港的中环至尖沙咀及湾仔至尖沙咀航线，并于明年1月25日生效。持续亏损 天星小轮公司上一次提高票价是在 2023 年，该公司于 3 月份申请每趟票价上涨 0.8 港元至 2 港元，平均票价上涨 30%。政府接受了票价调整的请求，但裁定涨幅应适度。香港的天星小轮。资料照片：Kelly Ho/HKFP。政府发言人表示，这家拥有138年历史的公司“在2018年至2023年的六年期间累计亏损超过1亿港元，不得不依靠债务融资来运营其专营服务”。
另见：中东燃油压力下，香港巴士营办商寻求票价加价高达17.7% 发言人补充说：“虽然天星小轮在2024年和2025年录得边际利润，但未来几年将继续面临严峻的财务压力，预计从2026年开始将再次录得亏损，原因是客流量增长缓慢、成本压缩空间有限，以及运营成本和债务相关利息支出持续增加。” 政府表示，该标志性渡轮服务的表现一直是“令人满意的”，并鼓励不断努力通过非票价收入来提高其长期财务生存能力。加价后，天星小轮仍是最实惠的过海交通工具，票价较港铁或专营巴士低约30%至50%。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong has approved fare hikes that will see Star Ferry passengers pay as much as HK$1.80 more per trip starting from January next year. A Star Ferry vessel promoting Black & White Evaporated Milk in August 2020. Photo: Ryan Ho Kilpatrick/HKFP. Under a proposal approved by the Executive Council last Tuesday and announced on Wednesday, weekday fares will rise by between HK$0.60 and HK$1, while cross-harbour trips on weekends and public holidays will increase by between HK$1 and HK$1.80. Adult fares will be capped at HK$6 on weekdays and HK$8.30 on weekends and public holidays, while the cost of monthly passes will remain unchanged at HK$190. The fare adjustments will apply to both the Central-Tsim Sha Tsui and Wan Chai-Tsim Sha Tsui routes across Victoria Harbour, and will come into effect on January 25 next year. Continued losses The Star Ferry Company , which last raised its fares in 2023, applied in March for increases of HK$0.8 to HK$2 per trip – an average fare hike of 30 per cent. The government accepted the case for fare adjustments, but ruled that the rate of increase should be moderated. Hong Kong’s Star Ferry. File photo: Kelly Ho/HKFP. The 138-year-old company “recorded heavy accumulated losses of over HK$100 million during the six-year period between 2018 and 2023, and had to rely on debt financing to run its franchised services,” a government spokesperson said. See also: Hong Kong bus operators seek fare hikes of up to 17.7% amid Middle East fuel pressure “While Star Ferry recorded marginal profits in 2024 and 2025, it will continue to face severe financial pressure in the coming years and is expected to record losses again starting from 2026 due to slow patronage growth, limited room for cost-compression, and continuous increases in operating costs and debt-related interest expenses,” the spokesperson added. The government said the iconic ferry service’s performance had been “satisfactory” and encouraged ongoing efforts to improve its long-term financial viability through non-farebox revenue. After the fare increase, Star Ferry will remain the most affordable means of crossing the harbour, with fares about 30 to 50 per cent lower than the MTR or franchised bus fares.

# Expanding the Military Footprint: China’s New Air Base in Laos

Establishment of the Laotian base follows a pattern in China’s growing external military presence and access.

By [Rajeswari Pillai Rajagopalan](https://thediplomat.com/authors/rajeswari-pillai-rajagopalan/)

October 20, 2026

[](https://www.linkedin.com/shareArticle?url=https%3A%2F%2Fthediplomat.com%2F2026%2F10%2Fexpanding-the-military-footprint-chinas-new-air-base-in-laos%2F&title=Expanding+the+Military+Footprint%3A+China%E2%80%99s+New+Air+Base+in+Laos "Share on LinkedIn")[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Fthediplomat.com%2F2026%2F10%2Fexpanding-the-military-footprint-chinas-new-air-base-in-laos%2F "Share on Facebook")[](https://bsky.app/intent/compose?text=Expanding+the+Military+Footprint%3A+China%E2%80%99s+New+Air+Base+in+Laos%0Ahttps%3A%2F%2Fthediplomat.com%2F2026%2F10%2Fexpanding-the-military-footprint-chinas-new-air-base-in-laos%2F "Share on Bluesky")[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=Expanding+the+Military+Footprint%3A+China%E2%80%99s+New+Air+Base+in+Laos&url=https%3A%2F%2Fthediplomat.com%2F2026%2F10%2Fexpanding-the-military-footprint-chinas-new-air-base-in-laos%2F "Share on X")

Credit: [Depositphotos](https://manage.thediplomat.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/thediplomat_2024-07-19-131528.jpg)

Ad

As China’s power and self-confidence grows, it’s becoming much more active in projecting that power by establishing military bases abroad. The latest is at Ban Keun Airport near Vientiane, where China has established a joint support and training facility with Laos, according to a September [announcement](http://eng.mod.gov.cn/2025xb/D/V/16490652.html) by the Ministry of National Defense in Beijing.

It is the first overseas military facility that China has openly acknowledged, unlike the ones in Djibouti and Cambodia. This has several implications for the region.

But first, the base itself. Satellite imagery procured and analyzed by[CNN](https://edition.cnn.com/2026/10/08/asia/laos-china-airbase-cia-intl-hnk-ml) shows a 2,000-meter-long runway, taxiway, and parking apron for 22 aircraft. CNN also reports rapid construction at the site. Other media[reports](https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/attack-aircraft-military-vehicles-visible-new-china-laos-base-satellite-images-2026-10-06/) mention that satellite photos show eight aircraft, likely Chinese-Pakistani Hongdu JL-8 training and light attack jets (also called K-8s), and more than two dozen support vehicles. Laos[is known to own](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.1080/04597222.2025.2445477) this type of aircraft, but fewer than the eight seen at the facility. Laos could have bought more, or the extras may be Chinese.

China has said that the facility is strictly for training Lao air force pilots, “enhancing practical military cooperation,” and “promoting regional peace and stability.” This sounds reasonable enough, but it conflicts with China’s own previous positions on foreign military facilities. It has been a vocal critic of the global U.S. military presence.

Establishment of the Laotian base follows a pattern in China’s growing external military presence and access. China established its first overseas military facility in Djibouti in 2017, maintaining then and now that it is merely a logistical facility. This is still its most distant foreign military base, sitting astride the crucial waters overlooking the Bab al-Mandab strait leading to the Red Sea.

Closer to home, a Washington Post story in 2022 revealed that China was upgrading the Cambodian Ream Naval Base, with the Chinese military being given “[exclusive use](https://www.washingtonpost.com/national-security/2022/06/06/cambodia-china-navy-base-ream/)” of parts of it. China and Cambodia initially denied the report, but last year they formally inaugurated the facility. Soon warships from both countries visited it, conducting joint military drills. Though the base is not very far from China’s own territory, it’s on the strategically crucial Gulf of Thailand and thereby strengthens China’s position in the Indo-Pacific and particularly in the South China Sea.

With the Ream Naval Base in Cambodia and Ban Keun Air Facility in Laos, China now has both naval and aviation logistics hubs in the area.

There are at least four implications from the establishment of the base in Laos, both for neighbors such as Vietnam and the whole region.

First, sitting to the west of Vietnam, it gives China one more pressure point on that country. Vietnam already has a complicated relationship with China, with close economic ties but also significant territorial disputes.

Second, it adds an air power dimension to China’s foreign base activity. The two foreign bases that China previously built were both naval ones. The latest base at Ban Keun provides China’s air force with an air power footing in a strategically sensitive region. China can be expected to later extend the runway to support Chinese surveillance aircraft or bombers. Though Laos is land-locked, its long and narrow geography could provide China with an excellent site for monitoring activity across Southeast Asia.

Ad

Third, this represents a new type of military basing activity. For China, what matters is assured access. By packaging access as joint training facilities or disaster relief and humanitarian support hubs, Beijing secures a more lasting presence while avoiding the diplomatic and political cost of building traditional military bases. As far as China is concerned, it has created pretty much the same strategic effect without investing in a dedicated Western-style base of its own. title: Donate to Uyghur Cultural Preservation and Survival Through Education, organized by Nurnisa  Kurban
summary: Uyghur Cultural Preservation and Survival Through Education Funding goal: $10,000 The Uyghur people have been persecuted and subjected to repressive Chinese government policies in their Indigenous homeland of East Turkestan for many years.
content:
Uyghur Cultural Preservation and Survival Through Education

Funding goal: $10,000

The Uyghur people have been persecuted and subjected to repressive Chinese government policies in their Indigenous homeland of East Turkestan for many years. It is estimated that up to three million Uyghurs have been interned, imprisoned, and enslaved in detention centers, prisons, and forced labor facilities throughout China since 2017.

In 2021, the Uyghur Tribunal found that China was committing genocide and other crimes against humanity against Uyghurs. In 2022, the United Nations also concluded that China was committing human rights violations against Uyghurs amounting to crimes against humanity. Countries including the United States, Canada, the Netherlands, Czech Republic, United Kingdom, Lithuania, Belgium, and France have all declared a genocide in East Turkestan. Despite these declarations of genocide and related reports by various human rights organizations, atrocities against Uyghurs continue today with very limited international recognition and accountability.

During this time of ongoing genocide and cultural erasure in their Indigenous homeland, Uyghurs of the diaspora are working to preserve their culture and identity as a matter of survival. Uyghur education has been eradicated by the Chinese State, Uyghur texts are forbidden and in danger of being eliminated, and the Uyghur language itself is prohibited.

Uyghur scholars, linguists, and other specialists in the diaspora worldwide serve on the Uyghur Language and Education Committee of the Uyghur Academy to preserve the work of Uyghur intellectuals who have been persecuted and forcibly disappeared. This work has been ongoing since 2009 and is continuing to expand.

The Committee has created standards-aligned K-5 textbooks, which include classic and contemperory Uyghur literature, poetry, historical texts, and biographies for Uyghur children to learn about their own culture and identity in their native language. The Committee is seeking funding to expand and revise the existing K-5 textbooks, create teacher’s edition textbooks for educators, and design supplemental resources. They also hope to develop Middle and High School textbooks and related supplemental resources. To effectively implement these educational materials, they would also like to provide training for teachers.

Please consider supporting this urgent work of the Uyghur Academic Foundation as a matter of cultural survival for future generations of the Uyghur people.

References:

Thum, R. (2025, February). Eight years on, China’s repression of the Uyghurs remains dire.

United Nations Human Rights Office. (2022, August 31). OHCHR Assessment of human rights

title: 英国报告再吁释放黎智英 批港府扩大国安权力和对付海外港人 中方提交涉
summary: 文章来源：rfa 作者：香港特约记者 麦燕庭 自香港回归后，英国外交部每半年发表一份香港报告，检视香港落实《中英联合声明》及「一国两制」的情况，最新一份报告涵盖今年上半年。 7月才上任的英国外相文立彬（Ed Miliband，中台译作埃德·米利班德 ）在报告前言中特别提到黎智英被判监20年，对他持续被囚深感忧虑及不安，呼吁立即释放黎智英，并表明会在与中国及香港当局接触时，持续提出相关要求。他同时提到支联会案和黄之锋案，指有关案件进一步加深外界对国安法律适用范围日益广泛的忧虑。
content: 文章来源：rfa 作者：香港特约记者 麦燕庭 自香港回归后，英国外交部每半年发表一份香港报告，检视香港落实《中英联合声明》及「一国两制」的情况，最新一份报告涵盖今年上半年。 7月才上任的英国外相文立彬（Ed Miliband，中台译作埃德·米利班德 ）在报告前言中特别提到黎智英被判监20年，对他持续被囚深感忧虑及不安，呼吁立即释放黎智英，并表明会在与中国及香港当局接触时，持续提出相关要求。他同时提到支联会案和黄之锋案，指有关案件进一步加深外界对国安法律适用范围日益广泛的忧虑。 文立彬指出，香港作为领先国际金融中心的地位，对港人丶中国以至世界而言，都是重要资产，英国会继续支持在香港营运的英国企业，并在符合英国利益的情况下，加强与香港当局合作。但他强调，会与历任外相一样，希望香港继续繁荣发展，关注国安法律适用范围持续扩大，对港人的言论丶集会丶结社及新闻自由造成日益严重的影响，英国会继续捍卫香港人获承诺享有的权利与自由。 批不守《联合声明》言词软化 新一份半年报告共有36页，分为十多个章节，详细记录过去半年香港国安法律对港人权利与自由的影响。对比今年3月发表的上一份半年报告，英方对中国持续不遵守《中英联合声明》的判断未变，但上一份对北京及港府的批评措辞较为强硬，直指港府透过海外通缉及悬红等「跨国镇压」手段，试图压制海外异见港人的声音，形容有关行动完全不能接受，亦批评北京进一步控制立法会，令反对声音没有生存空间。 最新报告则以较长篇幅，记录香港在宪制丶基本权利与自由，以及不同国安案件方面的发展。除了上述三宗案之外，亦提到被港府通缉的海外社运人士郭凤仪，其父亲因企图处理属于「潜逃者」的资金或其他财务资产及经济资源，被裁定罪成，判监八个月。郭凤仪批评有关案件属于「跨国镇压」。报告亦记录国安处拘捕独立书店负责人及店员，涉嫌出售具煽动意图刊物的事件。 报告亦指出，港府修订《港区国安法》实施细则後，进一步扩大执法机关的调查及执法权力，包括要求提供电子器材的密码及解密资料丶限制出境丶扣押旅行证件，以及扣押和充公涉及国安罪行财产等。 报告亦记录港府以维护公共安全及国家安全为由，计划在今年底前于香港各区额外安装4000部监控摄影机，并利用人工智能（AI）加强影像分析，以及维多利亚公园自2019年后再没有举行六四烛光晚会，今年六四期间，警方曾截查丶搜查或短暂拘留少数参与悼念活动人士等情况。 英方在报告中亦关注，港府持续向海外异见人士采取国安措施。报告指出，截至今年6月，香港警方已就国安罪行向身处海外的人士发出合共34份通缉令，当中包括居于英国及其他司法管辖区的人士，部分人被悬红通缉，亦有人被撤销香港护照及指定为「潜逃者」。当中，一名被通缉人士今年5月在泰国因入境事宜被捕，可能面临遣返。翻查资料，此人应是指被港府指为非法组织的「香港议会议员」张信燕，她其後在加拿大政府斡旋下，於8月安全抵达加国。 在新闻自由方面，报告提到香港多间独立媒体及相关人士继续受到税务局的税务审查，并引述香港记者协会指出，有关税务审查对香港独立传媒及记者构成不必要的压力及不公平的惩罚。 香港「一五」反映北京要港更配合 报告亦不点名地关注在宏福苑火灾后发起网上联署而被国安处拘捕的中文大学学生关靖丰，他其后遭校方开除；以及成立于1958年的香港专上学生联会，因压力持续增加而宣布解散等事件，反映香港新闻及学术自由面对的压力。 另外，英方在新一份半年报告中，亦提到香港正制定首份五年规划，配合中国的「十五五」规划，反映北京进一步要求香港更紧密配合及融入国家发展重点。 英国在报告亦重提，英国今年3月在联合国人权理事会上，再次呼吁北京废除《国安法》，并停止检控所有根据该法被起诉的人士，包括黎智英等。 中国向英提交涉 再促停发报告 中方和港府在英国公开新一份《香港半年报告》后，反驳报告的内容。中国驻英国大使馆发言人批评英方不断炮制所谓「半年报告」，对香港事务说三道四，粗暴干涉中国内政，并已向英方提出严正交涉。中方强调，英国对回归后的香港已无主权丶无治权，也无监督权，没有任何资格和权利对香港事务横加干涉，要求英方停止发表所谓「半年报告」，以及停止干涉中国内政及香港事务。 港府则批评《香港半年报告》内容失实丶颠倒是非，污蔑抹黑香港各方面的情况，企图以政治操弄干预特区政府依法施政，强烈敦促英国遵从国际法及国际关系基本准则，立即停止干涉纯属中国内政的香港事务。
