zh_title: 国防、债务、外交：高市担任日本首相的第一年
summary: 周三是日本首相高市早苗上任一周年，她疏远了中国，以其庞大的支出扰乱了市场，并将自己塑造为一个工作狂领导人。日本首相高市早苗于 2026 年 10 月 5 日在东京国民议会众议院全体会议上发表讲话。照片：Yuichi Yamazaki/法新社。以下是关于日本第一位女首相及其迄今为止的执政时期需要了解的五件事。与中国发生争执的高一上台后不久，就提出了
content:
周三是日本首相高市早苗上任一周年，她疏远了中国，以其庞大的支出扰乱了市场，并将自己塑造为一个工作狂领导人。日本首相高市早苗于 2026 年 10 月 5 日在东京国民议会众议院全体会议上发表讲话。照片：Yuichi Yamazaki/法新社。以下是关于日本第一位女首相及其迄今为止的执政时期需要了解的五件事。与中国发生争执高一上台后不久，就建议日本可以在台湾遭到袭击时进行军事干预，此举激怒了中国。北京声称台湾是自己的领土。她的言论引发了一场外交争端，导致中国警告其公民不要前往日本并实施贸易限制。高市将国防置于其议程的首要位置，日本一直在加强亚洲的军费开支和安全合作，在外岛部署导弹发射器，努力获得“反击”能力，并放宽武器出口规则。尽管如此，高市在最近的一份施政报告中仍称北京为“重要邻居”，并承诺在敌对国家之间建立稳定的关系。一面台湾国旗。照片：总统府台湾，来自 Flickr。
这位极端保守派领导人还表现出足够务实的态度，没有亲自参拜一座供奉战死者（包括被定罪的战犯）的有争议的东京神社，这一举动可能会激起中国和韩国的愤怒。 高市政府的巨额政府支出计划和日本央行相对低调的利率令市场感到不安，并将日本基准债券收益率推升至三十年来的最高水平。这位领导人重申了对积极和负责任的财政政策的承诺，但她还寻求从明年开始削减食品消费税，尽管市场担心日本不断增加的债务是年经济产出的两倍多。到目前为止，她未能确定每年需要大约 5 万亿日元（320 亿美元）为其提供资金。外国人政策 尽管亚洲第二大经济体正面临劳动力短缺和人口萎缩的问题，但对过度旅游和与外国投资相关的土地价格飙升的抱怨促使高市推动加强对移民的控制。在她的指导下，日本本月收紧了永久居留权的规定，要求外国人拥有更高的年收入和更高的日语流利程度。宝藏门，日本东京著名的旅游景点。照片：维基共享资源。
除了一些游客的签证费近 50 年来首次大幅上涨之外，对商务经理签证持有者的资本要求也变得更加严格。 工作道德 自称是工作狂的高一在当选保守派执政党主席后宣称，她“应该工作、工作、工作、工作、工作”。她在一篇被广泛嘲笑为“炫耀”的 X 帖子中透露，她每晚的睡眠时间在零到三个小时之间，从而强化了这一形象。她还表示，有时她会安排凌晨 3 点举行员工会议。她喜欢在深夜独自阅读下班回家的大量文件，这意味着她花在喝酒和吃饭上的时间比她的男性前任要少得多——这打破了日本传统的“夜间政治”。接下来是什么？饰演 高一

【原文 English Original】
Wednesday marks the first anniversary of Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi’s leadership that has seen her alienate China, rattle markets with her expansive spending and establish herself as a workaholic leader. Japan’s Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi delivers a speech during a plenary session of the House of Representatives at the National Diet in Tokyo on October 5, 2026. Photo: Yuichi Yamazaki/AFP. Here are five things to know about Japan’s first woman prime minister and her time in power so far. Spat with China Soon after coming to power, Takaichi incurred China’s wrath by suggesting that Japan could intervene militarily in the event of an attack on Taiwan, which Beijing claims as its own territory. Her comment triggered a diplomatic spat that led to China warning its citizens against travelling to Japan and imposing trade restrictions. Takaichi has placed national defence at the top of her agenda and Japan has been beefing up military spending and security cooperation in Asia, deploying missile launchers to outer islands, moving to acquire “counterstrike” capabilities and easing rules on weapons exports. Still, Takaichi called Beijing an “important neighbour” in a recent policy address and pledged to build a stable relationship between the rival nations. A Taiwan flag. Photo: Taiwan Office of the President, via Flickr. The ultraconservative leader also proved pragmatic enough to refrain from visiting a controversial Tokyo shrine honouring war dead, including convicted war criminals, in person — a gesture that would have provoked fury in China and South Korea. Expansive government spending Takaichi’s programme of big government spending and the Bank of Japan’s relatively low-key interest rate have unnerved the markets and pushed Japan’s benchmark bond yield to its highest level in three decades. The leader has reiterated her commitment to a proactive and responsible fiscal policy, but she is also pursuing a consumption tax cut on food starting next year, despite market concerns about Japan’s mounting debts more than double annual economic output. So far, she has failed to identify around five trillion yen ($32 billion) needed annually to fund it. Foreigner policy Complaints of overtourism and soaring land prices linked to foreign investment sparked Takaichi’s push for tighter control on immigration, despite Asia’s number two economy grappling with labour shortages and a shrinking population. Under her tutelage, Japan toughened rules for permanent residency this month, with foreigners required to have higher annual incomes and greater fluency in Japanese. The Hozomon Gate, a popular tourist attraction in Tokyo, Japan. Photo: Wikicommons. Capital requirements for business manager visa holders were also stiffened on top of a sharp increase in visa fees for some tourists for the first time in nearly 50 years. Work ethic A self-proclaimed workaholic, Takaichi declared she “shall work, work, work, work and work” upon being elected the president of her conservative ruling party. She has reinforced that image by revealing in an X post — that was widely derided for “showing off” — that she sleeps between zero and three hours a night. She also said she sometimes schedules 3 am staff meetings. Her penchant for solitary, late-night perusal of reams of documents brought home from work means she has spent far less time than her male predecessors wining and dining — a break with Japan’s traditional “nighttime politics”. What’s next? As Takaichi faces another Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) leadership election next year, and with her lone-wolf tendency costing her intraparty support, the longevity of her government hinges for now on public backing. The latest opinion polls have suggested a slight dent in her popularity due in part to the resignation of her scandal-hit farm minister, but overall, her approval rates remain fairly strong at around 40 to 60 percent.

title: 那部毁掉文斯·沃恩演艺生涯的电影
source: 澳洲唐人街 – Australia ChinaTown News 中文华人新闻
summary: 想一想本世纪最经典的喜剧电影：《老学究》、《赌球风云》、《婚礼傲客》、《王牌播音员》。它们有什么共同点吗？ 如果你猜到了文斯·沃恩，那你猜对了。（如果你把他未露面的客串也算在内，还可以加上《超级名模》。） 在乔恩·费儒的独立电影《舞出我人生》中成名后，沃恩找到了自己的定位，主演了一系列至今仍备受喜爱的票房大片，总票房超过 20 亿美元。 多年来，沃恩一直是极具票房号召力的巨星，所以，为了不过分夸大其词，到底发生了什么？这位曾被《新闻周刊》称为“无敌”（懂了吗？）的好莱坞黄金男
content: 想一想本世纪最经典的喜剧电影：《老学究》、《赌球风云》、《婚礼傲客》、《王牌播音员》。它们有什么共同点吗？ 如果你猜到了文斯·沃恩，那你猜对了。（如果你把他未露面的客串也算在内，还可以加上《超级名模》。） 在乔恩·费儒的独立电影《舞出我人生》中成名后，沃恩找到了自己的定位，主演了一系列至今仍备受喜爱的票房大片，总票房超过 20 亿美元。 多年来，沃恩一直是极具票房号召力的巨星，所以，为了不过分夸大其词，到底发生了什么？这位曾被《新闻周刊》称为“无敌”（懂了吗？）的好莱坞黄金男孩，是如何从杂志封面、充满赞誉的采访和卖座电影，变成了一系列票房惨败、低预算作品，甚至最近主演一部与猴子合作的电视剧，并与唐纳德·特朗普合影的？ 欧文·威尔逊和文斯·沃恩在 2005 年电影《婚礼傲客》中共同主演。 故事是这样的。沃恩出生于明尼阿波利斯，18 岁时拍完一部大型汽车广告后，搬到了洛杉矶，希望立刻被发掘。然而，他在试镜路上走了七年，直到最终在备受赞誉的《舞出我人生》中担任主角。随后他出演了一系列角色，包括《侏罗纪公园：失落的世界》和与詹妮弗·洛佩兹合作的《移魂女郎》，直到 2003 年的《舞出我人生》让他迎来了事业的巅峰。这部 R 级喜剧让他成为喜剧明星，随后他又主演了《霹雳游侠》、《赌球风云》、《婚礼傲客》、《分手信》和《爱在旅途》，并在《史密斯夫妇》和获得奥斯卡提名的《荒野生存》中出演角色。 文斯·沃恩在 2004 年热门电影《赌球风云》中。 2005 年，沃恩在报道中被誉为“喜剧之王”，《纽约时报》报道说，由于他“炙手可热”，各大制片厂为他的下一个项目《分手信》展开了竞价。出价最高者支付了 1700 万美元，相当于今天的 3000 万美元。证明他星途多亮的是，詹妮弗·安妮斯顿也签约与他共同主演，两人后来还开始约会。 文斯·沃恩和詹妮弗·安妮斯顿在电影《分手信》中的一个场景。他们在现实生活中后来也开始了约会。 在这一时期的某本杂志专访中，这位演员被问及约会建议，并非常谦虚地说：“我对单身男士的唯一建议是：出去拍几部电影。这让事情容易多了。” 当时做文斯·沃恩真是太棒了。 他的星途第一个打击来自 2011 年的《致命约会》，该片耗资 1 亿美元制作，上映首周仅收获 2500 万美元。随后，他又主演了一系列预算同样巨大的作品，如《监视者》、《实习生》和《送货员》，结果都惨败。 2015 年，他的职业生涯遭遇了最糟糕的开局，电影《未了情》上映首周末仅收获 670 万美元，尽管耗资 5000 万美元。观众并不友好，该片在烂番茄上的评分仅为 10%，评论家称其为“愚蠢”、“绝望”和“无趣、荒谬且毫无目的”。 文斯·沃恩在电影《送货员》中的一个场景。 2015 年，沃恩尝试了一次人们希望他能借此重振旗鼓的举措，主演了《真探》第二季。这部黑暗犯罪惊悚剧的第一季让马修·麦康纳从浪漫喜剧男神转变为备受尊敬的演员，而沃恩作为职业罪犯出演第二季，似乎也是为了同样的目的。 读者：并没有。虽然沃恩的表演获得了一定程度的赞誉，但整个季度广受批评，未能吸引观众的关注。 随后，他主演了一系列真正令人遗忘的 B 级和 C 级项目，如《99 号牢房暴乱》、《拖过混凝土》、《与我的家人搏斗》和《瑟伯格》。 文斯·沃恩在《真探》第二季中的一个场景。 唯一的亮点是他在 2016 年的《血战钢锯岭》中担任配角，以及在 2020 年的讽刺恐怖电影《怪诞》中担任主角，该片现在在 Tubi 流媒体上播出，在烂番茄上的评分为 86%，并为他赢得了多年来的最佳评价。 然而， complicating 他的公众形象的是他直言不讳的持枪立场，包括错误地声称在《GQ》杂志上，大规模枪击事件“只发生在不允许枪支的地方”，如校园。他还表示，他认为应该在学校鼓励持有枪支。 “我支持人们在公共场所持有枪支，而不仅仅是家中。” 他在采访中还抨击了当代的好莱坞，2024 年告诉《纽约时报》，对于电影制作人和制片厂来说，“目标不是被解雇”。同年，他告诉《综艺》，“负责任的”喜剧是“无聊透顶的”。 今年在为 Theo Von 做播客时，他谈到好莱坞的政治氛围时说：“确实有一种文化，如果你不同意这些观点，就会被视为坏人。” 2020 年，他被拍到与唐纳德·特朗普握手，并作为嘉宾参加了特朗普 2025 年的就职典礼舞会。去年 4 月，白宫官方社交媒体账号发布了一张照片，显示沃恩和特朗普在椭圆形办公室合影，配文是一张恶搞版的《婚礼傲客》海报。 2024 年，沃恩多年来的第一部电视剧《坏猴子》在 Apple 播出，一位评论家说它“并不差”，第二季将于今年晚些时候上映。 尽管如此，今天的沃恩与我们记忆中那个令人印象深刻的男主角相去甚远，那个机智、举止随意的魅力人物。在 2024 年《时代》杂志的一篇专访中，作家描述与他交谈的经历是“最奇怪的明星采访之一”，并说这位演员将对话变成了“自助指南”。其中也有点老派沃恩的影子。他开玩笑地对《好莱坞报道者》说，关于他的《坏猴子》中与他合作的猴子，“我们合不来”和“我再也不会和它合作了”。 文斯·沃恩在 AppleTV+ 喜剧剧《坏猴子》中的一个场景。 还没有人问过猴子她是什么感觉。 还没有人问过猴子她是什么感觉。

title: Hong Kong enhances food waste collection, ferry oversight after audit
zh_title: 香港在审计后加强食物垃圾收集和渡轮监管
summary: 香港政务司司长陈家伟表示，环境保护署已改进厨余服务合同，并使用人工智能审查招标文件。运输署已成立专责小组，提高渡轮营办商的非门票收入，并加强对渡轮服务的监管 [![图 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，编辑行政长官 2026 年 10 月 21 日 11:51 HKT · 2 分钟读 香港政务司司长陈家良表示环境保护
content:
香港
香港政务司司长陈家伟表示，环境保护署已改进厨余服务合同，并使用人工智能审查招标文件。运输署已成立专责小组提升渡轮营办商的非票务收入并加强监管渡轮服务

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 21 日 11:51 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

香港政务司司长陈家强表示，环境保护署（环保署）正在根据审计署和立法会政府帐目委员会的建议，不断改善厨余管理。措施包括扩大收集网络、加强公众教育、加强餐厨垃圾污染物筛查以提高回收质量。

陈茂波在立法机关回应委员会的报告时表示，环保署在四月份制定了一系列监察指引，明确订明巡查准则和程序、违规评估，以及逾期提交报告的跟进程序。该部门还尝试使用人工智能协助审查招标文件，利用技术确保遵守政府采购准则。
环保署优化厨余收集服务合约的投标概算估价方法及评审标准，并于7月份招标的服务合约中落实相关程序。陈补充，该署会继续物色更多收集点地点，同时检讨现有收集点的运作情况，并按需要调整地点和服务时间。

就渡轮服务的规管和监察而言，陈肇始表示，运输署一直积极与营办商协调，落实增加非门票收入的措施。该部门已成立专门的工作小组进行跨部门协调，并审查增加非门票收入的商业活动建议以及码头升级建议。

就专营渡轮服务而言，陈茂波表示，运输署正积极与营办商商讨优化时间表，并监察船队保养及引擎进度，以提升服务表现。当局亦按照审计署的建议，加强巡查非专营渡轮航线，以更好掌握营运情况。
此外，运输署还制定了内部工作指引，采取了措施，并加强了对负责实地调查的顾问公司的监管。当局已提醒所有营办商在船只显着位置展示部门提供的标记，并在部门网站及主要公众码头张贴附有二维码的宣传海报，让市民随时查阅最新的非专营渡轮服务资讯。

Hong Kong
Hong Kong Chief Secretary Eric Chan says the Environmental Protection Department has improved food waste service contracts and used AI to review tender documents. The Transport Department has set up a task force to boost ferry operators' non-ticket revenue and strengthened monitoring of ferry servic

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

21 Oct 2026 at 11:51 HKT · 2 min read

Hong Kong Chief Secretary Eric Chan said the Environmental Protection Department (EPD) is continuously improving food waste management following recommendations from the Audit Commission and the Legislative Council's Public Accounts Committee. Measures include expanding the collection network, stepping up public education, and strengthening screening of contaminants in food waste to improve recycling quality.

Speaking in the legislature in response to the committee's report, Chan said the EPD drew up a series of monitoring guidelines in April, clearly specifying inspection criteria and procedures, assessment of violations, and follow-up procedures for late submission of reports. The department has also trialled using artificial intelligence to assist in reviewing tender documents, employing technology to ensure compliance with government procurement guidelines.

The EPD has optimised the tender estimate valuation methods and evaluation criteria for food waste collection service contracts, implementing the relevant procedures in service contracts tendered in July. Chan added that the department would continue to identify more sites for collection points while reviewing the operation of existing points and adjusting locations and service hours as needed.

On the regulation and monitoring of ferry services, Chan said the Transport Department has been actively coordinating with operators to implement measures that boost non-ticket revenue. The department has set up a dedicated task force for cross-departmental coordination and to vet proposals for commercial activities that increase non-ticket revenue, as well as suggestions for pier upgrades.

For franchised ferry services, Chan said the Transport Department is actively discussing with operators to optimise timetables and monitoring fleet maintenance and engine progress to improve service performance. It has also strengthened inspections of non-franchised ferry routes in line with the Audit Commission's recommendations to better grasp operational conditions.

Additionally, the Transport Department has formulated internal working guidelines, taken measures, and strengthened oversight of the consultant companies responsible for field surveys. It has reminded all operators to display markings provided by the department in prominent positions on vessels, and to put up promotional posters with QR codes on the department's website and at major public piers so the public can access the latest non-franchised ferry service information at any time.

title: 中国经济第三季度增长数字好看但暗藏风险
summary: 20日出版的法国全国性大报继续以大版篇幅聚焦10月17日示威抗议活动因大量暴力事件引发的关注，侧重政府的各项善后安排。财经报刊《回声报》在头版凸出打砸抢事件带来的经济损失；《费加罗报》和《十字架报》都特别梳理政府恢复秩序的措施是否奏效；《解放报》和《人道报》则从政府的善后措施中看到了更多的镇压作为。中国第三季度经济增长略有回升。《回声报》和《费加罗报》都刊登文章，分析这些数字背后的中国经济形势。《费加罗报》还特别刊登文章介绍中国大学毕业生就业难问题。《回声报》刊登文章梳理中国
content: 20日出版的法国全国性大报继续以大版篇幅聚焦10月17日示威抗议活动因大量暴力事件引发的关注，侧重政府的各项善后安排。财经报刊《回声报》在头版凸出打砸抢事件带来的经济损失；《费加罗报》和《十字架报》都特别梳理政府恢复秩序的措施是否奏效；《解放报》和《人道报》则从政府的善后措施中看到了更多的镇压作为。中国第三季度经济增长略有回升。《回声报》和《费加罗报》都刊登文章，分析这些数字背后的中国经济形势。《费加罗报》还特别刊登文章介绍中国大学毕业生就业难问题。《回声报》刊登文章梳理中国最新推出的涉及高科技出口限制措施。美国总统特朗普提议美中俄三国共同商讨如何结束乌克兰战争，《回声报》就此发表文章，分析中国明显偏向俄罗斯的所谓“中立”政策背后的逻辑。 法国报纸摘要 RFI 广告 《费加罗报》：中国经济对出口贸易的依赖暗藏风险 关于中国经济第三季度增长数字，《费加罗报》的文章强调，中国官方口中的中国经济韧性正越来越多的依赖出口。今年9月份，中国出口同比增长达到36.3%，预示2026年中国的对外贸易盈余可能会再创新高，而人工智能产业对此贡献颇多。但文章指出，在欧盟以及其它贸易伙伴纷纷采取措施应对中国产品的“第二次冲击”背景下，中国经济对出口贸易的依赖也暗藏着风险。文章引述一名不愿披露姓名的经济分析师指出，出口贸易对中国经济增长的贡献达20%甚至30%，这是自中国改革开放以来从未有过的现象。中国国内的价格大战迫使企业加强竞争，并在国际市场寻找获利，也反过来加剧国内市场的通货紧缩。上述专家指出，价格竞争导致企业不敢上调工资，对失业率形成压力，也最终反映到居民消费上。这是一个令人不安的恶行循环。尽管有些专家认为，中国总是能找到增长途径，但文章针对中美在人工智能领域的竞争引述另一名经济分析人士指出，认为时间在中国这一边的说法站不住脚。 《费加罗报》的另一篇文章以“深切的幻灭感”形容中国大学生找工作之难。文章指出，中国年轻人受教育程度从未如此之高，但今年8月，25岁以下年轻人的失业率达到18.9% 。学习好已经不足以吸引招工企业注意。他们需要不断争取各种实习来增强竞争资本，但经济不景气，稳定工作难寻。人工智能技术又为就业市场增添了新的不确定性。 《回声报》：中国经济最难的时候是 2027 年 《回声报》的文章特别强调，尽管中国经济第三季度略呈增长，但供需仍然失衡，中国还是要依赖出口，来吸纳国内市场无法吸纳的过剩产能。中国经济的另外两个传统引擎——房地产以及基础设施建设，目前依然情况不佳。文章预期中国2026年经济增长仍然能达到预期水平。但法国兴业银行中国市场分析师向《回声报》表示，中国经济最难的时候是2027年，增长率可能会低于4.5%。 《回声报》介绍中国近期推出的限制技术出口措施的文章指出，新措施涉及40项技术，显示中国正改变策略。但文章也写道，中国并不是简单的阻止成就其经济增长的高科技产品出口，而是想防范技术转让。有些国家，比如法国，已经开始对来自中国的投资提出技术转让的附加条件。但从地缘政治角度看，这项限制出口清单与中国官方立场背道而驰。在此之前，中国力图展现自己与美国以及欧盟的贸易保护立场不同，是主张贸易开放，并愿意与全球南方伙伴分享技术的国家。 《回声报》：中国亲俄“中立”意在阻止美国在印太部署 这篇由该报专注地缘政治问题的记者Stéphane Marchand撰写的文章指出，尽管中国面对乌克兰战争感到不安，但还是支持俄罗斯，目的是将美国困在欧洲，阻止美国向印太地区部署。倘若俄罗斯失败，对于习近平来说，那将是一次重大挫败。 这篇文章以今年9月一些媒体披露出的一家中国国企向俄罗斯提供46吨可用于生产碳纤维的化学品物资开篇，指出，碳纤维是制造更轻型、更结实、也更便于隐身、因此也杀伤力更强的无人机的材料。这则消息曝光对自称立场“中立“的中国来说本应有些尴尬，但是，几乎与此同时，乌克兰首都一家智库公布的报告显示，95%的乌克兰无人机制造商仍然在使用来自中国的物资。而且欧洲联盟虽然无法向乌克兰提供关键武器，但允许乌克兰利用欧盟的60亿欧元援助款项，购买非欧盟产无人机，而这些非欧盟产无人机主要是产自中国。 文章因此认为，习近平领导下的中国可以说基本上保持了一种平衡，成功地让原来的老大哥俄罗斯在经济上成为附庸，但又拒绝批准西伯利亚2号输油管计划，以便保证自身的能源独立。同时，中国从未承认莫斯科对克里米亚以及其它四个乌东地区的兼并，而且依然是乌克兰第一大贸易伙伴，向乌克兰出售其对俄战争所需要的重要组件物资。 文章认为，所谓中俄友好无上限开始显露出它的局限性。2023年4月，俄罗斯宣布向白俄罗斯部署战术核弹头，而在此之前几天，中俄两国才刚刚签署协议，承诺避免此类武器的对外部署。中国在中亚地区的推进也并非普京政权所乐见。2023年，中国倡议发起中国与中亚领导人峰会更凸显出俄罗斯在该地区的挫败。 那么，中国为什么继续支持俄罗斯呢？文章写道，北京当局希望阻止美国让中俄两国脱钩，因为那样，美国将可以全力应对与中国的对抗。长期来看，中国的野心并不是取代美国，而是要将美国从世界格局的中心赶出去。目前尚难看出中国是否会为乌克兰重回和平发挥作用。目前的这种亲俄“中立”政策的结果尚难定论，但这场战争对中国来说还非常有用。 作者： 瑞迪

China’s state-led funds stepped into the market with the heaviest buying since the April 2025 rout, as authorities ramped up efforts to [stem](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-23/china-stocks-sink-deeper-into-bear-market-despite-state-buying) a market freefall.

Inflows into nine exchange-traded funds known to be actively traded by the national team reached 128.7 billion yuan ($19 billion) last week, according to data compiled by Bloomberg. That’s the most since the nearly 140 billion yuan recorded during April 2025, when US President Donald Trump’s trade war battered markets and Beijing took a slew of [actions](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2025-04-08/china-vows-to-fight-to-the-end-if-us-insists-on-new-tariffs) to prop up investor sentiment.

## **Takeaways** by Bloomberg AI[Subscribe](https://news.google.com/subscriptions)

He Jinbi, one of the biggest names in Chinese copper trading, has been sentenced to life in prison over fraud and other offenses committed by the company he founded, [Maike Metals International Co.](https://www.bloomberg.com/quote/0387958D:CH)

A court in the western Chinese city of Xi’an found Maike guilty of contract fraud, bribery and other offenses last month, and handed its 61-year-old boss, He, a life sentence, according to people familiar with the verdict. The ruling found Maike’s conduct had exposed several Chinese banks to more than $1 billion of potential losses, the people added, asking not to be named due to the sensitivity of the issue.

title: Hong Kong tourism plan aims to boost spending, extend stays
zh_title: 香港旅游计划旨在增加消费、延长停留时间
summary: 香港文化体育及旅游局局长罗淑娜制定了一项五年计划，到2030年将旅游业的年增加值从862亿港元提高到1,260亿港元，利用文化活动、当地社区和多元化景点，将游客人数转化为经济收益。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 26 日香港时间 06:02 · 2 分钟阅读秘书文化、体育及旅游 罗淑佩认为香港
content:
香港
文化体育及旅游局局长罗姗娜制定了一项五年计划，到2030年将旅游业的年度增加值从862亿港元提高到1,260亿港元，利用文化活动、当地社区和多元化景点，将游客人数转化为经济收益。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 26 日 06:02 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

文化体育及旅游局局长罗淑佩认为，香港的鲜明对比——商务会议、乡村远足和节日——可以说服游客停留更长时间、花更多钱并返回。随着香港推出第一个五年旅游计划，罗正押注于文化活动和当地社区，以将游客人数转化为经济收益。

罗说，2026年前9个月，香港接待了4070万人次游客，其中国庆黄金周期间有141万人次内地游客。政府的目标是到2030年将旅游业的年度增加值从2024年的862亿港元提高到1,260亿港元，并希望来自中国大陆以外的游客占过夜游客的40%。
为了传播好处，罗引用了旅游局发起的“品味香港”活动，该活动推荐了所有 18 个地区的餐馆，从茶餐厅到街头小吃摊。另一项名为“Hong Kong Good Take”的活动将绘制约 100 个电影拍摄地的地图，将影迷带入不同的社区。罗说，大约五分之一的中国境外游客会继续前往大陆，但她坚称这座城市不仅仅是一个中途停留地。

香港全年都有国际艺术、中国文化节目和大型节庆活动，为您提供了不同的回归理由。罗说，中秋国际灯会吸引了约73万人次参观，而圣诞节庆祝活动和新年倒计时之后，林村许愿树和黄大仙祠将举行农历新年传统活动。她说，其目的是通过独特的、限时的体验来产生“FOMO”（害怕错过的恐惧）。

根据拟议的资金改革，主要表演艺术团体将根据其过去的出席率进行评估，而不是根据其他学科进行评估。艺术素质以及在海外或内地演出的机会也很重要。在电影方面，罗希望巩固支持计划并吸引私人投资，认为香港电影必须与电影观众重新建立联系。在体育方面，启德体育公园定期举行的国际比赛可以鼓励围绕体育赛事的旅行，而新的培训计划将帮助退休运动员追求体育管理的职业生涯。
罗透露，她把拳击作为一种爱好，定期参加课程，并称自己是一名喜欢传统中餐馆和老式面包店的美食家。她徒步旅行，回忆起穿越大屿山的六个小时的长途跋涉，并希望尝试去离岛露营或豪华露营——这是她希望实现的儿时愿望。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

主编

负责 CLB.org.hk 报道和编辑标准的主编。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law outlined a five-year plan to raise tourism's annual value added from HK$86.2 billion to HK$126 billion by 2030, leveraging cultural events, local neighborhoods and diversified attractions to turn visitor arrivals into economic gains.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

26 Oct 2026 at 06:02 HKT · 2 min read

Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law Shuk-pui believes Hong Kong's contrasts – business meetings, countryside hikes and festivals – can persuade travellers to stay longer, spend more and return. As Hong Kong launches its first five-year tourism plan, Law is betting on cultural events and local neighbourhoods to turn visitor arrivals into economic gains.

Hong Kong welcomed 40.7 million visitors in the first nine months of 2026, including 1.41 million mainland travellers during National Day Golden Week, Law said. The government aims to raise tourism's annual value added from HK$86.2 billion in 2024 to HK$126 billion by 2030, and wants visitors from outside mainland China to account for 40 per cent of overnight tourists.

To spread benefits, Law cited Taste Hong Kong, a Tourism Board campaign recommending eateries across all 18 districts, from cha chaan teng to street-food stalls. Another campaign, Hong Kong Good Take, will map about 100 film locations, bringing fans into different neighbourhoods. About one in five visitors from outside China travels onward to the mainland, Law said, but she insisted the city is more than a stopover.

Hong Kong's year-round calendar of international arts, Chinese cultural programmes and festive mega events offers different reasons to return. The Mid-Autumn International Lantern Spectacular drew about 730,000 visits, Law said, while Christmas celebrations and the New Year countdown are followed by Lunar New Year traditions at the Lam Tsuen wishing tree and Wong Tai Sin Temple. The aim, she said, is to generate FOMO – fear of missing out – through unique, time-limited experiences.

Under proposed funding reforms, major performing arts groups would be assessed on their own past attendance, not against other disciplines. Artistic quality and opportunities to perform overseas or on the mainland would also count. In film, Law wants to consolidate support schemes and attract private investment, arguing that Hong Kong cinema must reconnect with moviegoers. In sports, regular international tournaments at Kai Tak Sports Park could encourage trips around sporting events, while a new training scheme would help retired athletes pursue careers in sports management.

Law revealed she has taken up boxing as a hobby, attends regular classes, and describes herself as a foodie who enjoys traditional Chinese restaurants and old-fashioned bakeries. She hikes, recalling a six-hour trek across Lantau, and hopes to try camping or glamping on an outlying island – a childhood wish she hopes to fulfil.

[![Image 3: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

# Eastern Taiwan may see heavy rain as Champi heads to Japan: CWA

CNA photo Oct. 24, 2026

Taipei, Oct. 25 (CNA) Eastern Taiwan could still see localized showers, with heavy rain possible in Hualien and Taitung counties, as Tropical Storm Champi weakens and moves farther away from Taiwan and toward Japan, the Central Weather Administration (CWA) said Sunday.

Northern Taiwan will see cloudy skies after brief showers on Sunday, while central and southern Taiwan will be mostly cloudy to sunny, with a chance of afternoon showers in mountainous areas and heavy rain possible in mountainous parts of southern Taiwan, the CWA said.

Daytime temperatures will range from 27 to 30 degrees Celsius in northern Taiwan and from 30 to 32 degrees in central and southern Taiwan, while nighttime lows will fall to 22-25 degrees, the agency said.

Localized showers are expected to persist in eastern Taiwan on Monday, while areas north of Taoyuan may see scattered showers, the CWA forecast.

The rest of the country will be mostly cloudy to sunny, with brief, scattered showers possible in mountainous parts of southern Taiwan, the CWA said.

On Tuesday and Wednesday, strengthening seasonal northeasterly winds will bring cooler temperatures to northern Taiwan, along with showers in eastern Taiwan, areas north of Taoyuan and the Hengchun Peninsula in the south.

Other parts of the island will see mostly cloudy to sunny skies, although brief afternoon showers are possible in mountainous parts of central and southern Taiwan, the CWA said.

As the seasonal winds weaken on Thursday and Friday, mostly cloudy to sunny conditions are expected to return across Taiwan, the CWA said.

As of 8 a.m. Sunday, Champi was located east-northeast of Taiwan and moving northeast toward Japan at 24 kilometers per hour, according to the CWA. Tropical Storm In-Fa was about 5,000 kilometers from Taiwan and was not expected to have a direct impact on the island.

# Recovering from Religion Support Group Meeting - South Carolina Chapter

[![Image 7: Photo of the user Charles Hammond](https://secure.meetupstatic.com/photos/member/c/b/8/6/thumb_325252102.jpeg?w=96) Hosted by Charles H. and 2 others Recovering from R. is a Super Organizer](https://www.meetup.com/rfr-south-carolina-chapter/events/316772548/attendees/)

## Details

The South Carolina Chapter Recovering from Religion support group will meet the fourth Wednesday or each month at 6pm Eastern. **This meeting will be held in-person at the We Are Family community room located at 3265 North Carolina Avenue, Suite 202 in North Charleston.** Attendees are welcome to share, but may also decide to remain anonymous if they so choose.

Light refreshments will be provided. Please contact one of the event hosts if you have any questions or concerns ahead of the meeting.

The primary focus of a Recovering from Religion support group is to provide ongoing support to individuals as they let go of their religious beliefs. This transitional period is an ongoing process that can result in a range of emotions, as well as a ripple effect of consequences throughout an individual’s life. As such, the support meetings are safe and anonymous places to express these doubts, fears, and experiences without biased feedback or proselytizing.
 We are here to help each other through this journey.

There is no cost to attend this support group but, if you feel so inclined, donations can be made at [www.recoveringfromreligion.org/donate](http://www.recoveringfromreligion.org/donate)

If you'd like to provide confidential feedback for this meeting, click here [https://forms.gle/yhC7frShmyrRS56G7](https://forms.gle/yhC7frShmyrRS56G7)

If you find you need to talk with someone before the next support meeting, RfR has a hotline and online chat for that express purpose. Call [844-368-2848](http://tel:+18443682848/) to speak with someone. To chat online, go to [www.recoveringfromreligion.org](http://www.recoveringfromreligion.org/) and click on the green chat bubble in the lower left corner of the site.

If you are in need of professional help, we can recommend the Secular Therapy Project to provide options to connect with a professional therapist. All therapists have been thoroughly vetted by our organization and offer only evidence-based and non-religious treatment. Connect with them at [www.seculartherapy.org.](http://www.seculartherapy.org./)

Like what RfR does? Why not volunteer! There are quite a few options. Head over to [RfR Volunteer Form](https://www.recoveringfromreligion.org/volunteer) for more info.

content:
香港
香港财政司司长陈茂波表示，已有142家重点企业在香港设立或扩建，截至9月底，前六批投资额达283亿港元，超出目标30%。第七批18家企业包括来自瑞士和深圳的黄金精炼企业

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 25 日 10:27 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

香港财政司司长陈茂波表示，香港重点企业招商办公室已迎来第七批18家企业，其中一半来自中国大陆以外的企业，其中许多企业的市值或估值超过1000亿港元。加上前六批，共有142家重点企业在港落户或扩建，预计未来几年将为港带来投资约840亿港元，并创造约27,000个就业机会。

陈说，投资正在逐步落实。截至上月底，前六批企业实际投资283亿港元，就业人数超过10,300人，分别超出原定阶段目标30%和34%。他表示，这表明企业对香港的信心越来越体现在实体经济上。
陈先生在博客中写道，前六批企业使用了283万平方英尺的商业和工业建筑面积，比去年3月增长了50%以上，反映了投资产生的真实需求。政府近期拟向新界科学城公司注入100亿港元初始资金，加快土地整理和一期工业设施建设，为更多科研和工业项目创造条件。

前六批中，约70%在香港设立全球或地区总部，近90%在香港设立研发中心，带来资金、就业机会以及决策、研发和业务协调功能。陈表示，这是将企业投资转化为香港长期竞争力的关键。

陈肇始表示，新一批企业的发展计划体现了落户香港的实实在在的好处，凸显了它们对生物医药发展的推动作用。他表示，企业带来了研发和应用需求，大学和医院提供了研究能力、临床环境和专业知识，参与者积累了经验。这些合作证明企业投资正在转化为当地的创新能力。
新一批企业还包括来自瑞士和深圳的黄金提炼企业，计划在香港发展黄金提炼、储存和贸易业务，有助加强香港的黄金供应链。

另外，陈茂波表示，他昨日出席科学园创新科技嘉年华开幕礼，首次设有太空专区，了解本地大学团队支援国家太空任务的研究项目。他表示，本地研究在国际舞台和实际应用中取得成果，不少本地科技初创公司的产品和技术进入海外市场，显示香港的研究能力和创新理念正在逐步发展。

Hong Kong
Hong Kong Financial Secretary Paul Chan said 142 key enterprises have set up or expanded in the city, with the first six batches investing HK$28.3 billion by end of September, exceeding targets by 30 per cent. The seventh batch of 18 firms includes gold refiners from Switzerland and Shenzhen, boosti

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

25 Oct 2026 at 10:27 HKT · 2 min read

Hong Kong's Financial Secretary Paul Chan said the city's office for attracting key enterprises has welcomed a seventh batch of 18 firms, half of them from outside mainland China, with many having a market capitalisation or valuation exceeding HK$100 billion. Together with the previous six batches, a total of 142 key enterprises have set up or expanded in Hong Kong, expected to bring about HK$84 billion in investment and create some 27,000 jobs in the coming years.

Chan said investment was gradually being realised. By the end of last month, the first six batches of enterprises had actually invested HK$28.3 billion and employed more than 10,300 people, exceeding original phased targets by 30 per cent and 34 per cent respectively. He said this showed that business confidence in Hong Kong was increasingly reflected in the real economy.

Writing in his blog, Chan noted that the first six batches of enterprises used 2.83 million square feet of commercial and industrial floor space, up more than 50 per cent from March last year, reflecting real demand for space arising from investment. The government recently proposed injecting HK$10 billion in initial funds into the New Territories Science City company to accelerate land preparation and first-phase industrial facilities construction, creating conditions for more research and industrial projects.

Among the first six batches, about 70 per cent set up global or regional headquarters in Hong Kong, and nearly 90 per cent set up research and development centres, bringing funds and jobs as well as decision-making, R&D and business coordination functions. Chan said this was key to converting enterprise investment into long-term competitiveness for Hong Kong.

The new batch of enterprises' development plans showed the tangible benefits of setting up in Hong Kong, Chan said, highlighting their role in driving biomedical development. He said enterprises brought R&D and application needs, while universities and hospitals provided research capabilities, clinical settings and expertise, with participants accumulating experience. These collaborations were proof that enterprise investment was being converted into local innovation capabilities.

The new batch also included gold refining enterprises from Switzerland and Shenzhen, planning to develop gold refining, storage and trading businesses in Hong Kong, helping strengthen the city's gold supply chain.

Separately, Chan said he attended the opening ceremony of the Innovation and Technology Carnival at Science Park yesterday, which for the first time featured a space zone where he learned about local university teams' research projects supporting national space missions. He said local research was achieving results on international stages and in practical applications, with many local tech startups' products and technologies reaching overseas markets, showing that Hong Kong's research capabilities and innovative ideas were gradually being converted into tangible benefits and business opportunities.

title: Hong Kong man arrested in Shek Kip Mei Park for alleged cat poisoning spree
zh_title: 香港男子涉嫌毒杀猫在石硖尾公园被捕
summary: 香港 一名 34 岁男子因涉嫌在流浪猫粮中添加老鼠药而被动物保护志愿者抓获。警方在他身上发现了一把14厘米的水果刀。嫌疑人何姓，因涉嫌虐待动物和持有武器罪而被拘留。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 24 日 18:00 HKT · 2 分钟阅读 A 10月24日星期六，34岁男子在石硖尾公园被捕
content:
香港
一名 34 岁男子在香港因涉嫌在流浪猫粮中添加老鼠药而被动物保护志愿者抓获。警方在他身上发现了一把14厘米的水果刀。嫌疑人何姓，因涉嫌虐待动物和持有武器罪而被拘留。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 24 日 18:00 香港时间 · 阅读 2 分钟

10月24日星期六，一名34岁男子在石硖尾公园被捕，动物保护志愿者发现他涉嫌在流浪猫食碗中添加啮齿动物毒药，警方随后在他身上发现一把14厘米水果刀。

警方在该街区连续数月多次投毒企图后，因涉嫌虐待动物和持有攻击性武器而拘留了这名何姓嫌疑人。

定期在公园 100 米范围内喂养社区猫的动物福利志愿者在 8 月中旬首次注意到可疑活动。救援人员多次发现两个喂食碗被一种不明的黑色污泥状物质污染。当志愿者随后发现猫粮中混有疑似商业老鼠药的蓝色颗粒时，人们的担忧进一步升级，引发了人们对当地动物遭受痛苦死亡的担忧。
为了找出罪魁祸首，志愿者在喂食区附近安装了隐蔽的闭路电视摄像头，进行全天候监视。录音很快就突出显示了一名穿着专业跑步装备的 30 多岁男子，他经常在深夜出现，用手电筒检查喂食碗，然后可疑地徘徊。在他夜间访问后，早上的检查不断发现新鲜受污染的食物，导致志愿者怀疑他利用深夜慢跑作为掩护来毒害动物。

10月18日凌晨2点左右拍摄的监控录像详细记录了嫌疑人的作案过程。视频显示，跑步者走近一个食物碗，撕开一包粉末，将所有内容物倒入食物中，并用手彻底搅拌。然后，他将丢弃的包装纸塞进跑步背心，然后溜走。

10 月 24 日凌晨，行动达到高潮，实时监控显示跑步者返回公园并乱动两个喂食碗。几名埋伏在那里的动物福利志愿者介入，在该男子离开之前将其拦截，将其当场拘留，并用手机记录了对峙过程，并拨打了紧急服务电话。
当救援人员询问时，该男子最初一再否认，然后坐在路边声称他只是想保持该地区的清洁。救援人员立即拒绝了他的借口，认为让动物在公共人行道上痛苦地死去会导致更大的混乱，同时也驳回了他随后的说法，即他相信猫实际上不会吃加了有毒物质的食物。警方随后赶到并进行搜查，在何身上发现了藏匿的老鼠药和一把14厘米的水果刀。案件现交由深水埗警区重案组第三队深入调查。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
A 34-year-old man was arrested in Hong Kong after animal protection volunteers caught him allegedly spiking stray cat food with rat poison. Police found a 14-centimetre fruit knife in his possession. The suspect, surnamed Ho, is being held on suspicion of animal cruelty and weapon offences.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

24 Oct 2026 at 18:00 HKT · 2 min read

A 34-year-old man was arrested in Shek Kip Mei Park on Saturday 24 October after animal protection volunteers caught him allegedly spiking stray cat food bowls with rodent poison, with police subsequently discovering a 14-centimetre fruit knife in his possession.

Officers detained the suspect, surnamed Ho, on suspicion of cruelty to animals and possession of an offensive weapon following months of recurring poisoning attempts in the neighbourhood.

Animal welfare volunteers who regularly feed community cats within a 100-metre stretch of the park first noticed suspicious activity in mid-August. Rescuers repeatedly discovered that two feeding bowls had been contaminated with an unidentified black sludge-like substance. Concerns escalated when volunteers subsequently found blue pellets suspected to be commercial rat poison mixed into the cat food, prompting fears that local animals would suffer agonising deaths.

To identify the culprit, volunteers installed concealed closed-circuit television cameras near the feeding area for round-the-clock surveillance. The recordings quickly highlighted a man in his 30s dressed in professional running gear who routinely appeared late at night, using a flashlight to inspect the feeding bowls before lingering suspiciously. Morning inspections consistently revealed freshly contaminated food following his nocturnal visits, leading volunteers to suspect he was using his late-night jogs as cover to poison the animals.

Surveillance footage captured around 2am on 18 October documented the suspect's method in detail. The video showed the runner approaching a food bowl, ripping open a packet of powder, emptying the entire contents into the food, and stirring it thoroughly by hand. He then tucked the discarded wrapper into his running vest before slipping away.

The operation reached a climax in the early hours of 24 October when real-time monitors showed the runner returning to the park and tampering with both feeding bowls. Several animal welfare volunteers waiting in ambush moved in and intercepted the man before he could leave, detaining him on the spot, recording the confrontation on mobile phones, and calling emergency services.

When questioned by rescuers, the man initially offered repeated denials before sitting on the roadside and claiming that he had merely wanted to keep the area clean. Rescuers immediately rejected his excuse, arguing that causing animals to die painfully on public walkways would result in a far greater mess, while also dismissing his subsequent claim that he believed the cats would not actually eat the spiked food. Police officers arrived shortly afterward and conducted a search, discovering a stash of rat poison and a 14-centimetre fruit knife on Ho. The case is now being handled by the third team of the Sham Shui Po District Crime Squad for in-depth investigation.

summary: 香港恒基兆业地产首次亮相香港美酒佳肴巡礼，并以 2,000 平方英尺的展馆作为其 50 周年庆典的一部分。该展示中心设有 12 家餐厅和酒吧，由扎哈·哈迪德建筑事务所 (Zaha Hadid Architects) 设计，并与合作伙伴将废食用油转化为可持续能源 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), 主编 2026 年 10 月 24 日 08:30 HKT · 阅读 2 分钟 恒基地产首次亮相香港葡萄酒及烈酒展
content:
香港
恒基兆业地产首次亮相香港美酒佳肴巡礼，并以 2,000 平方英尺的展馆作为其 50 周年庆典的一部分。该展示中心设有 12 家餐厅和酒吧，由扎哈·哈迪德建筑事务所 (Zaha Hadid Architects) 设计，并与合作伙伴将废食用油转化为可持续能源。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 24 日 08:30 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

恒基兆业地产首次亮相香港美酒佳肴巡礼，推出“恒基兆业 50A • Taste The Finest”，展示美食、鸡尾酒、建筑和设计，作为恒基地产 50 周年庆祝活动的一部分。该节于10月29日至11月1日在中环海滨举行，聚集了超过300个餐饮摊位，以香港旅游发展局的“品味世界最佳”为主题。
这座占地 2,000 平方英尺的展馆汇集了来自集团旗下酒店和合作伙伴的 12 家餐厅和酒吧，每家餐厅和酒吧均提供专为周年纪念打造的限量版菜肴或饮品。恒基地产再次与扎哈·哈迪德建筑事务所合作，将展馆转变为其设计语言的延伸，其灵感来自恒基兆业的流畅轮廓，并使用曲线和开发项目的标志性调色板，与中环地标顶部的鸡尾酒和餐饮目的地橄榄石建立视觉联系。

Peridot 入选 2026 年凡尔赛奖全球最美丽餐厅，为节日带来了三款饮品：Henderson Green、The 3 A.M.威士忌和激情帕洛玛。恒基翠绿是一款无酒精鸡尾酒，混合了菠萝、柠檬、香兰、乳清、桃子和茉莉汽水，其亮绿色源自恒基兆业地产的视觉形象。凌晨 3 点威士忌将单一麦芽威士忌与黑苹果汁、昆布和甜苦艾酒混合在一起，而Passion Paloma则带来了龙舌兰酒、百香果利口酒、酸橙和柚子苏打水。
食品包括用 50 年陈皮和普洱茶调味的鸡蛋仔，将街头小吃变成周年纪念菜肴。 CulinArt 1862 提供三款色彩缤纷的迷你汉堡，里面填满了澳大利亚 M9 和牛，而 SAYA 则将泰式罗勒和牛三明治搭配宣纸包裹的芒果糯米和 Peridot's Henderson Green。 Diplomat 餐厅提供爱尔兰咖啡，由詹姆森爱尔兰威士忌、马爹利 VSOP 干邑白兰地、德梅拉拉糖、热咖啡和冷奶油制成，而 Birdie 则提供不含酒精的 Early Birdie。其他周年纪念菜肴包括以鲍鱼和扇贝为基础的小吃以及素食惠灵顿和伊比利亚叉烧。

由恒基兆业地产主席李家杰家族办公室创办的可持续燃料生产商EcoCeres首次与香港旅游发展局合作，收集节日期间使用过的食用油，并将其转化为可持续航空燃料。对于恒基地产来说，这个节日是一种将建筑、酒店、生活方式和可持续发展与维多利亚港天际线融为一体的方式。

Hong Kong
Henderson Land makes its first appearance at the Hong Kong Wine & Dine Festival with a 2,000-square-foot pavilion as part of its 50th-anniversary celebrations. The showcase features 12 restaurants and bars, a Zaha Hadid Architects design, and a partnership to convert used cooking oil into sustainabl

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

24 Oct 2026 at 08:30 HKT · 2 min read

Henderson Land is making its first appearance at the Hong Kong Wine & Dine Festival with Henderson Land 50A • Taste The Finest, a showcase bringing together food, cocktails, architecture and design as part of its 50th-anniversary celebrations. The festival runs at the Central Harbourfront from October 29 to November 1, gathering more than 300 food and drink stalls under the Hong Kong Tourism Board's “Taste the World's Best” theme.

The 2,000-square-foot pavilion brings together 12 restaurants and bars from across the group's properties and partner portfolio, each offering limited-edition dishes or drinks created for the anniversary. Henderson Land has again worked with Zaha Hadid Architects to turn the pavilion into an extension of its design language, inspired by the flowing silhouette of The Henderson and using curved lines and the development's signature palette to create a visual link with Peridot, the cocktail and dining destination at the top of the Central landmark.

Peridot, selected among Prix Versailles' World's Most Beautiful Restaurants for 2026, brings three drinks to the festival: Henderson Green, The 3 A.M. Whisky and Passion Paloma. Henderson Green is an alcohol-free cocktail combining pineapple, lemon, pandan, whey, peach and jasmine soda, taking its bright green colour from Henderson Land's visual identity. The 3 A.M. Whisky blends single malt whisky with black apple reduction, kombu and sweet vermouth, while Passion Paloma brings tequila, passion fruit liqueur, lime and grapefruit soda.

Food offerings include an egg waffle flavoured with 50-year-aged dried tangerine peel and pu'er tea, turning a street snack into an anniversary dish. CulinArt 1862 offers three colourful mini burgers filled with Australian M9 Wagyu, while SAYA pairs a Thai basil Wagyu sandwich with mango sticky rice wrapped in rice paper and Peridot's Henderson Green. The Diplomat serves an Irish Coffee made with Jameson Irish whiskey, Martell VSOP cognac, demerara sugar, hot coffee and cold cream, and Birdie serves its alcohol-free Early Birdie. Other anniversary dishes range from abalone and scallop-based bites to vegetarian Wellington and Iberico char siu.

EcoCeres, the sustainable fuel producer incubated by the family office of Henderson Land chairman Peter Lee Ka-kit, is working with the Hong Kong Tourism Board for the first time to collect used cooking oil from the festival and convert it into sustainable aviation fuel. For Henderson Land, the festival serves as a way of bringing together architecture, hospitality, lifestyle and sustainability against the Victoria Harbour skyline.

title: Donate to Hong Kong Photojournalism Trip, organized by Hillary Johnson
summary: Hi everyone, my name is Hillary Johnson, and I’m a photographer living in Chicago, working all over the Midwest and in Hong Kong. I have two main threads to my photography practice, photojournalism and fine art. Though it feels awkward, I c
content:
Hi everyone, my name is Hillary Johnson, and I’m a photographer living in Chicago, working all over the Midwest and in Hong Kong. I have two main threads to my photography practice, photojournalism and fine art.

Though it feels awkward, I confess, I’m pushing ahead because I need your help.

I’m going to Hong Kong on November 12 to cover the protest and the election of a new cabinet in Hong Kong.

You might wonder why bother giving money to me or why my voice particular needs to be added to this news event, or even why this matters to you at all. I hear that and I’ll do my best to answer your questions. I’ll also explain what you can do if you’re interested in helping out.

A little bit about me: in addition to being a photographer I’m also someone who studies a martial art called Ving Tsun. This art is extremely popular in Hong Kong for various reasons that I won’t go into right now but if you’re curious you can ask me and I’ll be happy to answer. It was the practice of this martial art that introduced me to my husband, Matt Johnson who runs a kung fu school here in Chicago.

This martial art has a code of ethics that involves being a good citizen, being humble, promoting peace, and standing up for what is right and protecting those who need protection from bullies and so forth.

I made my first trip to Hong Kong a couple of years ago and I’ve been back a few times since then. Though I’m someone who likes spend a lot of time in remote locations being quiet and letting the busyness of my mind and heart settle down, I felt 100% in love with the city of Hong Kong, it’s culture, it’s people, and of course with my kung fu family there.

As a result it has been difficult watching the news and worrying about this place I love so much and the people who live there.
My concern for all of this led me to do a story for the Chicago Reader.

Here's a link to that: [https://www.chicagoreader.com/chicago/photos-hong-kong-protest-freedom/Content?oid=73815391](https://www.chicagoreader.com/chicago/photos-hong-kong-protest-freedom/Content?oid=73815391)

I’m extremely grateful to the reader for giving me the time and space that it did. I made all the photographs, did all the interviews, and wrote all the text with guidance from the amazing Reader staff. In the process of working on that story I began to see, that much that was going on in Hong Kong seems to not quite be making it into the news. This made me want to go to Hong Kong and do more.

The stories we have been seeing her only the tip of the iceberg. I’m interested in the stories of ordinary people, their everyday life, and what they do.

What are their day jobs?

How do they prepare for protesting?

How do they support each other in the midst of such extreme difficulty?

I want to understand the impact of what’s happening in this interaction between the Beijing mainland Chinese government in the city of Hong Kong in the Hong Kong people.

It’s interesting that Hong Kong has roots and connections stretching out from the city, all over the globe. While working on the story I’ve met many people here in Chicago who have a deep connections to Hong Kong.

I want to go and photograph an interview to help amplify the voices of those people not being heard as much as they might be.

Why do the events Hong Kong matter to you wherever you might live?

Here are a few reasons:

Number one. Hong Kong people are simply asking for fundamental human rights to be recognized.

Number two. The Hong Kong people are asking for the promises made by the Chinese government to be kept.

Number three. The Hong Kong people want their freedom.

All people everywhere around the world want their fundamental human rights, they want promises to be kept and they want freedom.

If we all look into our own hearts I believe we will see this truth is self evident.

What’s happening in Hong Kong matters to all of us, because all of us want the same things; freedom, respect- both given and received, dignity, and agency.

Further, for those of us living in other parts of the world, if we think that what’s happening in Hong Kong cannot happen to us wherever it is that we happen to live, I think if you forgive me, that view is naïve.

The road to tyranny is a slippery slope.

First one right is eroded, then another, then another.

For this trip to Hong Kong all the groundwork is in place.

Because of the network being built up over the years and as a result of my recent work, there are people on the ground in Hong Kong ready to help with making connections, translation, safety and getting around and so forth.

My intention is to get to Hong Kong do my work at the photographer and then do my best to get those stories out into the world so that everyone can know what is going on.

But I need help with the expenses.

Here is a list:

Airfare and hotel around $2100-2400 depending on flight details

Transportation in Hong Kong When the MTR is shut down taxis may be necessary - estimating maybe $300

Money to pay translators and other fixtures and facilitators estimating $300-500

A laptop to process photos while I’m there so I can send them out to editors at various news outlets - around $200-300

I’m hoping to raise $3500. to cover all of that as well as some of my bills while I’m away so that the lights and heat are still on when I return home.

Addition I’ll provide links to news outlets as well as the story I did for the reader so that you can get more information about the situation over there.

I’ll also link or attach a video that I made about the story.

As things when I’m planning to offer in addition to publicly thinking everyone who supports this is the creation of a private Facebook group where I post updates photos and video from my time in Hong Kong.

This content will be exclusively for anyone who supports this trip.

I’m excited to announce that someone already made a first donation of $500 before even launched this campaign which let me adjust the amount needed to $3500

Honestly I wasn’t even planning on doing this but so many people said to me that they wanted to support the trip and believe in the mission of supporting truth and openness and democracy, that I pushed past my own discomfort and jumped in.

I want to thank all of you in advance for your support and help.

Please know that even if you can’t donate money to this trip, I’d be very grateful for your repeated sharing of the campaign. We all know how this works, and whether we like it or not it requires a certain diligence. A lather rinse and repeat process.

For those of you who can donate, please know how grateful I am for your support. And that no donation is too small or too large.

Again my heartfelt thanks. You should know also that I’ve never felt more sense of mission or purpose in going after story. This has my whole heart and I hope very much but I’ll find out that’s for publishing material of the world to know what is going on in Hong Kong at this critical time in history.

As a final note, I want to add that one of the things I’ve heard lately, is that China may be starting to crack down on the practice of martial arts.

This truly is history repeating itself. This happened during the period of conflict between the Ming and Qing dynasty.

It happened again during the cultural revolution.

And now it’s happening once again.

Why does China always clamp down on martial artists?

Purely fear.

Because martial artists, as part of their training, learn how important it is to stand up and fight when it’s necessary. The core of traditional martial arts is about values that respect all people and offer protection to those who need it.

I like to think that with my camera I’m bringing the spirit of kung fu, of the Ving Tsun I love, to my practice using my camera to help protect and defend those in Hong Kong.

I hope that you’ll join me in this fight.

Thanks so much.

Let me know what questions you may have.

Happy to try my best to answer.

May all be safe, happy, strong and at ease. ❤️

title: 聯合國要求港府回應「侵害兒童權利」情況 關注「理大圍城」、《國安法》
summary: 追光者報道 海外港人組織「香港人權資訊中心」今（22日）表示，聯合國兒童權利委員會正式就香港情況展開審議程序，當中特別要求港府回應2019年「理大圍城」事件，以及《國安法》實施情況，港府須於明年2月15日前提交書面回覆，並預計明年下半年召開審議會議。資訊中心發言人接受《追光者》訪問時表示，很高興委員會採納他們的大部分關注，呼籲港府勿再將兒童聲音視為「耳邊風」，並相信這次審議能夠有助港人在繼續認清和掌握自己應有的權利。 聯合國要求港府回應「侵害兒童權利」情況 關注「理大圍城」、
content: 追光者報道 海外港人組織「香港人權資訊中心」今（22日）表示，聯合國兒童權利委員會正式就香港情況展開審議程序，當中特別要求港府回應2019年「理大圍城」事件，以及《國安法》實施情況，港府須於明年2月15日前提交書面回覆，並預計明年下半年召開審議會議。資訊中心發言人接受《追光者》訪問時表示，很高興委員會採納他們的大部分關注，呼籲港府勿再將兒童聲音視為「耳邊風」，並相信這次審議能夠有助港人在繼續認清和掌握自己應有的權利。 聯合國要求港府回應「侵害兒童權利」情況  關注「理大圍城」、《國安法》 對上一次就香港兒童權利的審議已經是2013年，資訊中心發言人向本台指出，審議相隔13年才能再度展開，除了受制於聯合國自身資源不足，中國和香港政府遲交報告亦是主因。他批評港府延宕令明年的審議要一次過審議13年來發生過的事情，每個議題的審議時間非常緊絀，甚至部分議題未及處理。 發言人又指，若按照正常的審議年期，國際機構就能夠就期間發生的人權侵害情況提出建議，甚至因而得到即時改善。翻查資料，港府上次提交報告的原訂限期為2019年3月，但延宕4年才提交報告，4年間香港的人權狀況已經因為《國安法》而出現翻天地覆的變化。 人權組織建議獲聯合國採納：港府須確保兒童無須擔心因表達而遭《國安法》追究 發言人指出，很高興8月時提交的報告，當中大部分核心議題都被委員會採納，並列入要求港府回應的「問題清單」（List of Issues），報告提及的2019年11月「理大圍城」事件，以及逾1,700名學生在反修例運動中遭受警察暴力、拘捕，以及被控暴動，相關議題都獲委員會採納並要求港府回應，他們認為反修例運動是兒童表達意見的方式之一。 委員會在「問題清單」中指出兒童表達權利不限於社會運動，《國安法》同樣亦限制兒童接觸多樣化資訊和享有言論自由，委員會要求港府提供兒童及其照顧者因《國安法》被起訴和判監的情況。委員會重申，港府須確保兒童能夠安全、自由地表達觀點，「而不必擔心因國家安全相關條款而受到追究」。中心發言人強調香港的社會撕裂，源於港府拒絕聆聽、拒絕接受兒童的聲音，呼籲港府正視問題，勿再把兒童聲音視為「耳邊風」。 港府回應後會再提意見 審議結果助港人認清自己權利 資訊中心在報告中曾提到香港目前出現充滿政治意識的「洗腦教育」問題，但委員會未有將「洗腦教育」列入問題清單中。不過發言人表示，明年下半年審議會議並非只就問題清單上的議題討論，相信屆時討論到教育面向時亦有可能提及；作為人權組織，他們亦會在港府提交書面回應後，提交更多元的觀點讓委員會作全面審視。 面對國際組織的批評，港府不時都以「戰狼」姿態反駁，資訊中心發言人預計這次兒童權利審議亦可能出現同樣的狀況，但他認為這個過程仍然是「很有價值」。他指出，在目前香港社會表達空間有限下，聯合國這個平台讓公民社會能夠透過報告呈現對香港的真實觀察，而不是只有政府的視角。 發言人又形容，聯合國的人權專家、公約機構、特別報告員，甚或是高級人權專員提出的意見，其實具有很強的國際道德權威，讓香港人能夠藉着他們的分析與框架，認知和掌握自己應有的權利。

title: 英国发布《香港半年报告》指港府国安打压延伸海外 并呼吁释放黎智英
summary: 文章来源：美国之音 作者：李伯安 英国外交发展部10月22日向议会提交最新《香港半年报告》，认定中国持续不遵守《中英联合声明》，同时批评港府持续扩大国家安全立法的范围和应用。香港驻伦敦经贸办事处对美国之音表示，港府强烈谴责并拒绝接受英国报告。 自香港主权移交后，英国外交发展部每半年发表一份香港报告，检视香港落实《中英联合声明》及“一国两制”的情况，这是英国政府提交的第59份《香港半年报告》，涵盖2026年1月至6月。 报告中再次要求立即释放英国公民、壹传媒创办人黎智英。黎智英
content: 文章来源：美国之音 作者：李伯安 英国外交发展部10月22日向议会提交最新《香港半年报告》，认定中国持续不遵守《中英联合声明》，同时批评港府持续扩大国家安全立法的范围和应用。香港驻伦敦经贸办事处对美国之音表示，港府强烈谴责并拒绝接受英国报告。 自香港主权移交后，英国外交发展部每半年发表一份香港报告，检视香港落实《中英联合声明》及“一国两制”的情况，这是英国政府提交的第59份《香港半年报告》，涵盖2026年1月至6月。 报告中再次要求立即释放英国公民、壹传媒创办人黎智英。黎智英今年2月被判处20年监禁；香港政府表示，他并非因政治立场或新闻工作受审，而是因法院认定其串谋勾结外国势力及发布煽动刊物。 政治与经济自治能否分开？ 报告指出，香港的共同法制度、商业监管及金融体系仍保留有别于中国大陆的部分特征，但报告同时认定，香港的国家安全法律在法律制度、媒体、公民社会、教育及公共行政中扮演越来越突出的角色。 香港监察研究及倡议主管汤玛斯·本森(Thomas Benson)认为，英国政府继续把政治自治和经济自治划开，声称后者可在前者消失后继续存在。 “这是一种虚构，”本森对美国之音说。他认为，政府和企业忽视了香港经济正日益受到中国当局及国安法影响。 海外通缉成焦点 报告中也提及香港国安打压延伸至海外。报告指出，截至今年6月，香港警方已向身处海外的34人发出涉及国家安全罪的拘捕令，当中包括居住在英国的人士。 英国港侨协会创办人郑文杰也是遭港府通缉的对象。2023年12月14日，香港警方指他涉嫌煽动分裂国家及勾结外国或者境外势力危害国家安全，发出拘捕令，并悬赏100万港元征集有关他或案件的资料。 郑文杰对美国之音说，报告低估了跨境镇压对英国本土安全的威胁。 “这不只是香港人的人权危机，更是英国的国家安全问题，”他说。郑文杰认为，通缉和悬红的目的不仅是追捕异议人士，也是在海外港人社群中制造恐惧，使他们担心个人行踪、家人安全及前往第三国的风险。 今年5月，英国法院裁定前香港警务人员、伦敦香港经贸办雇员袁松彪，以及英国边境部队前职员韦志良，协助外国情报机构的罪名成立。两人被指在英国收集资料和监视香港民主活动人士，并于6月分别被判监八年和十年。香港及中国政府否认案件与香港政府或经贸办有关，并批评英国将司法程序政治化。 郑文杰说，英国应从被动执法转向主动预防，整合警方、情报和边境部门的调查，并追查跨境镇压背后的资金及代理网络。“案件少不等于威胁小，更可能是政府未能发现问题。” 国际人权顾问公司(International Human Rights Advisors，IHR Advisors)联合创办人本·基思(Ben Keith)对美国之音说：“英国政府应向任何被悬赏通缉的人提供庇护，并对每一名受到针对的人进行专门安全评估。” 基思表示，英国也应更密切关注中国驻英使馆内涉嫌代表中国国家机关从事相关活动的人员，并扩大制裁范围，“不仅针对香港，也应针对中国方面负有责任的人”。 香港政府反驳报告 伦敦香港经贸办在回复美国之音查询时，转交香港特区政府10月23日发布的声明。声明“强烈谴责并拒绝接受英国报告”，指报告发表“失实言论、歪曲事实，并干预香港依法施政”。 香港政府称，《中英联合声明》没有赋予英国在香港回归后监督香港事务的权利；国安法和《维护国家安全条例》只针对危害国家安全的行为，不影响依法享有的权利及正常国际交流。 英国政府的报告结论中指出，香港虽然仍保留部分独立制度，但国家安全权力持续扩大，中国仍未履行《中英联合声明》所载义务。英国将继续支持香港人的权利和自由，并欢迎经英国国民(海外)签证移居英国的港人。

title: 13 counties, cities announce office, school closures for Saturday - Focus Taiwan
zh_title: 13县市宣布周六停课 - 聚焦台湾
summary: 中新社台北10月23日电 据当地政府公告，受台风“占比”影响，台湾13个市县的办公室和学校将于周六关闭，而台湾南部的办公室和学校将照常上课和工作。周五，基隆、台北、新北、桃园、新竹市县、台中苗栗县、彰化县、云林县、南投县、宜兰县、连江边远县等地方政府宣布停课。嘉义县、市周六不停课、不停工
content:
中新社台北10月23日电 据当地政府公告，受台风“占比”影响，台湾13个市县的办公室和学校将于周六关闭，而台湾南部的办公室和学校将照常上课和工作。

周五，基隆、台北、新北、桃园、新竹市县、台中苗栗县、彰化县、云林县、南投县、宜兰县、连江边远县等地方政府宣布停课。

周六嘉义县、市、台南、高雄、屏东县、花莲县、台东县及澎湖、金门等边远县不停课、不停工。

## 台风运动

截至晚上 8 点CWA数据显示，周五，台风占比在台湾东北部宜兰县以东约100公里处集中，以每小时16公里的速度向北东北移动。

据CWA称，台风中心附近的最大持续风速为155公里/小时，阵风高达191公里/小时，波弗特7级或以上的风速半径为320公里，10级或以上的风速为160公里。

CWA预报员林秉钰表示，预计周五晚上至周六，随着占比临近，台中和苗栗的波浪将超过6米。

林说，新北和台湾东海岸地区已经发布了高浪警报，并补充说，预计台中和苗栗也将发布类似的警报。
据CWA称，包括兰屿和绿岛在内的东海岸、基隆北海岸和恒春半岛已记录到超过6米的波浪。

北部及东南部沿岸曾观测到超过8公尺的巨浪，其中兰屿的巨浪高达10.6公尺，创下台东县附近岛屿的新纪录。

林说，“占比”的风暴半径已到达台湾，预计从周五晚上到周六凌晨将保持几乎静止状态，然后逐渐向北移动。林补充说，因此，中国气象局不排除对宜兰和新北沿海地区发布强风警报。

截至下午5时，宜兰县太平山累计降雨量达566毫米，台中南湖冰斗累计降雨量达343毫米，桃园拉拉山累计降雨量达275毫米。

## 风暴破坏和人员伤亡

根据中央紧急行动中心公布的数据，截至下午1点30分。周五，台风“占比”逼近台湾岛，造成 1 人死亡、163 人受伤。

该中心表示，大多数受伤都是轻伤，包括擦伤和瘀伤，并补充说，报告的大部分损坏涉及倒下的树木和脱落的招牌，主要发生在台中和台北。

死亡中心称，死者为一名男子，在屏东县琉球乡海滩被海浪卷走。
它还指出，截至下午2点。周五共疏散2,639人，其中新北934人、桃园684人、花莲县607人、宜兰县352人、南投县36人、屏东县24人、云林县1人、台东县1人。

该中心表示，在撤离的人员中，有140人来自花莲县万里河堰塞湖的危险地区。

与此同时，台电表示，截至下午2点，全台共有77,498户家庭停电。星期五，星期五

【原文 English Original】
Taipei, Oct. 23 (CNA) Offices and schools in 13 cities and counties across Taiwan will be closed due to Typhoon Champi on Saturday, while those in southern Taiwan will see classes and work proceed as usual, according to local government announcements.

On Friday, local governments in Keelung, Taipei, New Taipei, Taoyuan, Hsinchu City and County, Miaoli County, Taichung, Changhua County, Yunlin County, Nantou County, Yilan County, and the outlying county of Lienchiang announced school and office closures on Saturday.

Classes and work will not be suspended on Saturday in Chiayi County and City, Tainan, Kaohsiung, as well as Pingtung County, Hualien County, Taitung County and the outlying counties of Penghu and Kinmen.

## Typhoon movement

As of 8 p.m. Friday, Typhoon Champi was centered about 100 kilometers east of Yilan County in northeastern Taiwan, moving north northeast at 16 km per hour, CWA data showed.

The typhoon had maximum sustained winds of 155 kph near its center and gusts of up to 191 kph, with a radius of 320 km for winds at Beaufort force 7 or higher and 160 km for winds of 10 or higher, according to the CWA.

CWA forecaster Lin Ping-yu (林秉煜) said waves over 6 meters are forecast for Taichung and Miaoli from Friday evening through Saturday as Champi approaches.

High-wave alerts have already been issued for New Taipei and areas along Taiwan's east coast, Lin said, adding that similar alerts are also expected to be issued for Taichung and Miaoli.

According to the CWA, waves exceeding 6 meters have already been recorded along the east coast, including Lanyu and Green island, the northern coast of Keelung and the Hengchun Peninsula.

Waves exceeding 8 meters have been observed along the northern and southeastern coasts, while waves measuring 10.6 meters were recorded on Lanyu, setting a new record for the island off Taitung County, the agency said.

Lin said the storm radius of Champi has reached Taiwan and is forecast to remain nearly stationary from Friday evening until early Saturday morning, before gradually moving north. The CWA therefore did not rule out issuing strong-wind alerts for coastal areas in Yilan and New Taipei, Lin added.

As of 5 p.m., the CWA said, accumulated rainfall had reached 566 millimeters on Taipingshan (Mt. Taiping) in Yilan County, 343 millimeters at Nanhu Cirque in Taichung, and 275 millimeters at Lala Mountain in Taoyuan.

## Storm damage and casualties

According to data released by the Central Emergency Operations Center, as of 1:30 p.m. Friday, Typhoon Champi had left one person dead and 163 injured in Taiwan while approaching the island.

Most of the injuries were minor, including abrasions and bruises, the center said, adding that most of the reported damage involved fallen trees and dislodged signboards, mainly in Taichung and Taipei.

The fatality involved a man who was swept away by waves at a beach in Liuqiu Township, Pingtung County, the center said.

It also pointed out that as of 2 p.m. Friday, a total of 2,639 people had been evacuated, including 934 in New Taipei, 684 in Taoyuan, 607 in Hualien County, 352 in Yilan County, 36 in Nantou County, 24 in Pingtung County, one in Yunlin County and one in Taitung County.

Of those evacuated, 140 were from areas at risk from a barrier lake on the Wanli River in Hualien County, the center said.

Meanwhile, Taiwan Power Co. (Taipower) said a total of 77,498 households across Taiwan had experienced power outages as of 2 p.m. Friday, of which 58,469, or more than 75 percent, had their electricity restored.

(By Liu Chien-pang, Huang Chiao-wen and Elizabeth Hsu)

# Typhoon Champi damages roads, knocks out power across Taiwan

10/23/2026 03:41 PM

[](jsvscript:)[](jsvscript:)[](javascript:void(0))[Listen](javascript:)

[Link](javascript:)[Whatsapp](javascript:)[Reddit](javascript:)[Line](javascript:)[Email](javascript:)

A huge crane was battered by waves brought by Typhoon Champi and toppled into the ocean at Fugang Fishing Port in Taitung County on Friday. CNA photo Oct. 23, 2026

Taipei, Oct. 23 (CNA) Typhoon Champi caused damage and disruptions across Taiwan on Friday, including road closures and injuries, and prompted evacuations in several places as powerful winds and waves pounded the island's eastern coast.

At around 9:40 a.m. Friday, waves as high as 6 meters swept a large crane into the sea at Fugang Harbor in Taitung County, an incident captured in an online video that captured bystanders exclaiming as the waves hit.

In Hualien, two National Dong Hwa University students riding a scooter hit a fallen tree near the campus Thursday night because heavy rain had reduced visibility. Both suffered minor injuries and were discharged from the hospital after treatment.

Focus Taiwan Video

At Changbin Harbor in northern Taitung, waves as high as 8 meters battered the coast, sending seawater onto roads and overturning three bamboo rafts.

A section of the southbound lane of Provincial Highway 9 near the entrance to Duoliang Village in Taitung County, at the 401-kilometer mark, was closed after part of the roadbed on the outer side of the northbound lane was washed away.

Chiu Min-feng (邱民豐), head of the Highway Bureau's Dawu Maintenance Office, said the damage had not disrupted traffic, but the bureau was concerned that continued erosion could further damage the embankment.

The office will place concrete breakwater blocks as an emergency measure, and the outer northbound lane will close temporarily, Chiu said.

Passengers brave the windy rainpour in streets of New Taipei on Friday. CNA photo Oct. 23, 2026

Heavy rain also prompted evacuations. In New Taipei City, 1,397 people in landslide-prone areas of Yingge, Xindian, Pingxi and Shulin districts were expected to be evacuated, Mayor Hou Yu-ih (侯友宜) said.

Preventive evacuations involving 350 people were also carried out in Datong and Nan'ao townships in Yilan County, according to local authorities.

An engineering truck arrives as a Taipower worker repairs power lines in Yunlin County on Friday. Photo courtesy of a private contributor

As of 2 p.m., 77,498 households across Taiwan had lost power, with power restored to 75 percent of them and 19,029 households still without electricity, Taiwan Power Co. said.

Earlier Friday, the Central Emergency Operations Center reported that the typhoon had left one person dead and 94 injured as of 6 a.m.

Focus Taiwan Video

(By Seng Ju-feng and Shih Hsiu-chuan)

# Taiwan's September jobless rate drops to 3.36%, lowest in 26 years

10/23/2026 06:37 PM

[](jsvscript:)[](jsvscript:)[](javascript:void(0))[Listen](javascript:)

[Link](javascript:)[Whatsapp](javascript:)[Reddit](javascript:)[Line](javascript:)[Email](javascript:)

To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.

CNA file photo

Taipei, Oct. 23 (CNA) Taiwan's unemployment rate fell to 3.36 percent in September, the lowest recorded for the month in 26 years, according to data released by the Directorate General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics (DGBAS) Friday.

The rate fell 0.05 percentage points from August as more fresh graduates found jobs, the first decline after rising for three consecutive months since June, the DGBAS said.

The DGBAS attributed the decline to fewer first-time job seekers, as well as a drop in the number of people who left their jobs, down by 3,000 and 2,000, respectively.

After seasonal adjustments, the unemployment rate rose 0.01 percentage points from August to 3.33 percent, the data showed.

The number of unemployed people in September fell by 6,000 from August to 405,000, down 2,000 from the same month last year, according to the agency.

By age group, people aged 15-24 had the highest unemployment rate at 11.59 percent, as most were first-time job seekers adjusting to the workplace, the DGBAS said.

The rate was 5.69 percent among those aged 25-29 and 3.40 percent among those aged 30-34, while it was below 3 percent among those aged 35-64.

From January to September, the average number of unemployed people was 402,000, down 1,000 from the same period a year earlier, the data showed.

Meanwhile, employment declined to 12.045 million in September, down 21,000 from August but up 8,000 from a year earlier. The average employment in the first nine months was 12.044 million, up 20,000 from the same period last year, the DGBAS said.

The labor force participation rate was 59.59 percent in September, down 0.1 percentage point from August but still higher than a year earlier. The average rate for the first nine months was also 59.59 percent, up 0.20 percentage point from the same period last year.

(By Pan Tzu-yu and Shih Hsiu-chuan)

title: Taiwan industrial production up for 31st straight month in September - Focus Taiwan
zh_title: 台湾9月工业生产连续31个月增长 - 焦点台湾
summary: 中新社台北10月23日电 经济部周五表示，在人工智能热潮的推动下，台湾9月份工业生产同比增长超过19%，连续第31个月增长。经济部数据显示，9月份工业生产指数同比上涨19.17%至140.76，占总产量90%以上的制造业分类指数上涨20.21%至143.31。三季度工业生产同比增长21.95%，制造业分类指数上涨23
content:
中新社台北10月23日电 经济部周五表示，在人工智能热潮的推动下，台湾9月份工业生产同比增长超过19%，连续第31个月增长。

经济部数据显示，9月份工业生产指数同比上涨19.17%至140.76，占总产量90%以上的制造业分类指数上涨20.21%至143.31。

三季度，工业生产同比增长21.95%，其中制造业分类指数上涨23.05%。

今年前9个月，工业生产增长20.53%，其中制造业分类指数上涨21.83%。

经济部在一份声明中表示，出口导向型制造业继续受益于全球对人工智能应用、高性能计算设备和云服务的强劲需求。

国际品牌推出新的消费电子产品也提振了台湾的信息和电子产业，也提振了部分非科技制造商。

经济部表示，9月份电子行业产量同比增长23.62%，其中12英寸晶圆代工厂、集成电路(IC)封测企业、存储芯片供应商、IC设计和IC载板制造商带动增长。
经济部补充称，由于人工智能发展推动了对人工智能服务器、交换机、半导体检测设备和自动化设备的需求，计算机和光电子行业产量同比猛增45.92%。

该部表示，随着半导体供应商安装设备扩大产能，机械行业产量同比增长26.02%，基本金属产量因需求复苏而增长1.39%。

受需求放缓和年度检修减产影响，化肥行业产量同比下降4.29%。

工信部补充称，在电动乘用车和全地形车产量增加的带动下，汽车及汽车零部件产量同比增长2.35%。

展望未来，经济部表示，尽管地缘政治紧张局势和主要经济体的贸易政策可能继续给全球经济带来不确定性，但全球人工智能热潮和年底假期购物季预计将在今年余下时间继续支持台湾的工业生产。

（曾润廷、黄芳芳撰文）

Enditem/sfj

【原文 English Original】
Taipei, Oct. 23 (CNA) Taiwan's industrial production rose more than 19 percent year on year in September, driven by the artificial intelligence (AI) boom, marking the 31st consecutive month of growth, the Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) said Friday.

MOEA data showed the industrial production index rose 19.17 percent from a year earlier to 140.76 in September, while the manufacturing subindex, which accounts for over 90 percent of total production, rose 20.21 percent to 143.31.

In the third quarter, industrial production rose 21.95 percent year on year, with the manufacturing subindex up 23.05 percent.

In the first nine months of the year, industrial production grew 20.53 percent, with the manufacturing subindex up 21.83 percent.

In a statement, the MOEA said the export-oriented manufacturing sector continued to benefit from strong global demand for AI applications, high-performance computing devices and cloud services.

Launches of new consumer electronics by international brands also boosted Taiwan's information and electronics industries and also lifted part of non-tech manufacturers.

In September, production in the electronics industry rose 23.62 percent year on year, led by 12-inch wafer foundries, integrated circuit (IC) packaging and testing firms, memory chip suppliers, IC designers and IC substrate makers, the MOEA said.

Production in the computer and optoelectronics industry soared 45.92 percent from a year earlier, as AI development pushed up demand for AI servers, switches, semiconductor inspection equipment and automation equipment, the MOEA added.

With semiconductor suppliers installing equipment to expand capacity, production in the machinery industry rose 26.02 percent year on year, while base metal production rose 1.39 percent on a recovery in demand, the ministry said.

Bucking the trend, production in the chemical material and fertilizer industry fell 4.29 percent year on year due to slower demand and reduced output during annual maintenance.

Production of autos and auto parts rose 2.35 percent year on year, driven by higher output of electric passenger cars and all-terrain vehicles, the ministry added.

Looking ahead, the MOEA said the global AI boom and year-end holiday shopping season are expected to continue supporting Taiwan's industrial production for the rest of the year, though geopolitical tensions and major economies' trade policies could continue to create uncertainty for the global economy.

(By Tseng Yun-ting and Frances Huang)

Enditem/sfj

content: AI中国 2026-9-12 中国思想快递 (China Thought Express） 这是一种典型的权力悖论。一个独裁集团内部，如果最高掌权者不断清除有独立能力的人，短期会觉得越来越安全，长期却会越来越脆弱。因为所有人都只学会服从，没有人敢承担责任；所有坏消息都会被过滤，所有有能力的人都会变成潜在威胁。赵高把这种逻辑推到了极端。他终于没有对手了，也就没有帝国了。 李志德 秦二世二年，咸阳刑场上，李斯已经走到了生命的尽头。这个曾经帮助秦始皇统一文字、制度郡县、完成帝国建设的人，此时和自己的儿子一起被押出监狱。几十年前，他从楚国上蔡来到秦国，一路做到丞相。现在五刑加身，要在咸阳市上被腰斩，三族也不能幸免。 临刑之前，他忽然不谈天下，不谈皇帝，也不谈自己做过的那些大事。他回头看着儿子，说还想和他一起“牵黄犬俱出上蔡东门逐狡兔”。还可能吗？当然不可能了。司马迁只写了几个字：“遂父子相哭。” 这是秦帝国灭亡前最让人难忘的一个场景。李斯年轻时曾经观察厕所里的老鼠和粮仓里的老鼠，由此认定人的处境决定人的命运。他一辈子都在往粮仓里钻。他成功了，做到了帝国丞相，也站到了权力的最高处。可到了最后，他想要的已经不是丞相印，不是万户侯，甚至不是活着掌权，只是牵一条黄狗，和儿子回上蔡东门外走一走。 杀他的那个人叫赵高。更准确地说，赵高设计了李斯的毁灭。赵高控制审讯，反复拷打，又派人假装复审，让李斯无法分辨哪一次审问是真的。李斯最终不敢翻供。这个精通秦法、帮助建立秦帝国法律机器的人，最后死在了自己参与建立的机器里。 黄犬之叹因此不只是一个人的悲剧。它也是理解后来子婴为什么一定要杀赵高的一把钥匙。李斯已经用自己的命证明了一件事：和赵高讲规则，已经没有用了。 秦始皇死后，帝国最高权力的运行方式发生了变化。胡亥能够即位，赵高在其中扮演了关键角色。到了胡亥后期，李斯死，赵高成为中丞相，“事无大小”越来越由他决定。传世《史记》还记载了著名的“指鹿为马”：赵高把鹿说成马，借此观察群臣谁顺从、谁反对。这个故事的具体真实性，现代学界已有争论，北大汉简《赵正书》也让秦末历史出现了不同版本；但至少有一点没有太大疑问，胡亥统治后期，赵高已经掌握了极大的宫廷权力。 可赵高的权力有一个致命弱点：它不是自己的。赵高没有自己的国家，也没有一支独立于秦廷的军队。他的命令之所以有人执行，是因为命令最后披着皇帝的衣服。别人怕的表面上是赵高，真正不能违抗的是秦帝国留下来的皇权机器。 这就是赵高权力结构中最深的一条裂缝。只要胡亥还坐在皇位上，赵高可以躲在皇帝身后。可一旦赵高亲手杀掉皇帝，他就必须回答一个以前不需要回答的问题：谁来给赵高的权力盖章？ 秦二世三年，关东局势已经不可收拾。王离军在巨鹿遭到重创，章邯后来向项羽投降，刘邦也向关中逼近。赵高害怕胡亥追究战败和天下大乱的责任，最终发动望夷宫之变。赵高的女婿、咸阳令阎乐带兵进入宫中，逼迫胡亥自杀。 胡亥临死时，皇帝的尊严已经所剩无几。《史记》里的胡亥先想保住一个郡王的位置，不行；又想做万户侯，还是不行；最后甚至问能不能和妻儿一起做普通百姓，答案仍然是不行。三年前，他还是天下最有权力的人。到了这一刻，他连做一个普通人的资格都无法自己决定。 李斯临死前想起上蔡东门的黄狗，胡亥临死前想做普通百姓。这两个场景其实说的是同一件事： 权力越接近顶点的人，到了最后越发现，自己曾经最看不起的普通生活反而成了回不去的地方。 而赵高站在两个人的尸体旁边。李斯死了，胡亥也死了，赵高似乎赢到了最后。可就在这一刻，他真正的危险才开始。 传世《史记·李斯列传》说，胡亥死后，赵高一度想把皇帝的印玺佩在自己身上，但左右百官并不服从。另一篇《秦始皇本纪》的叙述稍有不同，却同样告诉人们一个事实：赵高不能只靠杀人就完成权力继承。秦的政治合法性仍然属于嬴氏。所以赵高还需要一个秦王。这个人就是子婴。 关于子婴究竟是谁，传世史籍本身就有矛盾。《史记·秦始皇本纪》称他为“二世之兄子”，一般理解为胡亥兄长的儿子；《李斯列传》等材料又留下了不同说法。因此，今天没有足够证据把他的父亲具体写成扶苏，或者断定他是秦始皇的哪一位近亲。可以确定的是，他属于秦宗室，而且已经成年，有两个儿子，并且在秦末宫廷中仍有一定地位。 赵高为什么选择他？《史记》没有告诉后人赵高全部的心理活动，所以不能替他说得太满。但从事情的结果看，赵高需要一个嬴氏宗室来维持最后的政治外壳，而这个新王又不能强大到威胁自己。子婴看上去是一个合适的人。 问题是，赵高看错了一件事。安静不等于软弱，没有兵权也不等于没有判断力。子婴面对赵高时，已经拥有一个李斯没有的优势：他看见了李斯的结局，也看见了胡亥的结局。 李斯曾经选择妥协，胡亥选择依赖，两个人最后都死在赵高手里。所以子婴面对的问题已经非常简单。赵高不是一个可以慢慢削权的普通权臣，更不是一个可以通过职位交换安抚的政治对手。这个人已经杀过丞相，又刚刚杀掉皇帝。子婴如果不先杀他，下一具尸体很可能就是自己。这才是击杀赵高最直接的历史逻辑。 赵高立子婴为秦王以后，按照礼制，要让他斋戒，再到宗庙行礼，接受王玺。《史记·秦始皇本纪》明确写道：“斋五日。”这五天不是后世小说编出来的。 真正精彩的事情就发生在这五天里。子婴没有一个人谋划，他把两个儿子叫来。传世《史记》记下了他们商议的大意：赵高在望夷宫杀了秦二世，现在假装为了大义拥立新王；又听说赵高与关东方面有联系，可能想灭掉秦宗室，在关中自己称王。如果按赵高安排去宗庙，可能正好落进他的圈套。 所以子婴提出了一个非常简单的办法：不去，就说有病。赵高如果急，一定会亲自来。来了，就杀。这不是一个复杂的军事计划。恰恰因为简单，才危险，也才有效。子婴没有军团，没有时间重新组织朝廷，也没有机会公开和赵高争夺权力。他手里真正能利用的只有一样东西：赵高需要他。 赵高需要子婴完成即位礼，需要这个秦王为已经破裂的权力结构重新披上一层合法外衣。可子婴反过来利用了这种需要。 赵高一次次派人来催，子婴就是不去。按照《史记》的叙述，赵高最后果然亲自来到斋宫。他见到子婴，问的是一句很符合他身份的话：宗庙是国家大事，大王怎么能不去？ 这句话很值得玩味。一个刚刚参与杀死皇帝的人，此时却跑来告诉新王，宗庙礼制很重要。赵高仍然以为自己控制着程序，可程序已经变成了陷阱。 《秦始皇本纪》简略地说，子婴在斋宫杀了赵高；《李斯列传》的记载更具体，说子婴与宦者韩谈及两个儿子谋划，赵高进来后，韩谈刺杀了他。随后赵高三族被诛。 子婴真正厉害的地方，不在剑法，在判断。他看懂了赵高权力最脆弱的那一点：赵高控制了皇帝，却没有能力取代皇帝；他敢杀皇帝，却还需要另一个嬴氏宗室替自己完成权力的合法化。 赵高一路杀掉扶苏阵营，逼死蒙恬、蒙毅，构陷李斯，最后又杀胡亥。他每赢一次，权力都更大，可每赢一次，能够支撑秦帝国的人也少一个。 这是一种典型的权力悖论。 一个独裁集团内部，如果最高掌权者不断清除有独立能力的人，短期会觉得越来越安全，长期却会越来越脆弱。因为所有人都只学会服从，没有人敢承担责任；所有坏消息都会被过滤，所有有能力的人都会变成潜在威胁。 赵高把这种逻辑推到了极端。他终于没有对手了，也就没有帝国了。 所以子婴杀赵高，并没有挽救秦朝。《史记》明确记载，子婴做秦王只有四十六日。刘邦攻破武关，继续推进到霸上，秦已经没有力量继续抵抗。子婴最后驾着白马素车，用丝带系颈，带着皇帝玺符，在轵道旁投降。 这里同样不能加入一个很动人的传说，说子婴投降时提出“唯一条件是不要杀咸阳百姓”。传世《史记》没有记载这句话。但他的投降客观上避免了一场继续在咸阳附近进行的死战。 刘邦也没有杀他。《高祖本纪》记载，有将领主张杀秦王，刘邦拒绝了，说人既然已经投降，再杀“不祥”，于是把子婴交给官吏看管。刘邦进入咸阳后，又退出霸上，并向关中父老宣布“约法三章”。 子婴暂时活了下来，可只活了很短时间。项羽后来进入关中，《史记·项羽本纪》留下了一段非常冷的记载：项羽西进咸阳，杀秦降王子婴，焚烧秦宫室。史书甚至说宫火“三月不灭”。那个在五天斋戒中设计杀掉赵高的人，最终还是没有逃过秦帝国灭亡的命运。 从结果看，子婴输了。可如果只用输赢判断他，就看不到这段历史真正有价值的地方。 李斯临刑以前想起黄犬，并不是因为他突然厌恶政治，而是因为一切已经来不及。他曾经拥有改变局面的权力，却在关键时刻一次次选择保存自己的地位。到了刑场，天下没有了，只剩一条记忆里的黄狗。 胡亥临死前想做普通百姓，也是一样。他做皇帝时可以决定无数人的生死，轮到自己要死，才发现权力从来没有真正属于他。 子婴和两个人最大的区别就在这里：他没有等到刑场上才明白。赵高把王玺交到他手里的时候，子婴看到的可能不是权力，而是危险。这个判断并不需要把他塑造成忍辱三年的政治天才，也不需要编出他秘密观察朝局的故事。史料没有这些内容。 现有史料能够确认的东西已经足够说明问题：赵高杀了胡亥，赵高立了子婴，子婴斋戒五日，子婴与两个儿子商议，他称病不去，赵高亲自来了，韩谈等人动手，赵高死了。 这套行动真正精彩的地方，是一个几乎没有时间、没有军事优势的人，用对方的需要设计了一个局。 赵高最大的优势，是控制皇权。赵高最后的弱点，也是离不开皇权。他靠皇帝杀了别人，最后却因为必须再找一个王，被这个王杀掉。这就是赵高之死最深的历史逻辑。 还需要说明的是，今天研究秦末史不能假装只有一种材料。2009年入藏北京大学的西汉竹书《赵正书》保存了和传世《史记》不完全相同的秦末记忆，其中甚至有赵高死于章邯之手的异说。学界因此重新讨论秦二世继位、“指鹿为马”以及赵高之死等问题。本文采用的是《史记》流传下来、也最完整的子婴诛赵高叙事，但异说必须保留。两千多年前的宫廷政变，本来就不可能像今天的监控录像一样留下全部细节。 历史真正能够确定的，往往不是每一剑从哪里刺进去，而是一个制度为什么走到了必须用剑解决问题的地步。 秦帝国建立时相信法律、官僚和皇权可以把天下控制得像一部机器。到了最后，机器还在，程序还在，王玺还在，宗庙也还在，可人与人之间已经只剩猜疑、恐惧和杀戮。 李斯懂法律，死于法律机器；胡亥拥有皇位，死于宫廷机器；赵高控制机器，最后也死在机器内部；子婴杀掉了赵高，却已经没有办法重新造出一个国家。 咸阳刑场上那条没有出现的黄犬，因此比许多帝王的玉玺更像秦亡的注脚。李斯到生命最后才明白，一个人可以得到天下，却再也回不了上蔡东门。 子婴比他晚出生在这个权力世界，却早一步明白了另一件事：当规则已经被掌握规则的人彻底毁掉时，真正的问题就不再是谁更懂规则，而是谁先看清这个制度已经走到了尽头。

title: Lawmakers visit Black Point Power Station to review decarbonisation and hydrogen trial
zh_title: 立法者参观 Black Point 发电厂，审查脱碳和氢试验
summary: 香港 香港立法会议员参观了中华电力的龙鼓滩发电厂，以审查脱碳工作、氢混合气体发电试验和燃料多样化。这次访问的重点是平衡能源安全、成本和城市的碳中和目标。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 22 日 21:30 HKT · 2 分钟阅读立法会环境事务委员会参观中华电力龙鼓动力P
content:
香港
香港立法会议员参观了中华电力的龙鼓滩发电厂，以审查脱碳工作、氢混合气体发电试验和燃料多样化。这次访问的重点是平衡能源安全、成本和城市的碳中和目标。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 22 日 21:30 香港时间 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

立法会环境事务委员会委员周二参观中华电力位于屯门的龙鼓滩发电厂，亲身了解该电力公司持续向低碳能源转型、脱碳策略和供电可靠性的情况。在小组主席 Judy Chan Kapui 的带领下，代表团研究了电力公司如何平衡能源安全和成本效益，同时与该市实现碳中和的更广泛目标保持一致。
访问期间，中华电力企业发展总监庄伟恩及营运总监张伟恩向立法会议员简介公司全面脱碳路线图。该公用事业公司概述了旨在支持政府气候目标的措施，包括从内地采购可追溯的零碳能源、深化区域伙伴关系以及推动香港更广泛的电气化。高管们解释说，中华电力积极协助消费者提高能源效率，同时探索新​​兴低碳技术，例如碳捕获、利用和储存。

A central focus of the tour was the city's pioneering hydrogen-blended natural gas electricity generation trial at Black Point Power Station. Lawmakers received detailed briefings on the project's operational scope, technical criteria, safety protocols, and implementation timeline.该试验是评估利用氢气作为香港大规模发电的可行燃料来源的运营绩效和商业可行性的关键技术基准。
代表团亦考察了主要发电机组，了解中华电力如何通过多元化的燃料组合维持稳定的供应。该站使用海南海上油田和西气东输二线的管道天然气、国际液化天然气以及广东大亚湾核电站进口的零碳核电。除了发电设施外，议员们还参观了该站的车间，工程师们在那里展示了自动焊接机器人，该机器人在预先编程的参数下执行精确的任务。

张表示，是次交流提供了一个重要机会，展示中华电力在平衡能源安全与可持续发展方面的举措。她补充说，公司将继续利用其技术专长，确保供应可靠性，同时稳步扩大零碳资源、低碳燃料和创新技术的采用，以协助香港的绿色经济转型。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

主编

负责 CLB.org.hk 报道和编辑标准的主编。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
Hong Kong lawmakers toured CLP Power's Black Point Power Station to review decarbonisation efforts, a hydrogen-blended gas generation trial, and fuel diversification. The visit focused on balancing energy security, cost, and the city's carbon neutrality goal.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

22 Oct 2026 at 21:30 HKT · 2 min read

Members of the Legislative Council's Panel on Environmental Affairs visited CLP Power Hong Kong's Black Point Power Station in Tuen Mun on Tuesday to gain first-hand insights into the power utility's ongoing transition toward low-carbon energy, decarbonisation strategies, and supply reliability. Led by panel chairman Judy Chan Kapui, the delegation examined how the power company balances energy security and cost-effectiveness while aligning with the city's broader target of achieving carbon neutrality.

During the visit, CLP Power Chief Corporate Development Officer Quince Chong Wai-yan and Chief Operating Officer Eric Cheung briefed legislators on the company's comprehensive decarbonisation roadmap. The utility outlined measures designed to support the government's climate targets, including procuring traceable zero-carbon energy from the mainland, deepening regional partnerships, and driving wider electrification across Hong Kong. The executives explained that CLP Power is actively assisting consumers with energy efficiency enhancements while exploring emerging low-carbon technologies, such as carbon capture, utilisation, and storage.

A central focus of the tour was the city's pioneering hydrogen-blended natural gas electricity generation trial at Black Point Power Station. Lawmakers received detailed briefings on the project's operational scope, technical criteria, safety protocols, and implementation timeline. The trial serves as a key technical benchmark to evaluate the operational performance and commercial feasibility of utilising hydrogen as a viable fuel source for large-scale power generation in Hong Kong.

The delegation also inspected key generation units to understand how CLP Power maintains a stable supply through a diversified fuel portfolio. The station utilises pipeline natural gas from Hainan offshore fields and the Second West-East Gas Pipeline, liquefied natural gas sourced internationally, and zero-carbon nuclear electricity imported from the Daya Bay Nuclear Power Station in Guangdong. In addition to generation facilities, the lawmakers toured the station's workshop, where engineers demonstrated an automated welding robot executing precise tasks under pre-programmed parameters.

Chong noted that the exchange provided an important opportunity to showcase CLP Power's initiatives in balancing energy security with sustainability. She added that the company will continue to harness its technical expertise to ensure supply reliability while steadily expanding the adoption of zero-carbon resources, low-carbon fuels, and innovative technologies to aid Hong Kong's green economic transition.

[![Image 3: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

# Chan's walk-off single keeps Brothers alive in Taiwan Series

10/21/2026 11:17 PM

[](jsvscript:)[](jsvscript:)[](javascript:void(0))[Listen](javascript:)

[Link](javascript:)[Whatsapp](javascript:)[Reddit](javascript:)[Line](javascript:)[Email](javascript:)

To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.

CNA photo Oct. 21, 2026

Taipei, Oct. 21 (CNA) Chan Tzu-hsien (詹子賢) hit a two-out, walk-off single in the 11th inning Wednesday, to give the CTBC Brothers a 5-4 victory over the Wei Chuan Dragons at Taipei Dome and avoid a Taiwan Series sweep.

Chan's first hit in five at-bats earned him the game's Most Valuable Player award and cut the Brothers' deficit to 3-1 in the Chinese Professional Baseball League's (CPBL) best-of-seven championship series.

The winning rally began with a walk to Tseng Sung-en (曾頌恩) against Dragons reliever Chen Kuan-wei (陳冠偉). The Brothers sent Yueh Cheng-hua (岳政華) in as a pinch-runner before Wang Wei-chen (王威晨) and Sung Sheng-jui (宋晟睿) were retired, bringing Chan to the plate with two outs.

The Brothers used five pitchers to extend their season, including Mario Sanchez and Felix Pena, who started Game 1 on Saturday and Game 2 on Sunday, respectively.

Sanchez delivered 4 1/3 scoreless innings, allowing three hits, striking out three and issuing no walks. Pena pitched a scoreless 11th, allowing two hits while keeping the game tied before Chan's decisive hit secured the victory.

Brothers fans in the stands hold up slogan towels to cheer on their team and rally support. CNA photo Oct. 21, 2026

Together with Tsai Chi-che (蔡齊哲) and Lu Yen-ching (呂彥青), the Brothers' bullpen combined for 6 2/3 scoreless innings after starter Cheng Hao-chun (鄭浩均) allowed four runs over 4 1/3 innings.

Although CTBC took a 2-0 lead in the third inning, the Dragons scored four times in the fifth to move ahead. The Brothers answered with two runs in the sixth to tie the game at 4-4, with neither side scoring again until Chan's winner.

The five-run performance surpassed CTBC's combined scoring total from the first three games, when the Brothers scored just once and were shut out twice.

Wei Chuan still needs one more victory to claim the championship, while CTBC must win the remaining three games to become the first team ever to win the Taiwan Series after trailing 3-0.

Game 5 is scheduled for Friday at 6:35 p.m. at Taipei Dome.

Video courtesy of CPBL

(By Chao Yen-hsiang)
