title: Graphs, matrices and second-method checks: where MathGPT fits in analytical work
zh_title: 图形、矩阵和第二种方法检查：MathGPT 在分析工作中的适用范围
summary: 香港的人工智能工作者和管理者可以使用 MathGPT.now 通过绘图、矩阵运算和第二种方法检查来验证分析工作。本文提供了在运营和财务环境中应用域、单位、替换和基于图的验证的实用协议。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 26 日香港时间 09:00 · 阅读 6 分钟负责确定茶的电子表格
content:
人工智能
香港的工人和管理人员可以使用 MathGPT.now 通过绘图、矩阵运算和第二种方法检查来验证分析工作。本文提供了在运营和财务环境中应用域、单位、替换和基于图的验证的实用协议。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 26 日 09:00 香港时间 · 阅读时间 6 分钟

当您负责确定团队奖金或贯穿整个季度的预算线的电子表格时，单个算术单可能会导致成本高昂的决策。香港的分析工作者——无论是运营、财务还是物流——通常都会处理图表、矩阵和多步骤计算。问题不在于是否使用人工智能数学工具，而在于如何在不外包判断的情况下使用它作为严格的第二次检查。 MathGPT.now 是一款免费的人工智能数学求解器，提供了一种结构化的方法来验证工作，但前提是您应用与同事评审相同的规则。

## MathGPT.now 为分析工作者提供什么
MathGPT.now 是一个基于浏览器的工具，它接受输入或拍照的数学问题并返回分步解决方案。其公开材料描述了一个将问题、方法、工作、答案和验证分开的结构。验证步骤是专业用途的关键：它可以包括替换、单元检查、域检查或通过替代方法求解。该工具还包括图形计算器、科学计算器以及练习题和公式参考库。基本使用无需注册，但付费套餐（每月 9.99 美元或通过学生电子邮件按年计费 4.99 美元）消除了使用限制。对于工作场所设置，免费套餐足以满足偶尔的验证任务，但大量用户应该意识到潜在的限制 - 该网站没有公开指定确切的免费套餐限制。

## 绘图作为操作中的目视检查
考虑香港仓库的一位运营分析师，他将拣货时间建模为订单大小的函数。假设模型为 _y = 0.4x + sin(x)_，其中 _x_ 是项目数，_y_ 是分钟。在 _x = 1.74_ 时，导数 _f'(x) = 0.91_ 表示曲线正在增加。经理可以将此函数输入 MathGPT.now 的图形计算器，并目视检查该点周围的斜率是否与声称的速率相符。该工具绘制曲线并可以显示交叉点和变化。这不是证明，而是一种快速的合理性检查：如果图表显示模型预测上升的情况下急剧下降，则说明有问题。协议很简单：输入函数，记下相关域的形状，然后与您自己的期望进行比较。如果视觉效果与您的计算相矛盾，请重新检查两者。

## 金融建模中的矩阵运算

香港的财务团队经常使用矩阵来衡量投资组合风险或多货币风险。例如，一个简单的二资产协方差矩阵可用于计算投资组合方差。 MathGPT.now 的线性代数主题涵盖向量、矩阵、变换、特征值和系统。工作人员可以输入矩阵乘法或求逆问题并收到逐步解决方案。要将其用作检查，请勿仅依赖最终数字。相反，请逐行遵循工作：验证

【原文 English Original】
Artificial Intelligence
Workers and managers in Hong Kong can use MathGPT.now to verify analytical work through graphing, matrix operations, and second-method checks. This article provides a practical protocol for applying domain, units, substitution, and graph-based verification in operations and finance contexts.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

26 Oct 2026 at 09:00 HKT · 6 min read

When you are responsible for a spreadsheet that determines a team’s bonus or a budget line that runs through the quarter, a single arithmetic slip can cascade into a costly decision. Analytical workers in Hong Kong—whether in operations, finance, or logistics—routinely handle graphs, matrices, and multi-step calculations. The question is not whether to use an AI math tool, but how to use one as a rigorous second check without outsourcing judgment. MathGPT.now, a free AI math solver, offers a structured way to verify work, but only if you apply the same discipline you would to a colleague’s review.

## What MathGPT.now offers the analytical worker

MathGPT.now is a browser-based tool that accepts typed or photographed math questions and returns a step-by-step solution. Its public materials describe a structure that separates the problem, method, working, answer, and verification. The verification step is the key for professional use: it can include substitution, unit checks, domain checks, or solving by an alternative method. The tool also includes a graphing calculator, a scientific calculator, and a library of practice questions and formula references. No signup is required for basic use, though a paid tier ($9.99/month or $4.99/month billed yearly with a student email) removes usage limits. For a workplace setting, the free tier is sufficient for occasional verification tasks, but heavy users should be aware of potential throttling—the site does not publicly specify exact free-tier limits.

## Graphing as a visual check in operations

Consider an operations analyst in a Hong Kong warehouse who models picking time as a function of order size. Suppose the model is _y = 0.4x + sin(x)_, where _x_ is the number of items and _y_ is minutes. At _x = 1.74_, the derivative _f'(x) = 0.91_ indicates the curve is increasing. A manager can enter this function into MathGPT.now’s graphing calculator and visually inspect whether the slope around that point matches the claimed rate. The tool plots the curve and can show intersections and change. This is not a proof, but it is a rapid plausibility check: if the graph shows a steep drop where the model predicts a rise, something is wrong. The protocol is simple: input the function, note the shape at the relevant domain, and compare with your own expectation. If the visual contradicts your calculation, re-examine both.

## Matrix operations in financial modelling

Finance teams in Hong Kong often use matrices for portfolio risk or multi-currency exposure. For example, a simple two-asset covariance matrix might be used to compute portfolio variance. MathGPT.now’s linear algebra topic coverage includes vectors, matrices, transformations, eigenvalues, and systems. A worker can type a matrix multiplication or inversion problem and receive a step-by-step solution. To use this as a check, do not rely on the final number alone. Instead, follow the working line by line: verify that the dimensions align, that each arithmetic step is correct, and that the final matrix has the expected shape. If the tool returns a 2x2 matrix where you expected 3x3, the error is likely in your input, not the tool. The public information does not specify whether MathGPT.now handles symbolic matrix entries or only numeric ones; a hands-on test would clarify this limitation.

## Domain, units, and substitution checks

MathGPT.now’s verification step explicitly includes checking the result by substitution, units, domain, or another method. For a Hong Kong logistics example: if you calculate the fuel cost for a delivery route as _cost = distance × rate_, and the answer is 500, ask: 500 what? The tool can check that units are consistent. If distance is in kilometres and rate is in dollars per litre, but fuel efficiency is missing, the number is meaningless. The domain check is equally important: if your model predicts a negative time for a positive input, the result is invalid. A worker can input the original equation and the proposed answer, and ask MathGPT.now to substitute and verify. The tool will show whether the left side equals the right side. This is a mechanical check, not a conceptual one, but it catches transcription errors and miskeyed numbers.

## Second-method checks: not a guarantee

The most powerful feature for professional use is the ability to solve the same problem by a different method. MathGPT.now’s interface allows you to ask for an alternative approach—for instance, solving a system of equations by substitution after you used elimination. If both methods yield the same answer, confidence increases. But this is not a guarantee. The tool may use the same underlying engine for both methods, meaning a systematic error could replicate. The UNESCO Guidance for generative AI in education and research (2023) warns that generative AI tools can produce plausible but incorrect outputs, and that human oversight remains essential. The OECD AI Principles (2019, updated 2024) emphasise transparency and accountability: you, the user, are accountable for the final decision. A second-method check in MathGPT.now is a useful cross-check, but it does not replace domain expertise or a manual sanity test.

## Privacy and security considerations for Hong Kong users

When you type or photograph a problem, the data is sent to MathGPT.now’s servers. The site states that payments are processed by Stripe and that progress stays in your browser, but it does not publicly specify data retention policies for problem inputs. For sensitive financial models or proprietary operational data, avoid entering actual numbers. Instead, anonymise the problem: change the values but keep the structure. For example, if your real covariance matrix contains confidential return data, replace the numbers with simple integers that preserve the mathematical relationship. The NIST AI Risk Management Framework resources (2023) recommend that organisations map risks related to data privacy and transparency. Hong Kong’s Personal Data Privacy Ordinance (PDPO) applies if any personal data is involved. For most analytical work, the risk is low if you use generic inputs, but be aware that the tool is not designed for confidential data.

## Practical checklist for using MathGPT.now at work

*   **Define the problem clearly** — Write down the equation or matrix exactly as you intend to check it.
*   **Run the tool once** — Input the problem and note the step-by-step working, not just the final answer.
*   **Verify units and domain** — Check that the answer has the right dimension and falls within a plausible range.
*   **Perform a substitution check** — Plug the answer back into the original equation manually or via the tool.
*   **Try a second method** — Ask MathGPT.now to solve using a different approach and compare results.
*   **Graph the function** — For any single-variable model, plot it and confirm the shape matches your expectation.
*   **Anonymise sensitive data** — Replace real numbers with structurally equivalent placeholders before input.
*   **Document the check** — Save or screenshot the steps as part of your audit trail.
*   **Apply human review** — Do not accept any output that contradicts your own understanding of the problem.

MathGPT.now is a free, accessible tool that can strengthen your analytical workflow when used with discipline. It does not replace judgment, but it can catch mistakes that a tired eye might miss. For Hong Kong workers juggling spreadsheets, models, and deadlines, that is a practical advantage.

**Help for Bhujung Tamang**

Dominic and Kayla are raising funds for Bhujung Tamang, a friend they met while traveling in Nepal before/after the Langtang trek. During that trip, Dominic and Kayla stayed with Bhujung for a few days in his village of Syabru Besi. Bhujung welcomed them with kindness and gave them a truly special local experience they have never forgotten. Now, after a devastating flood destroyed Syabru Besi, Bhujung is facing an unimaginable loss. His home and hotel were destroyed, many of his friends were killed or are missing, and he lost all of his possessions in the disaster. It is estimated that Syabru Besi still has 1300 people missing.

Dominic and Kayla met Bhujung by chance while starting their 7 day hike up the Langtang Valley, one of Nepal's premier hiking destinations. They were looking for a place to stay and found the only hotel in the Old Village of Syabru Besi. Upon getting to know Bhujung, Dominic and Kayla discovered that they were the first guests Bhujung had had in almost 3 years because he was taking care of his late mother's declining health. As a token of gratitude and friendship, Bhujung gifted Dominic and Kayla a hand stitched bag his mother made pictured above.

This fundraiser is meant to provide direct relief to Bhujung as he begins the long process of recovering and rebuilding after this tragedy. The money raised will go directly to him to help support his immediate needs (food, housing, etc.) and give him a foundation to move forward after losing so much. Dominic and Kayla are asking for donations of any amount to help Bhujung through this heartbreaking time. If you are able to give, thank you for showing compassion and support to someone who once showed such generosity to travelers far from home. Please consider donating and sharing this fundraiser to help Bhujung rebuild his life.

The Indian Association of Sacramento (IAS) based in Sacramento , California, USA has a long-standing commitment to helping families in need. **Tarra Subhar Massallo**

Donation protected

After fleeing from the Chinese annexation of Tibet, many Kyirong Tibetan families crossed into Nepal believing their exile would be temporary. It was not. Syabrubesi and the Trishuli valley had become their home instead- a place where hundreds of families had to rebuild from nothing, including my grandparents. Like many Tibetan refugees, they eventually moved on to build new lives in India. However, not everyone left. Some of their family stayed behind in Syabrubesi and the Trishuli valley, carrying on the roots left behind by previous generations.

On August 26, 2026, a glacier collapse high in the Langtang Himal sent a wall of water and debris surging down the Bhote Koshi and Trishuli Bazaar: the towns where that branch of our family stayed and built their lives after losing everything once before. **Four households in our family were directly affected:**

*   **Our cousin Dawa Dakpa (confirmed deceased) leaves behind a wife and two young children.**
*   **Aku Jangchup, his wife, and child (confirmed deceased)**
*   **Nama Nangsa Ghongma's family and relatives (missing)**
*   **Nama Karmo Subhar's family and relatives (missing)**

Now, our families face rebuilding once again, with roads and homes submerged in mud. **100% of every contribution will go directly to these impacted families and the wider flood-affected communities**as they recover together. The funds will be spent on various essentials based on each family's needs (including, but not limited to: temporary shelter, food, emergency medical care, and transportation costs). We invite you to help write the next chapter of this story. Please help support this fundraiser in any way that you can.

**Who I am:**

My name is Tarra Subhar Massallo. I am the granddaughter of Tibetan refugees who fled from Kyirong during the 1959 Chinese annexation of Tibet, and the daughter of a Tibetan immigrant mother who moved from India to the United States with her family in search of a better life. Growing up in a mixed household, I am surrounded by the importance of my many cultures and giving back to my respective communities.

**Free monthly real estate investor networking in Omaha.** Bring a deal, find capital, JV partners, agents, lenders and developers.

👉 **Grab your FREE ticket here (required for entry):**[https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/e/real-estate-investor-networking-omaha-property-deal-network-pdn-tickets-1999158473811](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/e/real-estate-investor-networking-omaha-property-deal-network-pdn-tickets-1999158473811)

Property Deal Network (PDN) is a relaxed monthly meetup for real estate investors, developers and professionals who want to do business face-to-face.

**What happens at PDN Omaha?**
 People bring deals. Others bring capital. Some are sourcing their next project, others are looking for JV partners or professional services. The format is simple: arrive, grab a drink and start conversations. No presentations, no pitches from the front – just direct networking with people who are actively working in real estate.

**Who attends?**
 Investors (from first-timers to portfolio owners), developers, sourcing agents, brokers, attorneys, architects, lenders and accountants. If you're involved in real estate – or want to be – you'll find relevant people here.

**Practical details**
 • **When:** Tuesday 27 October, from 7pm local time
 • **Venue:** Moe & Curly's Pub, 1011 Capitol Avenue, Omaha, NE, 68102
 • **Cost:** Free to attend. The venue asks that everyone buys a drink at full price
 • **Dress:** Smart casual (no sportswear). Over 25s only; ID may be requested

This is an established event that runs every month (except December) – if this date doesn't work, there's always next month. All Omaha dates: [https://www.propertydealnetwork.com/locations/north-america-networking-events/usa-networking-events/omaha-nebraska-usa-property-networking-event/](https://www.propertydealnetwork.com/locations/north-america-networking-events/usa-networking-events/omaha-nebraska-usa-property-networking-event/)

**Industry professional?** Paid promotion tickets (max 2 per event) are available on the ticket page for architects, accountants, builders, mortgage brokers, insurance brokers, interior designers, lenders, realtors and surveyors.

_Property Deal Network – real estate investor networking in 190+ cities worldwide. Join this group to hear about PDN events everywhere._

# Soup-a-rama Potluck!

[![Image 15: Photo of the user Jean Delehant](https://secure.meetupstatic.com/photos/member/8/8/5/6/thumb_67474902.jpeg?w=96) Hosted by Jean D. and Lois Bright S.](https://www.meetup.com/omaha-forks-over-knives-group/events/316898601/attendees/)

[![Image 16: Photo of Omaha Forks Over Knives Group group](https://secure.meetupstatic.com/photos/event/6/8/7/b/event_486086747.jpeg?w=3840) ### Omaha Forks Over Knives Group](https://www.meetup.com/omaha-forks-over-knives-group/)

## Details

Lois S. is graciously hosting us at her church. We'll have our very own whole-foods, plant-based, no-oil SOUPFEST.

Any plant-based soup is great, but you're free to bring anything that goes with soup--breads, corn bread, dessert. Bring dishes containing NO oil or animal products. Bring your own take-home containers, and we'll share our leftovers. Plates, eating utensils, and napkins provided. It might be helpful to bring your own serving utensils. We will provide coffee, tea, water, and maybe lemonade.
 If you'd like to help set up, come a bit early.

If you're unfamiliar with our way of eating, check our discussion board. You'll find plenty of recipe websites that comply with the Forks Over Knives program. (I promise, it's easy!) A couple of websites with easy, compliant recipes: [happyherbivore.com,](http://happyherbivore.com,/)[drmcdougall.com/recipes.](http://drmcdougall.com/recipes.) Can't cook? Think fruit salad, fruit plate, vegetable platter.

The church was kind enough to offer their space free of charge. We'll clean up after ourselves and wash the dishes after dinner. We'll have an optional free-will donation plate to give them as a thank-you.

(No need to RSVP if you can't make it.)

Omaha Forks Over Knives is a lively group celebrating the health benefits of a whole-foods, plant-based, no-oil diet. Each of us is in a different place with foods we do and do not consume; we're not The Food Police. We're here to support and learn from each other. (While we're at it, we entertain each other as well.) If you're new to this, we ask that, at a minimum, you limit your food selection to plant-based items.

title: China’s Argentina mining footprint smaller than it looks
zh_title: 中国在阿根廷的采矿足迹比看起来要小
summary: 智利咨询公司 Plusmining 的分析显示，中国公司仅占阿根廷大型投资激励制度 (RIGI) 批准的采矿项目投资的 9.2%，这对将北京与该国计划锂产量 70% 联系起来的估计提出了挑战。据经济部称，截至 10 月 1 日，阿根廷已在 RIGI 下批准了 23 个项目，价值 498 亿美元，其中包括 12 个矿业开发项目，价值 212 亿美元。通过中国股东的直接和间接股权对这些矿业投资进行加权，得出可归属价值
content:
智利咨询公司 Plusmining 的分析显示，中国公司仅占阿根廷大型投资激励制度 (RIGI) 批准的采矿项目投资的 9.2%，这对将北京与该国计划锂产量 70% 联系起来的估计提出了挑战。据经济部称，截至 10 月 1 日，阿根廷已在 RIGI 下批准了 23 个项目，价值 498 亿美元，其中包括 12 个矿业开发项目，价值 212 亿美元。 Plusmining 的政策和监管事务分析师安东尼娅·戈多伊·阿里亚斯 (Antonia Godoy Arias) 表示，按照中国股东的直接和间接股权对这些矿业投资进行加权，得出的权益价值约为 19.5 亿美元。戈多伊·阿里亚斯表示，米雷批准了与中国建立联系的锂矿扩张激励措施。这种差异反映了两种不同的参与措施。 70%的估计涉及与中国股东合作的项目中已公布的锂产能，包括等待批准的开发项目，而9.2%的数字则衡量已在RIGI下批准的项目的所有权加权投资。这种区别很重要，因为阿根廷寻求外国资本来扩大其关键的矿产工业，同时应对华盛顿和北京之间的竞争。中国企业已在锂领域确立了重要地位，但其财务状况、运营控制权和未来生产权在不同项目上存在很大差异。
衡量所有权 12 个获批采矿项目中，有 6 个具有可识别的中国股权风险，但只有 3 个拥有直接中方股东。紫金矿业 (SHA: 601899; HKG: 2899) 通过 Neo Lithium 控制卡塔马卡的 Tres Quebradas，而赣锋锂业 (SHE: 002460; HKG: 1772) 则持有 Cauchari-Olaroz 扩建项目 46.7% 的股份。胡胡伊省通过 Minera Exar。山东黄金（SHA：600547；HKG：1787）拥有圣胡安贝拉德罗金矿八期和九期50%的权益。其余三个项目通过企业所有权结构间接接触中国，项目层面没有中国股东。中铝公司持有力拓（ASX、LON、纽约证券交易所股票代码：RIO）约 11.23% 的股份，创造了 Rincón 和 Fénix 锂项目的权益敞口。在Los Azules，由于力拓旗下的Nuton 持有McEwen Inc.（纽约证券交易所代码：MUX；多伦多证券交易所代码：MUX）子公司McEwen Copper 的股份，该利息降至约1.8%。这些间接持股并不构成中国的运营控制权。 Plusmining通过将每个项目的批准投资乘以通过其所有权结构归属的中国股权来计算所有权加权数据。对于间接持股，该咨询公司将公司实体的连续所有权百分比相乘，以估计中国的最终经济风险。
该分析还考虑了一种更广泛的二元方法，只要存在符合条件的中国参与，则将项目的全部投资价值归因于中国，而不管股东的实际股权如何。包括在 Rincón、Fénix 和 Los Azules 的间接权益会增加测算的足迹，但即使是这种最广泛的计算，得出的份额也远低于 70%。该方法将投资风险与项目关联区分开来，但股权并没有涵盖所有形式的战略影响力。中国企业还可以通过承购协议、加工安排和融入电池供应链来确保未来的矿产供应。

【原文 English Original】
Chinese companies account for just 9.2% of investment approved for Argentina’s mining projects under its Large Investment Incentive Regime (RIGI), challenging estimates that link Beijing to 70% of the country’s planned lithium production, according to an analysis by Chilean consultancy Plusmining. Argentina had approved 23 projects worth $49.8 billion under RIGI as of Oct. 1, including 12 mining developments valued at $21.2 billion, according to the Ministry of Economy. Weighting those mining investments by Chinese shareholders’ direct and indirect equity interests produces an attributable value of approximately $1.95 billion, said Antonia Godoy Arias, a policy and regulatory affairs analyst at Plusmining. Milei approves incentives for lithium mine expansion with China ties The discrepancy reflects two different measures of participation, Godoy Arias said. The 70% estimate concerns announced lithium production capacity at projects with Chinese shareholders, including developments awaiting approval, while the 9.2% figure measures ownership-weighted investment in projects already approved under RIGI. The distinction matters as Argentina seeks foreign capital to expand its critical minerals industry while navigating competition between Washington and Beijing. Chinese companies have established a significant position in lithium , but their financial exposure, operational control and rights to future production differ substantially across projects. Measuring ownership Six of the 12 approved mining projects have identifiable Chinese equity exposure, although only three have direct Chinese shareholders. Zijin Mining (SHA: 601899; HKG: 2899) controls Tres Quebradas in Catamarca through Neo Lithium , while Ganfeng Lithium (SHE: 002460; HKG: 1772) holds 46.7% of the Cauchari-Olaroz expansion in Jujuy through Minera Exar. Shandong Gold (SHA: 600547; HKG: 1787) owns 50% of phases eight and nine of the Veladero gold mine in San Juan . The remaining three projects have indirect Chinese exposure through corporate ownership structures, without Chinese shareholders at the project level. Chinalco’s approximately 11.23% holding in Rio Tinto (ASX, LON, NYSE: RIO) creates attributable exposure to the Rincón and Fénix lithium projects. At Los Azules , that interest falls to roughly 1.8% because Rio Tinto’s Nuton holds a stake in McEwen Copper, a subsidiary of McEwen Inc. (NYSE: MUX; TSX: MUX). These indirect holdings do not establish Chinese operational control. Plusmining calculated the ownership-weighted figures by multiplying each project’s approved investment by the Chinese equity interest attributable through its ownership structure. For indirect holdings, the consultancy multiplied successive ownership percentages through corporate entities to estimate China’s ultimate economic exposure. The analysis also considered a broader, binary approach that attributes the entire investment value of a project to China whenever qualifying Chinese participation exists, regardless of the shareholder’s actual stake. Including indirect interests in Rincón, Fénix and Los Azules increases the measured footprint, but even this broadest calculation produces a share well below 70%. The methodology distinguishes investment exposure from project association, but equity ownership does not capture every form of strategic influence. Chinese companies can also secure future mineral supply through offtake agreements, processing arrangements and integration into battery supply chains without controlling mining operations. Lithium pipeline Chinese participation could rise substantially as Argentina considers another $4.9 billion in RIGI applications involving Chinese shareholders. Three pending lithium developments represent approximately 222,000 tonnes of proposed annual production capacity. The largest, Pozuelos-Pastos Grandes , involves $3 billion in planned investment and is 67% owned by Ganfeng. CNGR Advanced Material (SHE: 300919) backs Salar de Jama, while Tibet Summit Resources (SHA: 600338) is involved in Litio Ángeles. Approval of Pozuelos-Pastos Grandes alone would raise China’s ownership-weighted share of RIGI mining investment to 16.3%, according to Plusmining. Approving all three applications would lift it to 22.3%. Those scenarios apply the same equity-weighting method to the proposed investments and add them to the approved mining portfolio. They exclude spending outside RIGI, including the $1 billion Ganfeng paid to acquire Pozuelos-Pastos Grandes in 2022 and approximately $1.8 billion it had deployed alongside Lithium Argentina (TSX: LAR; NYSE: LAR) as of 2025. China’s direct equity participation remains concentrated in lithium. Argentina’s emerging copper developments, backed by companies including BHP (ASX, LON, NYSE: BHP), Lundin Mining (TSX: LUN; STO: LUMI) and Glencore (LON: GLEN), have no direct Chinese shareholders among the projects examined. Chinese-backed lithium developments represent approximately 307,000 tonnes of announced annual capacity, comprising 85,000 tonnes in approved projects and 222,000 tonnes awaiting approval. US $20B backing, stability key to Argentina’s mining push For that volume to represent 70% of the total, the relevant project universe would need to contain approximately 439,000 tonnes of annual capacity. Available disclosures omit production figures for several approved developments, including Rincón and Fénix, preventing independent confirmation of the widely cited proportion from the sources reviewed. The investment outlook also carries geopolitical implications. US President Donald Trump characterized dependence on imported processed critical minerals as a national security threat in January and reiterated that position in July. Argentina and the US signed a critical materials agreement in February, although Argentine Foreign Minister Pablo Quirno said the arrangement does not exclude Chinese investment. Economic ties complicate any rapid shift away from Beijing. The countries’ central banks extended their currency swap arrangement for five years, with its value equivalent to approximately 40% of Argentina’s international reserves. Argentina’s mining exports reached $4.7 billion in the first half of 2026, rising 74.4% year over year. Shipments to China increased 205%, compared with 90% growth in exports to the US. Argentina mining revival fuels $40B copper push Jorge Mora of the International Lithium Association has observed that China’s position as a leading lithium producer and consumer limits the direct influence US trade policy can exert on Argentina’s industry. Plusmining research shows the next RIGI approvals could materially change China’s measured participation. Their longer-term significance will depend on whether Chinese companies hold minority financial interests, control mining operations or secure future mineral supply through commercial agreements.

title: Hong Kong fencer Yu Chui-yee happy with six medals at Asian Para Games
zh_title: 香港击剑运动员余翠仪在亚残运会上获得六枚奖牌感到高兴
summary: 香港余翠仪在亚残运会上获得三枚银牌和三枚铜牌，比2018年多一枚。轮椅击剑队总共获得了八枚奖牌。团长卢子聪对80名运动员的表现给予了高度赞扬，其中不乏很多首次参赛的运动员。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 25 日 21:25 HKT · 2 分钟阅读《香港报》中国香港代表团草地滚球及轮椅击剑队于25日晚返回香港
content:
香港
余翠仪在亚残运会上获得三枚银牌和三枚铜牌，比2018年多一枚。轮椅击剑队总共获得了八枚奖牌。团长卢子聪对80名运动员的表现给予了高度赞扬，其中不乏很多首次参赛的运动员。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 25 日 21:25 香港时间 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

中国香港代表队的草地滚球队和轮椅击剑队在亚洲残疾人运动会结束比赛后于10月25日晚返回香港。

本届击剑比赛中获得三银三铜的余翠仪表示，她对自己的成绩感到非常满意。这位经验丰富的运动员曾参加过五届亚洲残疾人运动会，她指出，她今年的奖牌数比 2018 年雅加达亚洲残疾人运动会多了一枚。 “作为一名职业生涯后期的运动员，我仍然愿意寻求新的训练方法。我很感谢自己的努力，”她说。
余补充说，本届轮椅击剑队共获得八枚奖牌，成绩非常好。她指出，亚残运会是争夺2028年洛杉矶残奥会资格积分的第一站。 “这是两年后资格赛的良好开端，”她说。当被问及参加下一届亚残运会时，于说这是一个更遥远的目标，她说她首先要积累足够的积分以获得残奥会的参赛资格。

草地滚球方面，梁玉荣与张润在混合BC4双人项目中夺得金牌。梁振英表示，参加世锦赛后，他在亚残运会保持了状态。他说，在双人项目中赢得金牌特别有意义。张说，她现在的目标是参加亚洲锦标赛，这是一项赢得洛杉矶残奥会门票的比赛。

香港代表团共夺得3金、14银、24铜，奖牌总数达41枚。队长卢子聪对这次成绩表示满意。他说，该队派出了80名运动员参加奥运会，其中超过四分之一是首次参加比赛的年轻运动员。 “他们不仅取得了良好的成绩，还获得了宝贵的经验，”卢说。他补充说，让经验丰富的运动员和新运动员一起参加重大赛事可以让球队为未来的比赛做好准备。
[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

主编

负责 CLB.org.hk 报道和编辑标准的主编。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
Yu Chui-yee won three silver and three bronze medals at the Asian Para Games, one more than in 2018. The wheelchair fencing team took eight medals overall. Team团长 Lu Zicong praised the performance of 80 athletes, including many first-time participants.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

25 Oct 2026 at 21:25 HKT · 2 min read

The Hong Kong, China delegation's lawn bowls and wheelchair fencing teams returned to Hong Kong on the evening of 25 October after competing at the Asian Para Games.

Yu Chui-yee, who won three silver and three bronze medals in fencing at this edition, said she was very happy with her results. Having competed in five Asian Para Games, the experienced athlete noted that her medal count this year exceeded the one she achieved at the 2018 Jakarta Asian Para Games by one. 'As an athlete in the later stage of my career, I am still willing to seek new training methods. I am grateful for my own efforts,' she said.

Yu added that the wheelchair fencing team's total of eight medals this edition was an excellent outcome. She noted that the Asian Para Games served as the first stop for qualification points towards the 2028 Los Angeles Paralympic Games. 'This is a good start for qualification two years from now,' she said. When asked about competing in the next Asian Para Games, Yu described it as a more distant goal, saying she first wants to accumulate enough points to qualify for the Paralympics.

In lawn bowls, Leung Yuk-wing and Cheung Yun won a gold medal in the mixed BC4 pairs event. Leung said that after competing in the world championships, he maintained his form for the Asian Para Games. Winning gold in the pairs event was particularly meaningful, he said. Cheung said she now aims for the Asian Championships, which is a competition to earn tickets to the Los Angeles Paralympics.

The Hong Kong delegation won a total of 3 gold, 14 silver and 24 bronze medals, amounting to 41 medals overall. Team captain Lu Zicong described the results as satisfactory. He said the team sent 80 athletes to the Games, more than a quarter of whom were younger competitors participating for the first time. 'Not only did they achieve good results, they also gained valuable experience,' Lu said. He added that having both experienced and new athletes compete together in a major event has prepared the team well for future competitions.

title: Champi leaves 1 dead, 616 injured as storm moves away from Taiwan - Focus Taiwan
zh_title: 风暴远离台湾 占皮造成1人死亡、616人受伤 - 聚焦台湾
summary: 中新网台北10月24日电 据台湾中央紧急行动中心称，热带风暴“占比”已造成1人死亡、616人受伤，并造成基础设施部分破坏，随后于周六下午离开台湾。由于风暴目前正向日本南部移动，中央气象局 (CWA) 预计将于周六晚上 8:30 解除海上警报。下午2点30分解除了陆地警报。台风中心称，自周四开始影响台湾以来，截至下午5点，“占比”已造成1人死亡、616人受伤。死亡
content:
中新网台北10月24日电 据台湾中央紧急行动中心称，热带风暴“占比”已造成1人死亡、616人受伤，并造成基础设施部分破坏，随后于周六下午离开台湾。

由于风暴目前正向日本南部移动，中央气象局 (CWA) 预计将于周六晚上 8:30 解除海上警报。下午2点30分解除了陆地警报。

台风中心称，自周四开始影响台湾以来，截至下午5点，“占比”已造成1人死亡、616人受伤。

屏东县琉球乡发生死亡事件，周四，一名男子在海滩上被暴风浪卷走。

报告称，大多数受伤都是轻微擦伤和瘀伤，没有人报告失踪。

在收到的 9,027 份受损报告中，有 3,287 份涉及树木倒塌，其中台北市有 1,282 份，是所有市县中最多的，其次是台中市，有 646 份。 CEOC 表示，另外 3,033 起涉及重要基础设施，1,014 起涉及广告牌和标志。

CEOC表示，超过34万户家庭在风暴期间断电，截至周六晚间，约2.2万户家庭仍断电，但预计将在晚上11点恢复供电。
周四至下午4点，宜兰县累计降雨量为650.0毫米。周六，为全国最高，而桃园县和新竹县的降雨量均超过 500 毫米。 CEOC 表示，台北记录为 469.5 毫米。

仅周六至下午4点，苗栗录得302.0毫米降雨量，新竹县和台北录得约250毫米，嘉义县和南投县录得170毫米，云林县录得150毫米。

截至下午4点，共有4,960人被疏散。执行委员会表示，为预防山体滑坡，包括新北市、桃园市、基隆市、台南市以及宜兰、花莲、南投、云林、屏东、新竹、嘉义、台东县的居民。

截至下午 5 点周六，占比以台北东北约 320 公里处为中心，以每小时 14 至 21 公里的速度从东北偏北向东北移动。据 CWA 称，最大持续风速为 101 公里/小时，阵风高达 126 公里/小时。

中国气象局预报员林秉钰表示，占皮外环流周六晚至周日清晨仍将给苗栗县北部带来间歇性降雨。

林说，阵雨将逐渐减弱，并仅限于桃园以北地区以及台北和新北的山区，然后在周日早些时候逐渐减弱。
林说，周日和周一，台湾大部分地区多云到晴，东部有小雨。花莲、台东可能有大雨，中部、南部山区下午有零星阵雨。

与此同时，新北淡江大桥于下午3点关闭。周五下午 5 点重新开放，以防万一。

（刘建邦、张雄风、黄日升、石秀全撰）

尾项/ls

【原文 English Original】
Taipei, Oct. 24 (CNA) Tropical Storm Champi left one person dead, injured 616 and caused some damage to infrastructure before moving away from Taiwan on Saturday afternoon, according to Taiwan's Central Emergency Operation Center (CEOC).

With the storm currently on a course toward southern Japan, the Central Weather Administration (CWA) was expected to lift its sea warning Saturday night at 8:30 p.m. It lifted its land warning at 2:30 p.m.

As of 5 p.m., Champi had led to the death of one person and injured 616 since beginning to affect Taiwan on Thursday as a typhoon, the CEOC said.

The death was reported in Liuqiu Township, Pingtung County, where a man was swept away by storm-driven waves on a beach Thursday, the CEOC said.

Most injuries were minor scrapes and bruises, with no one reported missing, it said.

Of the 9,027 reports of damage received, 3,287 involved fallen trees, including 1,282 in Taipei, the most of any city or county, followed by 646 in Taichung. Another 3,033 involved essential infrastructure, while 1,014 involved billboards and signs, the CEOC said.

The CEOC said more than 340,000 households lost power during the storm, and about 22,000 were still without electricity as of Saturday evening but were expected to have service restored by 11 p.m.

Yilan County recorded 650.0 millimeters of accumulated rainfall from Thursday through 4 p.m. Saturday, the highest in the country, while Taoyuan and Hsinchu County each received more than 500 mm. Taipei recorded 469.5 mm, the CEOC said.

On Saturday alone through 4 p.m., Miaoli recorded 302.0 mm of rainfall, Hsinchu County and Taipei recorded about 250 mm, Chiayi and Nantou counties recorded 170 mm, and Yunlin County recorded 150 mm.

A total of 4,960 people had been evacuated by 4 p.m. as a precaution against landslides, including residents in New Taipei, Taoyuan, Keelung, and Tainan cities and Yilan, Hualien, Nantou, Yunlin, Pingtung, Hsinchu, Chiayi, and Taitung counties, the CEOC said.

As of 5 p.m. Saturday, Champi was centered about 320 kilometers northeast of Taipei, moving north-northeast to northeast at 14-21 kilometers per hour. It had maximum sustained winds of 101 kph, with gusts of up to 126 kph, according to the CWA.

CWA forecaster Lin Ping-yu (林秉煜) said Champi's outer circulation would still bring intermittent rain north of Miaoli County on Saturday night and early Sunday.

Lin said showers would gradually ease and become limited to areas north of Taoyuan and the mountainous areas of Taipei and New Taipei before tapering off early Sunday.

Lin said most areas in Taiwan would be partly cloudy to sunny on Sunday and Monday, with some rain in the east. Hualien and Taitung could see heavier rain, while mountainous areas of central and southern Taiwan could get scattered afternoon showers.

Meanwhile, Danjiang Bridge in New Taipei, which was closed at 3 p.m. Friday as a precaution against Champi, was reopened at 5 p.m.

(By Liu Chien-bang, Chang Hsiung-feng, Sunrise Huang, and Shih Hsiu-chuan)

Enditem/ls

title: Land warning for Typhoon Champi expected to be lifted Saturday evening: CWA - Focus Taiwan
zh_title: CWA：台风“占比”陆地警报预计将于周六晚上解除 - 聚焦台湾
summary: 中新社台北10月24日电 据中央气象局消息，台风“占比”陆地警报预计将于周六晚上解除，因为风暴将远离台湾。中国气象局天气预报中心副主任伍婉华对记者表示，“占比”可能会在周六下午减弱为热带风暴。她说，风暴海上警报预计将于周六晚上解除。 CWA 于周三晚间向 Champi 发布了海上警告，并于周四上午发布了陆地警告。随着风暴减弱，其半径缩小至250公里。
content:
中新社台北10月24日电 据中央气象局消息，台风“占比”陆地警报预计将于周六晚上解除，因为风暴将远离台湾。

中国气象局天气预报中心副主任伍婉华对记者表示，“占比”可能会在周六下午减弱为热带风暴。她说，风暴海上警报预计将于周六晚上解除。

CWA 于周三晚间向 Champi 发布了海上警告，并于周四上午发布了陆地警告。

吴说，随着风暴减弱，过去几个小时内其半径从280公里缩小到250公里，伴随的云系统也变得更加分散。

她补充说，周六早上风暴带来的降雨将继续减弱。

根据 CWA 的数据，截至周六上午 10 点，“占比”以台湾东北部宜兰县东北偏东约 170 公里处为中心，以每小时 21 公里的速度向北移动。

数据显示，台风最大持续风速为每小时126公里，阵风高达每小时162公里。

据中央紧急行动中心（CEOC）称，截至周六上午，占比强风和暴雨已造成台湾1人死亡、527人受伤。

屏东县琉球乡周四发生一例死亡事件，一名男子在海滩上被暴风浪卷走，伤者多发生在台北市和台中市。
CEOC补充说，受伤主要是由倒下的树木、掉落的电缆和广告牌以及损坏的水管造成的。

吴说，虽然台风最严重的影响已经过去，但台湾西部的迎风地区仍然遭遇大雨，特别是北部苗栗县的山区。

台北市、新北市、桃园市山区，以及台湾北部的新竹县、苗栗县等山区，发布特大暴雨警告或暴雨警告。

基隆市及北岸、台北市、新北市、桃园市、新竹市、新竹县、苗栗县、中部台中市、南投县、云林县、嘉义县、屏东县山区、高雄市、台南市山区、宜兰县也发布大雨特报。

据CWA称，特大雨预警意味着24小时内降雨量预计将超过200毫米，三小时内降雨量将超过100毫米，而大雨预警意味着24小时内降雨量预计将超过80毫米，一小时内降雨量将超过40毫米。

预计从周六晚上到周日清晨，降雨量将逐渐减少，台湾南部、东南部和东部地区的降水可能会在周日早上逐渐停止。

预计由 Champi 引发的风力也会减弱。她说，周五深夜，台湾最东端新北的三雕岬录得超过221公里/小时的阵风。
吴说，尽管占比强度减弱，但风暴产生的波浪仍然很高，特别是在台湾北部和东部海域，据报道波浪超过了六米。

（黄娇文、刘建鹏、黄芳芳撰文）

Enditem/吉隆坡

【原文 English Original】
Taipei, Oct. 24 (CNA) The land warning for Typhoon Champi is expected to be lifted Saturday evening as the storm moves away from Taiwan, according to the Central Weather Administration (CWA).

Speaking to reporters, Wu Wan-hua (伍婉華), deputy director of the CWA's Weather Forecast Center, said Champi was likely to weaken into a tropical storm Saturday afternoon. The sea warning for the storm was expected to be lifted Saturday night, she said.

The CWA issued a sea warning for Champi late Wednesday and a land warning Thursday morning.

As the storm weakened, its radius shrank to 250 kilometers from 280 km over the past few hours, while its accompanying cloud system became more scattered, Wu said.

Rainfall brought by the storm would continue to ease Saturday morning, she added.

As of 10 a.m. Saturday, Champi was centered at about 170 km east-northeast of Yilan County in northeastern Taiwan, moving north at 21 kph, according to CWA data.

The typhoon had maximum sustained winds of 126 kph, gusts of up to 162 kph, the data shows.

According to the Central Emergency Operations Center (CEOC), the strong winds and heavy rains of Champi had left one person dead and 527 injured in Taiwan as of Saturday morning.

The death was reported in Liuqiu Township, Pingtung County, where a man was swept away by storm-driven waves on a beach Thursday, and the injuries mostly occurred in Taipei and Taichung cities, the CEOC said.

The CEOC added the injuries were largely caused by downed trees, falling electricity cables and billboards and damaged water pipes.

Although the worst of the typhoon's impact was over, windward areas in western Taiwan were still experiencing heavy rain, particularly in mountainous areas of Miaoli County in northern Taiwan, Wu said.

An extremely heavy rain advisory or a heavy rain advisory was in effect for mountainous areas of Taipei, New Taipei and Taoyuan cities, as well as Hsinchu and Miaoli counties in northern Taiwan.

A heavy rain advisory was also in effect for Keelung and the north coast, Taipei, New Taipei and Taoyuan cities, Hsinchu City, Hsinchu and Miaoli counties, Taichung City and Nantou County in central Taiwan, mountainous areas of Yunlin, Chiayi and Pingtung counties and Kaohsiung and Tainan cities in southern Taiwan, as well as Yilan County.

An extremely heavy rain advisory means rainfall is expected to exceed 200 mm in 24 hours or 100 mm in three hours, while a heavy rain advisory means rainfall is expected to exceed 80 mm in 24 hours or 40 mm in one hour, according to the CWA.

Rain is expected to taper off from Saturday night through early Sunday morning, with precipitation likely to gradually stop in southern, southeastern and eastern Taiwan on Sunday morning.

Winds triggered by Champi are also expected to weaken. Late Friday night, Sandiao Cape in New Taipei, Taiwan's easternmost point, recorded a gust exceeding 221 kph, she said.

Despite Champi's weakening, waves generated by the storm remained high, particularly in waters north and east of Taiwan, where waves exceeding six meters were reported, Wu said.

(By Huang Chiao-wen, Liu Chien-pang and Frances Huang)

Enditem/KL

**Help Me Study Abroad in Taiwan – A Journey of Language, Culture & Growth**

Hi everyone,

I’m excited to share that I’ve been given an incredible opportunity to study abroad in Taiwan (June 3 - July 1)! This program will allow me to fully immerse myself in a new culture while studying Mandarin Chinese and engaging in meaningful cross-cultural experiences.

Studying abroad in Taiwan is more than just travel for me — it’s a chance to grow academically, professionally, and personally.

Why Taiwan?

Taiwan is known for its rich history and welcoming communities. By living and studying there, I will:

Strengthen my Mandarin Chinese language skills

Build cross-cultural communication skills

Study alongside local and international students

Experience Taiwanese traditions, festivals, and daily life firsthand

Develop independence, adaptability, and global awareness

**Why I’m Fundraising**

While I’ve worked hard to prepare for this opportunity, studying abroad comes with significant expenses, including:

Program tuition and fees

Housing

Flights

Cultural excursions and educational activities

Any contribution — big or small — will help make this life-changing experience possible.

**Your support is not just helping me travel — you are investing in my education, personal growth, and future.** I’m so grateful for any encouragement, donations, or shares. I can’t wait to share updates, photos, and stories from Taiwan along the way! Thank you for being part of this journey with me!

# 微软：网络攻击背后有与中国有关的黑客

19 小时前

* [复制链接](javascript:void(0);) [![图片 11：分享](https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/common/svg/ic_share.svg)](javascript:void(0);)
* [![图片12：facebook](https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/common/svg/ic_facebook.svg)](javascript:void(0);)
* [![图片 13: X](https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/common/images/x.png)](javascript:void(0);)
* [![图片 14: LINE](https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/common/svg/ic_line.svg)](javascript:void(0);)

微软表示，一群与中国政府有联系的黑客使用人工智能工具对全球数百个组织发起网络攻击。

这家美国科技巨头表示，这个与中国结盟的组织使用了一个名为 ARTEX 的框架来实施攻击，目标包括公共和私人组织。它表示通过对系统日志和其他记录的分析证实了网络攻击。

这些目标涵盖广泛的行业，包括航空航天、国防、能源和金融服务。

微软表示，其中几次攻击使黑客能够在三个小时内获得对组织云基础设施的特权访问。

据称，登录尝试次数峰值达到每分钟 2,900 次，这样的速度让防御者几乎没有时间检测入侵并做出响应。

目前尚不清楚 ARTEX 是否也被用于最近针对日本公司的一系列网络攻击，但据报道，在上个月末的一系列事件中，它被用来针对韩国金融机构。

# Microsoft: China-linked hackers behind cyberattacks

19 hours ago

*   [Copy link](javascript:void(0);) [![Image 11: Share](https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/common/svg/ic_share.svg)](javascript:void(0);)
*   [![Image 12: facebook](https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/common/svg/ic_facebook.svg)](javascript:void(0);)
*   [![Image 13: X](https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/common/images/x.png)](javascript:void(0);)
*   [![Image 14: LINE](https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/common/svg/ic_line.svg)](javascript:void(0);)

Microsoft says a group of hackers linked to the Chinese government used an AI tool to launch cyberattacks on hundreds of organizations worldwide.

The US tech giant says the China-aligned group used a framework called ARTEX to carry out the attacks, which targeted both public and private organizations. It says it confirmed the cyber-offensive through an analysis of system logs and other records.

The targets span a broad range of industries, including aerospace, defense, energy and financial services.

Microsoft says several of the attacks allowed the hackers to gain privileged access to an organization's cloud infrastructure in under three hours.

It says the number of sign-in attempts peaked at 2,900 per minute, a pace that leaves defenders with little time to detect an intrusion and respond.

It's not clear whether ARTEX was also used in a series of recent cyberattacks on Japanese firms, but it was reportedly used to target South Korean financial institutions in a series of incidents from late last month.

content: 作者臉書  2026-10-23 剛過去的十月十六日，《求是》雜誌發表習近平去年一篇講話，標題是《以更高標準、更實舉措推進全面從嚴治黨》，原文內容龐雜，全篇黨八股，但流露一種對黨的組織和領導能力的深度焦慮。 中共一個百年大黨，經歷戰爭年代、饑荒年代、文革動亂年代、改革開放年代、國力崛起年代、經濟倒退年代等多重考驗，不但組織沒有垮，甚且發展成世界第一大黨，迄今黨員近億，按理，全世界只有中共是最穩固的、能量最大的黨。 一個政黨的向心力，首先靠的是理想，其次是利益，再次是紀律，最後是懲戒，任何一個黨都不能缺這四樣。中共自延安年代起就整黨，以殺人為最高手段，規範每個黨員的言行，以黨的集體利益凌駕個人生死禍福。長年洗腦的結果，中共黨員已經自覺將黨性置換人性，早已形成一種獨特的馴服本能，每個人都成為中共的實用工具。 自鄧小平以下歷屆中共中央，都有改革開放帶來的經濟利益作背書，國家有錢了，黨的權力穩固了，周旋範圍大了，黨員幹部的財富暴漲，百姓的生活水平也有提高。這使黨的執政合法性得到確認，上下都撈得盆滿砵滿，當其時黨的向心力十足，無須整黨，將士用命。 但隨著習近平倒行逆施，中國經濟拾級而下，現在國庫空了，各級政府「水緊」，官員都勒緊褲腰帶，個人和親屬只能望「錢」止渴，而基層百姓窮困潦倒，到處生事，官員們的工作壓力倍增，中共執政的合法性在瓦解之中。 面對這種看不到盡頭的困境，各級官員產生的消極情緒，演變成各種不同形式的躺平策略，上有決策下有對策，而中央開始感覺到地方官員負面情緒的壓力，政令不行，行動遲緩，政策推行大打折扣，黨的肢體麻木。 經濟惡化的趨勢在未來日子裡會急速加劇，中共手上可以用的工具卻越來越少，現在沒有官員和中央談什麼理想了，原本靠地方經濟蓬勃而白撈的個人財富正在快速流失，而反腐的幽靈卻一天到晚在頭頂徘徊。講黨紀可以欺上瞞下，反腐落到頭上只能聽天由命，當時局日益不堪，性命隨時不保，各級官員的離心力快速成長，這成了習近平的心頭大患。 主要問題還在於，國內外局勢將在未來數年內極度惡化，經濟自由落體下墜，美英歐日台外圍壓力驟增，民生凋蔽造成社會動亂四起，而中共自身的政治經濟路線大面積敗壞，只能硬著頭皮「頂硬上」——不能指望形勢改觀，只能指望在腥風血雨之下，撐得一時是一時。 前無去路後有追兵，只能反求諸己，就是當風雨襲來時，自己的隊伍還能上下一心，靠一股主觀意志力，眾志成城來面對，這便是習近平在五中全會上提出「從嚴治黨」的來歷——這是最後一招了，這一招用完，只能等天來收。 習近平無疑有過人的政治野心，敗在他沒有過人的認知能力與處事能力，所以他上台十餘年，把所有戕害中共的事情都辦齊全了，而且唯恐辦得不夠快不夠徹底。在他努力之下，中共國果然在短短十餘年間，把家底都敗光了，他以為功蓋天下，實際是惡貫滿盈。 獨裁者通常都有一定的領袖魅力，斯大林、希特勒、毛澤東、鄧小平都有迷惑公眾的本事，他們直到晚年都還能呼風喚雨，反觀習近平，論領袖魅力根本不足道也。因此，他無法在精神上感召黨徒，也不能給各級官員實際的好處，再加上以反腐為工具，摧毀官員們最低限度的安全感，因此對習近平來說，今後最大的危險是黨內各級官員空前的離心力。 凡是獨裁者，一到晚年都有相同的精神毛病，一是多疑，二是偏執，三是焦慮，四是冷酷。因為自己的地位高不可攀，覬覦者必多，越是親信，越可能有二心，因此獨裁者身邊的人通常最危險。因為他們接近最高權力，深知權力的潑天好處，決不可能安於其位，所以斯大林和老毛，晚年都以殺親信為快。 獨裁者的偏執，也是晚年通病，越是位高權重，越聽不得反對聲音，越千方百計要堅持和維護自己的錯誤決策，越不能忍受他人質疑，越擔心身後名山事業，越不擇手段要收拾敢於擋路的政客。 獨裁者的焦慮來自兩方面，一是對自己至高無上地位缺乏安全感的焦慮，二是對自己身後可能遭遇千古罵名的焦慮，習近平現在也處在這雙重焦慮之中。他會不會遭遇黨內反對派的突然襲擊，被人以非正常手段奪權，還是因為得罪人太多，被政敵合謀，以正常黨紀國法廢絀？至於身後事，他更無把握，為保障自己的歷史地位，要在生前做更多缺德事。 至於獨裁者晚年的冷酷，那更是一種命定的心理癥候。在中共黨內混，稍有人性者都已敗下陣去，那些升上高位的，早已煉就一身百毒不侵的冷血本色。一旦升到最高位，殺人無須償命，殺錯了無須改正，時間長了，軟心腸倒成了無用的別名，上下都冷酷，冷酷成了正常。 整黨要幹什麼，整黨就要排除那些靠不住的黨官，強制黨官一心跟著自己走，不管自己走對或走錯，都要強化自己地位的安全感，保障百年後光宗耀祖的英名。為此，該罷官就罷官，該抓捕就抓捕，該殺頭就殺頭，以此立威，以此震懾百官。 一句話講晒，習近平的從嚴整黨，是沒有辦法中的辦法，是絕地一煲，拿中共生死作一手大賭注。黨已經在渙散中，你再從嚴整黨，把更多黨徒搞到心死，那時災難臨頭，各級黨官一哄而散，捲逃的捲逃，跳船的跳船，沒有人與你鎮守一寸土地，習近平還能安坐中南海裡喝茅台酒？

title: Hong Kong insurance premiums surge 35.5% in first half of 2026
zh_title: 2026年上半年香港保费飙升35.5%
summary: 香港保险业监管局的临时数据显示，2026年上半年，香港的保费总额增长35.5%，至5,736亿港元。汇丰人寿以 24.3% 的新业务保费份额领跑寿险市场。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 23 日香港时间 22:22 · 2 分钟阅读保险业监管局（保监局）公布临时统计数字，显示香港保费总额上升35.5%
content:
香港
根据保险业监管局的临时数据，2026年上半年香港的保费总额增长35.5%至5,736亿港元。汇丰人寿以 24.3% 的新业务保费份额领跑寿险市场。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 23 日 22:22 香港时间 · 阅读 2 分钟

保险业监管局公布的临时统计数据显示，2026年上半年香港的保费总额上升35.5%至5,736亿港元。

长期业务（不包括退休计划业务）的新保单保费达2,752亿港元，增长58.4%。这主要是由于非关联个人业务增加 2,629 亿港元，增长 57.8%。其中，参与业务贡献2,454亿港元，上升63.7%，其他业务贡献175亿港元，上升4.9%。关联个人业务贡献120亿港元，增长73.7%。保监局签发了约33,000份合资格延期年金保单，贡献21亿港元，占个人业务保费总额的0.8%。
有效业务总保费收入达5,099亿港元，增长39.7%。其中非关联个人业务为 4,658 亿港元，增长 44.8%；关联个人业务收入178亿港元，增长40%；退休计划业务为222亿港元，下降16.7%。已支付的索偿及赔偿总额为1,798亿港元，减少6.3%。

一般业务方面，毛保费总额为637亿港元，上升9.1%，净保费为421亿港元，上升5.7%。已赔付总额达313亿港元，上升22.2%。一般业务整体经营溢利为96亿港元，上升48.1%，其中承保溢利58亿港元，大幅上升253.1%。

根据保监局的临时数据，汇丰人寿在新业务保费和年化新保费方面均稳居香港寿险市场首位，市场份额分别为24.3%和23.3%，分别为668亿港元和253亿港元。

香港汇丰人寿行政总裁兼汇丰保险联席首席执行官曾黛诗表示，该保险部门预计长期保险的潜在需求将继续增长，特别是在有吸引力的方案、高质量服务和健全的风险管理的支持下，满足保障和遗产规划的需求。
[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
Hong Kong's total gross insurance premiums rose 35.5% to HK$573.6 billion in the first half of 2026, according to provisional data from the Insurance Authority. HSBC Life led the life insurance market with a 24.3% share of new business premiums.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

23 Oct 2026 at 22:22 HKT · 2 min read

The Insurance Authority (IA) has reported provisional statistics showing Hong Kong's total gross insurance premiums rose 35.5 per cent in the first half of 2026 to HK$573.6 billion.

New office premiums for long-term business, excluding retirement scheme business, reached HK$275.2 billion, an increase of 58.4 per cent. This was mainly driven by HK$262.9 billion from non-linked individual business, which rose 57.8 per cent. Within that category, participating business contributed HK$245.4 billion, up 63.7 per cent, while other businesses accounted for HK$17.5 billion, a rise of 4.9 per cent. Linked individual business contributed HK$12 billion, an increase of 73.7 per cent. The IA issued approximately 33,000 qualifying deferred annuity policies, contributing HK$2.1 billion, or 0.8 per cent of total premiums for individual business.

Total revenue premiums of in-force business stood at HK$509.9 billion, up 39.7 per cent. This comprised HK$465.8 billion from non-linked individual business, up 44.8 per cent; HK$17.8 billion from linked individual business, up 40 per cent; and HK$22.2 billion from retirement scheme business, down 16.7 per cent. Total claims and benefits paid amounted to HK$179.8 billion, a decrease of 6.3 per cent.

For general business, total gross premiums were HK$63.7 billion, up 9.1 per cent, with net premiums of HK$42.1 billion, up 5.7 per cent. Total gross claims paid reached HK$31.3 billion, an increase of 22.2 per cent. Overall operating profit for general business was HK$9.6 billion, up 48.1 per cent, of which HK$5.8 billion was attributable to underwriting profit, a surge of 253.1 per cent.

According to the IA's provisional data, HSBC Life retained its top position in Hong Kong's life insurance market for both new business premiums and annualised new premiums, holding market shares of 24.3 per cent and 23.3 per cent, representing HK$66.8 billion and HK$25.3 billion, respectively.

Daisy Tsang, chief executive of HSBC Life Hong Kong and co-CEO of HSBC insurance, said the insurance unit expects underlying demand for long-term insurance to continue growing, particularly to meet protection and legacy-planning needs, supported by attractive propositions, high-quality service and sound risk management.

[![Image 3: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

content:
中新社台北10月23日电 航空公司和轮渡当局表示，随着台风“占比”的临近，周六往返台湾的航班已被取消或推迟，国内航班和轮渡服务也已暂停。

据该航空公司网站周五晚间报道，星宇航空已取消周六从桃园飞往雅加达苏加诺-哈达国际机场的 JX761 航班，以及飞往下地岛机场的 JX890 航班和飞往冲绳那霸的 JX870 航班。

该网站显示，从桃园飞往菲律宾克拉克国际机场的JX789航班、飞往日本神户的JX834航班以及飞往越南新山一国际机场的JX711航班将被延误。

星宇航空宣布，周六所有往返台中的航班均被取消，台北-下地岛航线 JX890/JX891 和台北-冲绳航线 JX870/JX871 也被取消。

该航空公司表示，周六还将增加两趟从东京飞往台湾的航班，以帮助航班被取消的乘客。

台湾虎航表示，将取消周六台湾与日本之间的航班，包括桃园至冲绳的IT230/IT231、东京成田机场的IT200/IT280、大阪关西机场的IT210/IT284/IT710、桃园至石垣岛的IT736/IT737、桃园至东京的IT214/IT217、桃园至东京的IT216/IT217。羽田机场、IT234 往来札幌新千岁机场、IT240/IT241 往来桃园和福冈。
该航空公司还表示，往返台湾和韩国济州岛的 IT632/IT654/IT655/IT675 航班已取消。

台湾虎航表示，周六台湾与日本之间的多趟航班将延误，包括桃园至名古屋往返的IT206/207、高雄至仙台的IT772/773、桃园至高知的IT250/251、桃园至大分的IT750/751以及桃园至东京成田机场的IT202/203。

该航空公司表示，其他亚洲航线的航班也将被延误，包括从首尔仁川机场飞往桃园的IT603、桃园至釜山的IT606/607、台湾至普吉岛的IT503/504以及台湾至越南岘港的IT552/585。

长荣航空表示，周六中午之前部分往返桃园国际机场和台北松山机场的航班将被取消，敦促乘客在出发前查看最新航班信息。

中华航空表示，周六中午之前往返台湾所有机场的航班可能会提前、取消或延迟，建议乘客在前往机场之前先在其网站或移动应用程序上查看实时航班信息。

## 国内航班和渡轮服务

国内航空公司中，立荣航空表示，下午4点前有往返台北松山机场和台中机场的航班。周六下午1点前往返嘉义、台南、高雄的航班将取消。也将被取消。
立荣航空表示，周六所有飞往马祖的航班也将被取消，该航空公司补充称，将继续监测台风情况，并根据需要调整航班时刻表。

华信航空表示，松山-台东、松山-金门、松山-马祖、松山-澎湖、台中-金门、台中-澎湖、高雄-金门、高雄-澎湖、高雄-花莲航线周六部分航班将被取消。其他航班可能会根据天气情况重新安排。

海港局表示，基隆至马祖、南竿至福州、北竿至福州、东港至小琉球、盐浦至西安等6条航线

【原文 English Original】
Taipei, Oct. 23 (CNA) Flights to and from Taiwan have been canceled or postponed Saturday as Typhoon Champi approaches, while domestic flights and ferry services have also been suspended, airlines and ferry authorities said.

Starlux Airlines has canceled flight JX761 from Taoyuan to Jakarta's Soekarno-Hatta International Airport, as well as flights JX890 to Shimojishima Airport and JX870 to Naha, Okinawa, on Saturday, according to the airline's website as of Friday night.

Flights JX789 from Taoyuan to Clark International Airport in the Philippines, JX834 to Kobe in Japan and JX711 to Tan Son Nhat International Airport in Vietnam will be delayed, the website showed.

All flights to and from Taichung are canceled Saturday, as are the airline's Taipei-Shimojishima service JX890/JX891 and Taipei-Okinawa service JX870/JX871, Starlux Airlines announced.

There will be two additional flights from Tokyo to Taiwan Saturday to help passengers whose flights were canceled, the airline said.

Tigerair Taiwan said Saturday's flights between Taiwan and Japan would be canceled, including IT230/IT231 between Taoyuan and Okinawa, IT200/IT280 to Tokyo's Narita Airport, IT210/IT284/IT710 to Osaka's Kansai Airport, IT736/IT737 between Taoyuan and Ishigaki, IT214 to Okayama, IT216/IT217 between Taoyuan and Tokyo's Haneda Airport, IT234 to Sapporo's New Chitose Airport and IT240/IT241 between Taoyuan and Fukuoka.

The airline also said flights IT632/IT654/IT655/IT675 between Taiwan and Jeju, South Korea, are canceled.

Tigerair Taiwan said several flights between Taiwan and Japan on Saturday will be delayed, including IT206/207 between Taoyuan and Nagoya, IT772/773 between Kaohsiung and Sendai, IT250/251 between Taoyuan and Kochi, IT750/751 between Taoyuan and Oita, and IT202/203 between Taoyuan and Tokyo's Narita Airport.

Flights on other Asian routes will also be delayed, including IT603 from Seoul's Incheon Airport to Taoyuan, IT606/607 between Taoyuan and Busan, IT503/504 between Taiwan and Phuket, and IT552/585 between Taiwan and Da Nang in Vietnam, the airline said.

EVA Air said some flights to and from Taoyuan International Airport and Taipei Songshan Airport through noon Saturday will be canceled, urging passengers to check the latest flight information before departure.

China Airlines said flights to and from all airports in Taiwan through noon Saturday could be brought forward, canceled or delayed, advising passengers to check real-time flight information on its website or mobile app before heading to the airport.

## Domestic flights and ferry services

Among domestic carriers, Uni Air said flights to and from Taipei Songshan and Taichung airports before 4 p.m. Saturday will be canceled, while flights to and from Chiayi, Tainan and Kaohsiung before 1 p.m. will also be canceled.

Uni Air said all flights to Matsu will also be canceled Saturday, with the airline adding that it will continue to monitor the typhoon and adjust flight schedules as necessary.

Mandarin Airlines said some Saturday flights on its Songshan-Taitung, Songshan-Kinmen, Songshan-Matsu, Songshan-Penghu, Taichung-Kinmen, Taichung-Penghu, Kaohsiung-Kinmen, Kaohsiung-Penghu and Kaohsiung-Hualien routes will be canceled. Other flights are likely to be rescheduled depending on weather conditions.

Meanwhile, the Maritime and Port Bureau said that six ferry routes, including those between Keelung and Matsu, Nangan and Fuzhou, Beigan and Fuzhou, Donggang and Xiaoliuqiu, Yanpu and Xiaoliuqiu, and Fugang and Green Island, will be suspended Saturday.

For more information, passengers can check the bureau's website.

(By Yu Hsiao-han and Shih Hsiu-chuan)

title: Taiwan manufacturers' business sentiment hits 54-month high - Focus Taiwan
zh_title: 台湾制造商景气创54个月新高 - 聚焦台湾
summary: 中新社台北10月23日电 台湾经济研究院([TIER](https://www.tier.org.tw/))周五表示，受全球人工智能(AI)热潮的提振，台湾出口导向型制造业9月份的商业信心升至约54个月来的最高水平，同时警告未来潜在风险。台湾领先的经济智库之一TIER编制的数据显示，衡量本地制造商商业信心的制造业综合指数较8月上涨0.50点至101.39，为2022年2月以来的最高水平。时间
content:
中新社台北10月23日电 台湾经济研究院([TIER](https://www.tier.org.tw/))周五表示，受全球人工智能(AI)热潮的提振，台湾出口导向型制造业9月份的商业信心升至约54个月来的最高水平，同时警告未来潜在风险。

台湾领先的经济智库之一TIER编制的数据显示，衡量本地制造商商业信心的制造业综合指数较8月上涨0.50点至101.39，为2022年2月以来的最高水平。

数据显示，服务业综合指数环比下跌3.15点至92.65，建筑业综合指数则止跌回升，较8月上涨2.81点至110.42。

TIER 表示，制造商继续受益于国际品牌在新产品发布（包括 iPhone 18 系列和 iPhone Duo）之前对人工智能基础设施的大规模全球投资和库存积累。

该研究所表示，国际原油价格飙升也推高了石化产品价格，而一些非科技行业完成年度检修有助于提振生产。
在 TIER 9 月份的调查中，26.8% 的制造业受访者表示当月商业状况有所改善，高于 8 月份的 19.5%，而 20.3% 的受访者表示状况恶化，低于一个月前的 25.6%。

然而，对未来六个月的预期减弱。在同一调查中，24.0%的受访者预计经营状况将改善，较8月份下降3.1个百分点；19.8%的受访者预计经营状况会恶化，较8月份上升1.8个百分点。

TIER经济预测中心主任孙明德表示，尽管有AI热潮和消费电子旺季的支撑，台湾经济仍面临风险，包括美联储可能采取更强硬的立场来抑制通胀。

孙说，美联储加息可能会导致美元兑新台币走强，从而可能促使外国机构投资者将资金撤出台湾，并导致当地金融市场波动。

孙说，中东的军事冲突可能会推高原油价格，并促使上游石化供应商提高价格，但这种提价可能会削弱下游买家的需求。

孙还指出了对人工智能发展可能放缓的担忧，这最近给全球股市带来了压力。
TIER 表示，在服务业，近期金融市场的波动使企业更加谨慎，但食品和饮料行业继续受益于需求增长。

该智库表示，在建筑方面，央行在9月中旬放松了选择性信贷控制，支撑了房地产市场，但该行业仍面临大量未售出房屋库存。

（潘子瑜、黄芳芳摄）

Enditem/sfj

【原文 English Original】
Taipei, Oct. 23 (CNA) Business sentiment in Taiwan's export-oriented manufacturing sector rose to its highest level in about 54 months in September, buoyed by the global artificial intelligence (AI) boom, the Taiwan Institute of Economic Research ([TIER](https://www.tier.org.tw/)) said Friday, while warning of potential risks ahead.

The manufacturing sector's composite index, which gauges business sentiment among local manufacturers, rose 0.50 points from August to 101.39, its highest level since February 2022, according to data compiled by TIER, one of Taiwan's leading economic think tanks.

The composite index for the service sector fell 3.15 points month-on-month to 92.65, while the index for the construction industry rebounded from a previous decline, rising 2.81 points from August to 110.42, the data showed.

TIER said manufacturers continued to benefit from massive global investments in AI infrastructure and inventory buildup by international brands ahead of new product launches, including the iPhone 18 series and iPhone Duo.

A surge in international crude oil prices also pushed up the prices of petrochemical products, while the completion of annual maintenance by some non-tech industries helped boost production, the institute said.

In TIER's September survey, 26.8 percent of manufacturing respondents said business conditions had improved that month, up from 19.5 percent in August, while 20.3 percent said conditions had worsened, down from 25.6 percent a month earlier.

Expectations for the next six months weakened, however. In the same survey, 24.0 percent of respondents expected business conditions to improve, down 3.1 percentage points from August, while 19.8 percent expected them to deteriorate, up 1.8 percentage points.

Gordon Sun (孫明德), director of TIER's Economic Forecasting Center, said that despite support from the AI boom and the peak season for consumer electronics, Taiwan's economy still faced risks, including the possibility of the U.S. Federal Reserve taking a more hawkish stance to curb inflation.

A Fed rate hike would likely strengthen the U.S. dollar against the Taiwan dollar, potentially prompting foreign institutional investors to pull funds out of Taiwan and causing volatility in local financial markets, Sun said.

Military conflicts in the Middle East could push crude oil prices higher and prompt upstream petrochemical suppliers to raise prices, though such increases could weaken demand from downstream buyers, Sun said.

Sun also noted concerns about a possible slowdown in AI development, which have recently weighed on global stock markets.

In the service sector, recent financial market volatility has made businesses more cautious, though the food and beverage industry continued to benefit from rising demand, TIER said.

In construction, the central bank's easing of selective credit controls in mid-September supported the property market, but the industry still face a large inventory of unsold homes, the think tank said.

(By Pan Tzu-yu and Frances Huang)

title: THE BODY REMEMBERS:  Releasing Trauma Through Energy Healing with Susan Rogert, Mon, Nov 2, 2026, 7:00 PM   | Meetup
summary: Presented by Susan Rogert, Reiki Master, Teacher & Certified Medical Reiki Practitioner What if your body has been holding on to something your heart is ready to release? Some experiences leave more than memories. They leave echoes — old wo
content:
Presented by Susan Rogert, Reiki Master, Teacher & Certified Medical Reiki Practitioner

What if your body has been holding on to something your heart is ready to release?

Some experiences leave more than memories. They leave echoes — old wounds, unspoken emotions, and invisible burdens we may not even realize we're carrying.

Even when our minds have moved on, our bodies may still remember. But what if there's a gentler way to release what we've been holding and open the door to healing?

Join us for a fascinating exploration with Susan Rogert, as she takes us beyond the physical and into the unseen world of energy, where she believes the imprints of trauma can linger — and where new possibilities for healing may begin.

Drawing on nine years of working with first responders and military personnel, Susan will share what she has witnessed through her Reiki practice, how trauma may influence our energetic well-being, and how gentle energy work can offer a path toward greater peace, balance, and release.

Meet Susan Rogert
 Susan is a Reiki Master, teacher, certified Medical Reiki practitioner, and founder of Healing Home Omaha, a program devoted to offering natural energy healing practices to first responders and military personnel.

For nine years, she has dedicated herself to helping those who have carried extraordinary burdens, discovering along the way the profound connection she sees between the body's energy, our experiences, and our capacity for healing.

Susan brings something beautiful to her work: a gentle presence, a compassionate heart, and a deep respect for the healing journey of every person she encounters.

Perhaps the most extraordinary part of healing isn't what we discover we've been carrying — but what becomes possible when we finally begin to let it go.

If time permits, the talk will end with a meditation.

content:
商务
香港证券及期货事务监察委员会已对美味集团的三名高级管理人员和五名联系人提起诉讼，指控他们操纵股价以满足从创业板转主板的上市要求。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 22 日 16:59 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

香港证券及期货事务监察委员会（证监会）已向市场失当行为审裁处对Tasty集团的三名高级管理人员及其五名亲属、雇员和密切联系人提起诉讼，指控其计划操纵该公司股价，以便利其从香港联交所创业板转往主板的计划。

证监会指称，于2020年6月1日至9月18日期间，美味集团主席兼联合创始人黄宜山、行政总裁兼联合创始人陈伟珍以及前首席财务官余孟泰指示或协调另外五名人士——陈雪怡、黄一鸣、黄日进、黄家英和陈文——进行交易。五人被指直接或通过他人买卖Tasty Group股份，人为推高并维持股价于1.32港元左右，以满足主板转板的最低市值5亿港元的要求。
期内，公司股价由0.73港元飙升至1.36港元，涨幅达86%。证监会表示，这些交易表现出价格操纵的特征，包括在接近收市时提出激进的出价以及可能设定或影响收盘价的订单。六个交易日中，成交量占该日公司股票全部成交量。

证监会表示，个人之间的沟通包括讨论目标价格以及何时以及如何下订单。涉嫌的计划还涉及大量资金转移，资金在用于购买 Tasty Group 股票之前不久就被转移。股价于2020年7月27日首次收于1.32港元上方，公司于2020年8月5日宣布正式申请转主板，但最终没有进行计划的转板。

仲裁庭将确定是否发生任何市场不当行为，并查明参与涉嫌不当行为的任何个人。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

主编

【原文 English Original】
Business
Hong Kong's Securities and Futures Commission has launched proceedings against three senior executives of Tasty Group and five associates, alleging they manipulated the share price to meet listing requirements for a transfer from GEM to the Main Board.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

22 Oct 2026 at 16:59 HKT · 2 min read

Hong Kong's Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) has initiated proceedings before the Market Misconduct Tribunal against three senior executives of Tasty Group and five of their relatives, employees and close associates, alleging a scheme to manipulate the company's share price to facilitate its planned transfer from the Hong Kong Stock Exchange's GEM board to the Main Board.

The SFC alleged that between 1 June and 18 September 2020, Tasty Group Chairman and co-founder Wong Yee Shan, Chief Executive Officer and co-founder Chen Wai Zhen, and former Chief Financial Officer Yu Mang Tai instructed or coordinated five other individuals — Chan Suet Yi, Wong Yat Ming, Wong Yat Chun, Wong Ka Ying and Chan Man — to conduct transactions. The five are alleged to have bought and sold Tasty Group shares, either directly or through others, artificially pushing up and maintaining the share price at about HK$1.32 to meet the minimum market capitalisation requirement of HK$500 million for a Main Board transfer.

During the period, the company's share price surged 86 per cent from HK$0.73 to HK$1.36. The SFC said the transactions exhibited characteristics of price manipulation, including aggressive bids placed near market close and orders that could set or influence closing prices. On six trading days, the transactions accounted for all trading in the company's shares for that day.

The SFC said communications among the individuals included discussions about target prices and when and how to place orders. The alleged scheme also involved large fund transfers, with money moved shortly before being used to purchase Tasty Group shares. The share price first closed above HK$1.32 on 27 July 2020, and the company announced its formal application to transfer to the Main Board on 5 August 2020, though it ultimately did not proceed with the planned transfer.

The tribunal will determine whether any market misconduct occurred and identify any individuals who engaged in the alleged misconduct.

content:

据 CNBC 报道，2026 年前 9 个月，中国大陆和香港的主权财富基金投资额达到 142 亿美元，较 2025 年全年总额激增 190%，这主要是由中东基金推动的。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 22 日 17:47 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

据 CNBC 周四报道，2026 年前 9 个月，主权财富基金在中国大陆和香港的投资额为 142 亿美元（1107.6 亿港元），较 2025 年全年投资额增长 190%，主要由中东投资者推动。

报告称，这是因为主权投资者对中国技术、生物技术、消费业务和先进制造业的兴趣日益浓厚，旨在抓住中国竞争性行业的机遇。

报告援引新加坡咨询公司 Global SWF 的数据称，今年前 9 个月主权投资的强劲表现与 2025 年同比下降 54% 形成鲜明对比，当时地缘政治紧张局势和对中国经济前景的担忧抑制了投资者情绪。
在中国内地和香港的投资中，沙特阿拉伯公共投资基金出资60亿美元，阿布扎比投资局出资25亿美元。再加上阿布扎比穆巴达拉和卡塔尔投资局的8亿美元和6亿美元投资，这四个海湾财富基金占同期流入中国和香港的主权资金流入的近70%。

新加坡淡马锡首席投资官罗希特·西帕希马拉尼 (Rohit Sipahimalani) 在最近举行的米尔肯峰会上表示，生物科技是该基金在中国投资的一个特别令人兴奋的领域，本土消费品牌也拥有强大的潜力。他进一步指出，中国在人工智能硬件供应链上的竞争力不断增强，可能会让中国制造商越来越多地挑战全球参与者。

淡马锡是中国光学元件制造商中际旭创7月份在香港首次公开募股的基石投资者之一，该发行规模为534.1亿港元，这是今年亚洲第二大股票发行。 8月，卡塔尔投资局和挪威主权财富基金也加入了阿里巴巴102亿美元的股票发行。

Sovereign wealth fund investments in mainland China and Hong Kong reached US$14.2 billion in the first nine months of 2026, a 190 per cent surge over 2025's full-year total, driven largely by Middle Eastern funds, CNBC reported.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

22 Oct 2026 at 17:47 HKT · 2 min read

Sovereign wealth funds invested US$14.2 billion (HK$110.76 billion) in mainland China and Hong Kong in the first nine months of 2026, a 190 per cent surge over the funds' full-year investments in 2025, driven mainly by Middle Eastern investors, CNBC reported on Thursday.

This came as interest grew among sovereign investors in Chinese technology, biotechnology, consumer businesses and advanced manufacturing, aiming to seize opportunities in Chinese competitive sectors, the report said.

The robust performance of sovereign investment during the nine months this year contrasts with the 54 per cent year-on-year decline recorded in 2025, when geopolitical tensions and concerns over China's economic outlook dampened investor sentiment, according to the report, citing data from Singapore-based consultancy Global SWF.

Among the investments in mainland China and Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund contributed US$6 billion, while Abu Dhabi Investment Authority invested US$2.5 billion. Coupled with US$800 million and US$600 million investment from Abu Dhabi's Mubadala and Qatar Investment Authority, the four Gulf wealth funds accounted for nearly 70 per cent of sovereign inflow into China and Hong Kong during the period.

Singapore's Temasek chief investment officer Rohit Sipahimalani said at the recent Milken Summit that biotechnology stands out as a particularly exciting sector for the fund to invest in China, with local consumer brands also holding strong potential. He further noted that China's rising competitiveness across the AI hardware supply chain could see Chinese manufacturers increasingly challenge global players.

Temasek was among the cornerstone investors in Chinese optical-components manufacturer Zhongji Innolight's HK$53.41 billion Hong Kong initial public offering in July - Asia's second-largest share sale this year. In August, Qatar Investment Authority and Norway's sovereign wealth fund also joined Alibaba's US$10.2 billion share offering.

title: Endoscopic sleeve gastroplasty offers non-surgical obesity treatment in Hong Kong
zh_title: 内窥镜袖状胃成形术在香港提供非手术肥胖治疗
summary: 香港 Dennis Lam 医生将内窥镜袖状胃成形术 (ESG) 描述为一种无疤痕手术，可将胃容量减少 70%，帮助代谢综合征患者在 12 至 24 个月内实现 15% 至 20% 的总体体重减轻，且无需腹部切口。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 21 日 05:22 HKT · 2 分钟阅读《香港患者》据报道，患有严重肥胖症的香港人常常很难找到正确的治疗方法
content:
香港
Dennis Lam 博士将内窥镜袖状胃成形术 (ESG) 描述为一种无疤痕手术，可将胃容量减少 70%，帮助代谢综合征患者在 12 至 24 个月内实现 15% 至 20% 的总体体重减轻，且无需腹部切口。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 21 日 05:22 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

普通外科专家林展头医生表示，香港患有严重肥胖症的患者往往很难找到合适的治疗方法。他说，虽然腹腔镜减肥手术仍然是一种高效的金标准干预措施，但并不是每个候选人都适合或能适应大手术。

在临床实践中，患者经常表示感到陷入困境：传统的生活方式措施可能产生有限的长期效果，而外科手术感觉像是一个比他们准备采取的更大的飞跃。林博士在《标准》中写道，肥胖是一种复杂的代谢状况，而不是意志力的失败。
对于那些寻求安全替代方案的人来说，内窥镜袖状胃成形术 (ESG) 提供了宝贵的非手术中间立场。与传统手术不同，ESG 是在全身麻醉下完全通过口腔进行，无需任何腹部切口。医生使用配备专门缝合装置的柔性内窥镜，放置全层连续缝线，将胃壁向内折叠和收紧，将胃壁的容量减少大约 70%，形成一根窄管。

由于没有切除或永久切除胃组织，患者可以从最小的术后疼痛和顺利恢复中受益，通常需要住院几天进行密切监测和初步饮食适应。

除了显着减轻体重之外，ESG 还可作为对抗代谢综合征的有力干预措施，代谢综合征是包括高血压、高血糖、内脏脂肪和异常胆固醇水平在内的一系列疾病。通过物理限制胃容量并减慢胃排空，该手术可以帮助患者实现早期饱腹感，同时有利地重置关键的胃肠激素信号。
临床研究表明，患者在 12 至 24 个月内总体体重平均减轻 15% 至 20%，同时健康状况也得到显着改善。这些包括增强胰岛素敏感性和改善 2 型糖尿病的糖化血红蛋白控制，有利于心血管健康的血压和血脂下降，以及非酒精性脂肪肝参数的降低。

林博士总结说，减肥管理并不是一刀切的。通过将无切口、器官保留技术与经过验证的代谢益处相结合，ESG 扩展了现代医疗护理的范围，使患者能够安全地重新掌控自己的健康。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

Hong Kong
Dr Dennis Lam describes endoscopic sleeve gastroplasty (ESG) as a scarless procedure that reduces stomach capacity by 70 per cent, helping patients with metabolic syndrome achieve 15 to 20 per cent total body weight loss over 12 to 24 months without abdominal incisions.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

21 Oct 2026 at 05:22 HKT · 2 min read

Patients in Hong Kong living with severe obesity often struggle to find the right treatment, according to Dr Dennis Lam Chin-tou, a specialist in general surgery. While laparoscopic bariatric surgery remains a highly effective gold-standard intervention, not every candidate is suited for or comfortable with a major operation, he said.

In clinical practice, patients frequently express feeling stuck in a gap: traditional lifestyle measures may yield limited long-term results, while surgical operations feel like a larger leap than they are ready to take. Obesity is a complex metabolic condition, not a failure of willpower, Dr Lam wrote in The Standard.

For those seeking a safe alternative, endoscopic sleeve gastroplasty (ESG) offers a valuable non-surgical middle ground. Unlike traditional surgery, ESG is performed entirely through the mouth under general anaesthesia without any abdominal cuts. Using a flexible endoscope equipped with a specialised suturing device, the physician places full-thickness running stitches to fold and cinch the stomach walls inward, reducing its capacity by roughly 70 per cent into a narrow tube.

Because no gastric tissue is cut or permanently removed, patients benefit from minimal post-procedure pain and a smooth recovery, typically staying in hospital for a few days for close monitoring and initial dietary adaptation.

Beyond significant weight reduction, ESG serves as a powerful intervention against metabolic syndrome, a cluster of conditions including hypertension, high blood sugar, visceral fat and abnormal cholesterol levels. By physically restricting stomach capacity and slowing gastric emptying, the procedure helps patients achieve early satiety while favourably resetting key gastrointestinal hormone signals.

Clinical studies demonstrate that patients achieve an average total body weight loss of 15 to 20 per cent over 12 to 24 months, alongside meaningful health improvements. These include enhanced insulin sensitivity and improved glycated haemoglobin control in type 2 diabetes, favourable drops in blood pressure and lipid profiles for cardiovascular health, and reductions in non-alcoholic fatty liver parameters.

Bariatric management is not one-size-fits-all, Dr Lam concluded. By pairing an incisionless, organ-sparing technique with proven metabolic benefits, ESG expands the spectrum of modern medical care, empowering patients to safely regain control of their health.

content: （维权网信息中心报道） 2026 年 10 月 20 日，本网获悉：今天，获刑 6 年 6 个月的香港 47 人案之郑达鸿狱中度过其 38 岁生日。郑达鸿因参与 2020 年民主派初选，于 2021 年被捕， 2024 年 11 月被以 “ 串谋颠覆国家政权罪 ” 判刑 6 年 6 个月。他是申请终极上诉许可的 11 名被告之一。香港终审法院已排期 2026 年 12 月 10 日举行许可聆讯。 郑达鸿 ： 1988 年 10 月 20 日出生，英文名 Tat Cheng Tat-hung ，原英属香港籍、现中华人民共和国（香港）籍人，香港岛炮台山居住公民，前北炮同盟（已解散）成员，公民党青年公民前主席、公民党副秘书长及执行委员会成员，原香港东区丹拿选区议员，中共眼里的「反中乱港分子」，泛民主派人士，中国在押政治犯。 自 12 岁起在香港岛东区北角长大，曾先后就读于张祝珊英文中学、圣士提反书院及香港理工大学，并取得社会政策及行政（荣誉）学士；大学时期，因其热衷社会事务而于 2011 年成为公民党九龙西支部实习生；来年毕业后，其正式加入公民党，并于北角开拓地区服务； 2013 年初，其到香港北角丹拿地区工作，一直跟进北角海滨规划、抗衡地产霸权、官商勾结，关注棕地发展、倡议丁屋截龙等土地政策、监察皇都戏院保育工程，并曾多次出席城市论坛作公众教育及演说等活动； 2014 年 10 月 31 日— 2016 年 10 月 7 日，曾担任公民党青年公民前主席，并在此期间还曾担任过港岛支部副主席； 2015 年，其在区议会选举中以多数票选为香港东区北角丹拿选区议员，成为首个民主派区议员； 2016 年— 2018 年，曾又获选担任公民党副秘书长，并考获香港城市大学法律博士； 2019 年，其再次参选区议会，联同党友李予信及数名素人（即无从政经验但跻身于政坛的人）组成“北炮同盟”，出选北角炮台山七区； 2020 年立法会换届选举，由于时任议员陈淑庄因占中案被判入狱而无法寻求连任，故其代表公民党接替陈淑庄出战港岛区，同年 7 月 22 日，其以港岛区第四位的得票，最终胜出泛民阵营举办的初选，但仅过 8 天，其又因多项议题的政治立场与态度被询问，包括涉及其曾签署反对港区国安法的声明、争取外国制裁、否决财政预算案等范畴，遂其竟被选举主任裁定为提名无效；同年 12 月 15 日，其在社交网站上宣布退出公民党； 2021 年 1 月 6 日，其在香港民主派初选大搜捕中遭香港警务处国家安全处拘捕，后其虽于同年 3 月 13 日取保获释，但同年 5 月 21 日，其等 12 名各区民主派议员被曝请辞，之后其又被收押候审； 2024 年 5 月 30 日，香港高等法院 3 名国安法指定法官裁定其等 47 案被告「串谋颠覆国家政权」罪成； 2024 年 11 月 19 日，其等「 47 人初选颠覆罪」案被告在西九龙裁判法院统一宣判，其因「反中乱港分子」和「不认罪」而被判囚 6 年 6 个月（ 78 个月），刑期预至 2030 年； 2024 年 12 月 13 日获悉，其因不服判决，已提起上诉。
